title: 3D Computer Vision Research Engineer, Geospatial Visual Localization
descriptionHtml:
About Niantic Spatial

AI has learned from almost everything online, but it still struggles with the physical world, where 99.5% of economic activity happens. It doesn’t know where things are, how spaces fit together, or what changes over time.

That’s one of the biggest unsolved problems in AI, and it’s the one we’re solving at Niantic Spatial. We build spatial AI models and services so people and machines can reason, learn and act safely in the physical world. We turn camera imagery, video, sensor data and archives into accurate, AI-readable representations of real places that robots can train in and machines can use to know exactly where they are.

In physical AI, mistakes have real consequences. That’s why we build AI grounded in measured reality, not guesswork, so the people and machines relying on it can trust it to get things right.

Our team built some of the world’s most widely used maps. Now we’re building something bigger: a living, measured record of the real world that machines can query, learn from and use to understand how places change over time. If you want to help AI understand the world we actually live in, come build with us.

About the Role

We are looking for a Research Engineer to help develop our Geospatial Visual Localization technologies, which allows people and robots to accurately localize themselves anywhere on the planet.

This is an end-to-end applied research role. You will develop new approaches to open problems alongside our researchers in 3D vision and machine learning, and publish your work at leading conferences. You will help build and train large models on large-scale multi-modal datasets, including our proprietary collection of 30 billion posed images and ship them into production, to be used by people and robots from all over the world.

Our team works with heterogeneous captures from phones and other handheld devices, 360 cameras, vehicles, and drones, as well as aerial and satellite imagery, LiDAR, and external geographic data. Your focus will be to improve accuracy and robustness across urban and rural locations, cameras, seasons, weather, and capture quality. The system must remain reliable with noisy GPS, in GPS-denied environments, and with outdated reference maps. Each pose estimate comes with an uncertainty that our customers rely on, and keeping it well calibrated across these conditions is part of the work.

What You'll Do

  • Design, implement, and evaluate novel visual localization algorithms, combining 3D vision and deep learning.

  • Train large models on multi-modal data at scale, and build the benchmarks that measure their accuracy and robustness.

  • Develop robust solutions for difficult real-world conditions: noisy or denied GPS, changing appearance, varying capture quality, large geographic extents, and imperfect reference maps.

  • Work side-by-side with leading researchers in visual localization, 3D computer vision, and mapping, as well as engineering and product teams, to identify the highest-impact problems and turn research into end-to-end solutions that operate at production scale.

  • Communicate results clearly through technical writing, design reviews, internal presentations, and publications.

What You'll Bring

  • Strong grounding in 3D computer vision, deep learning, robotics, photogrammetry, or a closely related field.

  • Demonstrated experience with multi-view geometry and related problems, such as camera pose estimation, monocular depth estimation, SfM, SLAM, georeferencing, point-cloud registration, or sensor fusion.

  • Knowledge of transformer models for 3D vision, such as vision foundation models, feed-forward 3D reconstruction, or multi-view and multi-modal attention.

  • Knowledge of geospatial data and coordinate reference systems.

  • Ability to formulate ambiguous real-world problems, choose appropriate mathematical or learning-based tools, and evaluate solutions rigorously.

  • Strong Python skills and experience training deep learning models at scale, with libraries such as PyTorch, NumPy, and SciPy.

  • Strong software engineering skills, with the ability to turn research prototypes into reliable, scalable, and maintainable systems.

  • Experience taking an algorithm from research idea and experimental prototype through evaluation, benchmarking, and deployment on real-world data.

  • Clear written and verbal communication and the ability to collaborate across research and engineering disciplines.

Nice to Have

  • A PhD in computer vision, robotics, machine learning, photogrammetry, geodesy, remote sensing, or a related field, or equivalent research or industry experience. A PhD is not required.

  • A strong publication record or substantial active involvement in the research community, especially at venues such as CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, NeurIPS, ICLR, SIGGRAPH, SIGGRAPH Asia, 3DV, ICRA, RSS, or related conferences and journals.

  • Experience with aerial or satellite imagery, GNSS/GPS, IMUs, LiDAR data, geodesy, mapping systems, or large-scale spatial data.

  • Evidence of technical leadership, mentorship, or successful cross-functional delivery.

Compensation & Benefits

Base salary: Competitive market rate. Compensation also includes an annual bonus, equity, and a comprehensive benefits package.

Location & Work Model

This role is based in our London office, with three days per week in office.

Inclusive Application

We know the strongest candidates don't always tick every box. If you're excited about this role and believe you could do it well, we encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't match every qualification listed - you may be exactly who we're looking for.

Equal Opportunity

Niantic Spatial is an equal opportunity employer. Individuals seeking employment at Niantic Spatial are considered without regard to race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, creed, age, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding or related medical conditions), marital status, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, military or veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, or any other protected category under applicable laws. Niantic Spatial will also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in accordance with applicable laws. Please contact your recruiter if you want to request an accommodation for the job application or interview process.

Candidate Privacy

I understand that by submitting my job application, the information I provide as part of that application will be used in accordance with Niantic Spatial's Privacy Notice for Job Applicants and Candidates https://www.nianticspatial.com/applicant-privacy-notice.

title: 2027 Strategic Finance Analytics Graduate Programme
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

We’reCheckout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

The role

As part of Checkout.com’s #NextGen Strategic Finance Analytics Graduate Program you’ll work alongside experienced professionals, gaining hands-on experience and a comprehensive introduction to digital payments and technology. The program offers an extensive learning experience through technical training, professional development workshops, and direct access to industry experts. You'll be part of a global Early Careers, Graduate community, with regular networking events, mentoring opportunities, and social activities designed to build connections and accelerate your growth and leadership potential. By the end of the scheme, you’ll be equipped with the knowledge, experience, and confidence to make a lasting impact at Checkout.com and beyond.

How you’ll make an impact

During the programme, you may:

  • Analyse commercial and business performance in order to help the business assess where it is creating value.

  • Leverage AI tooling as a force multiplier to build and automate reusable analytical workflows and agents to create insights from financial data.

  • Collaborate directly with Data Engineering and Data Science to support the development and enhancement of our core financial data models, and the context layer that enables AI agents to leverage that data.

  • Craft executive-style deliverables, which may include decks, models, written documents or AI-powered apps.

  • Work with your manager to translate ambiguous requests from leadership, Finance and cross-functional stakeholders into clear, decision-ready insights.

  • Drive continuous reporting improvements, standardisation, and simplification whilst documenting definitions and limitations - leaving no room for approximation.

  • You will work with Finance and Data partners to scope requirements and support the delivery of key initiatives.

What we’re looking for

You’re a curious, analytical and innovative individual, either due to graduate in summer 2027 or having graduated within the last 12 months, who is excited to dive into the world of Finance.

You’ll bring:

  • A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a quantitative or business discipline.

  • Strong analytical mindset - You’re comfortable working with numbers, identifying the underlying patterns and drawing sound conclusions.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills - You have the ability to adjust your style to suit different perspectives and seniority levels.

  • Commercial curiosity - You want to dive into the details to understand how merchant, product, and commercial dynamics affect financial performance.

  • Confidence with data tools - You have a clear aptitude and willingness to learn data tooling. Python and SQL experience is a plus.

  • Exceptional attention to detail - You rigorously validate data, pressure-test assumptions, and transparently communicate analytical limitations.

  • Payments or financial knowledge is a bonus, but not required.

Early Careers experience

You’ll receive:

  • Dedicated onboarding and payments-focused training.

  • Professional skills workshops and leadership sessions.

  • Mentoring from experienced colleagues.

  • Networking and community events.

  • Opportunities to work on meaningful, business-critical projects.

  • Regular feedback and transparent performance conversations.

  • Potential progression into a permanent role, subject to performance, readiness, headcount availability and business requirements.

Eligibility

  • Graduated within the last 12 months or due to graduate by the programme start date, depending on the selected pathway.

  • Available to work full-time for the duration of the programme.

  • Able to work from the stated programme location and meet applicable right-to-work requirements.

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com, follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram

descriptionHtml:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

Dans un souci de clarté et d’accessibilité, nous avons choisi de ne pas utiliser l’écriture inclusive dans nos communications. WPP Media est fermement engagé en faveur de la diversité : nous valorisons l'inclusion et l'égalité, en considérant tous les candidats sans distinction d'identité de genre, d'origine ethnique ou de religion. Tous nos postes sont également ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap. 

A propos de WPP Media: 

WPP is the creative transformation company. Nous utilisons le pouvoir de la créativité pour construire un avenir meilleur pour nos collaborateurs, notre planète, nos clients et nos communautés. Pour plus d'informations, visitez wpp.com. 

WPP Media est le collectif média global de WPP. Dans un monde où les médias sont omniprésents nous regroupons la meilleure plateforme, les meilleurs talents et les meilleurs partenaires pour développer les solutions les plus innovantes, offrant une croissance inégalée à nos clients. Pour plus d'informations, visitez wppmedia.com. 

Chez WPP Media, nous croyons en la puissance de notre culture et de nos collaborateurs. C'est grâce à cette synergie que nous parvenons à créer des expériences véritablement exceptionnelles, tant pour nos clients que pour nos équipes internes. Pour réussir dans ce poste, il est fondamental d'incarner les valeurs essentielles qui unissent WPP et WPP Media : 

  • Être Extraordinaire en favorisant un leadership collectif qui inspire une créativité véritablement transformationnelle. 
  • Créer un environnement Ouvert en trouvant l'équilibre parfait entre l'épanouissement de nos collaborateurs et la satisfaction de nos clients, le tout fondé sur une confiance mutuelle. 
  • Diriger avec Optimisme en stimulant activement la croissance et le développement pour mobiliser l'ensemble de notre organisation. 

A propos d’Openmind : Une marque de WPP Media A Leading WPP Media Brand

Openmind by WPP est un modèle d'agence intégrée puisant dans les talents de l'ensemble de WPP. Il a été créé pour accélérer la transformation européenne de la fonction média de Nestlé. Au cœur de cette solution se trouvent les meilleures capacités avancées de données et de technologie, alimentées par l'investissement de WPP dans l'IA, pour maximiser l'impact de l'investissement média de Nestlé. 

LE RÔLE :
Au sein de l'équipe Above-Market d’OpenMind (WPP), l'International Account Director est un expert média confirmé dédié au compte Nestlé Europe sur la catégorie Café (Nescafé, Dolce Gusto & Starbucks At Home). Véritable consultant média auprès des équipes locales et clients, vous jouez un rôle d'orchestrateur et de facilitateur stratégique sur un périmètre clé allant jusqu'à 26 marchés.

À la croisée des chemins entre la vision stratégique et l'agilité opérationnelle, vous êtes "hands-on", force de proposition, et capable de mener à bien des projets complexes avec une grande autonomie. Ce poste est pensé pour s'intégrer dans une structure d'équipe optimisée pour garantir une réactivité et une excellence de service

RESPONSABILITÉS :

• Pilotage Client & Vision Stratégique : Mener les discussions stratégiques sur les campagnes Coffee, venir en soutien des leads Coffee pour orchestrer les cycles annuels de planification (avec un temps fort d'accélération stratégique d’avril à septembre).
• Coordination Internationale : Assurer la coordination fluide des agences WPP et des équipes locales (jusqu’à 26 marchés), en garantissant la cohérence régionale, la compréhension locale des directives et le succès des lancements multi-marchés.
• Conseil & Stratégie Média : Traduire la vision de marque en stratégies de prioritisation des allocations d'investissements multi channels (« fewer, bigger, better »). Agir en consultant média en produisant des guidelines de comms planning actionnables pour les pays.
• Gestion de la Performance & Reporting : Co-concevoir et animer les QBR, assurer le suivi mensuel des investissements et performances de campagnes (spend reporting, benchmarks) avec les experts digitaux.
• Synergie d'Expertises : Fédérer les équipes spécialistes du réseau (Search, Social, Programmatique/Video & RDM, Data & Tech) pour délivrer une planification média intégrée et innovante.

COMPÉTENCES REQUISES :

• Expérience : Expérience confirmée et solide (4-5 ans minimum) en agence média en conseil & coordination internationale et/ou comms planning est requise. Une expérience préalable avec de grands clients mondiaux de coordination multi-marchés est fortement recommandée.
• Expertise Internationale : Savoir-faire éprouvé en coordination multi-marchés et gestion de parties prenantes dans des organisations matricielles complexes.
• Mindset & Posture : Esprit consultant, pragmatique et autonome. Capacité démontrée à être hands-on pour faire avancer les projets et performer dans une équipe agile.
• Connaissance Sectorielle : Forte maîtrise des enjeux FMCG / PGC et des dynamiques omnicanales (une sensibilité à la catégorie Café / Boissons est un plus).
• Data & Storytelling : Solide culture data pour transformer les métriques de performance en opportunités stratégiques, doublée d'excellentes qualités de présentation et d'organisation.
• Langues : Anglais bilingue / courant impératif (100 % des communications, réunions et livrables au quotidien).

La vie chez WPP Media et ses avantages :

Notre engagement à façonner l'avenir des médias se manifeste par un soutien actif au développement professionnel de nos talents, les aidant à atteindre leur plein potentiel. Cette démarche s'accompagne d'une vision responsable dans nos stratégies d'investissement médiatique, reflétant ainsi notre double priorité : valoriser nos collaborateurs tout en adoptant des pratiques durables dans notre secteur. Les collaborateurs de WPP Media ont un accès privilégié aux réseaux internationaux de WPP Media et WPP, leur permettant de développer leurs passions, d'étendre leur réseau professionnel et de rester à la pointe des innovations en marketing et publicité. 

Nous disposons de ressources vastes et variées au service de nos collaborateurs, notre entreprise cultive activement l'inclusion des talents de tous horizons. Les réussites et expertises des équipes sont régulièrement mises en lumière lors d'événements fédérateurs qui ponctuent également les moments clés de l'année, renforçant ainsi notre culture d'entreprise collaborative et diversifiée. 

Nos avantages comprennent: 

  • Télétravail : jusqu'à 2 jours par semaine et 2 semaines complètes à prendre en deux fois dans l’année 
  • Deux jours de repos supplémentaires offerts, dont le lundi de Pentecôte  
  • Jours de congé additionnels par pallier de 5 ans d’ancienneté  
  • 5 jours de télétravail additionnels par mois pour les collaborateurs souffrant d’endométriose  
  • Politique handicap : 3 jours d'absence autorisés payés par an, accès à des Chèques Emploi Service Universel, et accompagnements spécifiques pour les collaborateurs ayant une RQTH  
  • Missions solidaires possibles via le programme We care and we act  

  • Un Cadre de Travail Inspirant : Chez Openmind, vous aurez l'opportunité de contribuer à des projets passionnants et de collaborer avec des marques renommées. Nous cultivons un environnement de travail inclusif où chaque talent peut s'épanouir et se développer.

Process de recrutement :

Entretien avec l’équipe recrutement : Un premier entretien téléphonique ou par vidéoconférence avec un membre de notre équipe. Cela nous permettra de mieux connaître vos compétences et votre expérience, et vous donnera l'occasion de poser des questions sur le poste et l'entreprise. 

Étude de cas : Une étude de cas vous sera proposée afin d’évaluer vos compétences techniques liées au poste. Une restitution vous sera proposée.

Entretien opérationnel : Vous échangerez ensuite avec la Business Partner et la Lead Openmind France.

Nous nous engageons à rendre ce process aussi rapide et efficace que possible, et à maintenir une communication ouverte et transparente tout au long du process. 

WPP Media garantit l'égalité des chances et considère tous les candidats sans discrimination ni considération de caractéristiques particulières. Nous nous engageons à cultiver un environnement de respect où chacun se sent à sa place et bénéficie des mêmes opportunités d'évolution professionnelle. 

Consultez notre politique de confidentialité pour tout savoir sur la protection de vos données politique de confidentialité. 

Bien que nous étudiions toutes les candidatures reçues, nous ne contactons que les personnes sélectionnées pour un entretien.

title: Account Executive (DACH)
descriptionHtml:
About SINGU

At SINGU, we’re redefining how the world’s most ambitious real estate companies run their operations. Our mission is to become Europe’s leading platform for managing warehouse, logistics, retail, and multi-site commercial real estate portfolios — empowering our Clients to protect revenue, boost efficiency, and unlock new value across every aspect of their business.

 

Our unified CAFM platform already powers the daily operations of over 250 million m² of real estate worldwide, supporting more than 500,000 professionals. Following our union with the UK’s Micad and Germany’s net-haus, we now help manage 100,000+ buildings across 35+ countries — and we’re just getting started.

 

Backed by a leading growth equity investor, we’re scaling rapidly and partnering with global leaders such as Prologis, ECE, CTP, Hillwood, Logicor, GLP, and Unibail-Rodamco-Westfield. As we continue to grow through strategic acquisitions and bold innovation, we stay true to our core values: adaptability, collaboration, and client focus.

 

If you’re ready to help build Europe’s leading platform for property operations — and make a tangible impact on how the real estate industry works — join SINGU and be part of this transformation.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a high-energy, relentlessly optimistic Account Executive with proven experience in SaaS and the real estate/proptech sector. You are a confident “hustler” who sees the glass as half full and thrives in a high-activity sales environment.

This is a pure new business role where you will own a defined territory and named-account set in the DACH region. You will control the pipeline you create and oversee the commercial outcome of every deal from the first conversation to the final signature. Singu supports complex property and facilities operations across more than 250 million square metres, with established customers spanning commercial real estate, logistics, retail, facility management, and the public sector. You will enter deals with credible enterprise references, a proven product, and senior executive support.

The deals are consequential rather than transactional: multi-stakeholder, multi-site, and typically take six to nine months to close. Initial deal values range from £25k to £100k and have clear multi-country expansion potential. Winning requires a strong business case, quantified value discovery, and the ability to align stakeholders across operations, real estate, procurement, IT, and finance.

Core Capabilities & What You Will Own

Strategic Navigator & Deal Execution

  • Deeply understand account politics and decision-making structures to “connect the dots” within complex opportunities.

  • Ensure opportunities are qualified to a MEDDICC standard, featuring a quantified business case and direct access to the economic buyer.

  • Ensure every material deal is multi-threaded so that it survives any change of internal sponsor.

  • Lead commercial negotiations that build value and protect price, rather than defaulting to discounts.

  • Apply rigorous qualification to make early decisions on opportunities that lack a credible business case, buying process, or route to decision.

Relationship Builder & “Land and Expand”

  • Cultivate strong connections and effectively influence key stakeholders across your target audience.

  • Scope first wins so they can grow, ensuring sites, countries, and use cases are sequenced from the start.

  • Execute a clean handover to Customer Success with a fully documented expansion path.

Market Educator & Alliance Builder

  • Proactively educate market participants and win strategic partners to build valuable alliances.

Driven Execution, Pipeline & Coverage

  • Maintain a high volume of sales activity with resilience, confidence, and a proactive mindset.

  • Take personal responsibility for territory coverage, hitting a new business quota mapped out by a strategic territory plan.

  • Build pipeline through business development, marketing, partner channels, and self-generated activity.

  • Lead diagnostic conversations grounded in operating cost, compliance, and risk.

Forecasting and Governance

  • Maintain a robust forecast with stage integrity, next steps, and close dates you confidently stand behind.

  • Surface risks early with an honest view of what has changed and what is needed.

  • Contribute to the sales playbook with competitive intelligence, repeatable use cases, and objection handling.

What Excellent Performance Looks Like

  • Commercial Outcomes: Hitting new-logo ARR against quota, robust pipeline creation, territory coverage, and securing strategic logos. Strong win rates against incumbents or “no decision” outcomes, driving high average deal values and total multi-year value.

  • Operating Standards: High forecast accuracy, multi-threading, MEDDICC quality, price protection, discount discipline, CRM quality, and process discipline.

Your First 12 Months

  • First 90 days: Complete onboarding, build the territory and account plan, establish pipeline coverage, and create the first qualified opportunities.

  • By six months: Achieve credible coverage against a ramped quota, progress multi-threaded opportunities through evaluation, and close (or materially advance) a first customer win.

  • By 12 months: Deliver against a ramped quota, establish a repeatable pipeline-creation motion in your territory, and land accounts with clear expansion potential.

What We’re Looking For

  • Typically five or more years in B2B software or complex technology sales, including a sustained period carrying a new business quota (quality of results matters more than years).

  • Evidence of sustained over-performance in new business sales: quota attainment, team ranking, pipeline personally created, and representative deals won (we will ask for specifics).

  • The ability to walk us through significant deals end-to-end: how the opportunity was created, how the buying group developed, what changed, and why it was won or lost.

  • A structured seller who uses MEDDICC (or a comparable methodology) in practice.

  • Strong results combined with the forecast and CRM discipline required to run a predictable business.

  • English and German at a business level is a hard requirement.

  • Experience in CAFM, IWMS, FM, PropTech, or multi-site operations is a strong advantage.


Package, Support, and Progression

  • Competitive base salary with uncapped commission and meaningful accelerators for over-performance.

  • Comprehensive support including business development coverage, Pre-Sales, marketing, and enablement to support your success.

  • Direct access to the CRO for deal strategy, coaching, and fast commercial decisions without a committee.

  • Structured onboarding, methodology training, and deal coaching, starting with a fairly ramped quota.

  • Clear progression into global accounts or sales leadership, as we back elite individual contributors as readily as future managers.

This role is for an accomplished new business seller who wants the autonomy to build a territory, the support to win complex enterprise deals, and real reward for over-performance. If you have created pipeline, won meaningful customers, and run a disciplined process, we would like to hear from you.

If this role sounds like a good fit, we’d love to hear from you. Apply and help us build technology that supports critical operations every day.

title: Account Executive, Influencer Marketing
descriptionHtml:
Position: Account Specialist
The Account Specialist position is a remote, work-from-home role, as are all positions at Acceleration Partners (a structure central to our culture and vision to change the work/life paradigm). Some travel may be required for client meetings, internal meetings, conferences, and other events. Please note: This position requires verbal and written fluency in German.
The Role:
As an Account Specialist, you will provide white glove service to diverse brands investing in influencer marketing campaigns. This role is particularly focused on campaign execution, including but not limited to driving influencer recruitment, managing influencer partnerships, and owning campaign deliverables, tracking, and reporting. The Account Specialist will also drive strategy by analyzing campaign performance, identifying success areas and/or challenge areas, and proactively implementing strategic measures to continuously optimize programs towards goals and objectives.
The successful candidate will have strong experience in developing and managing successful, KPI-driven influencer marketing campaigns for consumer products and/or services companies. They will have working knowledge of the overall partner marketing landscape, including affiliate, and the ability to both develop comprehensive strategy as well as capably execute. The successful candidate will be a self-starter that can confidently plug in to any challenging situation with ease and can balance competing priorities well. The Account Specialist must be flexible, willing and able to pivot quickly, and excited to operate successfully in an “intrapreneurial” situation. This person will also have a history of working well with their peers, quickly establishing relationships easily and leading through influence.
You’ll work closely with your manager and peers to maximize program effectiveness and create opportunities for growth.
Top 5 Responsibilities:
  • INFLUENCER RECRUITMENT, NEGOTIATING & ONBOARDING –Sources new partnership opportunities and creates influencer casting lists. Diligently vets opportunities to ensure brand alignment, authenticity and relevancy prior to presenting to client for approval. Conducts outreach to approved partners and skillfully garners their engagement and participation in the campaign, negotiating when necessary. Supports influencers through campaign onboarding by developing and providing resources to streamline processes.
  • INFLUENCER PARTNERSHIPS MANAGEMENT – Crafts program-wide influencer communications and vital creator resources. Guides influencers on content strategy and creation. Works with influencers to develop content timelines and ensures influencers stay on track with the schedules discussed. Collects content drafts and leads the content review process, including screening to ensure FTC guidelines are met. Closely works with influencers to adjust content strategy as needed, troubleshooting any signs of poor performance to optimize campaign towards goals and objectives.
  • AUDITING, REPORTING & ANALYSIS – Accountable for auditing program content to ensure compliance with FTC regulations and brand guidelines. Ensures content is tracked accurately and regularly shared with client, along with placement insights, partner insights, and campaign pace towards KPI goals. Performs robust analysis of influencer campaigns using both social analytics and conversion metrics to identify performance trends and areas of opportunity. Proactively provides actionable recommendations to client backed by data and continuously refines strategy to drive growth at scale. Supports team in creation of customized strategy plans, detailed campaign performance summaries and comprehensive hindsight presentations that are delivered to clients.
  • CLIENT SERVICE & COMMUNICATION- Consistently provides superior client service and escalates issues or key risks as appropriate. Works to ensure client develops trust in our team by delivering client outputs and communications in the AP way, consistently maintaining quality, accuracy, and precision. Develops and nurtures excellent relationships, supports team in promoting very high client satisfaction and retention rates, and an average 8.5 client rating.
  • PORTFOLIO MANAGEMENT- Own and manage client tasks with minimal supervision, ensuring deadlines are met and tasks are completed accurately. Manages multiple campaigns with solid organizational skills and the ability to focus on and prioritize tasks based on client objectives, flagging any potential delays and keeping the team informed. Has full grasp of each client’s scope of work, delivering what is due under terms; maintains ability to identify new opportunities to drive client success while conjunctively identifying possible goal misalignments, getting to the root of an issue, and working with their team to bring solutions to resolve.

What Success Looks Like:
BY 3 MONTHS:
  • The Account Specialist is contributing across a portfolio of influencer programs, collaborating with their team closely to ensure strong alignment with the campaign strategy in place.
  • You are working with key client contacts to ensure brand alignment with recruitment efforts and content creation.
  • You have become familiar with AP’s tools and solutions and are equipped to conduct casting for prospective influencers, execute content timelines with influencers, audit content, and ensure performance is tracked and measured.
By 6 MONTHS:
  • You are owning execution of the day-to-day operations of multiple influencer programs with little guidance from your team, including reporting, processing applications, recruiting and casting creators, and crafting partner communications.
  • Challenging client or team situations are being managed with guidance from managers and directors collaborating closely to bring a solutions-oriented approach to these situations proactively.
  • You are regularly analyzing client data and strategically leveraging insights to optimize campaigns.
  • Client accounts are being handled effectively and strategically, without dropping any balls, and clients are aware of and pleased with this outcome. Clients are being serviced profitably with AP targets, client KPI’s being met, and an average 8.5 client rating is being upheld across campaigns.
  • You will regularly present new campaign ideas to managers and demonstrate a clear understanding of program performance
By 1 YEAR:
  • You will troubleshoot and resolve account and creator issues independently, providing valuable insights and actionable recommendations to clients and internal teams.
  • You will be an integral part of each program, developing new ideas and improving processes to create efficiencies.
  • You will take on new account responsibilities with support from your manager and serve as a thought leader within the team, contributing to relationship-building and firm development.
Qualities of the Ideal Candidate
  • Has a strong internal motivation to get the job done and done well
  • Only provides superior results and unsurpassed customer service
  • Exhilarated by managing change and comfortable with ambiguity and moving targets
  • Passionate about the digital marketing industry and how influencer relates to the greater digital landscape
  • Ensures that influencer strategies and tactics have measurable results
  • Has incredible attention to detail and is capable of multi-tasking and coordinating several projects at once
  • Translates data and insights into actionable next steps for clients
  • Strong with data analysis, is easily able to pinpoint issues and opportunities within a data set
  • Prioritizes competing objectives and manages time with skill
  • Displays accountability, always meeting deadlines and keeping commitments
  • Thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys bringing order to chaos
  • Likes to share and collaborate with peers in a remote environment
  • Possesses superior written and verbal communication skills
  • Possesses mature and measured judgment, and the ability to solve problems on their own
  • Works independently with minimal supervision
  • Has confidence, poise, and eloquence in client meetings and difficult situations
  • Hears and incorporates feedback from other team members, clients and partners
Qualifications & Skills:
  • Fluency in German
  • 2+ years working for an influencer marketing agency and experience executing influencer campaigns and managing both client and influencer relationships
  • Solid understanding of omni-channel and digital marketing, with a track record of successfully running influencer campaigns for consumer products and/or services companies
  • Excellent at communicating, presenting and approval from clients on new campaign strategies and initiatives
  • Working knowledge of attribution in digital marketing
  • Strong understanding of how influencer and affiliate marketing can work together
  • Tools (CreatorIQ, Grin, Izea, etc.) experience preferred, not required
  • Knowledge of Affiliate Networks or SaaS platforms (Impact, ShareASale, Commission Junction, etc.) experience preferred, not required
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience
  • Ability to travel up to 15%
  • Advanced Excel capabilities and comfortable with formatting, formulas, customizing reports, etc.
WHY ACCELERATION PARTNERS?
Acceleration Partners is the world’s largest and first-to-market Partnership Marketing Agency creating and nurturing partnerships that drive exceptional measurable outcomes for their clients. Managing clients in 40+ countries, their global team of 300+ focuses on data-driven strategies that help connect brands to the right consumers through performance partnerships, traditional affiliate, influencer, performance PR, content, and B2B partnership marketing.

title: Account Manager / Key Account Manager (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Die Baubranche ist eine 14-Billionen-Euro-Industrie, die noch immer auf E-Mails, Excel-Tabellen und eingescannten PDFs läuft. Cosuno ersetzt das durch KI. Generalunternehmer schreiben ihre Projekte auf unserer Plattform an mehr als 250.000 Nachunternehmer aus, und unsere agentische KI findet die passenden Firmen, erkennt Auffälligkeiten in Angeboten und vergleicht jeden Preis mit 6,5 Millionen Datenpunkten aus über 136 Milliarden Euro verarbeitetem Angebotsvolumen. Jede Ausschreibung macht die KI klüger. Die Ergebnisse sind messbar: Generalunternehmer senken ihre Kosten um rund 6 %, Nachunternehmer gewinnen 22 % mehr Aufträge, und jeder neue Generalunternehmer-Kunde hat sich in diesem Jahr für unser KI-Produkt entschieden. 2019 in Berlin gegründet und von Cherry Ventures und Spark Capital mit über 40 Millionen Euro finanziert, skalieren wir mit diesem Kapital jetzt Sales, Customer Success und Marketing. Und genau hier kommst du ins Spiel.

Die Rolle

Du übernimmst ein eigenes Book von rund 70 bis 90 Generalunternehmern, Bauträgern und Planern und stellst gemeinsam mit unserem Consulting-Team eine erfolgreiche Aktivierung sicher. Du sicherst die Verlängerung, baust Nutzung und Vertrag aus und merkst früh, wenn ein Kunde abrutscht. Wo ein Kunde noch nicht richtig angekommen ist, holst du ihn gemeinsam mit dem Consulting-Team in die Nutzung.

Verlängerungen, Upgrades und Cross-Sell verhandelst du selbst, mit Geschäftsführung, Einkauf und Kalkulation. Jede Vertragsfrist der nächsten zwölf Monate hast du im Blick, ab 120 Tagen davor läuft dein Renewal-Ablauf, und deinen Forecast pflegst du jede Woche.

Als Key Account Manager machst du das für unsere größten Kunden: Unternehmensgruppen mit mehreren Gesellschaften und Standorten, vielen Entscheidern und längeren Deal Cycles.

Woran wir dich nach 12 Monaten messen

  • Dein Book trägt mehr ARR als zu Beginn: Verlängerungen, Upsell und Cross-Sell sind größer als Kündigungen und Downgrades.

  • Die Kündigungen in deinem Book liegen unter deinem Ziel, und jede Frist der nächsten zwölf Monate hat eine Renewal-Opportunity mit Forecast-Kategorie.

  • Dein Forecast steht jede Woche, ohne dass jemand nachfragen muss.

  • Warnsignale in deinem Book, etwa sinkende Nutzung oder ein weggefallener Key User, haben schnell einen Plan.

  • Als Key Account Manager: Mehr Gesellschaften und Standorte deiner Kunden arbeiten mit Cosuno, und deine großen Renewals landen dort, wo du sie vorhergesagt hast.

Wer bei Cosuno erfolgreich ist

  • Ownership. Du sprichst über eigene Fehler, bevor jemand fragt, und darüber, was du daraus geändert hast.

  • Speed. Du löst Probleme pragmatisch und heute, nicht perfekt und nächstes Quartal.

  • Drive. Wenn du zur Monatsmitte unter Ziel liegst, rufst du mehr Kunden an, nicht weniger.

  • Low Ego. Du teilst, was bei dir funktioniert hat, damit das Team besser wird.

Diese Rolle ist für dich, wenn

  • du ein Book mit vielen Kunden lieber selbst steuerst, als fünf Großkunden zu betreuen.

  • du Verlängerungen verhandelst und dabei den Preis hältst, statt Rabatt zu geben.

  • du schon einmal den echten Kündigungsgrund hinter dem genannten gefunden hast.

  • du deine Zahlen kennst und sie dich motivieren.

  • du mit Geschäftsführern im Mittelstand auf Augenhöhe sprichst und verstehen willst, wie am Bau eingekauft wird.

Diese Rolle ist nichts für dich, wenn

  • du Customer Success als Beziehungspflege verstehst und Verkaufen vermeidest.

  • du aus Support, Service oder reinem Onboarding kommst und noch nie eine eigene Zielzahl hattest.

  • du zehn Enterprise-Accounts gewohnt bist und 70 Kunden als zu viel empfindest.

  • du lieber über Transformation präsentierst, als einen Vertrag zu verlängern.

Harte Anforderungen

  • Rund 2 bis 3 Jahre im Account Management, Customer Success oder Sales im B2B-Umfeld, idealerweise SaaS, davon mindestens ein Jahr mit eigener Verantwortung für Bestandskunden und Umsatz.

  • Belegbare Ergebnisse bei Verlängerungen, Upsell oder Kündigungen in den letzten Perioden.

  • Deutsch auf Muttersprachniveau. Gutes Englisch und Erfahrung mit Bau, Immobilien oder Vertical SaaS sind ein Plus.

  • Für Key Account Manager zusätzlich: 3-5 Jahre Erfahrung mit Unternehmensgruppen oder Konzernkunden, mehreren Entscheidern und längeren Deal Cycles.

Vergütung

70-110k OTE - inkl. Ungedeckeltem Bonus mit transparenter Provisionsregelung; die Höhe richtet sich nach dem Level.

Was wir bieten

  • Klarheit: Ein eigenes Book, klare Ziele, direkter Einfluss auf dein Ergebnis.

  • Rückhalt: Ein eigenes Consulting-Team übernimmt das Onboarding, du konzentrierst dich aufs Halten und Ausbauen.

  • Entwicklung: Vom Account Manager zum Key Account Manager oder Team Lead, mit regelmäßigen 1:1s, Entwicklungsgesprächen und offener Feedbackkultur.

  • Vertrag: Unbefristet, moderne Ausstattung.

  • Arbeitsort: Remote innerhalb der EU möglich, Berlin-Kreuzberg bevorzugt.

  • Team: Firmen- und Teamevents, online und offline.

So läuft dein Bewerbungsprozess

  1. Kennenlernen mit unserem Head of Customer Success (45 Minuten)

  2. Gespräch mit unserer Geschäftsführung / CRO (30 Minuten)

  3. Case Study an einem realistischen Kundenfall, dazu ein Gespräch mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen aus dem Team

  4. Referenzgespräch, danach unser Angebot

Compensation: €70K – €110K

descriptionHtml:
Ben jij die Active Directory engineer die een bijdrage wilt leveren aan de toekomst van onze Active Directory en geïnteresseerd en bedreven is in PKI/Encryptie toepassing? Voel jij je thuis in een organisatie waar informatie beveiliging hoog op de agenda staat?

Waar jij het verschil maakt

Jij bent verantwoordelijk voor het operationeel en veilig houden van onze Active Directory omgeving, onder andere door middel van dagelijkse controletaken en onderzoeken van verstoringen. Je vervult een prominente rol in het voorkomen en opheffen van digitale dreigingen en security incidenten.

  • Je beheert & configureert Active Directory group policies conform de beleidslijnen op het gebied van informatiebeveiliging

  • Je beheert en optimaliseert de Active Directory omgeving (accounts, OU’s, groups en policies)

  • Je automatiseert zoveel mogelijk beheerwerkzaamheden met o.a. Powershell, Ansible en Terraform

  • Je werkt gevraagd en ongevraagd aan toekomst-vaste verbeteringen van onze Active Directory omgeving, waaronder forest upgrades en Active Directory redesign

  • Je werkt doorlopend aan remediation activiteiten die kunnen voortvloeien uit baseline scans, risico-analyses en security assessments.

Je toekomstige collega's

Je werkt in het Team Data&Webdiensten van de afdeling Generieke Infrastructuur (IGI). We opereren middels een Agile methodiek, in combinatie met ITIL. Een actieve bijdrage wordt verwacht in het succes van deze werkmethode, dit uit zich oa in het opstellen van kwalitatief goede story’s en Epics, het actueel houden van jouw story’s op het Azure DevOps bord, actieve en constructieve deelname aan events als dag-starts, planning, review en retrospectives. De totale omvang van de afdeling Generieke Infrastructuur is ongeveer 30 experts die werkzaam zijn in Heerlen en Den Haag. Het Data&Webdiensten Team bestaat uit ca 15 collega’s die in Heerlen en Den Haag werkzaam zijn. Plezier in het werk vinden we belangrijk en dat is dan ook verankerd in onze kernwaarden.

Dit ben jij

Je bent gericht op het continu verbeteren: je signaleert, adviseert, voert uit, reflecteert en pakt de regie en verantwoordelijkheid, zowel in samenwerking als op inhoud.

Daarnaast verwachten wij:

  • Hbo werk- en denkniveau.

  • Kennis van kaders zoals ISO27001, BIO, NIS2 en het toepassen van security baselines, zoals CIS.

title: Afstuderen: Integratie van machine data voor resourceplanning
descriptionHtml:
WAT GA JE DOEN?

Bij onze internationale klanten wordt voor de dagelijkse productie gebruikgemaakt van verschillende LogicSteel software applicaties. LogicSteel MRP ondersteunt hierbij operationele processen, zoals het plannen van productie, het beheren van projecten, inkooporders en het aansturen van medewerkers. Daarnaast zijn er systemen zoals Insights die machine- en prestatiegegevens inzichtelijk maken. Doordat informatie verdeeld is over meerdere applicaties, ontbreekt vaak één centraal overzicht voor resourceplanning en capaciteitsbeslissingen.

Tijdens deze afstudeeropdracht onderzoek je hoe relevante gegevens uit deze systemen beter gecombineerd en gepresenteerd kunnen worden, zodat gebruikers sneller de juiste inzichten hebben voor het plannen van mensen, machines en productiecapaciteit.

Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:

  • Het analyseren van het huidige resourceallocatieproces en de rol van machine- en productiegegevens hierin;

  • Het voeren van interviews met gebruikers om hun doelen, behoeften en knelpunten in kaart te brengen;

  • Het onderzoeken welke data uit Insights en MRP relevant is voor besluitvorming;

  • Het analyseren van gebruikersstromen, beschikbare data en bestaande schermen;

  • Het ontwikkelen van wireframes, gebruikersflows en ontwerpconcepten;

  • Het valideren en verbeteren van ontwerpen door middel van feedbacksessies met gebruikers en stakeholders;

title: AI Automation Intern (Sustainability)
descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

You've ordered dinner through Just Eat Takeaway. You've bought and sold on OLX. You've paid with PayU. Chances are, you've already used a Prosus company today.

We are Prosus, a global technology company powering some of the world's leading lifestyle ecommerce businesses. Every day, billions of people across India, Latin America, Europe and beyond use our products and services to buy, sell, pay, connect and discover.

Our AI-driven ecosystem spans 100+ companies across ecommerce, food delivery, fintech and experiences, serving billions of consumers worldwide. AI powers how we operate and innovate, with more than 60,000 active AI agents helping our teams build, scale and move faster. Through our investment team, we also back the founders and technologies shaping the future: From robotics and autonomous systems to synthetic biology and frontier AI.

Guided by our five values Innovation, Results, People, Impact, and Entrepreneurship, culture is our competitive advantage. We thrive with experimentation; we build, we test, we learn, we iterate.

Join us in shaping the future of technology at global scale.

The Opportunity

Join our global sustainability reporting team and help reinvent how we use technology and AI to bring greater transparency, efficiency, and accountability to ESG reporting. As stakeholder expectations and regulations evolve, we’re building the future of sustainability intelligence.

We’re looking for someone passionate about the intersection of tech and sustainability, who’s eager to simplify systems and data by developing digital-first tools. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in fast-paced, global teams and wants to shape the next generation of ESG reporting.


Who You Are

You’re passionate about sustainability and innovation, always exploring how emerging tech—like AI—can drive real-world ESG impact. You enjoy coding, structuring data, and building automated solutions that solve complex problems.

You thrive in global, cross-functional teams, communicate inclusively, and navigate diverse work cultures with ease. Analytical and solution-oriented, you turn regulatory complexity into clear, tech-driven actions.

An entrepreneurial self-starter, you’re adaptable, results-focused, and eager to work on cutting-edge sustainability projects.

You’re a recent graduate with a background in tech, strategy, data, economics or sustainability, based in the Netherlands (with the right to work here), passionate about using technology to solve sustainability challenges—and ready to grow in an international, dynamic setting.

What you bring

  • Strong interest in sustainability, ESG reporting, and emerging regulations (e.g., CSRD, ESRS, ISSB). Experience in application or through studies is a plus.

  • Passion for technology and AI, with experience or interest in process automation, data integration, or reporting systems.

  • Experience with data analysis, coding, building AI bots, or automating systems is a plus.

  • Comfortable with systems such as G-suite, Microsoft Office, etc.

  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to distill complexity into clarity.

  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across teams and present ideas to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • A self-starter mindset: proactive, adaptable, and comfortable navigating ambiguity.

  • Fluent in English; additional languages are a bonus.

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher.

Why Prosus?

At Prosus, your colleagues include 60,000 AI agents… and your job is to figure out what that actually means. We're one of the largest operators of agentic AI on the planet, inside a $100B+ portfolio across 100+ companies and two billion people. The humans here own what AI can't do alone: judgment, creativity, and the call on what gets built next.

Own the impact. Work the ecosystem. Earn your growth. Build with backing.

Curious about our perks and benefits? Take a look at this page.

Our Diversity & Inclusion Commitment

We respect the dignity and human rights of individuals and communities wherever we operate in the world. title: AI Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About us

People assume the supply chain is an automated, algorithmic system. It is not. It is a large number of people acting as the glue between organisations and systems, doing work the world depends on with tools that have barely changed in decades. Nexcade builds AI agents for those people, starting in freight forwarding, a $210BN industry.

Our agents are live in production with some of the leading global forwarders, pricing millions in freight every week, and we are expanding the platform deeper into the shipment lifecycle. We have raised $8.5M to make this a reality.

Our founders, Dan and Tasho, spent years at Sedna and Palantir working with supply chain companies on problems like this one. We are backed by top VCs and angels who backed or founded Synthesia, n8n and other world-class companies.

 

How we work

  • Everybody codes, founders included. The whole company is technical, commercial team included, and runs on coding agents.

  • Closely with customers and design partners, so what we ship changes how they operate.

  • At pace. Fast cycles and quick iterations, on the product and on how we work.

  • End to end. If you see something broken or missing, you have the freedom (and the responsibility) to fix it.

  • In person, 4+ days a week in London. We value synchronous communication.

  • Debate rigorously, decide quickly, execute relentlessly.

  • Enjoy the journey. Hard problems, good colleagues.

     

The role

We are building the AI platform for freight forwarding and expanding our product surface, and we are hiring software engineers across product, AI and platform to do it.

You will build products that do freight forwarding work alongside our customers' teams, operating across the entire shipment lifecycle. You will work across the stack in Python, TypeScript and React, and directly with customers and founders on what gets built.

Everyone here works across the stack, but each engineer has a spike: the area where they set the bar for the team. You spend most of your time where yours is, and lean on your colleagues where theirs are.

  • Product: You build best in class products for the core jobs in freight forwarding, one job at a time. You work as a design partner with our customers to understand the work deeply, turn that understanding into a product they would choose over anything else, and feed what you learn back into the platform everyone builds on.

  • AI: You raise the ceiling on what our AI can do and the floor on how reliably it does it. That spans high volume tasks like classification and extraction and deep workflow tasks that run for hours. You design for performance, reliability, explainability and control, set up the gyms and evals to measure them, and build the harness that runs our agents in all of our products.

  • Platform: You own the foundation every product stands on: the runtime for thousands of concurrent agents and workflows, the way they communicate and scale, the controls for how they access data with permissions that hold, and the observability to see and measure all of it. You ensure the rest of the team can move fast without fear.

     

What we look for

  • A spike, with evidence. Something you have been exceptional at and proof of it. We hire on slope rather than years, so there is no experience threshold in either direction.

  • Strong fundamentals. In the AI-assisted era, having good technical judgement is key. You have shipped production systems people depend on, seen them fail and learned from it.

  • High agency and ownership. You take an ambiguous problem, make a call, and see it through.

  • Humility and learning velocity. You want to get better and you change your mind when the evidence says so.

  • Interest in the problem. You do not need a freight background, but you need to find messy real-world operations interesting rather than a chore.

     

Why join

You will shape the product, the architecture and the company, working alongside an engineering team from Palantir, Raft, Faculty, UnlikelyAI and Oxford. You will work directly with the businesses using what you build, on AI applied to an industry that has resisted software for decades. You will get meaningful equity, so when this works you share in it.

title: AI-for-Hardware Engineer, Frontier Tech
descriptionHtml:
About Hexa

Hexa (formerly eFounders) gives entrepreneurs the best chances to build outstanding companies.

We are a pioneering, world-leading startup studio born in Europe that designs, builds and launches category-defining startups. We are today recognized as one of the best venture studios in the world, with a track record comparable to tier-1 VC funds.

We have created 60+ companies (including 3 unicorns) with a combined valuation of over $5 billion, among them Aircall, Spendesk, Front, Swan and Yousign.

Hexa is in full growth mode, with three early-stage activities: our Ventures programs Hexa Start and Hexa Sprint which help entrepreneurs go from zero to one, and a PE program, Hexa Scale, which takes majority stakes in existing startups and pushes them to new thresholds.

The hardware vertical at Hexa: Frontier Tech

Frontier Tech is Hexa’s studio focused on physical tech, led by Guerric de Crombrugghe.

We build companies that move atoms: real machines, deployed in the field, often for defense, energy, space and critical infrastructure. A few examples of what is on the bench today include containerized atmospheric water generators, expendable turbojets, and ship-borne satellite ground stations.

Our edge is velocity. We go from idea to working hardware with small teams and lean budgets, against legacy players with hundreds of engineers and decade-long programs. AI is now the biggest lever we have to widen that gap, today by speeding up how we build, and tomorrow by shaping what kind of companies we build.

Why this role, why now

AI for hardware is moving faster than any team can track. Our internal map now tracks close to 200 tools, from text-to-CAD, AI-native electronics and physics surrogates to manufacturing, test data, procurement and the MCP connectors that let agents drive CAD and EDA tools directly.

Most of these tools will not matter. A handful will cut weeks off our programs. We need someone whose job is to find those, prove them on our real parts, and put them in the hands of our founders before our competitors do.

The mission

We’re looking for an industrial hardware engineer who is 100% AI-pilled, with a dual objective:

  • Adopt AI inside our startups. Make every Frontier Tech venture the fastest-moving hardware team in its category, using the best AI tools available today.

  • Build companies that grow with AI. Design products and business models that are both AI-enabled (they get better with every new generation of models) and AI-enablers (they feed AI with the data, compute, energy or infrastructure it needs), and run the companies themselves on AI from day one. The goal is a positive feedback loop: the more AI grows, the more our companies grow.

Adoption is the immediate focus. The role splits into two:

80%: deploy AI inside our ventures

Hands-on, embedded in the teams, measured by weeks saved.

  • Map the bottlenecks. Sit with each venture and map its engineering workflow, from requirements to design, simulation, electronics, firmware, test, manufacturing and documentation. Find the steps that cost the most weeks.

  • Do the engineering. You are part of the team, not an advisor. You will run the CAD, set up the simulations, push the PCB, write the firmware agent, build the digital twin, produce the documentation, build the tools that automate technical pre-sales material that wins a contract. You ship parts and files, not slides.

  • Run the shared AI infrastructure. Set up and maintain the agents, repos and connectors between tools (CAD, EDA, simulation, data), with a common setup across ventures, so founders spend their time engineering rather than configuring.

  • Make it stick. Start with hands-on workshops on each team’s real problems, then train founders and engineers, write the playbooks, and track real adoption so tools are used every day rather than demoed once.

20%: studio radar and partnerships

  • Keep the map alive. Track the AI-for-hardware landscape and what frontier labs ship, and maintain our living map of tools, maturity and pricing.

  • See beyond the hype. Our founders want evidence, not promises. Benchmark tools on our own parts and problems, not on vendor demos, and tell the studio plainly where the value is and where it is not.

  • Close partnerships. Negotiate studio-wide deals with key players (early access, design-partner status, credits, preferential pricing) so every Hexa hardware venture starts with better conditions than it could get alone.

  • Build the default stack. Turn what works into a reusable AI toolkit that every new Frontier Tech venture gets on day one.

  • Design AI-native companies. Work with founders from day one on where AI sits in the product, how the business model captures value as models improve, which data to capture and own, and which workflows run on agents so the team scales without headcount growing in step with revenue.

Who we’re looking for

  • An industrial hardware engineer. 3 to 7 years designing, building and testing physical products in aerospace, defense, energy, automotive, industrial equipment or a hardware startup. You have taken parts from CAD to the shop floor and know tolerancing, DFM, test campaigns and suppliers.

  • 100% AI-pilled. You use AI agents every day, you have built your own automations, and you have already tried text-to-CAD, AI simulation or AI electronics tools on real work. You switch setups as soon as something better ships, and you have opinions on how a hardware company should be built when much of its engineering is done by agents.

  • A skeptical builder. You judge tools by measured time saved, not by launch videos. You are as happy killing a tool as adopting one.

  • High agency and fast. You figure it out and ship without waiting to be told how. You are comfortable jumping between projects in the same week.

  • Commercial sense and pedagogy. Comfortable in front of founders, engineers and vendors, able to run a workshop that turns skeptics into users, and to negotiate a partnership that actually benefits our ventures.

  • Languages and location. Working in English, based in Paris or Brussels, with regular days physically with the founding teams.

Recruitment process

  • First call with Laure, Talent Partner at Hexa

  • Interview with Guerric: mutual introduction, deep dive into the role and how we work.

  • Case study: a real engineering problem from one of our ventures with Tanguy, Hexa's CTO. Propose an AI-augmented workflow and run it as a short hands-on workshop with the founders, with at least one tool working live

  • Cultural fit interview with Matthieu (CEO)

  • Coffee with team members & Reference checks

title: AI-Native Software Engineer - CDI Paris - Theodo
descriptionHtml:
L’histoire du groupe Theodo et son succès Theodo accompagne depuis 2009 les entreprises innovantes dans la conception, le développement et le déploiement de produits digitaux ingénieux - tels que la plateforme TF1+, l'application LCL Pro ou l'application France Identité Numérique - en tirant parti du meilleur de la technologie et de l’approche Lean. Theodo connait une croissance exceptionnelle depuis 15 ans : nos équipes rassemblent plus de 750 Theodoers, principalement des Software Engineers, passionnés de technologie et d’amélioration continue. En 2025, le groupe Theodo génère 100M€ de CA. Aujourd’hui, l’ambition du groupe est de se positionner comme le leader de l’IA appliquée au développement logiciel, c’est pourquoi nous avons lancé la practice AI Modernisation. Au sein de cette practice, nous accompagnons nos clients dans la modernisation de leurs systèmes legacy. Grâce à une IA maîtrisée et une méthode éprouvée, nous allons 3 fois plus vite sur le delivery de ces projets critiques.
La practice accompagne principalement des scale-ups comme Qonto ou Doctolib et des grands groupes comme Carrefour, Pernod Ricard, Les Mousquetaires, Urgo, Cdiscount ou Edenred. Si tu veux rejoindre le futur de la tech, tu es au bon endroit !
Ton équipe : Tu rejoindras une communauté tech de plus de 120 Theodoers : software engineers, tech leads, engineering managers et architectes, avec lesquels tu pourras échanger, apprendre et progresser au quotidien. Chez Theodo, les techs travaillent en équipes projet, constituées en fonction des besoins de chaque client. Tu feras partie d’une équipe de Theodoers à taille humaine (4 à 5 personnes), réunissant Software Engineers, Tech Lead et Product Manager. Ensemble, vous collaborerez étroitement avec le client, avec des échanges réguliers pour partager vos avancées, approfondir la compréhension de son problème et faire évoluer le produit au plus près des besoins de ses utilisateurs. Tes futures missions : En tant que Software Engineer Fullstack chez Theodo, ta mission sera de concevoir et développer des produits digitaux utiles, performants et durables pour répondre aux problématiques de nos clients et de leurs utilisateurs. Tout au long de tes projets, tu seras accompagné pour monter en compétences et apprendre à écrire du code de qualité, à comprendre les enjeux produit et à intervenir sur l’ensemble du cycle de vie d’une application, de la conception au déploiement. Ce que tu vas apprendre en tant que Software Engineer chez Theodo :
  • Comprendre le problème de ton client et y répondre avec un produit performant, maintenable et orienté valeur, en intervenant sur tout le cycle de production, de la conception au déploiement.
  • Produire du code de qualité dans les délais, en intégrant tests, refactoring et standards techniques de l’équipe, quelle que soit la technologie utilisée.
  • Mener des investigations techniques, débugger efficacement et corriger les défauts de manière pérenne, dans tout type d’environnement.
  • Analyser en profondeur des problèmes dans le code pour développer son esprit de résolution de problèmes
  • Travailler avec un LLM pour accélérer les développements
Les problématiques et les technos sont très différentes d’un projet à l’autre, voici quelques exemples :
  • HealthHero : leader européen de la télémédecine, ils souhaitent moderniser leur plateforme française, Qare, en vue d’une fusion avec la plateforme UK. L’objectif est de passer de Loopback2 à Nest pour pouvoir upgrade de Node 10 vers Node 20. Grâce à notre méthode de modernisation accélérée par l’IA, nous passons d’une estimation à 70 semaines sans IA à une migration terminée en 21 semaines et accélérons la vitesse de delivery par 5.
  • Pernod Ricard : souhaitait moderniser une application interne utilisée pour gérer leur campagnes marketing, des millions d’euros en jeu. L’impact de Theodo : 23 semaines pour moderniser complètement l’application de Vue Express vers React Nest avec une réécriture plus pragmatique. Nous avons également effectué la connection à leur nouvel ERP, auparavant impossible sans la migration.
Tes perspectives d'évolution : Notre ambition est de former les leaders de la tech de demain. Grâce au coaching et formations que l’on propose, tu pourras :
  • Devenir un expert en développement en étant formé aux meilleurs standards de qualité
  • Développer des compétences transverses : coaching, recrutement, commercial, management et marketing technique
  • Participer à des groupes d’expertises avec d’autres passionnés (Cybersécurité, Serverless, Performance, GreenIT…)
  • Construire ton parcours sur-mesure pour atteindre tes objectifs : tech lead, senior architecte, évangéliste (spécialiste d’un sujet), CTO ou fondateur d’une entité etc
Une méthodologie basée sur l’apprentissage continu : Chez Theodo, nous avons construit notre approche tech autour d’une conviction forte : on développe d’abord les personnes, avant de développer les produits. Notre Lean Tech® System met l’accent sur l’apprentissage continu : tu évolueras dans un environnement qui investit sur le long terme, où l’objectif est de te permettre de progresser chaque jour, tout en construisant des produits utiles et performants pour nos clients. Profil recherché : Nous recherchons avant tout des potentiels plus que des compétences déjà acquises. Si tu n’es pas encore un·e développeur·se chevronné·e, ce n’est pas un frein : ne te retiens pas pour postuler.
  • Tu es diplômé·e d’une top école d’ingénieur
  • Tu as entre 0 et 2 ans d'expérience
  • Tu aimes travailler en équipe et intéragir avec des profils et des métiers variés, en faisant preuve de pédagogie et d’esprit constructif (revues de code, pair programming)
  • Tu es orienté·e création de valeur : tu t’intéresses à l’activité du client et tu ne fais pas de la tech pour la tech
  • Tu es promoteur de l’IA, notamment sur les sujets de GenAI, et tu cherches à progresser en continu grâce à la veille technique
  • Tu fais preuve d’exigence sur la qualité du travail produit et sais questionner, voire interrompre, la chaîne de production lorsque nécessaire (#jidoka)
  • Tu aimes travailler de manière structurée et appliques naturellement des principes d’organisation et d’amélioration continue (inspirés du 5S)
  • Tu souhaites évoluer dans un environnement qui encourage au quotidien l’envie de progresser, l’esprit d’équipe et la prise d’initiative
Le processus de recrutement :

  • Un échange d’une heure avec le même recruteur
  • Un exercice de refactoring à effectuer chez toi, suivi d’un échange avec un tech lead pour revenir sur tes erreurs
  • Un exercice en direct de debuging

Pourquoi rejoindre Theodo ? L’environnement: 💼 Rejoindre un groupe de 750 personnes avec de nombreuses possibilités d’évolutions cross-entités 🤝 Chaque Theodoer est accompagné par un coach interne. Son objectif : t’épauler dans ton quotidien et parler objectifs de carrière via des séances de coaching hebdomadaires. 🎯 Participation à des projets associatifs grâce à la Fondation Theodo (Ada Tech School, Code Phoenix, Article 1…) 🎉 Soirées mensuelles, keynotes et week-end d’entreprise annuel Le package : 📈 Actionnariat salarié pour être associé à la réussite du groupe 💸 De l’épargne salariale avec un mécanisme d’intéressement en partenariat avec Epsor 🖥 Budget équipement (ordinateur, smartphone, écouteurs…) 🧒 Des avantages fournis par notre CSE (sport avec Gymlib,...) 🏖 5 semaines + 8 à 12 RTT/an 🩺 Mutuelle (SideCare) prise en charge à 50% 🍽 Carte ticket-restaurants Swile 🧒 Aides et places en crèche réservées Prêt à nous rejoindre ?

title: AI Platform Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About us

People assume the supply chain is an automated, algorithmic system. It is not. It is a large number of people acting as the glue between organisations and systems, doing work the world depends on with tools that have barely changed in decades. Nexcade builds AI agents for those people, starting in freight forwarding, a $210BN industry.

Our agents are live in production with some of the leading global forwarders, pricing millions in freight every week, and we are expanding the platform deeper into the shipment lifecycle. We have raised $8.5M to make this a reality.

Our founders, Dan and Tasho, spent years at Sedna and Palantir working with supply chain companies on problems like this one. We are backed by top VCs and angels who backed or founded Synthesia, n8n and other world-class companies.

 

How we work

  • Everybody codes, founders included. The whole company is technical, commercial team included, and runs on coding agents.

  • Closely with customers and design partners, so what we ship changes how they operate.

  • At pace. Fast cycles and quick iterations, on the product and on how we work.

  • End to end. If you see something broken or missing, you have the freedom (and the responsibility) to fix it.

  • In person, 4+ days a week in London. We value synchronous communication.

  • Debate rigorously, decide quickly, execute relentlessly.

  • Enjoy the journey. Hard problems, good colleagues.

     

The role

We are building the AI platform for freight forwarding and expanding our product surface, and we are hiring software engineers across product, AI and platform to do it.

You will build products that do freight forwarding work alongside our customers' teams, operating across the entire shipment lifecycle. You will work across the stack in Python, TypeScript and React, and directly with customers and founders on what gets built.

Everyone here works across the stack, but each engineer has a spike: the area where they set the bar for the team. You spend most of your time where yours is, and lean on your colleagues where theirs are.

  • Product: You build best in class products for the core jobs in freight forwarding, one job at a time. You work as a design partner with our customers to understand the work deeply, turn that understanding into a product they would choose over anything else, and feed what you learn back into the platform everyone builds on.

  • AI: You raise the ceiling on what our AI can do and the floor on how reliably it does it. That spans high volume tasks like classification and extraction and deep workflow tasks that run for hours. You design for performance, reliability, explainability and control, set up the gyms and evals to measure them, and build the harness that runs our agents in all of our products.

  • Platform: You own the foundation every product stands on: the runtime for thousands of concurrent agents and workflows, the way they communicate and scale, the controls for how they access data with permissions that hold, and the observability to see and measure all of it. You ensure the rest of the team can move fast without fear.

     

What we look for

  • A spike, with evidence. Something you have been exceptional at and proof of it. We hire on slope rather than years, so there is no experience threshold in either direction.

  • Strong fundamentals. In the AI-assisted era, having good technical judgement is key. You have shipped production systems people depend on, seen them fail and learned from it.

  • High agency and ownership. You take an ambiguous problem, make a call, and see it through.

  • Humility and learning velocity. You want to get better and you change your mind when the evidence says so.

  • Interest in the problem. You do not need a freight background, but you need to find messy real-world operations interesting rather than a chore.

     

Why join

You will shape the product, the architecture and the company, working alongside an engineering team from Palantir, Raft, Faculty, UnlikelyAI and Oxford. You will work directly with the businesses using what you build, on AI applied to an industry that has resisted software for decades. You will get meaningful equity, so when this works you share in it.
