title: Head of CS - Nachunternehmer (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Über Cosuno

Die Baubranche ist eine 14-Billionen-Euro-Industrie, die noch immer auf E-Mails, Excel-Tabellen und eingescannten PDFs läuft. Cosuno ersetzt das durch KI. Generalunternehmer schreiben ihre Projekte auf unserer Plattform an mehr als 250.000 Nachunternehmer aus, und unsere agentische KI findet die passenden Firmen, erkennt Auffälligkeiten in Angeboten und vergleicht jeden Preis mit 6,5 Millionen Datenpunkten aus über 136 Milliarden Euro verarbeitetem Angebotsvolumen. Jede Ausschreibung macht die KI klüger. Die Ergebnisse sind messbar: Generalunternehmer senken ihre Kosten um rund 6 %, Nachunternehmer gewinnen 22 % mehr Volumen, und jeder neue Generalunternehmer-Kunde hat sich in diesem Jahr für unser KI-Produkt entschieden. 2019 in Berlin gegründet und von Cherry Ventures und Spark Capital mit über 40 Millionen Euro finanziert, skalieren wir mit diesem Kapital jetzt Sales, Customer Success und Marketing. Und genau hier kommst du ins Spiel.

Die Rolle

Du übernimmst das SC-Customer-Success-Team und verantwortest den Churn im Nachunternehmer-Segment vollständig. Nicht als Sponsor, sondern als Owner: Aktivierungslogik, Winback-Playbook, Durchsatz je Person, Forecast. Du entscheidest, was gemessen wird, was im Playbook steht und wann es sich ändert.

Wir führen Customer Success wie Vertrieb. Du bist dafür verantwortlich, dass dieses System läuft, und du bist selbst Teil davon: Die härtesten Kündigungen und Eskalationen fährst du persönlich.

Woran wir dich nach 12 Monaten messen

  • Churn im Nachunternehmer-Segment liegt unter 20 %. Heute sind es 28 %. Das ist die eine Zahl, an der sich alles andere ausrichtet.

  • Die Winback-Quote deines Teams liegt bei mindestens 50 % der bearbeiteten Kündigungen.

  • 90 % der onboardeten Kunden sind nach 30 Tagen aktiv – und das bleibt so, während du gemeinsam mit Product die Selbstaktivierung im Produkt ausbaust.

  • Winback- und Onboarding-Playbook gehören dir: Sie laufen, werden wöchentlich gemessen und du änderst sie, wenn die Zahlen es sagen. Der wöchentliche Forecast läuft ab deinem ersten Monat.

  • Die harten Cases und Eskalationen hast du selbst geführt – und wenn das Team unter Wasser ist, mehr.

  • Product und Sales bekommen von dir strukturiert, was Kunden sagen: Kündigungsgründe, Aktivierungshürden, falsche Erwartungen aus dem Closing.

Wer bei Cosuno erfolgreich ist

  • Ownership. Du sprichst über eigene Fehler, bevor jemand fragt, und darüber, was du daraus geändert hast.

  • Speed. Du löst Probleme pragmatisch und heute, nicht perfekt und nächstes Quartal.

  • Drive. Du hast Beispiele parat, wo du Prozesse gebaut oder Probleme gelöst hast, ohne dass dich jemand darum gebeten hat.

  • Low Ego. Du redest über Team-Erfolge und gibst Credit weiter – und hast trotzdem eigene Zahlen, die du nennen kannst.

Diese Rolle ist für dich, wenn

  • du ein Team mit eigener Zahl geführt hast und weißt, wie es sich anfühlt, wenn eine Person drei Wochen unter Ziel liegt – und was du dann tust.

  • du selbst Kündigungen gedreht hast, ohne den Preis zu verschenken, und das auch noch einmal tun willst.

  • du in Cases pro Woche denkst, nicht in zwanzig Accounts, die du betreust.

  • du am Vormittag ein Playbook schreibst und am Nachmittag den Kundencall führst

Diese Rolle ist nichts für dich, wenn

  • du Customer Success als Beziehungspflege verstehst und Verkaufen jemand anderem überlässt.

  • du als Head keine Kundencalls mehr machen willst.

  • du Prozesse baust, aber nie selbst gegen eine Quote gearbeitet hast.

  • du aus der Strategieberatung kommst und noch nie ein operatives SaaS-Team geführt hast.


Harte Anforderungen

  • 3–5 Jahre B2B SaaS in Customer Success, Retention, Renewals oder Account Management, davon mindestens 2 Jahre Führung eines quotentragenden Teams.

  • Eigener, belegbarer Winback- oder Renewal-Track-Record.

  • Erfahrung im SMB- oder High-Volume-Geschäft.

  • Sicher in Salesforce (oder vergleichbarem CRM) und einem BI-Tool, bei uns Looker.

  • Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau (C2), Englisch fließend. Unsere Kunden sind deutsche Handwerksbetriebe.

  • Berlin oder Bereitschaft zu mindestens zwei Bürotagen pro Woche.


Vergütung

120.000 € OTE pro Jahr (Zielgehalt bei 100 % Zielerreichung), bestehend aus einem Fixgehalt und einer variablen Komponente, die sich nach deiner Zielerreichung richtet.


Was wir bieten

  • Verantwortung: Du ownst Churn im wichtigsten Revenue-Stream des Unternehmens, mit direktem Draht zu Gründern und Geschäftsführung.

  • Vertrag: Unbefristet, moderne Ausstattung.

  • Arbeitsort: Berlin-Kreuzberg oder hybrid, du wählst.

  • Entwicklung: Regelmäßige 1:1s, Entwicklungsgespräche, offene Feedbackkultur.

  • Team: Firmen- und Teamevents, online und offline.

Compensation: €100K – €120K • 120.000 € OTE pro Jahr (Zielgehalt bei 100 % Zielerreichung), bestehend aus einem Fixgehalt und einer variablen Komponente, die sich nach deiner Zielerreichung richtet.

title: Head of Field Engineering, EMEA
descriptionHtml:
About Exa

We raised a $250M Series C to build the search engine for AIs. Led by a16z, with existing investors Benchmark, Lightspeed, and YC doubling down, the round brings Exa's valuation to $2.2 billion.

Exa is building a search engine for the AI era. Our Search API currently powers Agents, Fortune 500s, and AI labs as we transform an industry that hasn't been disrupted since the 90s. We're a largely SF-based team of ~100 from Harvard, MIT, Meta, Google Research, ex-founders, and dropouts alike. We are rapidly building the most intelligent search engine in history. We're high agency, low-ego, and united by the feeling that this is one of the last problems worth getting right.

About the Role

You'll build and lead Field Engineering in EMEA from our London office. In EMEA you'll lead both motions: Solutions Architects, who win new business in presales, and Forward Deployed Engineers, who get customers to production and grow them after the sale. You're measured on revenue: new business won and existing accounts retained and expanded across the region.

You'll be one of our first leaders in the region, so this is a player-coach role. You hold the same technical bar as the SAs and FDEs you'll hire, and you'll be hands-on in deals and customer integrations while you build the team.

In this role, you will:

  • Build Field Engineering in EMEA: hire, onboard and lead SAs and FDEs, and split into dedicated SA and FDE leaders as the team grows

  • Own the technical win on new business in EMEA, in partnership with the regional Sales leaders

  • Own post-sales technical success: onboarding to production, adoption, consumption growth, and early detection of churn and contraction risk on EMEA accounts

  • Stay hands-on: run discovery, demos, POCs and competitive evaluations on key deals, and step into critical customer integrations

  • Generate pipeline with Marketing in EMEA: webinars, technical content, events and meetups

  • Run the global operating model locally: SA to FDE handoffs, account health reviews, escalation paths, and the product feedback loop

  • Represent EMEA customers in product and roadmap conversations, ranking gaps by the revenue that depends on them

Requirements

  • A hands-on engineering background: you can build demos, review production integrations and run rigorous evals yourself, at the same technical level as the team you'll hire

  • 6+ years in technical customer-facing roles, such as solutions architecture, sales engineering, technical consulting or forward deployed engineering, including 2+ years leading teams, ideally at an AI-native or developer-first company

  • A track record of winning technical evaluations, and experience getting customers live after the sale

  • A track record of building a team or a region from an early stage

  • Clear communication with CTOs, engineers and executives across EMEA markets

You might excel if you...

  • Have owned or co-owned a revenue number as a technical leader

This is an in-person opportunity in London.

title: Head of Finance Automation/ AI Agentification
descriptionHtml:
Finance at Rohlik is being rebuilt to run on AI. We already have agents in production that chase overdue payments, process invoices, allocate cash and clear the team's inbox. The pieces work. What we need now is one person to own the whole thing and make it deliver at scale.

 

Role Overview

This is a new role that owns how AI and automation reshape the finance operating model across the Group. You will take a programme that is already live across procure to pay, order to cash and our shared services centre, and turn it from a set of promising experiments into the way finance actually runs.

You report to the Group CFO. You inherit a small team and a live roadmap, and you own the result. You decide what gets automated first, you build and ship with AI tools when that is the fastest way, and you hold every workstream to a number.

The role is deliberately hands on. You should be close enough to the work to build an agent or connect two systems through an API with AI assistance, even though you are not a software developer. You should also be senior enough to redesign how finance works and bring the rest of the business with you.

 

Why this role is exciting

  • You’ll inherit a live AI programme with real agents, real data and real impact from day one — not a greenfield slide deck.

  • You’ll shape how Finance actually runs across the Group as we move toward the next stage of growth — including the journey toward IPO readiness.

  • You’ll have access to a top-notch AI-first tech stack and the freedom to use it pragmatically.

  • You’ll work directly with the Group CFO, with fast decisions and no corporate red tape.

  • Your good ideas will be implemented almost immediately — not parked in a roadmap waiting for HQ approval.

  • You’ll lead a small team, but this is not a “manager from a distance” role. It’s highly hands-on, high-impact, and built for someone who wants to make things move fast.

 

What we expect from you

  • Own the AI and automation agenda across finance, from strategy through delivery to measured impact.

  • Lead process redesign the right way: map and understand the as-is, then design an agentic-first to-be rather than automating the old steps.

  • Lead complex cross-functional programmes across Finance, Tech and Operations, driving delivery through stakeholders and teams beyond your direct reporting line.

  • Bring the live programme to its targets, with a clear owner, baseline and deadline behind every workstream.

  • Redesign core finance processes around AI and agents, starting with close, reporting and forecasting.

  • Build and ship yourself when it is faster, using AI assisted tools to create agents and connect systems such as NetSuite, Rossum and n8n.

  • Lead and grow the team (three today) and raise AI fluency across finance and the SSC so the business can use what you build.

  • Track what matters and report it straight: automation rate, close time, cash allocation speed, cost and effort taken out.

  • Roll out across our five markets, balancing local reality against one Group standard.

 

What we look for

You have probably spent time in strategy consulting or in a transformation role, and you are now genuinely excited by what AI can do. You are a sharp generalist who can walk into a messy process, find the real problem, and fix it. You are as comfortable in a CFO pre-read as you are in the AI first tool building the thing.

  • A track record of leading transformation or automation programmes that actually delivered. A consulting, operations or generalist operator background all fit.

  • Strong understanding of finance processes, ideally gained through finance transformation, operating model redesign or automation programmes.

  • Hands on with AI. You can build agents and integrate APIs with AI assistance. You are not a software engineer and you do not need to be, but the tooling does not scare you.

  • You set baselines, name owners, hit deadlines, and say so early when something slips.

  • You can lead a small team and still do the work yourself.

  • You prioritise by impact and move fast. Better done than perfect.

  • You bring finance, tech and operations along with you.

  • Fluent in English. Czech is not required, but is an advantage.

 

What’s in it for you

  • Fair reward - You’ll get a strong fixed salary — no bonus games, no politics. Great work is rewarded clearly and fairly.

  • Good food every day - You’ll enjoy a free lunch every day and fresh fruit & veggies in the office. Because good food fuels great work.

  • Life, not just work - You’ll have real flexibility – three days in the office, 2 days Home Office where it suits you. And unlimited paid vacation based on trust.

  • Personal growth - You’ll grow as fast as Rohlik does. Every challenge is a chance to learn and make an impact.

  • Real impact - What you do here matters. You’ll see your work changing how people eat and live — from day one.

  • Recognition among colleagues - Your effort won’t go unnoticed. You can recognise others (and be recognised) through peer credits to use in our internal cafeteria.

  • Xtra membership - You’ll get free Xtra membership and 10% cashback on everything you buy on Rohlik.cz.

  • Sport & wellbeing - You’ll stay active with company sports challenges or a subsidised Multisport card.

  • A team that sticks together - You’ll work with people who move fast, support each other and celebrate wins together.

  • If this sounds like you…You’re someone who takes ownership, acts fast and gets things done. Ready to bake something great with us?

title: Head of Operations
descriptionHtml:
HEAD OF OPERATIONS JOB DESCRIPTION

About 1st Formations

At 1st Formations, we empower entrepreneurs to start, run, and grow their businesses with confidence.

Running a business shouldn’t be slowed down by company formation, statutory compliance, accounting, or payroll. From day one, these essentials should be seamless, reliable, and intelligently handled - freeing founders to focus on building and scaling.

We’re a leading UK provider of company formation and compliance services, building a modern, fully integrated technology platform that supports founders at every stage of their journey. Our platform brings together formation, compliance, accounting, payroll, and ongoing business support in one cohesive experience.

No stitched-together services.
No legacy workflows disguised as software.

Just a single, scalable platform built for ambitious founders who want to move fast, stay compliant, and grow with confidence.

Why Join Us Now?

You’ll be joining a business with strong momentum, clear direction, and real opportunity for progression.

● £18m annual revenue, including £9m ARR

● Over 1 million companies formed

● Certified B Corp and Carbon Neutral Business

● Forecast to grow 5x–10x over the next three years

The Role

We are seeking a commercially minded Head of Operations to drive day-to-day operational performance and execution excellence across 1st Formations and its associated business lines.

The Head of Operations is responsible for driving operational performance, alignment, and execution across 1st Formations' customer-facing operations and associated service lines. This role provides operational leadership across customer sales, retention, customer service, mail, company secretarial (Co Sec), and the serviced offices/business centre, ensuring the company's vision is translated into scalable, efficient, and commercially successful outcomes.

The Head of Operations will lead the integration and optimisation of these service lines and functions, ensuring consistent performance, operational resilience, and the delivery of the company's commercial objectives.

Working in close partnership with the CEO, the Head of Operations will play a key role in translating strategic priorities into practical plans, ensuring disciplined execution, sustainable growth, and measurable performance across every function it owns. This is a hands-on leadership role; the Head of Operations sets the strategic direction for their functions but remains close to the day-to-day detail, working alongside function managers and front-line teams to ensure execution matches ambition. This is an office-based role, five days a week, at our head office in Covent Garden, London.

Key Responsibilities

· Own the operating strategy and day-to-day performance across customer sales, retention, customer service, mail, Co Sec, and the serviced offices/business centre; translating commercial objectives into functional plans while staying hands-on in execution.

· Set and manage the operating cadence for each function; targets, workflows, and standards, ensuring consistent delivery across all customer-facing teams.

· Build and own the reporting and KPI framework across these functions, giving leadership real-time visibility into performance, risk, and opportunity.

· Drive cross-functional collaboration, resolving operational bottlenecks to ensure smooth customer journeys and efficient ways of working.

· Partner with the CEO to evaluate growth opportunities; new service lines and market opportunities, assessing operational readiness to scale ahead of commitment.

· Develop and coach function managers and senior leaders, strengthening leadership capability and organisational effectiveness, and ensuring each function operates with clear ownership, commercial discipline, and measurable performance outcomes.

· Work with Product to lead operational improvement and transformation initiatives; systems, automation, process redesign, and technology enablement to enhance scalability, efficiency, and competitive advantage. This includes operational ownership of the migration of customers and functions onto the new platform.

· Ensure operational resilience, enterprise risk management, and regulatory compliance across all regulated activities, maintaining robust governance and controls across the Group.

· Develop a high-performance culture grounded in accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and customer-centricity.

· Help ensure operational resilience and regulatory adherence across regulated activities within the Group.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Team Performance & Productivity

· Output/productivity per FTE across owned functions

· Employee engagement score and trend

· Team retention and voluntary attrition

· Function manager bench strength and internal promotion rate

Customer Experience & Service Delivery

· CSAT and NPS trends

· Complaint resolution time and effectiveness

· SLA adherence across owned functions

· Retention/churn rate linked to operational performance

· Facility occupancy and service standards

· Statutory filing accuracy and on-time completion rate

Operational Efficiency & Financial Performance

· Cost-to-serve across owned functions

· Revenue per employee within customer operations

· Process efficiency improvements (automation, cycle time, error rates)

· Scalability of operations relative to headcount growth

What we are looking for

· A commercially astute operator with experience running operations across multi-disciplinary or multi-entity service businesses; ideally within a scaling SME environment of a similar size to ours (circa 150 staff, £18m revenue) and with experience in a subscription, membership or B2B Services model

· Experience coordinating diverse business units or functions while maintaining performance accountability.

· Strong operational and organisational capability, with the credibility to work closely with senior leadership.

· Understanding of regulated, professional services, or compliance-led environments.

· A data-led leader who translates plans into measurable execution and consistent delivery.

· A collaborative leader who builds alignment across diverse teams and raises operational standards.

· A change-oriented operator who strengthens processes while supporting growth and innovation.

What We Offer

· £90k–110k and comprehensive benefits package

· Real opportunities for progression as the business scales

· The chance to influence both customer experience and product development

· A culture that values ownership, impact, and continuous learning

Equal Opportunities
1st Formations is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. We consider all applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, criminal history, disability, or gender identity. We encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

Compensation: £90K – £110K

title: Head of People Operations
descriptionHtml:
WHO WE ARE 🌍

Creating content that resonates is great — turning that attention into growth is even better. That's what Manychat does.

Our AI-powered automations help creators and brands engage with audiences across Instagram, Messenger, WhatsApp, and TikTok — at the right moment, with the right message, minus the manual work.

We're 400+ people across three continents behind the leading platform for conversational growth, with AI skills shaping how we build, how we work, and how we grow.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR 🌟

We are looking for a Head of People Operations to build and run a distributed hub model that delivers an excellent people experience — in every location, every day.

Your job is not to design the system from scratch. It's to own the execution of it across six hubs: hold the standard, make local teams genuinely strong, and build the kind of autonomy where hub partners decide and act without waiting.

This is not a classic HR Operations leadership role. What distinguishes it:

  • You lead distributed hub teams that own the full employee lifecycle on the ground — not a central function serving locations from a distance

  • You build autonomy, not dependency — hub teams should know what winning looks like and act on it

  • You partner directly with the individual domain leads across the function — Workplace & Experience, Payroll, Compliance, People Tech, Rewards. Not their manager, but a peer who depends on their expertise to run the hubs well

  • AI is core infrastructure, not a pilot — you default to automation for everything repeatable in the function

You thrive in ambiguity, move fast, and think in systems. You have the operational depth to manage complex multi-country employment realities, and the leadership to develop hub teams that genuinely own their work.

WHAT YOU'LL DO 🚀

Lead the Hub Model

  • Own People Operations across all hubs: Netherlands, Spain, Armenia, US (Austin, Bay Area, New York), Brazil, Remote

  • Each hub team covers the full employee lifecycle in location — pre-boarding, onboarding, changes, exits — with local office and facilities support, and local events and team-building

  • Set the standard for what excellent hub execution looks like, and hold it across all locations

  • Run the weekly sync rhythm with each hub — align priorities, surface blockers, keep quality consistent

  • Build the hub community: connect People Ops partners across locations to share practice and raise the floor

Own Outcomes, Not Process

  • Hub teams should decide and act — your job is to remove blockers, not add approval layers

  • Own the OKR cascade: every hub has OKRs that roll up through the function; you're accountable for making that cascade real, not formal

  • Define what success looks like in each location — local service standards, local processes, local roadmap

Partner with Domain Leads

Clear interfaces are the model, not the exception:

  • Workplace & Experience — deploy global programs and standards locally; coordinate on facilities, office improvements, and events beyond the local scope

  • Payroll — ensure multi-country payroll accuracy and surface local issues early

  • People Tech — maintain HRIS data quality and drive system adoption across hubs

  • Compliance — support policy adoption, manager training, and exit case handling in every location

  • Rewards — run compensation reviews and benefits implementation per country

Challenge feasibility, propose alternatives, execute agreed decisions.

Build the Team

  • Manage People Operations Partners across locations: NL, ES, AM, BR, US, Remote

  • You're standing up the hub model while running it — build the team while it's operating

  • Drive team development: upgrade skills, address underperformance, enable people with AI tools

  • Build hub teams that operate autonomously — no daily hand-holding required

Manage the Operational Realities

  • Visa and relocation support coordination across locations

  • Local compliance and employment framework adherence, in partnership with Compliance

  • Office and facilities baseline across hub locations — in coordination with Workplace & Experience on standards

Build AI-Native Operations

  • Default to automation for employee queries, document generation, onboarding workflows, and operational logistics

  • Build self-service so people don't need to contact us for anything a good system can answer

  • Treat AI adoption within the function as infrastructure and a performance metric

 

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE 🎯

  • Hub teams operating autonomously across all locations — you're steering, not executing day-to-day

  • Every hub has OKRs, knows what winning looks like, and can tell if they hit it

  • Employee lifecycle is consistent and increasingly automated across all locations

  • Cross-functional interfaces with Payroll, Tech, Compliance, W&E are clean and frictionless

  • Knowledge base live and current in a single source of truth

  • AI and automation handle the majority of repeatable operational tasks inside the function

  • Every hub partner owns their roadmap — not just their to-do list

TO SHINE IN THIS ROLE 💥

Experience & Background

  • 10+ years in People Operations, HR Operations, or Operations leadership in multinational environments

  • Direct experience managing distributed teams across multiple countries and employment frameworks

  • Proven record building distributed operating models — not just inheriting and running existing ones

  • Experience standing up new processes and functions in fast-changing environments

  • Strong change management experience — organizational transitions handled with operational rigor and human care

  • Experience in fast-scaling tech environments — SaaS and start-up / scale-up required

Skills & Mindset

  • Systems thinker: you see how processes connect, where the friction is, and what the fix is

  • AI-native operating instinct: you treat every new process as a question of which system or agent should own it

  • Comfortable with ambiguity: non-linear situations with predictable outcomes

  • Stakeholder management: you go and solve, not email and wait

  • Cross-cultural judgment: you understand employment realities across NL, ES, BR, AM, US — or learn fast when you don't

  • Executive presence: you partner with senior leadership and personally own the hardest operational calls

WHAT WE OFFER 🤗

Benefits at Manychat don't start with a spreadsheet — they start with a belief: that you should be healthy, able to care for the people you love, and set up to do your best work. Everything below follows from that:

  • 🌍 Hybrid onboarding to start work remotely and relocation support for you and your family

  • 💙 Comprehensive health insurance for both you and your family

  • 📚 Professional development budget for conference tickets, online courses, and other relevant resources to help you grow

  • 🫶 Flexible benefits package: instead of a fixed set of perks, you get a flexible benefits budget you can direct across the things that matter most — health, wellbeing, family, and your home office among them. Within these areas, the choice is yours.

  • 🪴 Hybrid work and generous, flexible time off — planned with your team, not rationed by a rigid quota

  • 🌎 Work from where you need to — agreed with your team, not tied to a desk. Flexibility we built in on purpose, because location shouldn't get in the way of great work.

  • 🍽️ In-office perks, including free meals and snacks

  • 🤝 Company-funded sport activities, annual offsites and team-building events

  • 🤖 AI isn't a perk here — it's how we work. Tools like Claude and OpenAI are available by default, and we genuinely back teams in adopting whatever makes them faster. It's a toolkit that's well ahead of the market, and you'll have it from day one.

Manychat is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We do not discriminate against qualified employees or applicants because of race, color, religion, gender identity, sex, sexual preference, sexual identity, pregnancy, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, marital status, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, military status, or any other characteristic protected by local law or ordinance.

This commitment is also reflected through our candidate experience. If you have individual needs that may require an accommodation during the interview process, please indicate this in your application. We will do our best to provide assistance throughout your interview process to ensure you’re set up for success.

title: Head of Product
descriptionHtml:
Head of Product

Our mission for you

European energy costs are 2x compared to US and China. Electricity demand is expected to double by 2050. Market price volatility & complexity are here to stay. The backbone of Europe's industrial economy is at risk — and companies need to act now.

trawa is building the solution: the first integrated B2B energy platform that orchestrates procurement, energy management, and flexibility steering in one product. Supply, Manage, Flex — combined. That integration unlocks up to 30% in recurring electricity cost savings — all while helping companies switch to renewable energy.

We're the fastest-growing B2B energy platform in Europe. Active in Germany and Austria now, and expanding operations to a third market in 2027. We're on the road to European scale and move fast — the market window is open and we intend to own it.

trawa is a scale-up based in Berlin with ~100 FTE, ~30 of whom work in Product & Tech. We've raised over €35M to date, including a €24M Series A in May 2025, backed by Balderton, Headline, Speedinvest, AENU, Magnetic, and Tiny VC. All three founders are on board and 100% committed to build the utility of the future.

We're looking for a Head of Product to own vision, strategy, and execution across the entire customer journey. You'll report directly to the CEO, with close collaboration with the CTO and COO. You will join the leadership team alongside other department leaders. You'll shape the product that makes European industry competitive again — and you'll do it at pace. This role is based in Berlin. trawa is an "office first" company, which means you will work from the headquarters in Berlin with our international, dynamic team.

Your team

You will lead a well-established team of 6 Product Managers and Designers embedded in 6 interdisciplinary teams in Product & Engineering. You will be the key decision-maker for what the teams work on. Our main customer segment is the German Mittelstand, therefore fluent German is required for this position.

You'll drive the evolution of three key areas:

Product Vision & Strategy: Own the product vision for the customer-facing products and roadmap across Supply, Manage, and Flex. Turn market dynamics and customer pain into a clear, prioritized strategy that compounds value across products. Internal products such as Trading platform as well as Energy Utility Platform are out of scope for this role.

Value Delivery at Scale: Drive execution across teams, products, and geographies. Own the metrics that matter. Turn data into decisions and trade-offs into momentum.

Team & Organisation: Build and lead high-performing product teams. Partner with Engineering, Design, GTM, and Operations. Create an environment where exceptional people do their best work.

Who we are looking for

Product Vision Leader: You deeply understand customer problems and translate them into a compelling product vision that aligns the entire company. You communicate strategy with clarity and conviction. You rally cross-functional teams around shared goals.

Product Excellence: You have excelled as a Product Leader (Staff, Head of, VP) at a fast-paced scale-up. Proven track record of shipping products customers love that drive measurable business results.

Value Delivery at Scale: You lead teams that deliver value at scale — shipping regularly, holding themselves accountable to outcomes, not just output. You set the bar for execution quality and speed across products, teams, and markets.

Software Builder: Expert in building B2B software products, ideally experienced with working with customers in the Commercial & Industrial segment. You understand and master software product dynamics — activation, retention, pricing and upsell along the full customer lifecycle.

Seasoned Executor: You deliver in high-paced environments with clear target achievement. You thrive in uncertainty — creating structure, driving momentum, and turning ambiguity into action. You prioritize with clarity and ship relentlessly.

AI-Native Builder: At trawa, we embrace new technology and use it to our competitive advantage. Core decision processes in trading and energy operations run on AI-based predictions. Customer success, sales enablement as well as Operations are fueled by agentic workflows. We are reinventing what a modern utility looks like — driving cost-to-serve toward €0 and increasing trading profits through AI-based signal processing. You will have the mandate and the environment to reinvent product development, tooling, and ways of working with AI across the organization.

Energy Expert (Strong Plus): Deep energy market expertise is beneficial — but not a prerequisite.

At trawa, we're dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. If you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly, we encourage you to apply — you may be the right fit for this or another opportunity.


90 Day Goals

After 6 Weeks (Onboarding):

  • You deeply understand trawa's business and product

  • You have established your philosophy of running Product & Tech teams’ delivery

  • You shape new quarterly roadmap and OKR plans for your teams

Month 3 (Ramp-Up):

  • You have assembled the company around your product vision for the entire customer journey

  • Your vision for the customer journey comes to live - first key metrics are moved

  • Your teams follow your rhythm of value delivery in fast measurable iterations

Why us?

Impact: European SMEs spend between €150k and €10M per year on electricity — most are overpaying and locked into outdated procurement. Your product will directly change how thousands of companies buy, manage, and use energy. The impact is measurable, the market is massive, and the timing is now.

The Role: This is a rare opportunity to own product end-to-end at a company where product is the business. You won't be managing a feature backlog — you'll be shaping a platform that spans energy trading, real-time asset steering, and enterprise software. Few product roles in Europe offer this combination of complexity, commercial impact, and speed.

Responsibility & Support: You'll join the leadership team with direct impact on company strategy. We support you through regular leadership sessions, cross-department leadership initiatives, and experienced mentors who want to see you succeed.

Ownership: We empower our team members to take ownership of their work and drive results, regardless of background or experience level.

Learning & Growth: We provide an annual budget and dedicated time for professional development. You'll have opportunities for mentorship, learning, and career progression.

Diversity and Inclusion: We're an equal opportunity employer, and our team reflects that. Our organisation brings together over 15 nationalities, contributing a variety of languages, experiences, and perspectives. At trawa, we're family-friendly with parents across all levels, and our diversity is represented throughout the company, including leadership. We're committed to an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.

Package & Benefits: We offer a competitive compensation package including salary and stock options, 30 days of vacation, and a range of benefits including subsidies for home internet and lunches, a Sports Club membership, dedicated learning days with an annual learning budget, plus a weekly team lunch and regular team events.

title: Head of Product — PAM Platform
descriptionHtml:
iGaming | B2B | Hybrid, London

 

We are hiring on behalf of our client, an international iGaming technology company providing platform solutions for operators across multiple markets.

The company develops its own casino and sportsbook platform, along with payment and affiliate products, and is now looking for a Senior Product Manager to take ownership of its core Player Account Management (PAM) platform.

This is a senior product leadership role with significant influence across the business. The PAM platform is at the heart of the company’s ecosystem, processes millions of transactions daily, and supports multiple partners in real time.

What you’ll do

  • Own the long-term product vision and strategy for the PAM/core platform

  • Define how the platform should evolve and lead its development

  • Own and prioritise the product roadmap and key product investments

  • Lead and mentor a small product team

  • Work closely with a large cross-functional Core team, including Engineering, QA and Product

  • Partner with Engineering on scalable, flexible and high-quality platform development

  • Collaborate with Commercial, Customer Success, Compliance and Operations

  • Use customer feedback, market insights, competitor analysis and product data to guide priorities

  • Help strengthen the platform’s position in Tier-1 regulated iGaming markets

  • Track product performance and business impact through relevant KPIs

What we’re looking for

  • Strong Product Management experience within iGaming

  • Hands-on experience with Player Account Management (PAM) or a comparable core iGaming platform

  • Previous product leadership / people management experience

  • Experience owning product strategy and roadmap for complex software platforms

  • Strong ability to work with and influence Engineering teams

  • Understanding of the wider iGaming platform ecosystem and its core components

  • Strong stakeholder management skills

  • Good English communication skills

Strong advantage

  • B2B iGaming platform experience

  • Experience with regulated iGaming markets

  • Experience scaling complex platform products

  • Exposure to PAM domains such as Wallet, Payments, CRM, Bonus Engine, Responsible Gaming, Risk & Fraud, KYC or Back Office

  • Demonstrable product or business impact through platform growth, adoption, revenue, operational improvements or other measurable outcomes

Team & impact

You’ll report directly to the CPO, manage a small product team, and work closely with approximately 30 specialists across the Core organisation.

This is an opportunity to own one of the company’s most strategically important products and directly influence how its core platform develops over the next several years.

Location & working model

This is a hybrid / office-based position. Candidates should be based in one of the following locations:

  • Limassol, Cyprus

  • Tbilisi, Georgia

  • Yerevan, Armenia

  • London, UK

The company offers flexible working hours around core collaboration hours, paid vacation and sick leave, medical insurance support, a flexible benefits package, professional development opportunities, corporate equipment, and regular team events.

If you have built or scaled PAM/core products in iGaming and are ready to take broader ownership of platform strategy and development, we’d be happy to hear from you.

title: Head of Sales
descriptionHtml:
About Artificial

Help shape the future of specialty insurance

At Artificial, we’re building the next generation of technology for the specialty (re)insurance market. Our mission is to transform how brokers and carriers operate in complex markets by removing operational barriers and enabling smarter, faster decision-making.

We use modern technology to solve real challenges for some of the world’s leading brokers and insurers. By automating the repetitive and structuring the complex, we help our partners unlock new opportunities for innovation and growth.

You’ll be joining a collaborative team that values curiosity, ownership, and continuous learning. We work in an environment where ideas are heard, support is built-in, and outcomes matter. Everyone here has the chance to make a tangible impact on our products, our customers, and the industry.

We've just raised $45M (£33M) in Series B funding from lead investor CommerzVentures, new investor Move Capital, as well as all existing shareholders. This investment round gives us the room to grow with confidence, continue to innovate, and ensure that Artificial remains the first choice for brokers and carriers seeking a smarter way to trade digitally.

Join us, and take the chance to be a part of something that will change the landscape of insurance for generations.

About the Role

Revenue Execution

  • Take ownership of Artificial's existing opportunity pipeline and drive deals through to close with pace and precision

  • Lead complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales processes — managing senior relationships, navigating internal sign-off structures, and bringing commercial negotiations to a successful conclusion

  • Ensure nothing stalls: actively manage deal timelines, identify blockers early, and mobilise internal resource to keep momentum

Client & Stakeholder Management

  • Build and deepen relationships with C-suite and senior decision-makers at our broker and carrier customers

  • Act as a trusted commercial adviser to prospects, articulating the value of Artificial's platform with credibility and precision

  • Work closely with the Client Success, Product, and Delivery teams to ensure a seamless transition from sale to onboarding

Commercial Leadership

  • Develop and embed robust sales processes, forecasting discipline, and CRM hygiene across the team

  • Recruit and develop a small but high-performing sales function as the business scales

  • Provide market intelligence and commercial insight to inform pricing, packaging, and go-to-market decisions

  • Represent Artificial at industry events and with target prospects as a credible voice in the London and global specialty insurance market

About You

Experience

  • A minimum of 10 years in senior commercial roles, with a demonstrable track record of closing significant deals in one or more of the following: a London market participant, or a technology or data business serving the commercial or specialty insurance industry

  • Candidates from senior executive backgrounds of relevant businesses are strongly encouraged to apply — we are looking for a superstar

  • Experience working with warm pipelines in high-trust, relationship-led markets; candidates who have thrived in environments where reputation and credibility matter as much as technique will stand out

Skills & Qualities

  • A natural closer — someone who reads a room, builds trust quickly, and knows how to bring complex, risk-averse organisations to a decision

  • Exceptional communicator: able to engage credibly at board level and translate technical propositions into clear commercial narratives

  • Highly numerate, with the confidence to model and negotiate commercial terms, understand client financials, and price creatively where needed

  • A strong bias for action — someone who sets priorities, cuts through ambiguity, and measures themselves by outcomes rather than activity

  • Resilient and energised by the challenge of a scaling business, where pace matters and process is still being built

Benefits

  • Private medical insurance

  • Income protection insurance

  • Life insurance of 4 * base salary

  • On-site gym and shower facilities

  • Enhanced maternity and paternity pay

  • Team social events and company parties

  • Salary exchange on pension and nursery fees

  • Access to Maji, the financial wellbeing platform

  • Company stock options managed through Ledgy

  • Milestone Birthday Bonus and a Life Events leave policy

  • Generous holiday allowance of 28 days plus national holidays

  • Home office and equipment allowance, and a company MacBook

  • Learning allowance and leave to attend conferences or take exams

  • YuLife employee benefits, including EAP and bereavement helplines

  • For each new hire, we plant a tree through our partnership with Ecologi Action

  • The best coffee machine in London, handmade in Italy and imported just for us!

We’re proud to be an equal opportunities employer and are committed to building a team that reflects the diverse communities around us. If there’s anything you need to make the hiring process more accessible, just let us know—we’re happy to make adjustments. You’re also welcome to share your preferred pronouns with us at any point.

Think you don’t meet every requirement? Please apply anyway. We value potential as much as experience, and we know that raw talent counts.

As part of our hiring process, we’ll carry out some background checks. These may include a criminal record check, reviewing your credit history, speaking with previous employers and confirming your academic qualifications.

title: Head of Supply Chain (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
About Yepoda

Clean K-Beauty Innovation. No compromises.

Our mission is to bring Clean K-Beauty Innovations,from Korea straight to Europe, UK, and the US – without ever compromising on our values, quality, and sustainability. Our clean, mindfully produced skincare products are made with love in Korea, vegan, cruelty-free, and packed with the best natural and active ingredients.

Founded in 2020 by Sander Joonyoung van Bladel and Veronika Strotmann, Yepoda is a fast-growing beauty start-up based in the heart of Berlin. Our products are available across Europe and the US, since March 2025, in Sephora Europe & since August 2026 in Sephora US – online and in over 1200 stores. As a certified B Corp™, we are committed to building a business with purpose. With a team of over 120 brilliant individuals from around the world, we are actively shaping Yepoda’s story every day.

About this opportunity

As our Head of Supply Chain, you will play a critical role in ensuring the efficiency, scalability, and reliability of our supply chain from Asia into our EU, UK and US warehouse network, driving operational excellence to support our ambitious growth plans.

You'll lead our entire supply chain operations from sourcing of raw materials and our cosmetic products to final delivery of orders at our customers’ door step. You ensure smooth procurement, manufacturing, and logistics processes via air and sea shipments (incl. import) to our warehouses and efficient delivery to our B2C and B2B customers. If you're a strong Operations leader, passionate about building efficient and scalable processes and enjoy solving complex supply chain challenges in a fast-paced environment, we’d love to have you on board.

Your tasks

  • Lead the end-to-end supply chain function, including demand planning, procurement/manufacturing, logistics and import, fulfilment, last mile, and inter-warehouse transfers.

  • Develop and implement strategies that improve supply chain efficiency, reduce costs, and strengthen reliability and agility as the business scales.

  • Own demand forecasting and inventory planning to ensure product availability while keeping inventory levels lean.

  • Oversee global logistics operations, optimising shipping modes from Asia and import flows into the EU, UK, and US.

  • Build strong relationships with suppliers, manufacturers, and logistics providers; negotiate contracts and favourable terms, and ensure adherence to quality standards and delivery timelines.

  • Evaluate and onboard new suppliers to support scalability and product innovation.

  • Leverage our ERP system and forecasting & planning tools to drive continuous process improvement, while working with Product Development on sustainability, packaging, and supply chain innovation.

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team, fostering accountability and collaboration, and align supply chain strategy with Product Development, Marketing, and Finance.

Your profile:

  • 6+ years of experience in supply chain, logistics, or operations management, ideally within beauty, consumer goods, retail, or eCommerce, including 3+ years leading operations teams.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Operations, Business Administration, or a related field.

  • Proven expertise across inventory management, demand forecasting, global procurement, and international logistics.

  • Track record of scaling supply chain operations in a high-growth, demand-volatile environment.

  • Proficient in ERP systems and specialised SCM tools for forecasting and planning, while still comfortable running ad-hoc analyses in Excel or Google Sheets.

  • Exceptional communication and leadership skills, with the ability to motivate and guide teams and secure buy-in from adjacent functions.

  • Excellent negotiation and relationship management skills with international suppliers, logistics partners, and internal stakeholders.

What We Offer:

  • Dynamic Environment: The opportunity to work in a start-up environment surrounded by a passionate and dedicated team.

  • Accelerate Your Career: Take on responsibility from day 1, with room for professional growth and advancement as the company continues to expand.

  • Inspiring Workspace: Located in the heart of Berlin's Prenzlauer Berg, a dog-friendly office, with free drinks and snacks.

  • Hybrid Working: We understand that sometimes you get more stuff done from home and need a change of scenery.

  • We Value Diversity: We seek to build an inclusive workplace that welcomes people from all different backgrounds. A welcoming, international, dedicated team with flat hierarchies and trust by default.

  • Employee Discounts: You’ll get to enjoy the Yepoda products at a discount and share it with friends and family to keep your glow going!

  • Unique Add Ons: A monthly benefits budget that's yours to spend. Through the Probonio app you pick what actually fits your lifestyle.

title: Head of Technical Program Management, Applied AI
descriptionHtml:
About LILT

AI is changing how the world communicates — and LILT is leading that transformation.

We're on a mission to make the world's information accessible to everyone, regardless of the language they speak. We use cutting-edge AI, machine translation, and human-in-the-loop expertise to translate content faster, more accurately, and more cost-effectively without compromising on brand, voice, or quality.

At LILT, we empower our teammates with leading tools, global collaboration, and growth opportunities to do their best work. Our company virtues—Work together, win together; Find a way or make one; Dance in the customer's shoes; Quicker than they expect; Quality is Job 1—guide everything we do. We are trusted by Intel Corporation, Canva, the United States Department of Defense, the United States Air Force, ASICS, and hundreds of global Enterprises. Backed by Sequoia, Intel Capital, and Redpoint, we’re building a category-defining company in a $50B+ global translation market being redefined by AI.

About the Role

As Head of Technical Program Management for Applied AI, you will drive and own all project execution, customer outcomes, and delivery excellence across LILT’s Applied AI practice

for the world's leading AI labs. Serving as builder and coach, you will lead the people, operations, and systems behind every Applied AI engagement — multilingual and multimodal training data, evaluations, and benchmark programs — and make sure each one ships on time, on budget, and to the highest quality bar. You are responsible for constructing LILT’s technical program management capabilities from the ground up while actively developing, mentoring, and elevating a high-performing team. Operating at the intersection of cutting-edge AI research and industrial-scale execution, you hold total accountability for every customer engagement —ensuring every deliverable across your entire team meets the highest standards of precision, speed, and technical rigour.

This is an operator's role: you will balance high-stakes operational ownership with a builder and coach mindset. You will manage and run a high-volume, high-velocity delivery organization: Technical Program Managers, project managers, and the expert and vendor workforces behind them. You bring equal passion to building the operational systems and cadence, capacity models, quality systems, and execution frameworks that power our AI lab deliverables, and coaching your team to operate as high-agency "CEOs" of their respective customer portfolios, , all while staying close enough to the work to step into a critical program or a customer escalation when it matters. You are technically fluent enough to partner with researchers and engineers, but your edge is turning complex, ambiguous customer requirements into reliable, repeatable delivery. While you empower your team to drive day-to-day execution, the buck stops with you for overall portfolio health, customer retention, program SLAs, and delivery outcomes.

Responsibilities

  • End-to-end Practice Ownership: Serve as the single point of accountability for customer outcomes across all Applied AI programs — technical delivery, project work and timelines, quality SLAs, margin, and customer satisfaction. You own top-line program success metrics, quality SLAs, delivery timelines, and customer satisfaction across all Applied AI projects.

  • Lead and scale the delivery team: Recruit, mentor, and scale a world-class team of TPMs and project managers. Set clear goals, coach for ownership, unblock across complex technical and operational challenges, and build a team that runs complex programs independently.

  • Run delivery operations and capacity planning at volume: Own capacity planning, staffing, and resource allocation across programs. Turn shifting customer demand into reliable production plans and delivery forecasts that protect speed and margin.

  • Build the delivery operating system: Standardize intake, scoping, kickoff, quality control, reporting, and close-out. Turn individual program learnings into repeatable playbooks, systems, processes, and dashboards.

  • Strategic Customer Partnership & Escalations: Act as executive partner and delivery sponsor for key frontier AI lab relationships. Proactively co-develop benchmark transcreations with customer research leads. Lead escalations, run business reviews, and help shape scope, pricing, and timelines with Sales.

  • Own quality: Partner with Research to standardize quality control across delivery, including embedded calibration, gold sets, inter-annotator agreement, LLM-as-a-judge evaluation, model eval pipelines and root-cause analysis into every customer program, ensuring that quality issues are proactively controlled and mitigated.

  • Manage the expert and vendor workforce: Work with Expert Supply and Operations to qualify, manage, and engage multilingual contributors and vendors, with clear performance and cost metrics.

  • Cross-functional Workflow Design and Execution: Design, build, and optimize scalable program frameworks for text, image, video, and audio modalities. Turn complex technical requirements into seamless operational realities, bridging Sales, Engineering, Research, Product, Production, and Engineering to scope and build project workflows that are designed optimally, launched quickly, and executed smoothly

Qualifications

  • Accountable Mindset & Ownership: Proven track record as the final owner of large-scale, mission-critical technical portfolios, with direct accountability for project delivery, customer outcomes, and SLA adherence. Demonstrated experience architecting mitigations for AI-specific operational risks (e.g., dataset contamination, domain drift, quality decay, and SLA vulnerabilities).

  • Experience: 10+ years in delivery, operations, or program leadership, including 5+ years managing managers or multi-team delivery organizations.Proven ownership of a large, customer-facing delivery portfolio with accountability for SLAs, quality, and margin.

  • Builder & Coach Mindset: Proven track record of building technical program functions, processes, and systems from scratch, coupled with a deep dedication to coaching, mentoring, and growing talent.

  • People Management & Leadership: 5+ years of direct people management experience building and scaling TPM, Product, or Engineering teams within high-growth AI or enterprise tech environments.

  • Frontier AI Expertise: Deep, hands-on understanding of the modern AI landscape—including LLMs, multimodal models, training/inference pipelines, and complex dataset diversity (multilingual and multi-domain). Hands-on experience delivering AI training data, human data, LLM evaluation, annotation, or localization programs at scale, with distributed contributor or vendor workforces.

  • 0-to-1 & Scale Experience: Demonstrated ability to build operating systems in high-velocity startup environments and scale them to support high-throughput, mission-critical operations where quality control is paramount.

  • Strong Data Fluency: comfortable using SQL, spreadsheets, or BI tools to run the business on metrics such as throughput, quality, cost per task, and utilization.

  • Contemporary Industry Acumen: Working knowledge of the modern AI landscape (LLMs, multimodal models, training and evaluation pipelines) to partner credibly with researchers and engineers.

  • Executive Stakeholder Management: Excellent business acumen, executive presence, and communication style with experience building high-trust partnerships with top-tier AI labs, customers, and enterprise executive teams

  • Education: B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science, AI, or a related technical field with 12+ years of industry experience (or Ph.D. with 8+ years).

Preferred Skills

  • Experience at an AI data, human data, or language services company, or delivering for frontier AI labs.

  • Experience leading globally distributed teams across time zones.

  • Familiarity with Python and modern program tooling (e.g., Linear, Jira, custom analytics) to automate reporting and workflows.

  • Fluency in multiple human languages.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary, equity, and benefits package.

  • Opportunity to work with cutting-edge AI technology in a rapidly growing industry.

  • A dynamic and collaborative work environment.

  • Significant opportunities for professional growth and development.

  • The chance to make a real impact on global communication and business.

Our Story

Our founders, Spence and John met at Google working on Google Translate. As researchers at Stanford and Berkeley, they both worked on language technology to make information accessible to everyone. While together at Google, they were amazed to learn that Google Translate wasn’t used for enterprise products and services inside the company.The quality just wasn’t there. So they set out to build something better. LILT was born.

LILT has been a machine learning company since its founding in 2015. At the time, machine translation didn’t meet the quality standard for enterprise translations, so LILT assembled a cutting-edge research team tasked with closing that gap. While meeting customer demand for translation services, LILT has prioritized investments in Large Language Models, human-in-the-loop systems, and now agentic AI.

With AI innovation accelerating and enterprise demand growing, the next phase of LILT’s journey is just beginning.

Our Tech

What sets our platform apart:

  • Brand-aware AI that learns your voice, tone, and terminology to ensure every translation is accurate and consistent

  • Agentic AI workflows that automate the entire translation process from content ingestion to quality review to publishing

  • 100+ native integrations with systems like Adobe Experience Manager, Webflow, Salesforce, GitHub, and Google Drive to simplify content translation

  • Human-in-the-loop reviews via our global network of professional linguists, for high-impact content that requires expert review


LILT in the News

  • Featured in The Software Report’s Top 100 Software Companies!

  • LILT makes it onto the Inc. 5000 List.

  • LILT’s continues to be an intellectual powerhouse, holding numerous patents that help power the most efficient and sophisticated AI and language models in the industry.

  • Check out all our news on our website.

Spanning five iconic L’Oréal divisions—Luxe, Consumer Products Division (CPD), L’Oréal Dermatological Beauty (LDB), Professional Products Division (PPD), and Dragon—the account is entering an ambitious growth phase, expanded scope across Amazon Ads and CPD, and fast-growing African markets. You will not simply inherit a structure—you will build, shape, and lead the new Paris-based planning hub while orchestrating scaled activation via our offshore specialist desks in Delhi.   • Offshore Hub Integration: Establish efficient, collaborative, and accountable working rhythms with our specialist activation leads in Delhi.

  • Holistic Solutions: Bridge implementation planning with Strategy, Commerce, Analytics, and Finance to deliver connected consumer journeys and commercial value.
  • Financial Governance: Oversee accurate budget tracking, variance management, and financial reconciliations across multi-currency, multi-market plans.

  • End-to-End Planning Mastery: Proven track record running the entire lifecycle: brief deconstruction, multi-channel architecture, offshore/specialist briefing, client sign-off, QA, and advanced reporting.
  • Senior Client Ownership: Demonstrated authority managing and holding boundaries with Marketing Directors, Division Heads, and Procurement.

  • Team Leadership: Experience managing planners/associate directors and leading through structural change or hub transitions.
  • Languages & Location: Fluent English is mandatory. Must be currently based in Paris or actively relocating.
Preferred & Functional Skills
  • Bilingual English / French: A significant asset given daily proximity to the Paris-based client team.
  • Channel Breadth: Strong literacy across Digital Performance, Brand Media, Offline/Local channels, and Amazon Ads / Retail Media.
  • Category Familiarity: Experience in Beauty, FMCG, or Luxury is advantageous, though proven multi-market operational rigour is our primary criterion.
Why Join Us?

  • Scale & Momentum: Work with a rapidly expanding media budget across 30 dynamic markets spanning Europe, the Middle East, and Sub-Saharan Africa.

We have vast and varied resources available to our employees; our company actively cultivates the inclusion of talents from all backgrounds. The successes and expertise of the teams are regularly highlighted during unifying events that also punctuate key moments of the year, thus strengthening our collaborative and diverse corporate culture. title: Influencer Marketing Manager (d/f/m)
descriptionHtml:
Our story:

Every year millions of people are either filing their taxes in fear or giving up on their tax refund altogether. We're working on fixing that. Our intuitive app enables anyone, regardless of education or background, to file their taxes with newfound confidence.

Spread across Germany, Spain and the UK, the team at Taxfix Group with its brands Taxfix and Steuerbot, is a compassionate group of solution-finders. We speak our minds openly, and with over 400 professionals, including tax experts, developers, and IT security experts, we're rich in ideas and voices. The group has facilitated more than 3.5 billion euros in tax refunds for its customers since its founding in 2016.

The opportunity:

We're now growing our consumer business and building new services for self-employed people and freelancers. To support that, we're looking for an Influencer Marketing Manager to run creator campaigns for Taxfix and Steuerbot.

Most people find taxes stressful. Hearing from a creator they already trust that they got money back in one evening is more convincing than an ad. That's why creators are a big part of our marketing. We run the channel in-house with a significant yearly budget and use it both to bring in new users and to build trust in our brands. The hard part is doing both at once: getting new users at a good cost while keeping the content credible for the creator's audience.

This role reports to the Influencer Marketing Lead and focuses at first on our two German brands, Taxfix and Steuerbot.

What you'll do

  • Run and scale creator campaigns from start to finish: find creators, reach out, negotiate, brief them, review content, take it live and report on results.

  • Negotiate deals that make sense for both sides. Push back on first prices and agree on terms like view guarantees or performance-based pay.

  • Build long-term relationships with creators and their managements, and decide how we work with them across both brands.

  • Run frequent hypothesis-driven experiments. We put strong emphasis on asking the right questions, good experiment design, and generating actionable data and interpretations. You own large parts of creator and influencer experimentation.

  • You continue to expand our creator database and context layer, allowing you to work very data and insight driven, and enabling AI agents to work alongside or for you equipped with the right data and context.

  • Automate the repetitive parts of your job with n8n, Claude Cowork/Code and GitHub, so research, scoring and reporting run on their own and you can spend your time on higher value work with creators, negotiations, content and strategy.

  • Seasonal campaign planning across multiple platforms, formats and creator sizes.

What you'll bring

  • 2–4 years of hands-on experience running influencer campaigns on TikTok, Instagram and YouTube, at a brand or an agency.

  • You’re highly curious about the creator economy and thrive on turning complex, ambiguous challenges into practical solutions in a high-agency role.

  • You’re an effective and confident negotiator who always strives to get the best deal and who’s not shy to walk away from a deal.

  • You’re highly analytical and very comfortable with processing and critically interpreting data sets, with an eye for detail.

  • You are on the path of becoming an AI builder with first basic to advanced workflow automations or other agentic solutions under your belt with measurable impact.

  • You’re experienced in general in how to work with LLMs and agentic solutions effectively, including when to critically review their outputs.

  • Strong communicator and relationship builder with both, internal stakeholders and external managements and creators. You’re fluent in German and English.

If you come from performance marketing, growth, affiliate or creator operations and have worked with creators, apply anyway. We'd like to hear from you.

What your first 90 days look like

  • A creator pipeline where you can explain why each creator is on it.

  • Working relationships with the creators and managements you book.

  • Two structured experiments, with read-outs that say what failed as clearly as what worked.

  • One recurring task automated, with the hours it saves measured.

Why Taxfix? 

  • A chance to do meaningful, people-centric work with an international team of passionate professionals.

  • Holistic well-being with free mental health coaching sessions.

  • A monthly allowance to spend on an extensive range of services that you can use and roll over as flexibly as you like.

  • Employee stock options for all employees—because everyone deserves to benefit from the success they help to create.

  • 30 annual vacation days and flexible working hours.

  • A generous learning budget to support your personal and professional development and guidance from our internal L&D experts.

  • Work from abroad for up to six weeks every year. Just align with your team, and then enjoy your trip.

  • Plenty of opportunities to socialise as a team. In addition to internal meetups, our international team hosts regular get-togethers—virtually and in person when possible.

  • Free tax declaration filing, of course, through the Taxfix app—and internal support for all personal tax-related questions.

  • Have a four-legged friend in your life? We’re happy to have dogs join us in the office.


Excited? So are we. Check out our Life at Taxfix page on LinkedIn to get a glimpse of our culture.

At Taxfix, we believe that incredible things happen when you have a wealth of perspectives and experiences. We're proudly committed to equal employment and development opportunities no matter your gender, race, religion, age, sexual orientation, colour, disability, or place of origin. To help mitigate any potential unconscious biases, we ask that you refrain from including your picture, age, or marital status on your CV. Let your experiences speak for themselves.

Not sure if you meet all the requirements for this role? Please apply anyway. You might bring something special to the team that we hadn't considered previously.

title: Information Security Officer
descriptionHtml:
Your next mission

Shield critical radar innovations from sophisticated threats. Lock down our infrastructure – keeping our airspace defence rock-solid.

As our Technical Information Security Officer, you lead the technical defence protecting our defence-grade radar systems and intellectual property. You partner closely with IT, DevOps, and Development to design controls, roll out Zero Trust, and secure emerging AI workflows. You report directly to our Head of Information Security (CISO), acting as the central technical bridge between IT and security. Your work ensures our technology stays safe from state-level threats while operating in critical environments.

What you'll do

  • IT collaboration and infrastructure: Collaborate closely with the Head of IT and the team. Design, implement, and optimise infrastructure controls like IAM, PAM, and endpoint protections.

  • Zero Trust execution: Drive the technical rollout of our corporate Zero Trust architecture. Enforce continuous verification across systems, cloud environments, and internal networks.

  • AI security and governance: Establish secure boundaries and technical governance for internal AI technologies. Enforce cryptographic data isolation and role-based access for RAG architectures.

  • Emerging threat mitigation: Spot and neutralise AI threat vectors like prompt injections and automated exploits. Guard company intellectual property against unintended exposure via public models.

  • Defence and radar connectivity: Build multi-layered security measures for remote radar management and data links. Protect radar systems deployed and operating within active conflict zones.

  • Incident response and monitoring: Serve as primary technical liaison for our Managed Security Services Provider. Lead technical investigations into complex security incidents alongside internal teams.

What you bring

  • BA/MSc or HBO degree in Computer Science, IT Engineering, Cybersecurity, or similar

  • Over 5 years of hands-on technical experience in Information Security, IT infrastructure, or Network Security

  • Deep technical knowledge and proven experience configuring and managing modern security tools and architectures, including Next-Gen Firewalls, XDR/EDR, SIEM, IAM, and PAM solutions

  • Strong understanding of modern cloud environments, API management, and the implementation of continuous verification and Zero Trust principles

  • Specific expertise in addressing the double-edged nature of AI in security, with a strong grasp of safe GenAI usage controls, LLM vulnerabilities (e.g., OWASP Top 10 for LLMs), and data-residency isolation

  • Experience operating in defense, military, or critical infrastructure environments, with a strong understanding of the specialized protections required against state-sponsored threat actors

Nice to have

  • Familiarity with secure coding practices and integrating automated security testing into DevOps/SSDLC pipelines

  • Agile and proactive work ethic with strong analytical skills

  • Highly Desirable: CISSP (Certified Information Systems Security Professional)

  • Highly Desirable: CCSP (Certified Cloud Security Professional)

  • Desirable: Zero Trust / Micro-segmentation (e.g., GDSA, Forrester)

What we offer

  • Working for a Great Place to Work® certified company;

  • Comprehensive pension plan;

  • Commuting allowance;

  • 30 days of paid holiday leave (with the possibility to buy 3 additional days);

  • Opportunities to develop your skills even further through training and certifications;

  • High quality laptop/desktop, monitor, headphones, and any other equipment necessary for your role

  • An international team of 30+ nationalities, full of high performance colleagues you can exchange experiences with and learn from. As well as having a lot of fun in our social events and Friday drinks!

Robin Radar is a defence technology leader in detecting, tracking and classifying drones and other small airborne objects. Our radars and software protect military sites, borders and critical infrastructure from drone threats, and also help prevent bird strikes in aviation and reduce the impact of wind farms on wildlife. Our work shows up at defence and security sites, airports and wind farms around the world.

We're one of the top 10 fastest-growing companies in the Netherlands, with a crew of bright minds across 30+ nationalities. Growth doesn't mean we lose the plot – eyes on the skies, feet on the ground. Our values keep us grounded: WE TRUST. WE OWN IT. WE AIM HIGH.

Want to work on next-level radar tech, solve real problems, and never have to pretend your job has meaning? You'll fit right in – we're saving you a seat.
