title: Ingénieur PS Zero Trust / SASE (Cloudflare One)
descriptionHtml:
À propos de Brixio

Brixio est un partenaire spécialiste de Cloudflare : intégration, services professionnels et services managés sur l'ensemble de la plateforme, de la sécurité applicative au SASE. Brixio est partenaire Cloudflare certifié ASDP et fait partie depuis juillet 2026 du groupe Equans (groupe Bouygues), 18,7 Md€ de chiffre d'affaires et environ 85 000 personnes.

L'équipe compte une trentaine d'ingénieurs répartis entre Paris, Dubaï et un centre de production à Casablanca. Les clients sont des grands comptes et des ETI en France, en Europe et au Moyen-Orient, ainsi que les entités du groupe Equans.

La mission

L'ingénieur PS Zero Trust / SASE déploie Cloudflare One chez les clients français de Brixio, du cadrage technique à la mise en production. Il devient la référence opérationnelle Zero Trust de l'équipe France et prend en charge les projets SASE dès son arrivée, notamment le déploiement interne de Cloudflare One chez Brixio et l'accès distant sécurisé aux sites industriels du groupe Equans.

Il travaille avec le Delivery Manager France, qui pilote le planning, le budget et la relation projet, et avec l'architecte principal, référent technique de l'équipe.

Responsabilités

  • Cadrage : animer les ateliers techniques avec les équipes réseau, sécurité et poste de travail du client, puis rédiger le design détaillé (architecture d'accès, politiques, plan de migration).
  • Déploiement Cloudflare One : Access (ZTNA), Gateway (SWG et filtrage DNS), client WARP, Tunnel, CASB, DLP, isolation de navigation (RBI), et selon les projets Magic WAN, Magic Firewall et Email Security.
  • Migrations : remplacer les VPN par du ZTNA et les proxies existants par Gateway, sans rupture de service pour les utilisateurs.
  • Intégrations : fournisseurs d'identité (Entra ID, Okta) en SAML, OIDC et SCIM, contrôles de posture (Intune, EDR), remontée des logs vers le SIEM du client.
  • OT et industrie : sécuriser l'accès distant des prestataires et techniciens aux équipements industriels et techniques.
  • Sécurité des usages IA : appliquer les contrôles Cloudflare One aux usages de l'IA (détection du shadow AI, DLP sur les prompts, gouvernance des applications IA).
  • Livraison et passation : documentation (HLD, LLD, runbooks), recette avec le client, passation au support et au MSP de Casablanca.
  • Rigueur projet : travailler dans le périmètre signé, signaler au Delivery Manager toute demande hors périmètre avant de la traiter, et saisir son temps chaque semaine dans Brixio One.
  • Industrialisation : contribuer aux modèles de déploiement réutilisables (configurations types, Terraform, playbooks) pour accélérer les projets suivants.

Requirements

Profil indispensable

Le poste demande d'être opérationnel sur le SASE dès les premières semaines. Sans expérience SASE en production, la candidature ne sera pas retenue.

  • SASE en production : au moins 2 ans de déploiements Zero Trust / SASE chez des clients, sur Cloudflare One, Zscaler (ZIA, ZPA), Netskope, Palo Alto Prisma Access, Cato Networks ou Fortinet SASE.
  • Expérience : 3 à 6 ans en sécurité réseau, intégration ou services professionnels.
  • Fondamentaux réseau : TCP/IP, DNS, TLS et PKI, routage, VPN IPsec, proxies, pare-feu.
  • Identité : SSO en SAML et OIDC, provisioning SCIM, Entra ID ou Okta.
  • Poste de travail : déploiement d'agents à grande échelle, MDM et contrôles de posture.
  • Relation client : capacité à animer seul un atelier technique et à rédiger une documentation claire.
  • Langues : français courant, anglais professionnel (équipe internationale).
  • Mobilité : déplacements réguliers chez les clients en France, ponctuellement en Europe.

Atouts

  • Expérience directe de Cloudflare One, ou certification Cloudflare (sinon, à obtenir dans les 90 jours suivant l'arrivée).
  • Automatisation : Terraform, API, scripts Python.
  • Connaissance des environnements OT et industriels.
  • Connaissance des exigences NIS2 et DORA.
  • Intérêt pour l'IA et pour la plateforme développeurs de Cloudflare (AI Gateway, Workers).

Évolution et ce que Brixio offre

Le poste démarre sur le SASE mais ne s'y limite pas. Il s'ouvre ensuite aux autres produits Cloudflare (sécurité applicative, API Shield, Workers, IA), selon la progression et l'intérêt de la personne. La sécurité de l'IA s'appuie largement sur Cloudflare One, ce qui fait de ce poste une porte d'entrée naturelle vers les projets IA de Brixio.

  • Rémunération fixe selon profil, plus une part variable liée à des objectifs projet (qualité, respect des délais, saisie des temps).
  • Certifications Cloudflare prises en charge.
  • Projets variés chez des grands comptes, des ETI et les entités d'un groupe international.
  • Une équipe à taille humaine, avec la solidité du groupe Equans.

Processus de recrutement

  1. Entretien de présentation avec le cabinet de recrutement.
  2. Entretien technique avec l'architecte principal, avec un cas pratique SASE (migration VPN vers ZTNA).

The Role

Alan’s Insurance Compliance Counsel, you will be Alan's expert on insurance compliance and consumer protection regulation. You will define how regulatory obligations translate into Alan's tools, processes, and products. You will own the compliance posture on your perimeter, proactively manage our exposure, and be the primary interface with regulators on the topics you cover.

You will also be a key connector between the compliance function, internal control, and the audit processes Alan conducts - ensuring audit findings are properly digested, remediated, and embedded into how we operate.

As Alan expands into new markets, you will play a central role in ensuring our compliance standards travel with us: adapting Group frameworks to local requirements and helping stand up the right compliance foundations in new geographies.

The role sits within the Legal Area in the Corporate Unit, and involves close daily collaboration with the Legal, Insurance, Operations, Sales, Care, and Product teams across all of Alan's markets.

 

What You Will Do

Own Alan's Insurance Compliance Posture

  • Define how regulatory obligations relating to Alan’s core product (IDD including duty of advice, product governance, AML/CFT, etc.) translate into Alan's operational processes, product design, and tooling

  • Suggest optimal ways to meet regulatory requirements within Alan's products while improving members' experience - from pricing components and options design to UX choices and complaint handling

  • Proactively identify compliance risks, assess their exposure, and develop mitigating action plans in coordination with internal stakeholders

  • Lead the structuring and continuous improvement of Alan's complaints management framework across France, Belgium, and Spain, ensuring compliance with ACPR recommendations and local equivalents

Reporting & Audits

  • Serve as the compliance function's key contributor to Alan's internal control system: document compliance-related risks and controls in the Group's centralised mapping, and co-deploy the internal control approach across teams (Insurance, Operations, Sales, Care)

  • Prepare and support internal and external audits: assess Alan's standing against planned operational improvements, define remediation plans, and drive and monitor their effective implementation

  • Report on compliance obligations and risk exposure to Alan's Board and governance committees, with clarity and foresight; Manage regulatory reporting obligations including the ACPR Questionnaire Protection de la Clientèle (QPC)

  • Respond to regulatory inspections (ACPR, FSMA, or equivalent in Alan’s operating countries), coordinating internally and ensuring Alan is always audit-ready

AML/CFT & KYC

  • Support the AML framework: conduct second-level analysis on suspicious cases, manage relationships with regulatory bodies and financial intelligence units, approve high-risk client relationships (including PEPs), and maintain the AML/CFT risk assessment framework

  • Oversee KYC Ops referents' training and upskilling, including Belgium-specific AML requirements

  • Coordinate with the AMLO on annual priorities, documentation, monitoring tools, and regulatory reporting to the ACPR and equivalent supervisors

Compliance Roadmap & Stakeholder Coordination

  • Maintain Alan's compliance roadmap: prioritise, track progress, update the risk mapping, and re-prioritise as the regulatory environment evolves

  • Lead compliance projects with internal stakeholders across Insurance, Product, Sales, Care, and Operations, translating regulatory requirements into concrete deliverables and timelines

  • Contribute to pragmatic compliance positions on regulatory requirements that affect our products and contracts - turning complex constraints into well-reasoned, pragmatic solutions that support the business.

Regulatory Training & Internal Capability

  • Design and maintain mandatory regulatory training programmes for Sales and Care roles (IDD competency requirements including duty of advice and product governance, Loi Evin, AML/CFT)

  • Build internal compliance frameworks, guidelines, and decision-making tools that increase team autonomy and reduce reliance on external resources

  • Contribute to Alan's written culture by producing high-quality documentation that teams can rely on independently

International Compliance & Localisation

  • Ensure Alan's compliance standards travel consistently across all Group markets, whether existing (France, Belgium, Spain, Canada) or newly opened, adapting Group frameworks to local regulatory requirements and deploying them locally in coordination with local counsel.

 

Profile

Experience & Skills

  • 4+ years of experience in compliance in an insurance or fintech company; solid coverage of at least two of the following: AML/CFT, insurance distribution (IDD), complaints handling, regulatory reporting

  • Solid understanding of the French insurance regulatory framework and ability to work across EU/local requirements

  • Proven ability to lead compliance projects cross-functionally: you translate regulatory requirements into clear priorities, align internal stakeholders, and deliver without creating bottlenecks or increased friction

  • Bilingual French/English (both required, written and spoken)

  • International exposure is a strong plus

You Will Thrive Here If You Are

  • A pragmatic problem-solver: you find the right answer within regulatory constraints rather than defaulting to the most conservative one

  • Rigorous and well-organised: you maintain high documentation standards, track your commitments, and keep stakeholders informed

  • Business-minded: you understand what matters for the company's growth and your members' protection, and you calibrate your compliance work accordingly

title: Intern - AI Financial Advisory (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Über Finton

Finton ist eine AI-Native Finance-Beratung, die AI-gestützte Lösungen für den CFO-Bereich konzipiert und implementiert. Unsere Services erbringen wir mit unserer eigenen Software, die den Berater von Projektmanagement über Datenverarbeitung bis zu Datenanalyse und Dashboard-Erstellung durchgängig mit AI unterstützt.

Konkret heißt das: Wir setzen auf dem bestehenden ERP, der Buchhaltung und den operativen Systemen des Kunden auf, bringen die Daten zusammen und liefern in kürzester Zeit ein produktives Ergebnis, etwa ein monatliches Management Reporting mit Kommentierung, einen rollierenden 13-Wochen-Cash-Forecast, eine Deckungsbeitrags- und Umsatzanalyse nach Kunden, Produkten oder Projekten oder einen Datenraum und ein Financial Fact Book für eine anstehende Transaktion.

Daneben arbeiten wir klassisch beratend: als Sparringspartner des CFO bei Budget, Forecast und Investorenkommunikation, als Interim-Kapazität in der Finanzabteilung und als Unterstützung bei M&A, Fundraising und Due-Diligence-Vorbereitung.

Unsere Kunden sind mittelständische und investorenfinanzierte Unternehmen mit typischerweise 10 bis 250 Mio. Euro Umsatz, bei denen das Finance-Team für die Anforderungen von Gesellschaftern und Banken zu klein oder zu manuell aufgestellt ist.

Finton wurde 2023 von Jan, Julian und Neil gegründet und betreut Kunden in der gesamten DACH-Region von Hamburg, Köln und München aus. Mehr als 150 abgeschlossene Projekte sprechen für sich.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Projektunterstützung: Du arbeitest im Hintergrund in laufenden Kundenprojekten mit: Du bereitest Finanzdaten aus ERP und Buchhaltung auf, baust Auswertungen und Dashboards auf unserer AI-Plattform und lieferst dem Projektteam die Grundlage für das Gespräch mit dem CFO.

  • Finanzmodelle und Analysen: Du wirkst an Finanzmodellen, Cash Forecasts, Deckungsbeitragsanalysen und Unternehmensbewertungen mit und prüfst Daten und Ergebnisse auf Plausibilität.

  • Business Development: Du recherchierst Zielkunden, Investoren und Multiplikatoren, pflegst unsere Lead-Listen und erstellst Angebots- und Pitch-Unterlagen sowie Case Studies.

  • Strategie: Du arbeitest direkt mit den Gründern an strategischen Fragen wie Positionierung, Pricing, neuen Service-Linien und Partnerschaften, von der Analyse bis zur Entscheidungsvorlage.

  • Markt- und Wettbewerbsanalyse: Du beobachtest Markt, Wettbewerber und AI-Entwicklungen im Finance-Bereich und leitest daraus Empfehlungen für unser Angebot ab.

  • Produktentwicklung: Mit deinem Feedback aus Projektarbeit und Markt hilfst du unserem Technologie-Team, die AI-Plattform weiterzuentwickeln.

  • Eigeninitiative: Du gestaltest mit, statt nur abzuarbeiten, auch bei internen Themen wie Recruiting, Wissensaufbau oder Prozessverbesserung.

Das bringst Du mit

  • Studium: Laufendes oder abgeschlossenes Bachelor- oder Masterstudium der Wirtschaftswissenschaften, des Wirtschaftsingenieurwesens oder eine vergleichbare Fachrichtung mit sehr guten Leistungen, mindestens drei abgeschlossene Semester.

  • Erfahrung: Erste relevante Praxiserfahrung, etwa durch Praktika in Consulting, Investment Banking, Transaction Advisory, Private Equity oder in der Finanzabteilung eines Unternehmens.

  • Handwerk: Sicherer Umgang mit Excel und PowerPoint, Grundverständnis von Bilanz, GuV und Cashflow; erste Berührung mit Finanzmodellen oder Bewertung ist ein Plus.

  • Technologie: Interesse an AI und Prozessautomatisierung im Finanzwesen. Programmierkenntnisse sind kein Muss, aber du willst verstehen, wie unsere Lösungen funktionieren.

  • Analytik: Starke analytische Fähigkeiten, strukturierte Arbeitsweise und ein gutes betriebswirtschaftliches Verständnis.

  • Haltung: Eigeninitiative, Zuverlässigkeit und Freude daran, in einem kleinen Team Dinge selbst voranzutreiben.

  • Sprachen: Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

Deine ersten Monate bei Finton

In den ersten Tagen lernst du unsere Plattform, unsere Projektmethodik und unsere laufenden Mandate kennen und bekommst einen festen Ansprechpartner im Team. Schon in der ersten Woche unterstützt du ein Kundenprojekt aus dem Hintergrund: Du bereitest Daten auf, baust erste Auswertungen und siehst, wie aus Rohdaten ein Reporting für den CFO wird.

Nach den ersten Wochen übernimmst du eigene Arbeitspakete, etwa einen Teil eines Finanzmodells, eine Wettbewerbsanalyse oder den Aufbau einer neuen Lead-Liste, und präsentierst deine Ergebnisse direkt den Gründern.

Benefits

  • Echte Aufgaben statt Zuschauen: Du arbeitest an realen Projekten, Modellen und Strategiethemen mit und siehst, was mit deiner Arbeit beim Kunden passiert. Kein Kaffeekochen, kein Folienschubsen ohne Kontext.

  • Direkter Draht zu den Gründern: Du bekommst einen festen Mentor aus dem Gründerteam, regelmäßiges Feedback und Einblick, wie eine Beratung aufgebaut und geführt wird.

  • Perspektive: Wer überzeugt, hat die Option, nach dem Praktikum in Vollzeit bei uns einzusteigen.

  • Vergütung: Eine faire Praktikumsvergütung, die deine Erfahrung berücksichtigt.

  • Technologie: Du arbeitest mit unserer eigenen AI-Plattform statt mit Excel-Handarbeit und lernst, wie Finance- und Beratungsarbeit in den nächsten Jahren aussehen wird.

  • Standort Köln: Unser Büro liegt am Friesenplatz, mitten in der Stadt. Wir arbeiten gemeinsam vor Ort, weil du so am schnellsten lernst und wir als kleines Team schnell entscheiden wollen. Flexible Arbeitszeiten gehören dazu.

  • Ausstattung und Extras: Firmenlaptop, Zuschuss zum ÖPNV-Ticket, Fitnessabo, kostenlose Getränke im Büro, lockere Kleiderordnung sowie regelmäßige Teamevents und Firmenfeiern in einem kleinen Team mit flachen Hierarchien.

Bewerbung

Wenn du diesen Weg mitgestalten willst, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung über die Plattform. Ein Lebenslauf reicht uns für den Anfang; ein Anschreiben brauchst du nicht. Du hörst innerhalb von einer Woche von uns, und dein erstes Gespräch führst du direkt mit einem der Gründer.

descriptionHtml:

Marble is a climate tech venture studio. We partner with scientists, engineers, and operators to create companies solving hard climate problems in the world's largest industries.

Our first 15 companies are building transformative products across energy, industry, agriculture, and climate resilience. 100% have been successful in raising follow-on to date. We are looking to partner with exceptional individuals to create our next venture.

We are hiring a Junior Venture Analyst intern to join the Marble team and support the market and commercial exploration of key opportunity areas in climate tech.

You will work directly with Partners, senior team members, and brilliant founders on a mission to turn the tide on the climate crisis. This role offers a unique opportunity to work with some of the brightest and most mission driven individuals you’ll meet!

You will be immersed into the worlds of climate and deep tech venture creation. Expect direct exposure to the many aspects of running a climate tech studio: developing new opportunity theses, supporting founders on strategy and fundraising, running customer reserach, and forming a view on which companies are worth building.

This internship is a great fit for a student with a passion for climate tech and venture, with prior exposure in fast-paced environment where they had to own work, navigate ambiguity, and help shape key decisions (e.g. startups, scaleups, VC, corporate dev, consulting, etc.)

Location: HQ in Paris, Station F

title: IT Analyst
descriptionHtml:
Get to Know Us

Horizon3 is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organizations to proactively find, fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZero™ platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organizations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by IT Ops/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs.

 

We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers & operators, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools and false positives, resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, “checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn it alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results.

 

What You’ll Do

We are seeking an IT Support Analyst to provide hands-on technical support with a focus on coverage for our EMEA wide employees - both onsite and remotely. This is a front-line role for someone who enjoys solving technical problems directly with end users and wants to build depth across endpoint, identity, and collaboration tooling.

This role will resolve day-to-day technical issues remotely for the broader distributed workforce — covering hardware, software, account access, and collaboration tools. The ideal candidate brings solid troubleshooting fundamentals, reliable follow-through, and a customer-service mindset, and is comfortable escalating complex or ambiguous issues to senior support staff or the Global Help Desk Manager.

 

This role will be responsible for.....

  • Provide onsite technical support including hardware setup, network connectivity, conference room/AV equipment, and printer/peripheral troubleshooting.

  • Resolve incoming help desk tickets and requests for the broader distributed workforce, covering hardware, software, account access, and [ticketing system] queue management

  • Support onboarding and offboarding logistics for employees, including equipment provisioning, account setup, and device retrieval

  • Administer routine identity and access tasks (password resets, MFA support, access requests) within [identity/access platform], escalating complex or policy-sensitive requests

  • Support endpoint management tasks such as imaging, patch verification, and asset tracking within tools like Jamf or Iru

  • Maintain accurate records of tickets, assets, and resolutions to support reporting and audit needs

  • Follow documented runbooks and knowledge base articles for common issues, and flag gaps or outdated content to the Global Help Desk Manager

  • Escalate unresolved or high-impact issues to the appropriate lead or manager in a timely manner, providing clear context and troubleshooting steps already attempted

  • Partner with Security and IT Engineering on device compliance and access control practices as directed

  • Demonstrate a commitment to integrity, process improvement, and customer satisfaction

 

What You’ll Bring

  • Must have foundational experience in IT support, help desk, or end-user services

  • Must have working knowledge of common endpoint operating systems (MacOS and/or Windows) and standard enterprise collaboration software

  • Must be able to communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical employees

  • Must be able to prioritize and manage a queue of concurrent requests with minimal direction

  • Must demonstrate sound judgment in knowing when to resolve an issue independently versus escalate it

  • Must demonstrate curiosity and a willingness to question the norm in pursuit of an exceptional user experience.

 

Minimum Education and Experience

  • 2–4 years of experience in IT support, help desk, or IT operations

  • Experience supporting both in-office and remote/distributed employees preferred

 

Required Tech Stack Experience

  • Familiarity with Jira or Jira Service Management

  • Comfortable managing identity in Okta, Entra, or similar

  • Experience using Jamf, Iru, or Intune

  • Expert in Google Workspace, Slack, and Zoom

 

What Sets You Apart?

  • You've supported a hybrid or distributed workforce and are comfortable switching between in-person and remote troubleshooting

  • You've contributed to onboarding/offboarding or endpoint management processes that improved speed or consistency

  • You're proactive about documenting fixes and updating knowledge base content for the next person

  • Relevant certifications such as CompTIA A+, ITIL Foundation, or similar

  • Experience in high-growth SaaS or cybersecurity companies

 

Perks of Horizon3

  • Inclusive Team: We value diversity and promote an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive.

  • Growth Opportunities: Be part of a dynamic and growing team with numerous career development opportunities.

  • Innovative Culture: Work in a collaborative environment that encourages creativity and out-of-the-box thinking.

  • Hybrid & Remote Work: We embrace a mix of remote and hybrid work models depending on role and location, including our Chicago office, where some roles require regular in-office presence.

  • Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salary, equity and benefits. Our benefits include health, vision & dental insurance for you and your family, a flexible vacation policy, and generous parental leave.

Compensation and Values

At Horizon3, we believe that our people are our greatest asset, and our compensation philosophy reflects this core value. We are committed to fostering an environment where all employees feel valued, respected, and rewarded for their contributions. Our compensation structure is designed to be fair, competitive, and transparent, ensuring that every team member is recognized and compensated equitably across roles, levels, and locations.

In accordance with various State’s transparency regulations, we provide the following salary range information for this position:

  • Base salary range: The exact salary will be determined based on the selected candidate’s location, qualifications, experience, and relevant skills.

  • Additional compensation: All full-time roles are eligible for an equity package in the form of stock options.

You Belong Here

Horizon3 is not just an equal opportunity employer - we are a community that values diversity, equity, and inclusion as fundamental principles of our culture and success. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace where everyone feels welcome and respected, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, hair length or any other legally protected status by law.

Our commitment to diversity and inclusion means we strive to attract, develop, and retain a workforce that reflects the varied communities we serve. We believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation and strengthen our ability to create cutting-edge cybersecurity solutions. At Horizon3, every team member is valued and supported in an environment that encourages personal and professional growth.

We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and experiences, and we encourage all qualified individuals to apply. Come be a part of Horizon3, where your unique contributions are recognized, and your potential is limitless.

Other Duties

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice. 

Application Note

In any materials you submit, you may redact or remove age-identifying information such as age, date of birth, or dates of school attendance or graduation. You will not be penalized for redacting or removing this information.

title: Junior Clinical Fellow
descriptionHtml:
Be at the forefront of a new era in patient care

Are you a doctor who has completed Foundation Training and is looking for a unique clinical opportunity? This is your chance to work at the cutting edge of cannabis based medicines, supporting patients with complex and often life changing conditions while gaining experience in an emerging area of medicine.

Join a passionate and forward thinking clinical team in a rapidly growing field where no two patients, or days, are the same. You will work alongside experienced consultants, pharmacists and multidisciplinary specialists, contributing to meaningful patient outcomes while developing your clinical expertise in a progressive and innovative healthcare environment. This role is offered as a 12 month fixed term contract

 

What is the job?

We are recruiting a Junior Clinical Fellow to join our London team. This is a hands-on, patient focused role where you will play a critical part in prescribing and reviewing cannabis-based medicines for patients with complex clinical needs.

Your work will centre on delivering safe, effective and highly personalised treatment, supporting patients across a wide range of conditions.

Collaboration is at the heart of what we do. You will work closely with a multidisciplinary clinical team, contributing not only to outstanding patient outcomes but also to the development of clinical pathways, education initiatives, and service improvements. This role offers a genuine opportunity to grow your expertise and make a lasting impact in a fast-evolving specialty.

This is a full time role contracted at 40 hours per week. Your time will be split across three days on site and two days working remotely, with one Saturday per month required on site. Saturday working is compensated with a day in lieu.

What will you be doing?

  • Conduct clinical reviews via video call with patients during their journey through the clinic.

  • Prescribe medicines and tailor treatments to individual patient needs.

  • Provide expert guidance to patients on treatment options.

  • Clinically check and review CBPM prescriptions for safety and accuracy.

  • Help to answer complex clinical queries and provide guidance to our patient support and other external teams.

  • Maintain accurate patient records in line with GMC standards.

  • Deliver education and training on CBPM to patients, clinicians, and staff.

  • Collaborate with the wider team to streamline processes and improve outcomes.

What do you need?

  • Registered medical practitioner with the GMC and a full licence to practice

  • Completion of Foundation Year 2 (F2) training or equivalent clinical experience including a placement in GP or A&E.

  • Experience working in a clinical setting

  • Knowledge of CBPM is desired not essential or willingness to undergo specialised training

  • Clear and confident communicator across clinical and non-clinical settings

  • Highly effective at managing time and prioritising competing demands

  • Proactive and resourceful when identifying and resolving problems

  • Well-organised, detail-oriented, and able to manage complex workflows

What we offer:

  • Generous Leave: 25 days holiday (rising to 27 after year one and 30 after year three) + 8 bank holidays

  • Pension Matching: Up to 5% employer matching contributions

  • Flexibility and Wellness: Work-from-home options, cycle-to-work scheme, and more

  • Growth Opportunities: Collaborate across teams and represent Montu at events, with support to grow your skills and impact

  • Enhanced Maternity & Paternity Leave

  

About Us

Montu UK is a leading digital health company specialising in cannabis-based medicines (CBPM), dedicated to improving patient access to safe and effective treatments. Our mission is to transform lives by combining innovative technology with high-quality clinical care, ensuring patients receive the support they need at every step of their journey.

 

As a fast-growing organisation, we offer a collaborative and supportive environment where talented people can develop their careers while contributing to meaningful change in healthcare. At Montu UK, your work has a direct impact on improving patients’ lives and expanding access to modern medical treatments.

title: Junior Pricing Data Scientist
descriptionHtml:
We started building Marshmallow in 2017. Since then, we’ve grown from 3 to 700+ people, gained unicorn status, raised ~£140M over three funding rounds, turned profitable, insured millions of drivers and lent millions in car loans.

But we’re only just getting started. Our goal is to become one of the largest financial services providers in the world. Over the next 10 years we’ll grow exponentially, not only by scaling our existing products, but also by building new ones.

To achieve our goals we need incredibly ambitious, commercially driven people who never settle for ‘good enough’. Marshmallowers are hungry for autonomy and ownership, and would rather improve than coast. Everyone raises standards and has an impact, with a focus on collective success over self-interest.

We’ve created an environment where curious, tenacious people win and grow together. If that sounds motivating, this could be the place for you.

London (hybrid, 3 days in office)

We are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this position.

 

About the team

Marshmallow's pricing team applies quantitative methods to real insurance problems. In this role, you'll learn how pricing decisions work in practice and turn data into meaningful outcomes. You'll work closely with a senior pricing team member, bringing your quantitative background into an industry setting. The aim is for you to develop the practical judgement and independence to take on – and eventually lead – increasingly substantial work.

What you'll be doing

  • Working closely with pricing colleagues on scoped analytical and data-driven projects, taking on more responsibility as your experience develops.

  • Applying mathematical, statistical and machine learning techniques to practical pricing questions, connecting your analysis to the decision it needs to inform.

  • Explaining your findings clearly, keeping colleagues from different areas of the business updated on progress and following up on agreed actions.

  • Using feedback to improve your work and build your understanding of data science methods, coding best practice and the commercial context of insurance pricing.

Who you are

  • You want to learn, seek feedback and build towards working independently.

  • You communicate your rationale and findings clearly, and keep colleagues informed about your progress.

  • You follow through on agreed actions and take ownership of your work.

What you’ll bring

  • A strong academic record and a research master's or PhD in a quantitative field, such as mathematics, physics or econometrics.

  • Experience applying quantitative methods or machine learning to a practical problem through your studies, research, a personal project or work.

  • Industry experience is preferred - a placement, internship or experience whilst studying, or in between research masters / PhD.

  • The ability to explain how your approach fits the problem, rather than relying on theory alone.

 

Perks of the job

  • Bonus scheme designed to reward high performance

  • Private medical insurance with Vitality, mental health support with Oliva

  • Personal learning budget and 2 dedicated L&D days a year

  • Monthly flexible benefits budget to spend as you choose

  • 25 days holiday plus bank holidays

  • 4 weeks Work From Anywhere per year

Our process

  • Initial call with a member from our Talent Team (30 mins)

  • Combined Past Experience & Technical interview (90 mins)

  • Onsite Culture interviews (90 mins)

Diversity of thought

We know the best ideas come from having different perspectives in the room - and we're committed to hiring fairly, regardless of background, identity or experience. If you see yourself in this role, we'd encourage you to apply.

title: Key Account Manager
descriptionHtml:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⭐️ The Key Account Management Team


Our Account Management team’s purpose is to make our key accounts stay and grow with Alan. We created the team in 2020 and we are now 30+.
We are looking for amazing people to help us take care of our growing pipe on Public Sector accounts (Ministries and other public entities).
Being a Key Account Manager at Alan means joining a team of talented, committed and passionate experts, with different backgrounds.
We move fast, with a lot of ownership, and are proud to tackle big problems!

⭐ Is it you we’re looking for?


As a Key Account Manager, you will:

  • Handle a portfolio of strategic accounts in the Public Sector

  • Build and maintain strong customer relationships with key stakeholders and display a customer-centric approach to identify the main needs and allow our clients to achieve their goals through Alan

  • Proactively identify potential signals of dissatisfaction and implement solutions to answer them

  • Ensure successful onboarding of new accounts and promote Alan health partner positioning to generate massive adoption by employees and admins

  • Analyze and present consumption reports to customers through business reviews

  • Identify and execute out-of-the-box initiatives to engage our existing customers

  • Renegotiate contracts to guarantee both great value for money to our customers and sustainable profitability

  • Participate in the evolution of our products and services, acting as the voice of our customers when discussing with Product teams

You would be a great fit at Alan if most of this sounds like you:

  • You have at least 6 years of experience in a customer-facing role including frequent interactions with C-Levels

  • You have full working proficiency in French (excellent oral and written communication)

  • You have at least advanced level in English

  • You are experienced in dealing with very large organizations and potentially with unions

  • You have the tact and empathy that make great negotiators

  • You are an expert in positive lobbying with key stakeholders and create long-term relationship based on trust and transparency

  • You are very analytical, very comfortable with presenting deep data analysis to clients and solving complex problems

  • You have great active listening skills and are a master in the art of crafting the right follow-up message

  • You have a growth mindset: you are able to adapt to new trends and to develop an in-depth understanding of the health insurance market

  • You are currently based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille or Annecy.


It is nice to have a previous experience in Insurance or any industry linked to benefits. Having experience with or within the Public Sector space is also a nice to have.


For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the C1-E level range.

🙌   Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers. 

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary.

  • Flexible Office. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Bordeaux, Marseille or Annecy.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your  time as you  wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Country-specific commuter benefits.

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly  flexible Training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk -it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential.Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents.

Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist.

We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.

title: Key Account Sales Executive
descriptionHtml:
Key Account Sales Executive – Paris (Office-first)

Team description

Our Paris sales team helps small and growing merchants across France get set up with SumUp's payment tools, often as their very first introduction to the brand. We're a close-knit, target-driven group that thrives on outbound conversations, quick thinking and celebrating wins together. This role gives you a real seat at the table from day one: you'll own conversations end to end, learn the fundamentals of a fast-paced sales cycle and see the direct impact of your work every time a merchant signs up.

What you'll do

  • 💼 Reach out to small business prospects by phone, email and social media, starting the conversation and building the pipeline

  • 🤝 Get to know each business's needs and show how SumUp can genuinely help them

  • 🎤 Run product pitches and demos that turn curiosity into commitment

  • 🔥 Manage the full sales cycle, from first contact through to closing the deal

  • 📊 Track performance against targets and use feedback and data to keep improving

  • 🧠 Share ideas with the team and help build an energised, collaborative office culture

What we're looking for…

  • Experience in outbound sales or business development, with a genuine drive to learn and grow quickly.

  • Comfort working with high volumes of phone-based outreach.

  • Curiosity and confidence when speaking with new people and solving their problems.

  • A results-driven mindset with a track record of working towards targets.

  • Fluency in French and English, given daily contact with local merchants and a global team.

Why you should join SumUp

  • 🌎 Opportunity to work with a truly global, multicultural team from our Paris location. This involves an office-first setup

  • 🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced

  • 📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget of €2000 for your individual development, which can be used to attend conferences and/or advance your career through further education

  • 💼 Financial security: corporate pension contributions that support your long-term future

  • 🏥 Healthcare support: we cover 50% of the monthly cost of your health insurance for your Mutuelle and Prévoyance

  • 🚌 Extra allowances: we offer restaurant tickets (Swile) and cover transportation costs

About SumUp

Be empowered to do more that matters.

At SumUp, we're on a mission to empower small businesses across the globe by providing simple and affordable tools that allow them to thrive. Today, over 4 million businesses in 37 markets rely on SumUp as their financial partner to manage payments, finance and customer relationships.

Our commitment to small businesses is reflected in our diverse team of over 3,000 SumUppers from over 90 nationalities, united by global collaboration and an innovative mindset. Our core values lay the foundation for who we are and what we stand for, shaping our work culture and driving our success. We foster inclusivity and a continuous learning culture, providing a safe space for personal and professional growth. Our differences make us unique and strong as we strive to create an environment where everyone belongs and feels supported, no matter how they identify.

SumUp is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer, actively seeking and embracing diversity in our workforce. We don't make hiring or employment decisions based on race, colour, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age or any other basis protected by applicable laws or prohibited by company policy. Our commitment extends beyond recruitment to creating a safe and respectful workplace where harassment of any form is strictly prohibited. Discover more about our culture and opportunities on our careers website, and follow our journey on LinkedIn, Instagram, and TikTok.

Job Application Tip

We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. Please note that this is only a guide. If you don't tick every box, it's ok too because it means you have room to learn and develop your career at SumUp.

title: Klaviyo Email Marketer for DTC Brands
descriptionHtml:
We're a full-service email and SMS marketing agency helping 7-figure and 8-figure DTC brands scale profitably. We specialize in high-performance email flows, campaigns, and retention strategies using Klaviyo for high-growth brands.

As an Email Marketing Manager at our agency, you will fully own email marketing for a portfolio of DTC brands.

You are responsible for strategy, execution, and performance across campaigns, flows, and pop-ups.

You will manage your team (designer, brand copywriter, and Klaviyo technician) and ensure all deliverables are completed on time, on-brand, and error-free.

Your role is to bring strategy and direction to the team, maintain high standards, and ensure every email sent on behalf of the client meets those standards.

You will also be the main point of contact for your clients, owning communication, performance, and overall account success.

This is a fast-paced role where attention to detail, responsiveness, and consistency are critical.

Who’s a Great Fit

✓ You have 2+ years of experience managing email marketing for eCommerce/DTC brands

✓ You are fluent in German and English

✓ You have deep expertise in email and SMS marketing for eCommerce

✓ You've already worked for a brand or an email marketing agency before

✓ You are highly proficient in Klaviyo and understand both flows and campaigns deeply

✓ You have a strong eye for layout, hierarchy, spacing, and modern design, and understand how to design emails that drive conversions, not just look good

✓ You can work quickly without sacrificing quality

✓ You are responsive, reliable, and communicate clearly with your team

✓ You can manage your team (designer and Klaviyo technician) and keep work moving efficiently

✓ You can manage multiple brands and stay organized without needing reminders

✓ You have strong agency, are independent, and proactive. You take ownership of your work and do not need to be reminded of tasks or deadlines

✓ You can work 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM CET with minimal interruptions

Key Responsibilities

- Own full email marketing strategy and execution across campaigns, flows, and pop-ups
- Create and manage monthly campaign calendars for each client
- Review email copy to ensure clarity, performance, and brand alignment
- Brief designers and review email designs for layout, hierarchy, and conversion
- Manage client communication, approvals, and feedback loops
- Handle revisions quickly (standard within 24 hours)
- Oversee scheduling and QA to ensure all emails are error-free before sending
- Manage your team to ensure deadlines are met across all deliverables
- Maintain clean, organized Figma and Klaviyo environments
- Prepare and deliver monthly performance reports with insights and improvement plans
- Stay active in Slack and respond within 15 to 20 minutes during working hours

Why Work With Us?

- 100% remote work
- High ownership and autonomy in your role
- Opportunity to work with high-growth DTC brands
- A high-performing, collaborative team
- Work at the cutting edge of retention marketing

title: Kundenberater/in – Vollzeit (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Hamburg-Altona · Vollzeit · vor Ort · 4.300–4.900 € brutto/Monat

Du telefonierst gerne, kannst Menschen gut zuhören und arbeitest am liebsten mit klaren Abläufen und einem festen Aufgabenbereich?

Als Kundenberater/in bei der ESH Unternehmensgruppe führst du die ersten Gespräche mit Interessenten, die sich auf die Steuerberaterprüfung vorbereiten möchten. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt dabei aktuell auf unserem größten Unternehmensbereich, der ESH StB-Examensvorbereitung.

Du findest heraus, wo die Interessenten aktuell stehen, klärst erste Fragen und bereitest die weiteren Beratungsgespräche mit unseren Strategieberatern vor.

Dabei arbeitest du nach klar definierten Abläufen und Gesprächsstrukturen.

Keine Vertriebserfahrung? Kein Problem.
Wir arbeiten dich strukturiert in unsere Gesprächsabläufe und Prozesse ein. Steuerrechtliche Kenntnisse brauchst du für diese Position nicht.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du führst telefonische Erstgespräche mit Interessenten.

  • Du findest anhand klarer Fragen heraus, wo der Interessent aktuell steht und wobei er Unterstützung benötigt.

  • Du prüfst, ob unser Angebot grundsätzlich zur jeweiligen Situation passt.

  • Du bereitest passende Interessenten auf das weiterführende Gespräch mit unseren Strategieberatern vor.

  • Du planst Termine und sorgst für eine vollständige Vor- und Nachbereitung.

  • Du dokumentierst Gespräche und Informationen zuverlässig in unseren Systemen.

  • Du unterstützt unsere Strategieberater bei wiederkehrenden operativen Aufgaben.

  • Gelegentlich begleitest du uns auf Messen, Seminaren und Veranstaltungen.

So sieht dein Arbeitsalltag aus

Der Großteil deiner Arbeit besteht aus telefonischen Gesprächen, Terminvorbereitung und dokumentierten Abläufen.

Du arbeitest mit festen Gesprächsstrukturen und klar definierten Prozessen. Dadurch weißt du, was in welcher Situation zu tun ist und welche nächsten Schritte vorgesehen sind.

Innerhalb deines Aufgabenbereichs arbeitest du selbstständig und übernimmst Verantwortung dafür, dass Gespräche, Termine und Dokumentation zuverlässig erledigt werden.

Wenn ein Sonderfall auftritt oder etwas unklar ist, stimmst du dich mit dem zuständigen Kollegen ab.

Die Stelle passt besonders gut zu dir, wenn …

  • du gerne mit klaren Aufgaben und festen Abläufen arbeitest,

  • du zuverlässig bist und Absprachen einhältst,

  • du auch wiederkehrende Tätigkeiten dauerhaft sorgfältig erledigst,

  • du gerne telefonierst und offen auf Menschen zugehen kannst,

  • du aufmerksam zuhörst und Informationen schnell erfassen kannst,

  • du Verantwortung für deine Ergebnisse übernimmst,

  • du gerne weißt, was von dir erwartet wird,

  • du einen langfristigen Arbeitsplatz und einen festen Aufgabenbereich suchst.

Das solltest du mitbringen

  • sehr gute kommunikative Fähigkeiten

  • eine klare, professionelle und angenehme Gesprächsführung am Telefon

  • schnelle Auffassungsgabe

  • sorgfältige und strukturierte Arbeitsweise

  • Verlässlichkeit und Disziplin

  • die Fähigkeit und Bereitschaft, bestehenden Prozessen zu folgen

  • sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

  • die Fähigkeit, auch bei höherem Gesprächsaufkommen konzentriert und verbindlich zu arbeiten

Eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung ist hilfreich, aber keine Voraussetzung.

Erfahrung in Vertrieb, Beratung oder Kundenkontakt ist von Vorteil, aber ebenfalls nicht zwingend erforderlich.

Kenntnisse im Steuerrecht benötigst du nicht.

Deine Einarbeitung bei ESH

Deine Einarbeitungsphase dauert in der Regel 2–4 Monate.

Mit unserer digitalen Schulungsplattform, Gesprächsleitfäden, Anleitungen und Checklisten lernst du deine Aufgaben Schritt für Schritt kennen.

Du kannst Inhalte jederzeit wiederholen und nachlesen und hast feste Ansprechpartner für deine Fragen.

Unser Ziel ist, dass du deinen Aufgabenbereich nach der Einarbeitung sicher und eigenständig übernehmen kannst.

Das erwartet dich bei ESH

Sicherer Arbeitsplatz in einem wachsenden Unternehmen

Die ESH Unternehmensgruppe entwickelt sich kontinuierlich weiter und baut ihre Unternehmensbereiche Schritt für Schritt aus.

Gleichzeitig arbeiten wir in einem Umfeld rund um Steuerberatung und berufliche Weiterbildung mit langfristigem Bedarf. Neue Stellen schaffen wir mit dem Ziel, unser Team dauerhaft zu verstärken und langfristig zusammenzuarbeiten.

Wenn es für beide Seiten passt, möchten wir, dass du deinen Aufgabenbereich langfristig bei ESH übernimmst und ein fester Teil unseres Teams wirst.

Klare Strukturen

Du arbeitest mit festen Zuständigkeiten, geregelten Arbeitszeiten und nachvollziehbaren Prozessen. So weißt du, was von dir erwartet wird und kannst dich auf deine Aufgaben konzentrieren.

Attraktive Vergütung

Je nach Erfahrung und Qualifikation liegt dein Gehalt bei 4.300–4.900 € brutto pro Monat.

Zusätzlich bieten wir dir über unser Mitarbeiter-Benefit-System verschiedene Vergünstigungen und Zuschüsse, unter anderem über Probonio.

Moderne Arbeitsplätze

Dich erwarten moderne Büroräume in Hamburg-Altona, hochwertige Arbeitsgeräte und höhenverstellbare Schreibtische.

Strukturierte Einarbeitung

Auch als Quereinsteiger kannst du bei uns starten. Wir arbeiten dich Schritt für Schritt in unsere Gesprächsführung, Systeme und Abläufe ein, die du für deine Position benötigst.

Steuerrechtliche Kenntnisse sind für deine Aufgabe nicht erforderlich.

Gemeinsame Veranstaltungen

Gelegentlich sind wir als Team auf relevanten Messen, Kongressen und Veranstaltungen der Steuer- und Bildungsbranche vertreten.

Rahmenbedingungen

Arbeitsort: Hamburg-Altona
Beschäftigung: Vollzeit
Arbeitsmodell: vor Ort
Gehalt: 4.300–4.900 € brutto/Monat
Einarbeitung: in der Regel 2–4 Monate

Wenn du einen sicheren und langfristigen Arbeitsplatz suchst, gerne mit Menschen sprichst und klare Abläufe und Zuständigkeiten schätzt, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung.

title: Kundenverantwortlicher (m/w) "Geldanlage" 80% - 100%
descriptionHtml:
Die Brevalia AG ist ein wachsendes Unternehmen, welches sich auf die individuelle und umfassende Beratung von in der Schweiz lebenden Privatpersonen fokussiert und dank seiner FINMA-Lizenz als Vermögensverwalterin agieren kann. Für den weiteren Ausbau wenden wir uns an eine sehr proaktive und gut vernetzte Persönlichkeit, welche die nächste Wachstumsphase der Firma mit verantworten will.

Aufgaben

Als Kundenverantwortliche/r beraten und betreuen Sie Ihre Kunden selbständig in den Themenbereichen der Geldanlage (Vermögensverwaltung und Anlageberatung inkl. Aktien, Obligationen, Fonds/ETF’s sowie Derivate/Strukturierte Produkte), deren Finanzierungsbedürfnissen (Hypotheken und Lombardkredite) und decken auch die Grundbedürfnisse bezüglich Vorsorge (keine Versicherungen) Steuern und Güter & Erbrecht ab. Sie koordinieren zusammen mit internen/externen Fachexperten die zeitgerechte, umfassende Bearbeitung der Kundenbedürfnisse aller Finanzthemen und sorgen damit für ein hochwertiges Beratungserlebnis. Eine Ihrer Hauptaufgaben wird die proaktive Neukundenakquisition sein, um Ihren Kundenstamm auf- und auszubauen. Dabei werden Sie vom Team unterstützt und Ihre Stellvertretung ist jederzeit sichergestellt.

Qualifikation

Sie sind seit mind. 5 Jahren als Kundenberater/in für Schweizer Kunden tätig, betreuen eigene Kunden und verfügen nach Ihrer Grundausbildung über mindestens einen Weiterbildungsabschluss (AZEK, CFA, MAS PB&WM, MAS Financial Consulting). Mit Ihrem Fachwissen und Ihrer kundenorientierten Art konnten Sie sich in den letzten Jahren bei Kunden wie auch Kollegen einen Namen als wissender Leistungsträger aufbauen und streben heute eine Position an, in welcher Sie Ihre Kontakte, Ihre Erfahrungen und Ihr Wissen einbringen können sowie in der Sie weiter gefördert werden. Zudem konnten Sie sich in den letzten Jahren über die proaktive Neukundenakquisition beweisen und verfügen über ein gutes Netzwerk, da Sie sich neben Ihrer beruflichen Tätigkeit in diversen Netzwerken persönlich engagieren. Sie wollen sich aktiv einbringen und Verantwortung übernehmen.

Benefits

Wir bieten Ihnen die Chance, dass Sie sich auf die umfassende Beratung und Betreuung konzentrieren und ohne Verkaufsziele, Mehrwert für Ihre Kunden schaffen können. Dazu bieten wir ein umfassendes Dienstleistungsangebot, viele Fachexperten und etablierte Beziehungen zu Partnerinstituten. Unsere moderne IT-Infrastruktur sowie unsere moderne Arbeitsweise unterstützten Sie in der Akquisition sowie in der Kundenbetreuung. Zudem können Sie jederzeit ortsunabhängig arbeiten. Sie arbeiten in einem spannenden Arbeitsumfeld in einem kleinen Team in welchem sehr persönlich und menschlich agiert wird. Der Wissenstransfer zwischen den Persönlichkeiten ist ein wichtiger Bestandteil unseres Angebots, um ein fruchtbares Klima zu schaffen. Sie erhalten die Chance, in einem kleinen Unternehmen sehr viel mitzugestalten, zu bewegen, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und sich weiterzuentwickeln. Ihr Arbeitsplatz in der Stadt Zürich ist nicht an starre Arbeitszeiten gekoppelt, wir leben eine Kultur des Vertrauens, der gegenseitigen Rücksichtnahme, der offenen Kommunikation und der Leistungsfokussierung.

Ihre persönlichen Ziele sind die Grundlagen der persönlichen Weiterentwicklung, welche wir laufend zusammen besprechen und in deren Erreichung wir Sie aktiv unterstützen.

title: KYC & AML Operations Manager (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Über Vestlane

Vestlane ist die Plattform für Onboarding, KYC/AML und Tax Compliance für Private-Market-Fonds. Fondsmanager und Fondsadministratoren in ganz Europa wickeln über Vestlane ihre KYC-, AML- und Zeichnungsprozesse ab, in über 14 Jurisdiktionen und über den gesamten Investor-Lifecycle hinweg. Wir sind zertifiziert und für die regulatorische Realität spannender Akronyme gebaut – von GwG, BaFin, AMLR, RTS, CSSF bis hin zu DORA, RAIF, AIFMD, MiFID uvm.

Du machst seit Jahren fundierte und pragmatische KYC- und AML-Arbeit und bist bereit, mehr zu verantworten, als die Karriereleiter über dir zulässt? Du möchtest mit modernen Tools und KI am Puls der Zeit in einem dynamischen Team arbeiten? Dann ist diese Rolle für dich!

“KYC/AML Services” ist Vestlanes jüngstes Team, das die operative KYC- und AML-Arbeit für Fonds- und Asset Manager-Kunden in Deutschland, Großbritannien und Luxemburg erbringt. Du arbeitest direkt mit unserem Head of KYC & AML Operations zusammen und übernimmst echte Verantwortung ab Tag eins und hast direkten Investoren- und Kundenkontakt. Deinen Entwicklungspfad gestaltest du aktiv mit, erfolgsabhängig, statt getrieben vom nächsten Beförderungszyklus.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Investorenakten von A bis Z: Du führst KYC-Prüfungen, Risikobewertungen und Enhanced Due Diligence für Investoren und Assets in Fondsstrukturen in Deutschland, Großbritannien und Luxemburg durch – mithilfe unserer KI-gestützten, digitalen Plattform.

  • Screening-Treffer bearbeiten: Du bewertest und dokumentierst Treffer aus Namens-, Sanktions- und Adverse-Media-Screening und bereitest klare, entscheidungsreife Bewertungen vor – mithilfe nativer KI-Agenten.

  • Geldwäschebeauftragte der Kunden unterstützen: Du erstellst Eskalationsvermerke und Reportings, damit Geldwäschebeauftragte und Responsables du Contrôle unserer Kunden auf solider Grundlage entscheiden können.

  • Die Maschine mitbauen: Du wirkst an Policies, Checklisten, QA-Standards und Tooling unserer Abteilung aktiv mit. Du hinterfragst kritisch, denkst Prozesse neu. Du willst KYC/AML als Geschäftschance verstehen und nicht als Last.

  • Das Produkt verbessern: Du zeigst auf, wo die Vestlane-Plattform KYC-Arbeit schneller und sicherer machen kann, und setzt das gemeinsam mit unserem Produktteam um.

Dein Profil

  • Mindestens 3 Jahre operative KYC/AML- oder vergleichbare Erfahrung, etwa bei einer Big-4- oder Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaft, einem Fondsadministrator, einer KYC/AML-Beratung oder in der AML-Funktion eines Fonds oder Finanzinstituts.

  • Sichere Kenntnisse des deutschen und des Luxemburger Rechtsrahmens: GwG und BaFin-Auslegungspraxis auf der einen Seite, CSSF-Anforderungen und das Luxemburger AML-Gesetz auf der anderen. Du kennst beide Welten und weißt, wo sie sich unterscheiden. UK-Erfahrung ist ein Plus.

  • Erfahrung mit Fondsstrukturen und ihren Investoren (Institutionelle Anleger, Gesellschaften, Trusts, verschachtelte UBO-Ketten). Private-Markets-Erfahrung ist ein starkes Plus.

  • Zertifizierungen (z. B. ACAMS, ICA) sind willkommen, keine Voraussetzung.

  • Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und Englisch. Französisch hilft in Luxemburg, ist aber keine Bedingung.

  • Präzision und Urteilsvermögen: Du dokumentierst sauber, eskalierst im richtigen Moment und willst, dass deine Arbeit jeder Prüfung standhält. Gleichzeitig bist du pragmatisch, du weißt, dass Risiko aus “Impact” und “Likelihood” besteht.

  • Du siehst dich als Unternehmer innerhalb von Vestlane, nicht als reiner Checklisten-Abhaker. Du willst heute Verantwortung und morgen Führung, und du willst dir beides erarbeiten, indem du etwas aufbaust.

Benefits bei Vestlane

  • Teammitglied mit klarem Entwicklungspfad, wenn der Kundenstamm wächst

  • Direkter Kundenkontakt ab Tag eins, keine fünf Ebenen zwischen dir und den Menschen, für die deine Arbeit zählt

  • Kompetitives Gehaltspaket

  • 30 Tage Urlaub

  • Bezahlte Weiterbildungen und Zertifizierungen (z. B. ACAMS, ICA)

  • Büro in Bonn

  • Flexiblen Arbeitszeiten und Home-Office-Regelungen

  • Ein Team, das Compliance ernst nimmt, weil Compliance das Produkt ist, kein Kostenfaktor

Abschluss

Wir freuen uns auf deinen Lebenslauf und ein aussagekräftiges Anschreiben. Wir prüfen deine Bewerbung persönlich und melden uns innerhalb von zwei Wochen.

Der Prozess ist bewusst kurz und hat drei Schritte: ein 30-minütiges Kennenlerngespräch, in dem es um dich, deinen Weg und die Frage geht, ob wir zueinander passen. Dann ein 45-minütiger Termin mit einer praktischen Aufgabe aus dem echten Alltag der Abteilung, damit du siehst, was dich erwartet, und wir sehen, wie du arbeitest. Zum Abschluss ein 30-minütiges Gespräch mit der Geschäftsführung. Insgesamt weniger als zwei Stunden deiner Zeit, und du bekommst nach jedem Schritt zeitnah Rückmeldung.

title: Lead Product Manager - Business Lines
descriptionHtml:
At Joko, our mission is to we help consumers save time and money when shopping online or in-store.

Founded in Paris, Joko is a tech company and certified B Corp with over 120 talents across Paris, Barcelona, and New York (and beyond). More than 7 million users already save money every day at 10,000+ merchants with Joko.

From cashback and automatic coupons to price alerts, we've kept expanding our products to make shopping smarter. Today, Joko is an AI shopping app: with Juno, our shopping assistant, users can find the right product at the best price in only a few seconds, with recommendations that get sharper the more they use it.

Having reached profitability in our core market, we’re now scaling globally, with a strong focus on the US.

It’s still day 1, come build the future of shopping with us!

📱 Our Product Team

Led by Fabien, our VP Product, Joko's Product team groups the passionate individuals behind our users' delight! From brainstorming to development to launch, the Product team's main mission is to turn ideas into reality by working hand-in-hand with the Engineering, Design, and Business teams.

Joko is organized into four product tribes, each owning a key dimension of the company's value:

  • Business lines owns the current core value proposition, covering online shopping, in-store experiences, and gift cards, each run as a dedicated team.

  • Scale focuses on growing and amplifying this value through growth, international expansion, and shared core user experiences across the app.

  • Juno builds the next value proposition: an AI shopping assistant that finds the right product at the best price in seconds, backed by a universal catalog of what merchants actually sell.

  • AI Platform helps Joko become a state-of-the-art AI company from the inside, owning the internal agent infrastructure, automation layer, internal tools, infrastructure, compliance, security and operational scalability.

💲The Business Lines tribe

Business Lines owns Joko's current revenue engine across three product lines, each run by a dedicated task force:

  • 🌐 Online, Joko's historical core, covers the app, web app and browser extensions. Its challenge is to make sure users discover the right offers, clicks are tracked, purchases are attributed, commissions are approved, and cash back lands reliably.

  • 💳 In-Store owns card-linked offers, where users link their bank card and earn cash back when they pay at partner merchants in physical stores. It is a very different product line, closer to banking, payment integrations and merchant operations.

  • 🎁 Gift Cards lets users buy or earn gift cards from a catalog of brands, and already represents a significant and fast-growing share of company revenue.

Across these scopes, the tribe works on hard, high-impact product problems: improving catch and track rates, reducing funnel leaks, adapting to privacy and browser changes, strengthening payment and affiliate flows, and creating better customer experiences.

🎯 What you will do

As Lead Product Manager for the Business Lines tribe, your mission is to grow and strengthen the revenue Joko runs on today, across Online, In-Store and Gift Cards. You will report to Fabien, our VP Product, lead the Product Managers who own each task force, and personally take the calls that cut across them.

  • Set the tribe's strategy: You will arbitrate between three task forces with very different mechanics and very different economics, decide where the next engineer and the next euro go, and defend those trade-offs in front of leadership.

  • Own the revenue chain end to end: Catch rate and track rate decide whether a purchase becomes revenue, and a fraction of a point there is worth hundreds of thousands of euros a year. You will make sure the tribe knows exactly where the chain leaks, sizes each lever properly, and prioritises accordingly.

  • Go deep where it matters: Affiliate tracking and attribution, card-linked payment integrations, checkout and coupon flows. You will not be the PM writing every spec, but you will be expected to understand these mechanics well enough to challenge a diagnosis and make the final call.

  • Champion the user experience: You will stay close to user needs and pain points across each business line, and make sure the tribe turns them into dedicated features, sharp product improvements and astonishing customer experiences.

  • Navigate the structural challenges: Privacy regulation, browser tracking restrictions, payment ecosystem changes and last-click competition keep changing the rules. You will build the product strategy that keeps the business healthy as conditions shift, rather than reacting to each change as it lands.

  • Lead and grow the PMs: You will manage and mentor the Product Managers on Online, In-Store and Gift Cards, set the bar on funnel analysis, experimentation and delivery, and grow people who can own a revenue stream on their own.

  • Define what healthy looks like: You will set the metrics that matter for each business line, hold the tribe to them, and be accountable for the tribe's contribution to company revenue.

  • Work across the company: You will partner with the B2B teams who own merchant relationships, with Care on the user pain that untracked transactions create, with Data, and directly with the affiliate and payment partners themselves.

👀 Who we're looking for

  • Experience: You have 5+ years of experience in Product, including experience leading or mentoring other Product Managers, ideally on consumer products. Experience in e-commerce, marketplaces, payments, adtech or affiliate marketing is a strong plus.

  • Data fluency: This is the criterion that carries the most weight here. You can interrogate a funnel yourself, break a metric into its components, and tell a real signal from noise. Much of this job is diagnosis before it is delivery, and you need to be able to do it yourself, not just ask for it.

  • Business sense: You think in revenue, margin and trade-offs. You can size a lever in euros before committing a team to it, and you are comfortable being accountable for a number in front of the exec team.

  • Management: You have a proven track record in people management. You know how to grow Product Managers, set a high bar for rigor, and give direction without taking every decision yourself.

  • Technical appetite: You want to understand how the tracking and the payment integrations actually work: browser behaviour, cookies, redirects, backend pipelines, card networks. Coding is not required, but you will be close to the mechanics every week.

  • Experimentation: You have run real A/B tests, you know how to design one that answers a question, and you can tell a team when theirs will not.

  • Stakeholder leadership: You are excellent at alignment, prioritization and saying no, with merchants, partners and internal teams alike.

  • Resilience: Much of this domain sits outside your control: browsers change, merchants change, regulation changes, competitors change. Problems that never fully close are what motivate you. If you are looking for a blank page and a 0-to-1 product, this is not that seat: this is a mature business with real revenue on the line every day.

  • AI fluency: You are hands-on with AI tools in your own product work. At Joko this is expected daily, across the whole company.

  • Location: Based in France or Spain.

  • Languages: Fluent in English, both written and spoken. French is a plus, but it is optional.

  • Mindset: You have an entrepreneurial mindset, you like challenges, you welcome feedback and you love constantly learning and getting better.

💎 Our perks

(Some of the benefits listed below are available to full-time positions only)

At Joko, we believe that flexibility and trust are essential. Our work environment reflects this through:

  • Flexible remote : If you live in Paris, you can choose to work from our office or from home with no constraints. If you live elsewhere, we can provide access to a coworking space and a coworking budget.

  • Work from anywhere : Want to spend a month in Italy while working? You can work from most countries in the world for up to 3 months per year.

On top of that, we offer plenty of perks:

  • 💸 Top-market compensation

  • 📈 Equity for everyone with the chance to own a piece of what you build

  • 🤖 Half-day each week dedicated to leveling up with AI by exploring new tools, iterating hard, and sharpening your skills

  • 🌴 Yearly offsite in amazing locations and budget for team-building events & monthly in-person gatherings

  • 💪 Contribution to your ClassPass subscription

  • 🍼 8-week leave paid 100% for the second parent

  • …and much more, check the full list here!

🤝 Our hiring process

  1. Intro call: Quick screening with the Hiring Manager or the Talent team.

  2. Step 1 – Team interview (45 min): Conversation with two Joko team members (could include the Hiring Manager, people from the team you’d join, or colleagues from other teams).

  3. Step 2 – Role-specific assessments

    • For non-engineering roles: A take-home case study followed by a 45-min interview. We assess both your output and how you think in real time. The exercise will be relevant to your role (e.g. analysis, strategy, or process design).

    • For engineering roles: A 90-min live technical interview on CoderPad covering code understanding, review, system design, and product thinking (with AI serving as a collaboration tool).

  4. Step 3 – Leadership interview (45 min): Conversation with a SteerCo member and a Founder.

  5. References: Up to 3 calls with former colleagues or managers.

☕ You may also be invited for coffee with team members to get a feel for our culture.

Compensation: €78.3K – €125.9K

title: MAIT Additive Manufacturing Materials Intern
descriptionHtml:

The ideal candidate will support the development and qualification of materials for additive manufacturing applications. This includes supporting material characterization campaigns, powder management, process parameter development, quality activities, and technical manufacturing documentation.

Role Overview

As a MAIT Additive Manufacturing Materials Intern, you will gain hands-on experience across the lifecycle of critical spaceflight hardware, from early development stages through qualification and production. You will support the development, characterization, qualification, and industrialization of materials for Laser Powder Bed Fusion (LPBF) technologies. You will contribute to material characterization campaigns, new alloy development, powder management, process parameter development, manufacturing documentation, and quality-related activities.

Working as part of the LPBF Team and closely in collaboration with the AM Operations Team, as well as Propulsion and Quality teams, you will help us advance our additive manufacturing capabilities and support the delivery of flight-ready components across TEC's propulsion, launch vehicle, and space systems programs.

  • Operate LPBF machines and associated equipment as required and following appropriate training.

  • Prepare structured build reports and material test data summaries, ensuring consistent documentation.

  • Support the creation and continuous improvement of work instructions, manufacturing procedures, qualification documentation, and standardized reporting templates.

Required Qualifications

  • Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Materials Science, Materials Engineering, Metallurgy, Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field.

  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

  • Ability to work effectively within multidisciplinary and international teams.

  • Fluent in English.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Completed a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Materials Science, Materials Engineering, Metallurgy, Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field.

title: Manager Design Engineer - Facilities (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
About us

We see the semiconductor industry as a realm of possibility. We see opportunity. We see the profound impact that our graphene solutions will have in transforming the industry. We invite you to join us in driving change with our fundamentally human-centered approach, uniting bright minds around a shared vision. The vision is: Prove to everybody that you can make a fundamental change. Prove with your knowledge and skills how things can be done differently. Together, we can change the paradigm of how the world connects

About our technology

The semiconductor industry’s growing demand for more powerful chips with higher bandwidth and lower power finds its solution in our technology. We connect chips to high-throughput, low-delay computing networks. The key lies in harnessing the physical properties of graphene to combine electronic computing with photonic communication, allowing countless chips to interact almost as if they were one. Our graphene photonic innovation increases computing power and efficiency to a new order of magnitude

In short, we connect chips to create powerful and energy-efficient networks, overcoming connectivity limitations in the semiconductor industry. We deliver the graphene solution

The Role

We are seeking an experienced Manager Design Engineer - Facilities (f/m/d) at Black Semiconductor to provide senior-level technical leadership in the design, modification, and commissioning of semiconductor manufacturing facility infrastructure. You will play a key role in bridging front-end design intent with construction execution, commissioning, and operational readiness, ensuring that facility infrastructure meets the requirements of our semiconductor manufacturing operations.

To join our team, you should be excited to

  • Lead the design, review, and validation of mechanical, electrical, and civil/structural systems for semiconductor manufacturing facilities.

  • Develop utility matrices, P&IDs, and single-line diagrams for equipment installations and tool hookups.

  • Coordinate with EPC contractors, A/E firms, and equipment OEMs to ensure design intent is met.

  • Support technology migrations, new tool installations, and brownfield modifications.

  • Develop detailed cost models and capital expenditure estimates for facility projects.

  • Provide technical direction and mentorship to junior and senior engineers.

Your Qualifications

  • At least 10 years of experience in semiconductor, advanced manufacturing, or mission-critical facility design, including a minimum of 5 years in a principal or senior technical leadership role.

  • Strong knowledge of mechanical and electrical plant systems, including low- and medium-voltage (LV/MV) systems, transformers, HVAC, exhaust systems, scrubbers, compressors, and cleanrooms.

  • Strong leadership skills, with the ability to provide technical direction and mentorship to engineers.

  • Fluent in both English and German, with excellent communication skills.

  • Basic knowledge of AutoCAD and Navisworks.

  • Proficiency in reading and preparing technical schematics, performing engineering calculations, interpreting blueprints, and understanding BMS software.

  • Experience in engineering project budget preparation, budget control, and energy cost evaluation and control.

  • Experience with FMEA and resilient design.

  • Professional registration with a recognized engineering body will be considered a plus.

Our work culture

People Over Processes. At Black Semiconductor, flexibility is key—we ensure work adapts to life, not the other way around. We champion work-life harmony, where careers are meaningful and enriching. Our processes are human-centric, allowing you to focus on what matters

Let’s grow together. Your potential is our priority. We provide the autonomy to make a lasting impact and nurture your growth through a culture of continuous learning. We invest in your journey for professional and personal development

Your Health and Future Matter. Your well-being is paramount. We offer a comprehensive benefits package with outstanding insurance, pension and virtual stock options for your mental, physical, and financial health. Your peace of mind is our priority - in the present and future

We Live Openness. Collaboration and inclusivity are the cornerstones of our culture. We practice openness, fostering trust and respect. Individuality is our collective strength, fueling innovation and driving us forward

We connect chips – and people. We encourage qualified individuals from any background to apply. We foster an inclusive and supportive work environment that values collaboration, innovation, and growth. Join our team and be part of an organization dedicated to making a difference in the industry
