descriptionHtml:
Who/What is Artefact?
Artefact is a next-generation strategy and data consulting firm dedicated to transforming organizations through data and AI. We combine the rigor of top-tier strategy consulting with deep expertise in data, digital, and analytics to help clients achieve tangible
business impact.
With 1,800+ consultants, data scientists, and engineers across 23 countries, we work with global leaders such as Samsung, L’Oréal, Orange, and Sanofi. Cross-dimension optimization and trade-offs
  • Orchestrate decisions across make, buy and customization options, weighing capex against opex and total cost of ownership.
  • Assess the impact of tool and architecture choices on vendor lock-in, performance, latency, scalability, security and compliance.
  • Translate these trade-offs into clear recommendations that business and IT leaders can act on.
Team and stakeholder leadership
  • Guide development teams technically: set the architecture, review solutions and unblock delivery.
  • Present solutions and recommendations to C-level audiences.
  • Run technical and strategic workshops independently, from discovery to design and prioritization.
  • Coach and develop consultants and architects in the team.

  • At least 8 years of professional experience in IT.

Technical and functional skills:
  • GenAI architectures: RAG, agentic and multi-agent patterns, LLMOps, model evaluation, guardrails and responsible AI.
  • Agent protocols and copilots: MCP, A2A, Microsoft Copilot and Copilot Studio, custom assistants and their integration with enterprise systems.

What we offer:

  • International projects on GenAI, agentic systems and support function transformation.
  • A growth path towards senior programme and practice leadership roles.
  • Location and working model: (Hybrid) Zurich or Lausanne.
  • Highly competitive compensation package.

This position is based in Zürich.

title: Médecin Généraliste - Alan Précision 🩸
descriptionHtml:
🐻 Qui est Alan ?

En France, des millions de personnes renoncent aux soins faute de temps, d'accès ou de moyens. Alan est né pour changer ça — en combinant assurance santé et clinique virtuelle dans une seule application pour devenir un vrai partenaire santé.

La Clinique Alan réunit plus de 120 professionnels de santé disponibles 7j/7 : médecins généralistes, sages-femmes, psychologues, kinésithérapeutes, dermatologues, pédiatres, nutritionnistes, infirmières puéricultrices.

Nos membres bénéficient d'une prise en charge véritablement intégrée :

  • 🩺 Téléconsultation vidéo : pour les situations qui nécessitent une consultation médicale en direct

  • 💬 Chat médical : conseils de professionnels de santé, 7j/7, réponse en moins de 30 minutes

  • 🤖 Mo, notre compagnon santé IA : répond instantanément aux questions du quotidien, avec des réponses relues et validées par nos médecins

  • 🎯 Des programmes de prévention (mal de dos, gestion du stress) : guidés et personnalisés

  • 🧘 Alan Play : une approche ludique de la prévention autour de l'activité physique, du bien-être mental et de la cohésion d'équipe

🩸 Qu’est-ce qu’Alan Précision ?

Il s’agit de notre tout nouveau programme de prévention ; un service de santé préventive avancée, à la croisée de la médecine de précision, de la biologie et du mode de vie.

Le constat : en France, il y a environ 12 ans d’écart entre l’espérance de vie et l’espérance de vie en bonne santé, et plus de la moitié des maladies chroniques sont évitables. Plutôt que d’attendre les symptômes, nous repérons les signaux biologiques précoces et nous les traduisons en actions concrètes.

Le service repose sur trois briques :

  • 💉 Un bilan sanguin de plus de 80 biomarqueurs et ratios, réalisé dans plus de 300 laboratoires partenaires. Il couvre le cardiovasculaire (ApoB, Lp(a)…), le métabolisme (insuline, HOMA-IR, HbA1c), le foie, le rein, la thyroïde, l’inflammation (hs-CRP), les micronutriments et les hormones.

  • 💬 Un questionnaire d’environ 200 questions sur le mode de vie, les objectifs et les antécédents.

  • 🎯 Un rapport personnalisé généré par IA et validé par nos médecins, qui contient l’analyse de chaque biomarqueur en contexte, un Score de Santé, un Âge Biologique, des recommandations sur le mode de vie et un plan d’action avec 3-5 objectifs prioritaires basés sur les grands “piliers” de la prévention (activité physique, nutrition, santé mentale, sommeil, …).

🔍 Ce que nous recherchons

Nous recrutons des médecins généralistes curieux de prévention et de médecine de précision, pour rejoindre le petit groupe de médecins qui relisent et valident les rapports Alan Précision.

  • ✅ Curieux(se) de ce que l’IA peut apporter à la pratique

  • ✅ Convaincu(e) que prévention et accompagnement changent vraiment la vie des patients

  • ✅ Un vrai intérêt pour la thématique et l'envie d'apprendre : un DU (nutrition, prévention…) est un plus, mais pas indispensable

  • ✅ Disponible au moins 4h par semaine (horaires flexibles)

  • ✅ Statut libéral

🧠 Votre rôle : le regard médical qui fait la différence

L’IA prépare, vous validez. Avant d’arriver chez le membre, chaque rapport passe entre vos mains : vous en êtes le garant médical, et c’est votre expertise qui en fait un rapport fiable et utile.

Concrètement, vous :

  • Relisez le rapport généré par l’IA et vérifier son exactitude médicale

  • Vous vous assurez que les interprétations collent au profil de la personne (âge, sexe, activité, habitudes)

  • Apportez la nuance que seul un médecin sait apporter :

    • un lien de causalité trop affirmatif (« est causé par » doit devenir « peut être lié à »)

    • une formulation anxiogène

    • une incohérence entre les sections du rapport

    • une recommandation qui ne correspond pas au profil

    • une supplémentation exotique ou mal étayée

  • Êtes le filet de sécurité : vous bloquez et faites remonter les situations qui sortent du cadre de la prévention (valeur critique, pathologie active suspectée, interaction médicamenteuse…)

  • Signalez les erreurs récurrentes de l’IA : vos corrections servent directement à améliorer les rapports suivants

A noter:

  • Vous n’écrivez pas les rapports, vous ne prescrivez pas, et vous n’échangez pas directement avec les utilisateurs. Les résultats biologiques arrivent automatiquement par MSSanté.

  • Tout se fait en asynchrone : pas de créneau fixe, pas de patient qui attend. Vous relisez les rapports quand vous voulez — le soir, entre deux consultations, le week-end.

  • Il s'agit donc d'une activité complémentaire idéale pour diversifier votre exercice, sans salle d’attente ni urgence.

     

🙌 Pourquoi rejoindre Alan ?

  • 🔬 Une thématique passionnante. Médecine de précision, biomarqueurs, prévention avancée qui associe biologie et mode de vie : une approche encore rare en France, que vous pratiquerez au quotidien. title: Medior / Senior Data Analyst
descriptionHtml:
SQL in BigQuery? Gesneden koek. Een dashboard in Looker Studio? Staat er zo. Maar jij wil meer. Je wil weten welk verhaal er achter de cijfers zit, en je vertelt dat verhaal net zo graag. Met een advies waar klanten en collega’s echt iets mee kunnen. AI zet je daarbij vanzelfsprekend in, om sneller en slimmer tot de kern te komen.

Wij zijn Follo: een snelgroeiend, award-winning digital agency (ontstaan uit de fusie van vier topbureaus) waar data de basis is onder alles wat we doen. Als Medior Data Analist werk je zelfstandig voor een eigen set klanten en projecten, samen met onze Data & Analytics Consultants en de specialisten in Search en Social. Je levert niet alleen de cijfers, je vertelt ook wat ze betekenen en wat er moet gebeuren.

Wat je gaat doen

  • Je analyseert data uit onder andere GA4, advertentieplatformen en CRM- en e-commercesystemen en ontdekt zo trends, kansen en knelpunten.

  • Je zet AI actief in om sneller patronen te herkennen, hypotheses te toetsen, SQL te schrijven en grote datasets te doorgronden, zonder je kritische blik op de uitkomsten te verliezen.

  • Je presenteert je bevindingen aan klanten en collega’s en vertaalt ze naar heldere, commerciële aanbevelingen. Je komt zelf met verbetervoorstellen voor marketing, meetopzet en businessprocessen, en kijkt verder dan de vraag.

  • Je schrijft SQL in BigQuery en bouwt aan schone, herbruikbare datamodellen (bijvoorbeeld in Dataform), zodat databronnen goed gekoppeld zijn en iedereen met dezelfde definities werkt.

  • Je ontwikkelt en onderhoudt overzichtelijke dashboards en rapportages in onder andere Looker Studio, en bepaalt mee welke KPI’s er echt toe doen en hoe je die het best visualiseert.

  • Je bewaakt de betrouwbaarheid van data, signaleert afwijkingen en spoort de oorzaak op, of die nu in de tracking, de koppeling of het model zit.

  • Je maakt terugkerend werk slimmer met automatisering en AI, en deelt je kennis met het team.

Wat je van ons mag verwachten

  • Een salaris tussen de €3.250 en €5.000, afhankelijk van je ervaring.

  • Een ambitieus team waarin verantwoordelijkheid en samenwerken voorop staan.

  • 26 vakantiedagen per jaar, met de mogelijkheid om er 5 bij te kopen.

  • Een eenmalig thuiswerkbudget tot €1.000 om je thuiswerkplek goed in te richten.

  • Een goed geregeld pensioen, zonder eigen bijdrage.

  • De vrijheid om hybride te werken, zodat jij het best tot je recht komt.

  • Interne kennissessies, events en brainstorms, van AI en automatisering tot data deep-dives.


Dit ben jij

Je bent een analist met oog voor detail die het grotere plaatje blijft zien. Je werkt gestructureerd, bent nieuwsgierig en vindt het leuk om complexe data begrijpelijk te maken voor anderen. Daarnaast herken je jezelf in het volgende:

  • Je hebt minimaal 2 jaar relevante werkervaring als data analist of in een vergelijkbare rol.

  • Je bent communicatief sterk: je legt een analyse net zo makkelijk uit aan een marketing manager als aan een developer, en je durft met een onderbouwd advies te komen.

  • Je beheerst SQL goed; ervaring met BigQuery is een grote pré.

  • Je hebt ruime ervaring met dashboarding in Looker Studio, Power BI of een vergelijkbare tool.

  • Je kent GA4 en begrijpt hoe online marketingdata tot stand komt. Ervaring met Google Tag Manager is een pré.

  • Je gebruikt AI al in je dagelijkse analysewerk, of hebt de sterke ambitie om dat te doen.

  • Kennis van Python of ervaring met Dataform of dbt is mooi meegenomen.

Waarom Follo?

Bij Follo is data geen bijproduct van marketing, maar het fundament eronder. Van Search en Social tot Marketplaces en CRO: elke strategie begint bij betrouwbare data en scherpe inzichten. AI is bij ons geen buzzword, maar onderdeel van hoe we dagelijks werken. Minder handwerk, meer tijd voor analyse, advies en impact.

  • Data als fundament: met de FolloEngine, ons eigen platform voor data intelligence, datakwaliteit en automatisering, start je met een voorsprong.

  • AI in je dagelijkse werk: je werkt met de nieuwste tools en technieken, van AI-gedreven analyse tot geautomatiseerde workflows.

  • Sterke merken, echte vraagstukken: jouw analyses sturen de beslissingen van ambitieuze adverteerders.

  • Werken aan internationale, award-waardige cases in een bureau met Europese ambities.

Zin om bij Follo te werken?

title: Meewerkstage Architectuur
descriptionHtml:
Jouw impact bij Movares

Jij draagt bij aan de gebouwde omgeving van de toekomst.

Dit ga je doen bij Movares

  • Je werkt mee aan publieke projecten zoals stations, transferia, fietsenstallingen, bruggen en utiliteitsbouw (nieuwbouw en transformaties).

  • Je ondersteunt het team met analyses, ontwerpen, visualisaties en presentaties.

  • Je draait inhoudelijk mee in het ontwerpproces en krijgt ruimte voor eigen initiatief.

Tijdens deze stage architectuur draai je mee in het ontwerpproces van studioSK, het ontwerplabel van Movares. Samen met architecten en multidisciplinaire adviseurs werk je aan publieke projecten. Denk aan stations, bruggen, fietsenstallingen of mobiliteitshubs. Je onderzoekt locaties, werkt ontwerpen uit en presenteert ideeën. Daarbij krijg je ruimte om initiatief te nemen en bij te dragen aan projecten die zichtbaar zijn in Nederland.

Dit ben jij bij Movares

  • een hbo- of wo-opleiding in de richting van Bouwkunde, Architectuur of interieurarchitectuur;

  • je hebt de interesse om te werken in digitale tekenprogramma’s zoals Sketch-up, revit en Vectorworks;

  • je hebt ervaring met het Adobe pakket (illustrator/photoshop/indesign).

Een stage bij Movares is een kickstart van je carrière, en dat heeft verschillende redenen. Zo kun je erop rekenen dat de begeleiding door jouw stagebegeleider, je team én campus recruiter Sander op-en-top voor elkaar is. Daarnaast kom je terecht in een groep vol gelijkgestemden. Elk jaar verwelkomen we namelijk tussen de 30 en 40 stagiaires. Hen ontmoet je tijdens de maandelijkse bijeenkomsten van Movares Backstage, waar verbinden met anderen voorop staat. Soms gaan jullie samen lunchen of bezoeken jullie een project. Andere maanden staat er een inhoudelijke sessie op de planning en leer je bijvoorbeeld beter presenteren of adviseren.

En ook als lid van Young Movares, onze jongerenvereniging, staan er regelmatig leuke activiteiten in je agenda. Daarnaast kun je elke tweede dinsdag van de maand aanschuiven bij het Café van de Toekomst: een inspiratiesessie waarbij je samen met je collega’s wordt bijgepraat over onderwerpen en projecten die in onze organisatie spelen. En dat is nog niet alles: je kunt gebruikmaken van onze eigen Academy met ruim 3.000 verschillende leerlijnen, trainingen en e-learningmodules.

Dit krijg je bij Movares

Bij Movares werk je mee aan een uitdagende opdrachten met volop kansen om jezelf te ontwikkelen, een leuke en gezellige sfeer, een kijkje in de keuken van een toonaangevend advies- en ingenieursbureau, volop ruimte voor eigen initiatief en een goede begeleiding. De duur en startdatum zijn in overleg nader te bepalen. Verder krijg je:

  • een aantrekkelijke vergoeding van €550 op basis van een fulltime dienstverband;

  • ruimte voor het vinden van jouw ideale werk-privé-balans;

  • leuke collega’s en een stageplek in hartje Utrecht.

En er is méér. Want stagelopen bij Movares betekent ook:

  • bijdragen aan een schone wereld, omdat je stageloopt bij het eerste bedrijf in Nederland met een Zero Waste-certificaat;

  • lid worden van Young Movares, de jongerenvereniging waar je leert van én met andere jonge collega’s.

Jouw team bij Movares

StudioSK is een ontwerpstudio voor architectuur, stedenbouw en landschap. Ons team is een mix van ervaren ontwerpers en jong talent. In een creatieve werksfeer leveren wij verfrissende ontwerpen en inspirerende adviezen voor vaak complexe vraagstukken. Met architectuur, stedenbouw en landschap in één bureau overzien we de potenties van een locatie, de samenhang en het totale speelveld. We focussen op waardecreatie en leefkwaliteit voor een duurzame samenleving op weg naar een circulaire economie. Zie voor meer projecten: www.studiosk.nl.

title: Microsoft Fabric Analytics Engineer (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Sie haben schon einmal aus SAP-Auszügen und verstreuten Excel-Listen ein Datenmodell gebaut, mit dem ein Fachbereich wirklich arbeitet? Und Sie möchten Business Intelligence jetzt in einem Unternehmen von Anfang an aufbauen und Ihre Handschrift darin hinterlassen?

Über unseren Mandanten

Unser Mandant ist ein international tätiger Industriezulieferer der Mobilitätsbranche mit Hauptsitz im Großraum Kassel. Das Unternehmen wächst auf einer sehr soliden Auftragsbasis und macht BI und Analytics jetzt zu einem eigenen Thema.

Warum diese Rolle

Sie sind die erste Person, die BI und Analytics im Unternehmen verantwortet. Die Plattform ist gesetzt: Microsoft Fabric und Power BI, mit SAP als wichtigster Datenquelle. Die Datenbasis ist noch lückenhaft, und das Wissen über BI wächst in der Organisation gerade erst. Beides bauen Sie mit auf.

  • Weil Sie die BI-Landschaft von Anfang an prägen und Ihre Entscheidungen darin Bestand haben.

  • Weil Sie direkt an die IT-Leitung angebunden sind und Ihre Ergebnisse im ganzen Unternehmen sichtbar werden.

  • Weil in einer Aufbauphase Ausprobieren dazugehört und eine erfahrene IT-Leitung Ihnen dabei Rückhalt gibt.

Das sind Ihre Aufgaben

  • Sie bauen die BI-Landschaft auf Microsoft Fabric auf: Datenanbindung, vor allem aus SAP, Lakehouse oder Warehouse sowie Pipelines und Dataflows.

  • Sie entwickeln zentrale, wiederverwendbare Datenmodelle in Power BI, auf denen weitere Berichte aufsetzen.

  • Sie erstellen die ersten Basisberichte für die Fachbereiche.

  • Sie etablieren Report-Governance: Workspaces, zertifizierte Datenmodelle, Namenskonventionen, Berechtigungen und Deployment.

  • Sie machen Lücken in der Datenqualität sichtbar und bereinigen sie gemeinsam mit den Fachbereichen.

  • Sie nehmen Anforderungen auf, holen die Beteiligten an einen Tisch und setzen Prioritäten.

  • Sie befähigen die Fachbereiche zu Self-Service mit klaren Leitplanken und zeigen den Kolleginnen und Kollegen, wie man einen Bereich und eine Analyse strukturiert.

Zur Einordnung: Ihr Schwerpunkt liegt auf Analytics und Engineering, also auf Datenanbindung, Datenmodellen, Berichten und Governance. Sie setzen selbst um und klären die Anforderungen direkt mit den Fachbereichen. Data Science und Machine Learning spielen in dieser Aufbauphase eine Nebenrolle.

Das bringen Sie mit

  • Ein Studium der (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, Mathematik, Statistik oder Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit entsprechender Berufserfahrung

  • Fundierte Praxis mit Power BI aus zwei bis drei Jahren oder mehr: Power Query, DAX und Datenmodellierung

  • Erste Erfahrung mit Microsoft Fabric, etwa mit Lakehouse, Data Factory oder Dataflows Gen2, sowie sicherer Umgang mit SQL

  • Erfahrung im Auf- oder Ausbau von BI-Lösungen im eigenen Unternehmen, gern auch als einzige Person für das Thema in einem kleineren Haus

  • Freude daran, mit Fachbereichen Anforderungen zu klären und Wissen weiterzugeben

  • Sehr gutes Deutsch und gutes Englisch für die Zusammenarbeit mit den internationalen Standorten

  • Von Vorteil: Verständnis von SAP-Daten (ECC oder S/4HANA) sowie Zertifizierungen wie PL-300, DP-600 oder DP-700

Das erwartet Sie

  • Eine Fachrolle mit voller Verantwortung für Ihr Thema und kurze Entscheidungswege

  • Arbeitsplatz im Großraum Kassel: Die Rolle lebt vom direkten Austausch, deshalb arbeiten Sie überwiegend vor Ort. Eintritt ab Anfang 2027.

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und 30 Tage Urlaub

  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket, Bikeleasing und Weiterbildung, zum Beispiel für Microsoft-Zertifizierungen

descriptionHtml:
About Dust

Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it.

With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done.

With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast.

We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026.

Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50.

The role

We’re hiring a Sales Leader to build Dust’s go-to-market presence across French Mid-Market and SMB customers. This is an opportunity to shape how we reach and grow a broad range of businesses, from developing an efficient sales motion to helping customers see value quickly and expand over time.

You’ll act as the business lead for the segment, with accountability for revenue. You’ll lead and coach the sales team, stay close to customers and deals, and build a repeatable approach that balances efficient execution with the different needs of SMB and Mid-Market customers.

You’ll also coordinate the teams that support pipeline generation, sales, and customer growth. Working closely with BDR, Growth, Field Marketing, Partnerships, Revenue Operations, Solutions Engineering, Deployment, and Customer Success, you’ll focus resources on the channels and activities that can best support the segment’s goals.

What you’ll do

  • Lead, coach, and grow the sales team for the Mid-Market and SMB segment, including hiring, performance, and day-to-day execution.

  • Own the segment’s ARR plan, forecast, and qualified pipeline. Set priorities with the CRO, review progress, and address gaps early.

  • Define and refine the sales approach for SMB and Mid-Market customers, adapting qualification, messaging, and deal support to each customer’s needs.

  • Build an efficient path from target account and first conversation through qualification, evaluation, close, handoff, and expansion.

  • Coach sellers on discovery, value-based selling, pipeline discipline, and helping customers make decisions with confidence.

  • Make clear, evidence-based recommendations to Product based on customer conversations, deal patterns, and segment needs.

  • Work with BDR and Growth leaders to build qualified pipeline through targeted outbound and other relevant channels.

  • Partner with Field Marketing to prioritize campaigns, events, customer advocacy, and community programs that support pipeline and revenue goals. Work within the marketing leadership’s standards and methods, and ensure programs are well executed and measured.

  • Set direction for how Partnerships can support segment priorities, working with the Partnerships lead on relevant sourcing, co-selling, and delivery opportunities.

  • Coordinate with Solutions Engineering, Deployment, Professional Services, and Customer Success to support effective evaluations, smooth implementations, adoption, and expansion.

  • Share market learning with the CRO and other segment leads, helping Dust develop a coherent France go-to-market approach.

What we’re looking for

  • A proven B2B software sales professional who has grown from individual contributor into people leadership, with 5+ years leading sales teams and a hands-on understanding of how to help sellers succeed.

  • Experience selling to SMB and Mid-Market customers, with the judgment to adapt the sales motion to different deal sizes, buying processes, and customer needs.

  • A track record of owning a segment or market revenue number end to end and building pipeline through functions you did not directly manage.

  • Experience coaching sellers, building a reliable forecast, and creating consistent sales practices.

  • Good commercial judgment about where to focus team capacity and budget, including how direct sales, marketing, and partners can support growth.

  • Strong collaboration skills across BDR, Growth, Field Marketing, Partnerships, RevOps, and post-sales teams.

  • High EQ, clear communication, and a supportive but accountable leadership style.

  • Comfort building repeatable sales practices in a scaling organization. French fluency and strong working English are important.

What success looks like

The Mid-Market and SMB segment has clear sales ownership, a focused pipeline, and progress against its ARR goals. Sellers are well coached and can execute an efficient, repeatable motion suited to their customers. Cross-functional support is aligned to segment priorities, and learning from customers and deals helps Dust improve how it serves and grows SMB and Mid-Market accounts in France.

Location

We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together.

We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect.

That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call.

Why Dust

The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves.

We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast.

If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk.

Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.

Learn how we think and work.

  • Our product constitution, a story about our mission

  • Your Next Co-Worker Isn’t Human, Stanislas Polu, VivaTech 2026. A conversation about AI agents taking on larger parts of work and how teams collaborate with them.

  • Dust: Gabriel Hubert on Enterprise AI, Gabriel Hubert, Nasdaq, published May 7, 2026. On Dust’s approach to enterprise AI and building the company in Europe.

title: Mitarbeiter / Leiter (w|m|d) interne Qualitätssicherung Wirtschaftsprüfung – Vollzeit oder Teilzeit
descriptionHtml:
Der Verband Sächsischer Wohnungsgenossenschaften e. V. (VSWG) ist gesetzlicher Prüfungsverband sowie Fach- und Interessenverband der sächsischen Wohnungsgenossenschaften. In den Bereichen Prüfung, Beratung, Weiterbildung und Interessenvertretung begleitet der VSWG seine Mitgliedsgenossenschaften.

Mit Genauigkeit für geprüfte Qualität

Als Mitarbeiter / Leiter (w/m/d) übernehmen Sie eine wichtige Rolle in der internen auftragsbezogenen Qualitätssicherung der Wirtschaftsprüfung. Genauigkeit, Struktur und fachliche Tiefe prägen dabei Ihren Arbeitsalltag. Ihre Tätigkeit umfasst insbesondere die formelle und materielle Berichtskritik:

  • Sie prüfen Prüfungsberichte auf Zahlenkonsistenz, inhaltliche Plausibilität und sprachliche Korrektheit und berücksichtigen dabei interne Qualitätsstandards und Fristen.

  • Sie stellen die formelle und fachliche Richtigkeit sowie die Vollständigkeit der Berichte sicher.

  • Tabellen und Texte kontrollieren Sie auf rechnerische und orthografische Korrektheit.

  • Hinweise auf mögliche Bilanzierungsfehler identifizieren Sie und geben diese entsprechend weiter.

  • Sie pflegen Berichtsdateien, bereiten diese vor und übernehmen die finale Aufbereitung.

Zudem wirken Sie an der Fortentwicklung, Durchsetzung und Überwachung des gemäß § 55b WPO bestehenden internen Qualitätssicherungssystems mit.


Fachliches Know-how trifft auf sorgfältiges Arbeiten

Für die Berichtsprüfung und Berichtskritik bringen Sie ein gutes Verständnis für Zahlen und Zusammenhänge mit. Eine strukturierte und präzise Arbeitsweise bildet die Grundlage für Ihre Tätigkeit.

  • Strukturierte, sorgfältige und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise

  • Hohes Maß an Diskretion und Vertrauenswürdigkeit

  • Sicherer Umgang mit MS Office, insbesondere Word, Excel und Outlook, sowie mit gängigen Videokonferenz-Tools

Rahmenbedingungen für Ihre berufliche Entwicklung

Beim VSWG verbinden sich fachliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten mit Rahmenbedingungen, die die Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Privatleben unterstützen.

title: ML Ops Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Our ML teams build and optimize the models at the core of our autonomy stack. As a team scales, the workflow the models run on needs to move from a manual, organically grown setup onto a controlled, automated, and reproducible footing.

As an MLOps Engineer, operating out of Paris, Lausanne, or Zurich, you will own that machinery, across training and evaluation pipelines, CI, experiment tracking, and reproducibility, so that models are trained, benchmarked, and compared in a controlled and repeatable way. You free the modelers to focus on models rather than infrastructure, and you set the standard the team builds on.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Training & Evaluation Pipelines: Build and maintain the reproducible training and evaluation pipelines the modelers run on, along with the pipeline templates and tooling they build on. The verdict on model quality stays with the modelers.

  • CI & Reproducibility: Bring CI to ML work and make runs genuinely comparable across code, config, and models.

  • Model Registry: Maintain a model lifecycle registry, from sandbox to production.

  • Experiment Tracking & Logging: Keep results comparable and traceable across the team.

  • Test Automation: Help wire on-device and hardware-in-the-loop test runs into automation and collect the results.

CANDIDATE REQUIREMENTS

  • Educational Background: A degree in a STEM field, or equivalent practical experience. Practical pipeline, CI, and reproducibility experience matters more than the specific degree.

  • MLOps Experience: Built and maintained ML pipelines, CI, and experiment tracking in a real production or research setting, ideally taking a manual flow and making it controlled and reproducible.

  • Engineering: Strong in Python and software engineering for infrastructure.

  • Bonus: Experience wiring pipelines to on-device or hardware-in-the-loop testing.

  • Attributes: Systematic, reliability-minded, and service-oriented so the team is enabled, pragmatic, and good at reducing friction.

  • Commitment: 100% dedication to Harmattan AI's mission of providing a defensive edge to allied nations through ethical, high-impact technology.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

title: Mobile Paid User Acquisition Manager (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
Are you fascinated by performance marketing and can't wait to open your laptop in the morning to see how your latest ad campaign is performing? Do you eat Lookalikes for breakfast and drink coffee with CPAs? Then keep reading!

About REPLUG

REPLUG is a Mobile Revenue Growth partner that helps companies turn mobile into a measurable driver of revenue, customer value, and long-term business growth.

From global app publishers to established brands looking to unlock more value from mobile, we partner with companies that want to grow more efficiently, reduce dependency on saturated acquisition channels, and build sustainable growth.

Our work combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution across App Store Optimization, Paid User Acquisition, CRM, measurement, and mobile growth consulting.

REPLUG is looking for an experienced Mobile Paid User Acquisition Manager (m/f/d), eager to take the next steps in their mobile marketing career working in a fast-growing international agency.

You will have the opportunity to deepen your knowledge of mobile paid user acquisition, working alongside top industry specialists, launching, scaling, and optimizing mobile performance campaigns for our clients' portfolio, from subscription apps to mobile games.

Your responsibilities

  • Setting up and managing performance advertising campaigns on major Paid Social Media platforms (Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, Snapchat, TikTok, etc.).

  • Setting up and managing campaigns on Google Ads and Apple Search Ads

  • Managing and analyzing campaigns on main Mobile DSPs (Applovin, Moloco, Mintegral, Kayzen, Unity, etc).

  • Taking care of MMP (Mobile Measurement Partners) setup to ensure proper monitoring by our Mobile Paid User Acquisition team

  • Creation and updating of performance reports based on targeted KPIs on tools such as Google Sheet, Google Data Studio, Tableau, etc.

  • Continuous analysis and optimization of user acquisition and retargeting campaigns to achieve our clients' business goals.

  • Prepare creative briefs for our graphics team so that we always have new creative for campaigns.

  • Use UGC (user-generated content) tools to find the best creators to promote our clients' apps.

  • Exploring artificial intelligence tools to improve our creative production process and our advertising activities in general

  • Answer our clients' questions on campaigns, performance and setup independently, and explain why the numbers look the way they do.

  • Take responsibility for your accounts' targets and KPIs, flag early when we're at risk of missing them, and come with concrete proposals for what to do about it.

  • Consult with our clients on tracking & analytics topics such as SKAN, MMP, Attribution, etc.

Requirements

  • You have 3+ years of proven success in managing paid user acquisition channels for mobile applications

  • You have in-depth knowledge of the main Mobile Measurement Partners tools (Adjust, Appsflyer, Branch, Kochava, etc.) and know all about tracking and attribution

  • You know how to set up Apple's SKAd network

title: National Key Account Manager DIY (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:

Bei der Umsetzung deiner Kundenstrategien arbeitest du eng mit unserem Area Sales Management sowie den internen Teams aus Marketing, Produktmanagement und Supply Chain zusammen.

  • Du beobachtest Markt-, Wettbewerbs- und Sortimentsentwicklungen und identifizierst neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten.

  • Du analysierst Kundenpotenziale und entwickelst gezielte Strategien für die Gewinnung neuer Handelspartner.

  • Du bringst deine Marktkenntnis und dein Netzwerk aktiv in die Weiterentwicklung unserer Vertriebsstrategie ein.

  • Du berichtest regelmäßig an den Director Sales Deutschland und sorgst für Transparenz über Geschäftsentwicklung, Kundenpotenziale und Vertriebsmaßnahmen.

Das bringst du mit

Deine fachliche Qualifikation

  • Mehrjährige, erfolgreiche Berufserfahrung im Key Account Management des deutschen DIY-Handels.

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse.

  • Idealerweise bringst du Erfahrung bei einem Markenhersteller oder Lieferanten aus dem DIY-, Home-, Garden- oder Consumer-Electronics-Umfeld mit. Entscheidend ist nicht, dass du bereits exakt unsere Produktkategorien betreut hast, sondern dass du den deutschen DIY-Handel verstehst, über die richtigen Kontakte verfügst und nachweislich Geschäft entwickeln kannst.

Deine Persönlichkeit

title: Opto-Mechanical Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Job Overview

We are looking for an Opto-mechanical Engineer to join our Manufacturing team and play a critical role in the design, integration, and manufacturing of opto-mechanical systems for our photonic products. This role will sit at the intersection of mechanical design, optics, and manufacturing, helping us translate optical designs into robust, manufacturable hardware.

You will take ownership of designing and validating opto-mechanical assemblies, including mounts, and alignment structures for optical and photonic components. You will work closely with Hardware, and manufacturing engineering teams as well as vendors from across the world to ensure designs are optically sound, mechanically robust, and ready for scalable production.

This is a highly hands-on engineering role suited to someone comfortable moving between CAD design, optical modelling, and physical prototyping and testing. You will be expected to troubleshoot mechanical and optical integration issues, iterate on designs quickly, and help establish repeatable, production-ready opto-mechanical solutions. Fresh graduates with strong relevant project, internship, or academic experience are welcome to apply.

What you'll be doing

  • Design opto-mechanical components and assemblies (mounts, housings, brackets, alignment stages) using SolidWorks

  • Model and analyse optical systems and tolerances using Zemax

  • Translate optical design requirements into manufacturable mechanical designs

  • Perform tolerance analysis to ensure optical alignment and performance across manufacturing variation

  • Build and test prototypes to validate opto-mechanical designs against optical performance targets

  • Support fibre-to-chip and free-space alignment integration for photonic assemblies

  • Work closely with manufacturing team and vendors to ensure designs are suitable for production and assembly

  • Investigate and resolve mechanical or thermal issues affecting optical performance (e.g. misalignment, drift, stress-induced effects)

  • Create and maintain design documentation, drawings, and version-controlled files

  • Collaborate with suppliers on machining, coatings, and assembly processes

  • Support root cause analysis for opto-mechanical failures identified in test or field use

What we're looking for

  • Proficiency in SolidWorks for mechanical design and drafting (2+ years of hands-on experience)

  • Experience with Zemax or similar optical design/simulation software (2+ years of hands-on experience)

  • Solid understanding of optics fundamentals (alignment, tolerances, beam propagation, focusing)

  • Some industrial, internship, or substantial project experience in opto-mechanical, mechanical, or optical engineering

  • Ability to perform tolerance stack-up analysis for optical and mechanical systems

  • Comfortable working hands-on in laboratory and prototyping environments (hands-on lab /manufacturing experience)

  • Strong troubleshooting mindset with a practical, iterative approach to engineering

  • Ability to communicate clearly with cross-functional engineering teams

  • Able to travel to vendor sites to transfer knowledge and troubleshoot problems.

Even better if you have

  • Experience with photonic or semiconductor packaging and assembly

  • Familiarity with fibre alignment, free-space optics, or laser-based systems

  • Experience with thermal or structural analysis (FEA) as it relates to optical performance

  • Exposure to manufacturing or production environments

  • Understanding of Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing, and its application to precision optical assemblies

  • Familiarity with material selection for optical and thermal stability

We are open to candidates from Physics, Mechanical Engineering, Optical Engineering, or related technical disciplines. Fresh graduates with strong relevant experience through projects, internships, or research are encouraged to apply.

This is an opportunity to work on genuinely challenging problems across optics, mechanics, and manufacturing, with direct influence on how advanced AI hardware is designed and built.

You will also have access to cutting-edge equipment, collaborative engineering teams, and the chance to help shape opto-mechanical design capability from the ground up.

title: Organic & AI Search Manager
descriptionHtml:
What do we do?

Paddle offers digital product companies a completely different approach to their payment infrastructure. Instead of assembling and maintaining a complex stack of payments-related apps and services, we’re a Merchant of Record for our customers. That means we take away 100% of the pain of payment fragmentation. It’s faster, safer, cheaper, and, above all, way better.

We’re backed by investors including KKR, FTV Capital, Kindred, Notion, and 83North and serve over 10,000 software sellers in 245 territories globally.

 

The Role:

The way people find information is changing. Search now includes AI-generated answers, large language model (LLM) citations, and zero-click journeys. People often get an answer without visiting a website, so how a brand is understood and cited matters as much as where its pages rank.

We’re looking for an Organic & AI Search Manager to help Paddle show up well in those answers. You’ll shape how Paddle is understood, cited, and recommended by both people and machines. Ranking pages is part of that. Being cited and recommended is the rest. You’ll work across organic strategy, AI discoverability, and content, partnering closely with our Brand, product marketing (PMM), and Growth teams so the content we create is easy to find, trust, and surface in AI-generated answers.

Reporting to the Head of Web, you’ll connect the people who create content with the changing landscape of organic and AI-powered discovery. You’ll turn insight into strategy, and strategy into decisions.

You’ll also help move the work forward. You’ll help shape new content, and you’ll steer business-as-usual (BAU) updates, refreshes, and improvements that strengthen organic visibility, AI discoverability, and performance. Where it helps, you’ll draft first versions for review, using AI to speed that up. This is a broad role for someone who can move between spotting opportunities, making recommendations, and moving the work forward.

 

What you'll do:

  • Own Paddle’s organic and AI discoverability strategy, from brand awareness to category-level consideration, so we’re visible wherever our audience looks for answers

  • Audit our presence across traditional search, AI-generated responses, and LLM citation patterns, then build and maintain a prioritized roadmap based on the gaps

  • Turn organic and AI visibility data into clear content decisions for Brand, PMM, and Growth

  • Work with Creative, Social, and PR within Brand to structure, frame, and distribute content so search engines and LLMs can find and use it

  • Work with PMM to align messaging, terminology, and the topics we want Paddle to be known for, so we’re represented consistently wherever people look

  • Steer BAU content updates and refreshes, drafting first versions for review with the help of AI, and bring SEO and AEO input to new content

  • Define and track the metrics that show real discoverability (AI citation share, share of voice in LLM outputs, and organic visibility trends), and use them to create accountability across content functions

  • Link organic and AI visibility to commercial goals, and influence pipeline through the content and topics we prioritise

 

We'd love to hear from you if you:

  • Have a strong foundation in search engine optimisation (SEO), across technical, on-page, and off-page work, and are building expertise in AI and LLM discoverability, answer engine optimisation (AEO), or generative engine optimisation (GEO)

  • Understand how LLMs surface, cite, and recommend content, and have an informed view on how brands can influence that

  • Have experience working cross-functionally with content, brand, or product marketing teams, and have shaped and influenced how they work

  • Can steer content updates and produce a first draft for review, using AI to help

  • Are comfortable turning complex organic data and trends into clear direction for non-specialist stakeholders

  • Can connect organic performance to commercial outcomes such as pipeline, and explain the link to stakeholders

  • Can balance long-term strategic thinking with moving quickly and testing your hypotheses

  • Are curious about how information discovery is changing and have strong opinions on where it’s heading

 

Everyone is welcome at Paddle

At Paddle, we’re committed to removing invisible barriers, both for our customers and within our own teams. We recognise and celebrate that every Paddler is unique and we welcome every individual perspective. As an inclusive employer we don’t care if, or where, you studied, what you look like or where you’re from. We’re more interested in your craft, curiosity, passion for learning and what you’ll add to our culture. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t match every part of the job ad, especially if you’re part of an underrepresented group.

Please let us know if there’s anything we can do to better support you through the application process and in the workplace. We will do everything we can to support any accommodations needed. We’re committed to building a diverse team where everyone feels safe to be their authentic self. Let’s grow together.


Our Values

  • Paddle Together - “None of us, is as smart as all of us”

  • Paddle Simply - “Simple can be harder than complex: you have to get your thinking clean to make it simple”

  • Paddle for others - “We can realise our wildest dreams, so long as we help enough other people to realise theirs”

 

Why you’ll love working at Paddle

We are a diverse, growing group of Paddlers across the globe who pride ourselves on our transparent, collaborative and respectful culture.

We are a ‘digital-first’ company, which means you can work remotely, from one of our stylish hubs, or even a bit of both! We offer all team members unlimited holidays and 4 months paid family leave regardless of gender. We invest in learning and will help you with your personal development via constant exposure to new challenges, an annual learning fund, and regular internal and external training.

title: Partner Solutions Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Retire the ERP.

Light exists to replace factory-era ERPs with software that feels alive. Our AI-native financial platform gives modern, global companies automated accounting, real-time reporting and financial flows that move at the speed of the business. In a short time we've become the operating core for companies like Lovable, Legora and Keyshot.

The largest finance transformations don't start with a demo. They start with a Big 4 firm or a technology partner putting Light through its paces on behalf of their clients. Come help us win those rooms and make Light the global default for next-gen finance.

The role

TLDR: Be the technical lead when Big 4 firms and technology partners evaluate Light, and turn those evaluations into strategic enterprise deals.

Before a Deloitte, PwC, EY or KPMG practice recommends Light to its clients, or a tech vendor builds Light into its offering, they test us hard: scripted scenarios, self-paced proof-of-value windows, architecture and security reviews, then a readout to their partners. You run that cycle end to end. You'll work directly with our founders, Partnerships, Sales and Product, and as an early member of the team you'll write the playbook every future partner evaluation follows.

What you'll bring

  • 4+ years as a Solutions Engineer, Solutions Consultant or Pre-Sales lead for ERP or finance software (vendor side preferred), or in a Big 4 ERP / finance transformation practice.

  • Hands-on experience with at least one major ERP (NetSuite, SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics or Workday) and real implementation projects: data migration, integrations, APIs.

  • Genuinely AI-native. You've changed how you work because of AI tooling, not just added it to your workflow.

Bonus points

  • Ex-Big 4 (advisory or audit) and a qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, CPA or equivalent).

  • Exposure to IFRS and local GAAP across several European markets, and SOC 2 / ISO 27001 security reviews.

title: Patent Engineer (Life Sciences)
descriptionHtml:
The way companies innovate is broken. The systems built to create and protect ideas can’t keep up with the pace of change. Today, 90% of S&P 500 company value is intangible (e.g., in intellectual property) - yet R&D and IP teams spend half their time buried in manual work, sifting through patents and paperwork instead of pushing the frontier forward. The tools of creating and protecting are stuck in the past. We’re here to fix that.

Ankar is building the R&D tools for the AI era and defining what applied research will look like in the next 20 years. We’re building infrastructure and product experiences our customers rely on every day. You’ll translate messy, ambiguous problems into clean, dependable software—and you’ll do it at the cutting-edge of AI.

We’re at an inflection point:

  • We’ve raised >$24M to date from Tier-1 VCs like Atomico, Index Ventures, Norrsken, Daphni, and angels like the Founder of Hugging Face, CEO from Datadog, and Leaders from DeepMind and OpenAI.

  • We’re already working with the world’s most innovative companies including Fortune 500 company L’Oréal and global law firm Vorys

  • Expanding our world-class team with alumni from Palantir, Amazon, and BCG to tackle the $1T+ innovation market. We’re just getting started.

What you’ll be doing
We’re looking for a patent professional with deep large-molecule life sciences expertise who can bridge product development, engineering and IP protection. You’ll work hands-on with pharmaceutical and biotech customers to design AI-powered patent solutions that understand the nuances of biologics—including antibodies, proteins, peptides, nucleic acids, vaccines and cell and gene therapies—and the conventions that govern their patent protection.

  • Build life sciences-specific patent products: Partner with product and engineering teams to develop AI tools tailored to large-molecule patents—from protein and antibody sequence analysis to biologics claim generation, sequence-listing support and prior-art searching across life sciences databases.

  • Embed with pharmaceutical and biotech customers: Work directly with in-house patent counsel and prosecution teams to design, prototype and deploy high-value proofs of concept for large-molecule patent workflows.

  • Shape product development with biologics expertise: Translate complex large-molecule patent challenges into product requirements, ensuring our AI understands sequence data, CDR and epitope definitions, functional claim language, sequence variants, experimental data and biologics drafting conventions.

  • Drive customer success in large-molecule patents: Lead technical sessions with patent professionals to ensure our products deliver measurable value across biologics patent portfolios.

  • Identify emerging biologics patent opportunities: Recognize evolving needs across therapeutic antibodies, recombinant proteins, vaccines, nucleic acid technologies, cell and gene therapies, biologics formulations and regulatory IP strategy.

What we’re looking for

  • Large-molecule patent expertise: At least two years of experience in biologics patent prosecution, pharmaceutical or biotech IP, or other large-molecule-focused patent work, with a strong understanding of the patent lifecycle from invention disclosure through prosecution, grant and enforcement.

  • Technical life sciences foundation: Strong knowledge of molecular biology, biochemistry, immunology or a related discipline, including an understanding of protein and nucleic acid sequences, antibody structure and function, biologics development, and how these translate into patentable subject matter.

  • Strong biologics drafting skills: Experience developing claim strategies for antibodies, proteins, nucleic acids or other biologic modalities, with an understanding of written-description, enablement, sequence-listing and functional-claiming requirements.

  • Builder’s mindset: You thrive in ambiguity, iterate quickly on prototypes and enjoy creating order from complexity. You can move seamlessly between high-level patent strategy and detailed biologics claim construction.

  • Extreme ownership: You anticipate problems, take responsibility for outcomes and consistently deliver. This is how you grow—and how we win.

  • [Bonus points]: Experience at a patent law firm representing pharmaceutical or biotech clients; in-house patent counsel experience at a pharmaceutical or biotech company; expertise in emerging modalities such as antibody-drug conjugates, bispecific antibodies, RNA therapeutics or cell and gene therapies; or an advanced life sciences degree combined with patent training.

     
 

This role is not for you if...

  • You need a highly structured environment, a predefined playbook, regular working hours, or a schedule that never requires travel. We operate with high autonomy and ownership, expect our team to go above and beyond, be obsessed with our mission and thrive in ambiguity rather than wait for direction.

  • You prefer long planning cycles and certainty before acting. We move quickly, ship often, and adapt based on customer feedback and new information.

  • You want to manage the work rather than do the work. We're builders first, and everyone is expected to contribute directly to creating exceptional products.

  • You take it personally when ideas are challenged, priorities shift, or work gets redirected. We care more about finding the right answer than defending a particular one.

 

What we put behind our people

Building at the frontier takes exceptional people. We invest accordingly.

title: People Operations Lead (Fixed term Contract)
descriptionHtml:
About Flock

Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we're changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time.

We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK's leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We're growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we're hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead.

We're on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us!

About the role

You'll own the people engine room at Flock: the employee lifecycle, payroll input, benefits, the HRIS, the office and our in-person events. Your job is to design how a modern People function should work at a company where repetitive admin is automated out of existence and every process is simple, scalable and AI-native by default. You'll report to our Senior People Partner and work with everyone here, from a new joiner on day one to the CEO, who cares deeply about our culture. Please note this role is a 12-18 month fixed term contract.

What you'll be doing

People Operations

  • Own the full employee lifecycle: contracts, right-to-work, starter and leaver logistics, probations and changes. Shape the first day and first week alongside managers, delivering a strong employee experience across the lifecycle.

  • Be the first point of contact for people queries and audits. Own the People inbox and core HR templates, and drive every query to resolution.

  • Own the HRIS (HiBob) and people data: records, workflows, surveys and data integrity. Deliver monthly People reporting and metrics that spot and close gaps early.

  • Own payroll input end to end: collate, calculate and submit each month, including bonuses and comp changes. Manage the provider and partner with Finance on reporting and year-end.

  • Own benefits end to end as the main contact for providers, systems, data and employee advice, keeping policies and materials current.

  • Cut manual effort across the lifecycle by building AI-native workflows, so every routine people process is automated by default, then coach the business to use them. Own continuous improvement across People Ops.

  • Partner with IT on joiner and leaver access automation, and on cost and data audits.

Office Management & Socials

  • Run the office environment and vendor relationships, including routine upkeep like weekly snack orders and post. Cover health and safety as a trained First Aider and Fire Marshal, and provision hardware fast.

  • Own the company social calendar and rituals, from bi-weekly Flock o'Clock (working closely with the CEO) to quarterly Town Halls and larger events, keeping them engaging and on budget.

What you'll need

  • Hands-on People or HR Operations experience, ideally in a fast-moving scale-up, with real ownership of end-to-end processes. CIPD or equivalent experience required.

  • Hands-on payroll input and benefits administration. HiBob experience is a plus.

  • Strong HRIS skills across workflows, automations and integrations, plus confident data and spreadsheet ability.

  • Real evidence of building with AI: workflows or tools you've shipped and use, not ones you've only read about.

  • Exceptional organisation and judgement. You spot what needs doing and get ahead of it, you build the credibility that lets you influence without leaning on authority, and you treat confidential matters with discretion.

  • A quick, first-principles learner who is comfortable with pace, ambiguity and autonomy.

  • Working knowledge of UK employment law, compliance and people governance.

  • Low ego and high standards. You care most that the work is right and well run.

Benefits

  • 25 days of holiday (+ Bank Holidays) 🏖

  • Share Incentive Plan 📈

  • Workplace Pension 💰

  • Private Medical Insurance 🏥 (including Dental 🦷 Optical 👓 & Mental Health 💆‍♀️ support options)

  • Various Salary Sacrifice Schemes - Holiday Purchase, Tech, Gym, Cycle to Work, Electric Vehicle, Private Medical Insurance for families 💵

  • Enhanced Parental Leave and Pay 🐣

  • £1000 toward relevant professional qualifications 🎓

  • £500 per annum towards learning and development 🌱

  • 3 days paid leave for L&D purposes 🌻

We work hybrid, typically three days a week in our Central London office (fewer office days can be accommodated for longer commute times), a few minutes from Moorgate and Liverpool Street. Visits to client sites, conferences and broker offices count towards office days.

Making the world quantifiably safer takes more than good data. It takes a team where different perspectives are heard, and that's a priority here. We insure fleets and drivers from every background, and we know a team built the same way makes sharper decisions and a better product for our customers. So we hire on merit, full stop, and we actively encourage applications from everyone. If you don't tick every box, apply anyway. Just come as your genuine self: the qualities and experiences only you bring are exactly what we want.

title: People Tech & Analytics Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

As a People Tech & Analytics Engineer on the People team, you will build the systems, data pipelines, and automations behind how Mistral runs People Operations. Reporting to the People Tech & Analytics Lead, you will turn the roadmap into reality: wiring our HR tech stack together, making data flow reliably between systems, and automating people processes with third-party tools as well as Mistral's own models, agents, and APIs.

This is an individual contributor role for someone who loves building. You will spend most of your time in the systems and the data, deep-diving into problems: connecting HRIS, ATS, payroll, identity, and finance tools, standing up the data layer behind our people metrics, and shipping automations that remove manual work from the People team.

If you are a data engineer or people technology specialist who wants to deliver meaningful automation outcomes at Europe's largest AI company, this is the role for you.

What You Will Do

  • Build, maintain, and troubleshoot integrations and data pipelines across our HR systems (HRIS, ATS, payroll, identity and finance), run data quality checks, and fix inconsistencies at the source.

  • Implement and evolve the Metabase visualisation layer of our people data lake, build the dashboards and self-serve reporting managers and People partners rely on, and run hands-on analyses of workforce trends, retention and organisational health, supporting the move to conversational insights for leadership.

  • Design, build, test and document automated workflows, mainly with Mistral's own models, agents and APIs, with human review wherever decisions affect people, monitor live automations with alerting, error handling, logging and runbooks, and prototype AI use cases on people processes, productionising the ones that prove their worth.

  • Implement configuration changes across the HR tech stack (workflows, fields, roles and permissions, new countries and entities), support testing and rollout of system changes and integrations, and act as first-line troubleshooter for the People team, leading issue resolution through to production with a clear audit trail.

  • Architect end-to-end HR workflows with key stakeholders in HR Operations, Business Partnering and Reward, and implement data governance in practice: quality standards, access controls, retention rules and audit trails for employee data.

  • Provide clear enablement materials in Notion so the People team and managers can use our systems confidently, with strong tier-1 support via a bot.

What We're Looking For

  • Experience in data engineering, analytics engineering or HR technology, ideally within an HR or People function or working closely with one as a stakeholder.

  • Strong practical SQL and Python skills: you are comfortable building pipelines and transformations yourself.

  • Hands-on experience with HR systems such as Ashby, and integrating them with ATS, payroll, identity and finance tools via APIs, middleware and data pipelines.

  • Real automation experience: you have built and maintained workflows in n8n or similar tools such as Make, Zapier, Workato or Langdock, and you are excited to do the same with Mistral's own models and tooling.

  • Working experience with data warehousing (Snowflake, BigQuery) and the modern data stack (dbt or similar), and with visualisation tools such as Metabase, Looker, Tableau or Power BI.

  • You are low-ego and team-spirited, and you take a prioritised problem and run with it in ambiguity: you would rather build a first version and iterate than wait for a perfect spec. You start from the HR need, not the technology, stay hands-on, and have a track record of building foundations in growing organisations without creating legacy.

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

descriptionHtml:
The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

You'll own the creative engine behind one of iwoca's highest-growth channels. Your mission is to turn performance insights into a steady stream of ads that actually cut through in a category where most look the same, building the creative infrastructure that fuels scalable, measurable growth across Meta, TikTok, and beyond.

About iwoca

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don't wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that's as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science, and five-star customer service ensure business owners can act with the speed, confidence, and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We've already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The Team

The Direct Acquisition team at iwoca acquires customers profitably across paid and organic channels. Paid Social is one of our highest-growth channels - we've validated the opportunity, proven incrementality through conversion lift studies, and scaled from test budgets to six-figure monthly spend across Meta and TikTok.

Creative is the core growth lever for the channel. We've learnt that the ad is the targeting, that creator-led content significantly outperforms traditional UGC in funnel conversion, and that the gap between a good concept and a great one is the difference between breaking even and scaling aggressively. But we've also learnt that building a creative engine - sourcing creators, briefing agencies, managing production, and connecting it all to testing insights - is a full-time challenge that deserves dedicated, passionate ownership.

You'll work closely with a tight group of collaborators:

  • Paid Social Channel Lead: Sets strategy and manages performance.

  • Paid Social Executive; Launching/optimising campaigns and reporting performance/insights

  • Head of Brand: Shapes creative direction and ensures brand consistency.

  • In-house Designers: Produce statics and AI-assisted imagery.

  • External Partner Network: Includes UGC agencies, creator management platforms, and freelance video editors.

The Role

We need someone genuinely obsessed with what makes people stop scrolling, who understands social platforms intuitively because they live on them, and can translate that into a disciplined creative operation that delivers results.

Creative Vision and Strategy

  • Develop the creative roadmap for paid social, working with the channel owners to translate performance data, testing insights, and cultural trends into a pipeline of concepts across video, static, UGC, partnership ads, and emerging formats.

  • Work with the channel owners and brand team to shape creative direction for multiple products including our core flexi-loan and a new credit card ensuring each has a distinct identity that stands out in-feed.

  • Push beyond the generic stock imagery and safe messaging that dominates financial services. Find the concepts, formats, and creators that people actually notice.

  • Research & understand customers, translating insights into creative concepts.

  • Balance high-performing hooks with positioning iwoca as a mature, trustworthy lender.

Creative Production and Resource Management

  • Own the full production pipeline: concept through briefing, production, feedback, delivery, and asset management.

  • Build and manage a network of in-house designers, external UGC agencies, and a self-built roster of creators for partnership ads, who can speak authentically about business finance.

  • Manage contracts, usage rights, and production timelines across multiple concurrent projects, balancing quality with velocity.

  • Tie creator content to seasonal business moments such as stock purchasing ahead of peak trading seasons or year-end cash flow to maximise relevance.

Testing, Insights and Iteration

  • Work with the channel owners to build a creative testing framework connecting platform metrics such as hook rate, hold rate, CTR, and landing page conversion to commercial outcomes.

  • Turn monthly creative reviews into actionable briefs: what to iterate, what to retire, what to double down on.

Requirements

Essential

  • Proven track record producing paid social creative that drives measurable business outcomes, not just engagement.

  • Deep fluency with Meta and TikTok, understanding how algorithms reward creative, how formats perform differently, what makes content feel native.

  • Experience managing creative production across multiple formats and partners simultaneously.

  • Strong project & stakeholder management with a proven ability to source, brief, and manage creators or influencers, including negotiating usage rights and partnership arrangements.

  • Strong creative judgement paired with commercial discipline; ie. you can tell the difference between a concept that will perform and one that just looks good in a deck.

  • Social native. You live on these platforms. Understanding of performance marketing / paid social creative landscape and industry trends.

Nice to have

  • B2B or financial services paid social experience (or strong B2C analytical chops that transfer).

  • Hands-on video production or editing skills.

  • Experience with creator management platforms (e.g. Grin, CreatorIQ).

  • Familiarity with creative testing methodologies and connecting creative variables to conversion.

  • An existing network of creators, UGC producers, or freelance creative talent.

The culture

At iwoca, we prioritise a culture of learning, growth, and support, and invest in the development of our team members. We value thought and skill diversity, and encourage people to explore new areas of interest, adopt better tools – including AI – and apply sound judgement so our products and decisions improve over time.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A choice between a dedicated dental plan or a health cash plan that reimburses everyday medical expenses.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

title: Ph.D. Researcher. Knowledge Discovery: From Unstructured Data to Shared Cognitive Maps
descriptionHtml:
Constructor University in collaboration with Constructor Knowledge Labs and Constructor Technology

About the Position

The research group led by Prof. Dr. Andrey Ustyuzhanin at Constructor University, in collaboration with Constructor Knowledge Labs (CKL) and Constructor Technology (industry partner), invites applications for Ph.D. student positions in the field of Computer Science, with a focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML).

This PhD position is part of an initiative to advance knowledge representation and adaptive reasoning systems. The research will focus on developing flexible frameworks for actionable knowledge representation that support storage, retrieval, and dynamic adaptation of information across diverse tasks.

Key objectives include:

  • Transforming unstructured data into interactive knowledge graphs and personalized cognitive maps.
  • Designing models that provide interpretable, persistent, and navigable structures of knowledge.
  • Addressing challenges such as hierarchy, composability, and coarse-graining for robust, task-specific reasoning.
  • Exploring individual and community-level knowledge modeling, including personalized domain maps, profile extraction from artifacts (e.g., papers, courses), and cross-domain abstraction.

The overarching goal is to create systems that enable transparent, adaptive, and spatially intuitive representations of knowledge, supporting both individual users and collaborative communities.

Applicant Profile

Mandatory requirements:

  • Holding recognized MSc degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, AI, ML, or a related discipline.
  • Students holding BSc degree and exhibiting outstanding performance and extraordinary potential can apply for fast-track PhD.
  • Strong mathematical background supported with experience in defining and developing knowledge-graph or information retrieval systems.
  • Hands-on experience with large language models (LLMs) and their applications.
  • A track record of publications in AI/ML or related areas.

title: Photonic Integrated Circuit Designer Intern (H1/2027)
descriptionHtml:
About Quandela

Quandela stands as a global leader in quantum computing, driven by groundbreaking technology and a strategic vision for scaling quantum solutions. The company’s unique ability to offer both hardware and software solutions, along with its commitment to build energy efficient datacenters and scalability, positions it to play a key role in the next wave of innovation, and in many strategic and sovereign industrial sectors.

Join Us at the Forefront of Quantum Computing Innovation 🚀

Description of the Team

The internship will be conducted in the Photonic Integrated Circuits (PICs) department ofQuandela. The PICs team works on the production and development of the optical processors of Quandela quantum computers, having in mind performance and scalability.

In detail, the team members carry out electromagnetic and thermal simulations to estimate the performance of the integrated components, prepare PICs layouts to be fabricated in collaboration with external foundries, and take care of both the characterization and the packaging of the fabricated devices.

Your Key Responsibilities

Depending on your experience and the duration of the internship, your work may involve deepening the understanding of existing building blocks, exploring new functionalities or tools, or developing advanced modeling approaches for testing. In particular, the goal of this internship will be to either bridge the gap between fabrication and design, or to evaluate new architecture for quantum processing unit (QPU).

In this role you will be using standard electromagnetic simulations and/or circuit modelling by means of commercial software like Lumerical FDTD, FDE, EME or free-tools (gdsfactory, tidy3d, meow, sax..).

Requirements

  • Enrollment for the whole duration of the internship in a MSc in Physics, Telecom/Electronics Engineering, Photonics, Quantum Technologies or related fields. This position is only valid with an Internship Agreement.
