title: Pre-Sales Solution Consultant (People Analytics)
descriptionHtml:
Pre-Sales Solution Consultant (People Analytics)

Who We Are

One Model is seeking a passionate Pre-Sales Solutions Consultant to help us scale our market presence in EMEA and bridge the gap between deep HR data capability, Workforce Intelligence, AI Measurement and Transformation,  and strategic business value.

With customers and staff around the world, One Model offers a complete workforce intelligence platform along with a cutting-edge AI Impact evaluation tool.  Our products feature cloud-hosted data orchestration and advanced visualization and analytics tools all controllable via AI interfaces. Our platforms enable companies to unlock the real value of their HR and AI usage  data from the lens of the workforce.

This isn't your standard, script-reading sales demonstration role. We aren't looking for a "demo expert" who only knows which buttons to click, nor are we looking for someone with extensive People Analytics or HR experience.

The ideal fit: You are a proven pre-sales consultant who loves being a part of the sales process. You are eager to learn about HR, Workforce Intelligence, and AI Organizational Transformation,  and are ready to incorporate that knowledge into the demonstration process. In other words, you’re going to learn about Workforce Intelligence and AI Transformation,  and combine that with your demonstration expertise so you can confidently present how our products support Workforce Intelligence, AI Transformation, and Technical teams in their mission. 

What You’ll Do

As a critical partner to our sales team, you will showcase the business value, scalability, and strategic impact of One Model products to prospective enterprise customers:

  • High-Impact Demos: Prepare for and deliver live, dynamic product demonstrations tailored to the specific organizational and HR and AI transformational and measurement challenges of prospects.
  • Tailored Use Cases: Create custom content, metrics, and data mockups in the products to showcase specific HR scenarios (TA, Comp, L&D, retention, and AI Impact and measurement use cases, etc.) .
  • RFP & Functional Support: Partner with Account Executives (AEs) to navigate complex RFPs, write functional descriptions of product capabilities, and handle ad-hoc product queries.
  • Content Creation: Record engaging product videos to showcase features and drive market excitement.

Project Work: Engage in projects designed to support the sales team and reinforce our pre-sales activities. Event Engagement: Attend local and regional events, delivering demonstrations on-site, speaking to audiences about the value of One Model products, and interacting with prospects as part of the sales process. 

About You

  • Pre-Sales Expertise: You are an experienced HR, Workforce Intelligence, and/or AI transformational software pre-sales professional who can learn a platform quickly, demonstrate with authority, and adjust your flow quickly to prospect questions and demands. You are able to quickly learn our products and basic people analytics concepts so that you can establish yourself as a knowledgeable trusted advisor in the sales process. 
  • Gets it Done: You get it done, quickly and correctly.  You aren’t afraid to jump into the deep end and absorb as much as you can as fast as you can. You know each demonstration is an opportunity to grow and improve. 
  • Not Afraid to Sell: You understand that this role is a critical part of the sales process and as such, you are able to build excitement about the One Model products and clearly explain its value proposition.
  • Natural Charisma & Presence: You are an exceptional communicator who commands a room or a web call. You genuinely enjoy meeting new people, building rapport quickly, and reading an audience to adjust your presentation style on the fly.
  • The Storyteller & Translator: You can develop a people analytics mindset, but your real superpower is translation. You can confidently discuss advanced analytics, metrics development, and system adoption with CHROs, HR leaders, AI Transformational Officers just as easily as you can discuss data logic with IT and Technical Buyers buyers.
  • Thrives in Momentum: You are adaptable, comfortable with a fast-paced scale-up environment, and can manage your time effectively when juggling multiple priorities.
  • What This Role Is NOT: This is a consultative, high customer-facing pre-sales role, NOT a backend data analytics or engineering position, nor is it a post-sales consulting role. This is not an applied People Analytics role, nor does it involve coding or data architecture work. 
  • Location: We are a remote organization, supporting our employees to work from home. Ideally, you will be located near London, but we will consider candidates in the UK, followed by candidates in continental Europe. 

Schedule: Hours of operations may vary depending on business needs. This role does provide some support for Account Executives located in the Eastern Time Zone in the US. As such, there will be situations where you will be expected to respond to Slack messages and support calls into the evening hours (London time). 

Want to skip the line and guarantee your application gets reviewed?

The "Show Us Your Spark" Video Challenge:

While this video is optional, candidates who submit a video will be heavily prioritized and fast-tracked straight to the interview round. We are looking for people who can command a room, so this is your chance to stand out.

We don't want a long, dry, feature-by-feature software demo. Instead, record a quick 2-to-3-minute video (using Loom, Zoom, or your phone) answering one of the prompts below:

  • The 2-Minute Pitch. Pitch us your favorite app or tool on your phone right now. You have 2 minutes to make us want to download it immediately.

The Golden Rule: Keep it under 3 minutes. If it feels like a dry, robotic corporate slide-read, you're doing it wrong! We aren’t grading your video editing or lighting; we are looking for your natural charisma, clarity, and ability to keep an audience engaged. Have fun with it.

How to Submit Your Video:

Please email your video file or link (Loom, YouTube, Drive, etc.) directly to ----- with the subject line: [Your Name] - Solutions Consultant Video Entry. Ensure your standard application is also submitted through our job board.

We Support You As An Individual By

  • Fostering a friendly, inclusive, respectful workplace culture.
  • Supporting flexible work options, including 100% remote work and flexible hours.
  • Coaching and development through our "Growing Together" conversations.
  • Generous compensation, benefits, and professional mental health support (EAP).

At One Model, we see the immense value of a diverse workforce. We encourage you to apply for the role even if you don't think you check every single box.

Base Salary Range£100,000—£115,000 GBP

title: Principal Engineer (w/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Über Protofy

Wir sind Protofy, die Outcome Agency aus Hamburg, und entwickeln seit über 10 Jahren digitale Produkte, Plattformen und KI-Systeme, die messbar wirken. Technologie ist für uns kein Selbstzweck, sondern ein Business Case, den wir in Umsatz, Effizienz und Wachstum übersetzen.

Deine Rolle

Als technische*r Lead führst Du engagierte Teams und sorgst dafür, dass auch komplexe Projekte pragmatisch, sorgfältig und wirtschaftlich umgesetzt werden. Wir entwickeln Websites und Mobile-Apps für Branchen wie E-Commerce, Wissensmanagement und Sport. Unsere Projekte laufen drei bis neun Monate oder werden als Produkte langfristig weiterentwickelt. Du bringst fundierte Erfahrung mit React sowie in Node.js, Flutter oder Kotlin mit und hast ein sehr gutes Verständnis von Architektur.

Den Entscheider*innenunserer Kund*innen begegnest Du auf Augenhöhe: Du leitest Architekturworkshops eigenständig und unterstützt uns bei Pitches. Gemeinsam mit Deinen Kolleg*innen aus Produkt Designer*innen und Product Owner*innen verantwortest Du Spezifikation, Umsetzung, Testing und Deployment von Features.

Neue Technologien erschließt Du hands-on und machst sie für das Team nutzbar. Außerdem gestaltest Du professionelle Standards in der gesamten Organisation mit, insbesondere für KI-gestützte Entwicklung. Den Großteil Deiner Zeit arbeitest Du selbst im Code, daneben übernimmst Du Führung, Kundenkontakt und Themen der Organisation.

Deine typische Woche

  • Du bist technischer Ansprechpartner*in für die Entscheider*innen unserer Kund*innen und berätst sie strategisch

  • Du unterstützt Pitches, erarbeitest Slides und technische Konzepte und präsentierst sie

  • Du führst Projekte technisch ganzheitlich, von der Architektur bis zum Deployment

  • Du entwirfst neue Funktionen mit Produktmanager*innen und UX-Designer*innen und setzt sie gemeinsam mit Deinem Team um

  • Du baust neue Themen und Technologien hands-on im Projekt auf, z. B. neue Shopsysteme, Frameworks oder Cloud-Provider

  • Du begleitest Dein Team, gibst regelmäßig Feedback und förderst Deine Kolleg*innen durch Tech-Mentoring

  • Du gestaltest Entwicklungsprozesse pragmatisch mit, insbesondere KI-gestützte Entwicklung (Tools, Workflows, Qualitätssicherung)

  • Du behältst die Wirtschaftlichkeit im Blick: Du schätzt Aufwände, achtest auf Budgets und unterstützt das Projektmanagement

  • Du entwickelst die gesamte Organisation aktiv mit

Das bringst du mit

  • Du hast 7+ Jahre Erfahrung in der Web- oder App-Entwicklung

  • Du hast 4+ Jahre Erfahrung als Tech Lead bzw. in der technischen Führung von Teams

  • Du hast fundierte Erfahrung mit React sowie in Node.js, Flutter oder Kotlin

  • Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung in der technischen Verantwortung mittelgroßer Projekte (500+ Personentage)

  • Du hast Erfahrung mit Application Architecture und begleitest Teams dabei, Anwendungen auf der grünen Wiese aufzusetzen

  • Du kannst Projekte ganzheitlich technisch führen

  • Du behältst auch in intensiven Projektphasen einen klaren Kopf und gehst gelassen mit Unsicherheit um

  • Du übernimmst gern Verantwortung über Deine eigene Arbeit hinaus und lernst gern Neues

  • Du sprichst verhandlungssicher Deutsch und Englisch

Deine ersten Monate bei Protofy

In deinen ersten Wochen wirst du dich in unsere bestehenden Projekte und Architekturkonzepte einarbeiten und erste Features für unsere Kund*innen umsetzen. Du tauschst dich eng mit dem Team aus und übernimmst schrittweise die Verantwortung für die technische Ausrichtung von unser Kund*innen. Dann übernimmst du Verantwortung und steigst in Pitch Prozesse mit ein. Wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen auf Anhieb erfüllst, aber Lust hast dich schnell weiterzuentwickeln, freuen wir uns trotzdem auf deine Bewerbung.

Das bieten wir dir

Bei uns bekommst Du 29 Urlaubstagen im Jahr. Wann und wo Du arbeitest, gestaltest Du flexibel: im Büro, im Homeoffice oder komplett remote in Deutschland. Firmenlaptop und passendes Home-Office-Setup gibt’s von uns dazu.

Für Deine Zukunft sorgt die betriebliche Altersvorsorge. Dazu kommen du das Deutschlandticket Premium komplett finanziert.

Und weil Arbeit auch Spaß machen soll: Wir feiern regelmäßig zusammen bei Teamevents und Firmenfeiern. Getränke und Snacks gehen auf uns. Dein Hund ist im Büro herzlich willkommen.

title: Principal Infrastructure Engineer
descriptionHtml:
500M+ downloads. 80M+ monthly users. A decade of building – and we’re still accelerating.

Flo is the world’s #1 health & fitness app worldwide on a mission to build a better future for female health. Backed by a $200M investment led by General Atlantic, we became the first product of our kind to reach a $1B valuation in 2024 – and we’re not slowing down.

With 7M paid subscribers and the highest-rated experience in the App Store’s health category, we’ve spent 10 years earning trust at scale. Now, we’re building the next generation of digital health – AI-powered, privacy-first, clinically backed – to help our users know their body better.

The job

Principal Infrastructure Engineer

More than 80 million women open Flo every month to understand their bodies and their health. Every one of those sessions runs on infrastructure we build, and the data behind it is as personal as data gets. Keeping that fast and private at this scale is the job.

Velocity runs the platform that every Flo engineer builds on: Kubernetes on AWS, the data stores behind our services, and the golden paths that let product teams ship without needing to be infrastructure experts. We treat our internal developers as our customers. You will:

  • Own the foundations: Design and run the Kubernetes and data infrastructure behind 80 million monthly active users, and make it boring in the best sense.
  • Turn expertise into self-service: Take what you know about running clusters and databases well, and build it into the defaults so product teams get it for free.

What You Will Do

  • Kubernetes at scale: Architect and evolve our EKS estate: cluster lifecycle and upgrades, networking, autoscaling, workload isolation, and the Helm and Terraform that deploy onto it.
  • Data infrastructure: Shape how our services use PostgreSQL, DynamoDB and Kafka. Set the patterns for provisioning, access, backup, failover and capacity, so teams aren't solving these problems one service at a time.
  • Golden paths: Build self-service tooling and Terraform modules that give product teams autonomy without sacrificing stability or security.
  • Reliability: Lead resilience work, including business continuity planning, disaster recovery testing and a sustainable on-call rotation.
  • Privacy at scale: Support the infrastructure behind privacy features such as our TIME-recognised "Anonymous Mode", and keep us SOC2, ISO 27001 and ISO 27701 certified while handling some of the most sensitive data there is.
  • Observability: Make sure metrics, logs and traces tell us something is wrong before our users do.

What You Bring

  • Experience: Many years in infrastructure, platform, SRE or DevOps roles running high-traffic, distributed systems in production. You have operated at Principal or Staff scope, setting direction across teams as well as delivering.
  • Kubernetes depth: You have run Kubernetes in production for real workloads, ideally EKS. You can explain what happens between kubectl apply and a pod serving traffic, and you have debugged it when it didn't.
  • Data infrastructure awareness: You understand how PostgreSQL, DynamoDB and Kafka behave under load and when they fail: connection limits, replication lag, hot partitions, consumer lag, retention. You don't need to have been a DBA, but you know what good looks like and when to ask for help.
  • AWS and infrastructure as code: Strong AWS knowledge and fluent Terraform. Coding experience in Go or Python is a plus.
  • Communication: A doc-first habit, and the ability to bring distributed product teams with you.

AI first: you will have seen the impact AI automation is having on development teams and the software delivery lifecycle, and have strong ideas on how infrastructure should support it.

Bonus Points

  • Hardening infrastructure for high-compliance or security-sensitive environments (HIPAA, SOC 2, PCI).
  • Running managed data services in AWS (RDS, Aurora, MSK, DynamoDB) at scale, including migrations and major version upgrades.
  • Scaling consumer platforms with millions of concurrent users.
  • Certifications such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect Professional, CKA or CKS.

Why Join Flo?

  • High impact: Flo is used by 1 in 4 women aged 18–44 in the US, and has raised $200M to build what comes next.
  • Autonomy: We hire experts and trust them to deliver.
  • Modern stack at scale: EKS, Terraform, Kafka, PostgreSQL, DynamoDB and Sentry, serving more than 80 million people a month.
Annual Salary Range (ranges may vary based on skills and experience)£130,000—£150,000 GBP

How we work

We’re a mission-led, product-driven team. We move fast, stay focused and take ownership – from brief to build to impact. Debate is encouraged. Decisions are shared. We care about craft, ship with purpose, and always raise the bar.

You’ll be working with people who take their work seriously, not themselves. It takes commitment, resilience, and the drive to keep going when things get tough. Because better health outcomes are worth it. 

What you'll get

We support impact with meaningful reward. Here’s what that looks like:

  • Competitive salary and annual reviews
  • Opportunity to participate in Flo’s performance incentive scheme
  • Paid holiday, sick leave, and female health leave
  • Enhanced parental leave and pay for maternity, paternity, same-sex and adoptive parents
  • Accelerated professional growth through world-changing work and learning support
  • In-person collaboration and work in a hybrid model, with 3 days per week spent in the office
  • 5-week fully paid sabbatical at 5-year Floversary
  • Flo Premium for friends & family, plus more health, pension and wellbeing perks

Diversity, equity and inclusion

Our strength is in our differences. At Flo, hiring is based on merit, skill and what you bring to the role – nothing else. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and we welcome applicants from all backgrounds, communities and identities. Read our privacy notice for job applicants.

title: Principal Researcher
descriptionHtml:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

About the Team

DoorDash’s mission is to grow and empower local economies. By building intelligent, last-mile delivery technology for local cities, DoorDash connects people with the local businesses they care about — helping grow businesses and the communities that support those businesses. At DoorDash, there are three audiences that are at the core of every decision we make - our Consumers, Merchants, and Couriers. The Research team has a direct link to uncover the unmet needs and pain points of each of these audiences. We bring their voices into the business in order to help set the strategic vision for all of DoorDash’s current and future products.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Principal Researcher to be a strategic research leader for EMEA, shaping what DoorDash builds next. You’ll combine deep expertise in qualitative and quantitative methods to find the unmet needs, behavioral shifts, and market openings that point to new products and new growth. You’ll work as a peer to senior product, design, engineering, data science, and business leaders, and your work will directly inform roadmaps, investment decisions, and company-level strategy.

This role is built for a seasoned researcher who is equally comfortable in a living room interview, a survey dataset, and a leadership review, and who uses AI as a daily tool to move faster and see further, without giving up the judgment that makes research trustworthy. You’ll also raise the bar for the wider research practice by mentoring researchers, sharing methods, and helping the team define what great looks like in an AI-enabled era.

What You’ll Be Doing

Shape Product Strategy: Translate deep understanding of Consumers, Merchants, and Couriers into a clear point of view on where DoorDash should play and win. You’ll frame the highest-stakes questions, bring evidence to roadmap and investment debates, and influence decisions at the director and executive level.

Detect New Opportunities: Proactively identify emerging needs, behavior changes, and white space that point to new products, new verticals, and new growth levers. You’ll size and validate opportunities with a mix of foundational discovery, market and competitive context, and behavioral data, and turn them into concepts teams can act on.

Lead Mixed-Methods Research: Design and run rigorous research end to end, choosing the right method for the question: ethnography, in-depth interviews, diary studies, and usability testing alongside surveys, conjoint and MaxDiff, segmentation, experiment design, and behavioral and log analysis. You’ll triangulate across sources so the “what,” the “how much,” and the “why” tell one coherent story.

Partner with Data Science and Experimentation: Work closely with data science and analytics to connect qualitative insight to A/B test design, metrics, and product outcomes, and to explain the “why” behind results. You’ll help teams learn from what worked, what didn’t, and what to test next.

Apply AI to the Research Craft: Use AI tools and LLMs in your daily workflow for synthesis, analysis, survey and discussion guide design, and scaling qualitative depth, and design human-in-the-loop checks that catch confident but wrong outputs. You’ll help the team identify where AI accelerates research and where it should not be trusted, and contribute to shared prompts, workflows, and standards. You’ll also study how people experience AI-powered features across DoorDash’s products.

Influence and Communicate: Tell compelling, decision-ready stories that move partners from insight to action. You’ll adapt depth and format to the moment, from a fast directional read that unblocks a team this week to a foundational body of work that anchors a multi-year strategy, and you’ll follow through to see that findings change what gets built.

You’ll help set the team’s research agenda, methods, and standards, and contribute to hiring and growing the team.

Operate Across Brands and Regions: Bring a global lens to your work, partnering across brands, markets, and cultures and adapting approaches to local context so that insights scale beyond a single market.

  • Exceptional storytelling and executive presence, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders without authority and build trust across product, design, engineering, data science, and business teams
  • A bias for speed and pragmatism: comfortable delivering directional insight quickly while knowing when a decision calls for deeper rigor
  • Experience mentoring or coaching researchers and raising the quality of a research practice
  • Advanced degree in HCI, Psychology, Sociology, Anthropology, Economics, Statistics, Survey Methodology, or a related field preferred, or equivalent practical experience

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving.

We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

descriptionHtml:

At Ping Identity, we believe in making digital experiences both secure and seamless for all users, without compromise. We call this digital freedom. And it's not just something we provide our customers. It's something that inspires our company. People don't come here to join a culture that's built on digital freedom. They come to cultivate it.

Our intelligent, cloud identity platform lets people shop, work, bank, and interact wherever and however they want. Without friction. Without fear.

While protecting digital identities is at the core of our technology, protecting individual identities is at the core of our culture. We champion every identity. One of our core values, Respect Individuality, reminds us to celebrate differences so you are empowered to bring your authentic self to work.

We're headquartered in Denver, Colorado and we have offices and employees around the globe. We serve the largest, most demanding enterprises worldwide, including more than half of the Fortune 100. At Ping Identity, we're changing the way people and businesses think about cybersecurity, digital experiences, and identity and access management.

As a Professional Services Technical Consultant, you will play a technical role in the architecture and successful installation, integration, and deployment of Identity and Access solutions in our clients' environments. You will also assist our implementation partners in that process. You will report to the Director of Professional Services.

You will:

  • Deliver technical consulting to our customers and partners from various industries including financial services, manufacturing, government, utilities, and more.
  • Evaluate client business, process, systems, and technology requirements and advise clients on best practices to help guide and solidify proposed designs.
  • Consult with clients to assess current problem states, establish desired future states, and make solution recommendations.
  • Participate in the detailed solution design, implementation, and delivery of Ping Identity IAM product solutions to our clients.
  • Work with customers to install, deploy, and configure Ping Identity solutions to meet the customer's requirements.
  • Collaborate with Ping Internal teams on escalated customer issues requiring deployment expertise.
  • Participate in services pre-sales processes including presentation of effort size, best practices, and feasibility studies.
  • Develop materials for providing technical consulting (e.g., best practices, report templates, delivery guides, knowledge base articles).
  • Help partners ensure they design an architecture aligned to Ping best practices for a successful customer deployment.
  • Mentor and assist in the development of internal and external technical resources.
  • Lead technical delivery from discovery and design through implementation, testing, production readiness, and handover, coordinating dependencies and surfacing delivery risks early.
  • Design and validate secure, scalable, highly available IAM deployments across cloud, hybrid, and on-premises environments, including integration, operational, and disaster-recovery considerations.
  • Troubleshoot complex implementation and production issues by analysing logs, traces, configurations, and network behaviour; work with Support and Product Engineering to drive resolution where needed.
  • Define and execute technical validation activities, including integration, end-to-end, performance, and resilience testing, and support cutover and go-live planning.
  • Produce clear implementation documentation, runbooks, and knowledge-transfer materials so customer and partner teams can operate and support the solution after delivery.
  • Balance strong security controls with a seamless user experience when shaping identity journeys and recommendations.

  • Background in a consulting capacity within the Identity and Access Management space, including practical System Integration and Implementation experience

title: Product Designer
descriptionHtml:
TL;DR

We’re looking for a world-class product designer who’s obsessed with craft & excited about AI. You’ll join +60 builders shipping one of Europe’s biggest consumer AI products, shaping how millions of students learn.

Why Knowunity?

We're building the #1 AI learning companion for 1 billion students. A future where every student on the planet can access, enjoy & benefit from the highest quality education. Since founding Knowunity straight out of high school in 2020, we've been committed to revolutionising how students learn.

Millions of students already use our AI learning companion weekly. We just raised €27m - Europe’s largest education round in the past three years. The AI learning market is at an inflection point, finally enabling true personalisation at scale, and we're determined to build the first AI learning unicorn in this space.

You will join an elite team of +60 hands-on builders serving 1 billion students worldwide. If we execute on our product vision, you will have built something generational that transforms education globally. This is your chance to build a generational company that shapes how an entire generation learns.

Why now?

Design is the single highest-leverage investment at Knowunity right now. You’ll be at the center of that shift.

We’ve built a product millions of students love, powered by an engineering team that ships & learns extraordinarily fast. Now we’re going all-in on craft. The kind of UI excellence, motion design, and systematic thinking that turns a loved product into a world-class one.
We just brought on a new Head of Design. We’re building a design system from the ground up. And we’re working with Ragged Edge (the agency behind the Transferwise & Granola rebrands) on a major brand evolution.

You won’t be maintaining someone else’s vision. You’ll be shaping it from the start.

Who you are

Your portfolio matters more than your years of experience. Show us work that moved metrics & delighted users:

  • Craft-obsessed: The details are the design. You push back until the bar is raised.

  • AI enthusiast: From prototyping to research to shipping. You see AI tools as a multiplier, not a threat.

  • Systems thinker: You care about scaling quality across a product, not a pretty Figma library. Code-first design systems, AI-powered design reviews, whatever works at speed & scale.

  • Simplifier: Education is messy. AI is unpredictable. You turn complicated user journeys into experiences that feel obvious.

  • Biased to action: You move fast by default. Prototypes over presentations, experiments over endless debate.

  • Builder: You like getting your hands dirty. Bonus if you’ve shipped a side project end to end, or opened a merge request.

  • Team-first: Direct feedback, no preciousness, no territory. Engineers prototyping features? More builders means better outcomes.

  • Curious: New tools, new patterns, new ways of thinking. You stay up to date & experiment continuously because you want to, not because someone told you to.

What you'll do

Raise the bar on everything students see, touch & feel. Make the Knowunity product undeniably world-class.

  • Set the standard: UIs students want to screenshot & details they feel, but can’t name. Your work is the reference point.

  • Scale it: Curated references, stellar components & sharp reviews. Make it easy even for vibe-coding PMs to hit the standard.

  • Pioneer AI-native design: AI changes how we research, ideate, ship, as well as what we ship. You’ll figure out both, from AI-assisted workflows to AI-native product experiences.

  • Idea to production, fast: Work directly with C-level & engineering. Concept on Monday, shipped on Wednesday, live for a million students on Thursday.

What we offer

Not for everyone. Everything for the right ones:

  • Impact at scale: Your work reaches millions of students daily. Future generations will know what you build.

  • Elite team, real ownership: +60 exceptional people. Direct access to C-level & founders. You own entire areas from conception to delivery.

  • Compensation & equity: Competitive salary paired with meaningful equity in a company with genuine unicorn potential.

  • Benefits: 28 days annual leave, 40 days work from anywhere, personal development budget, mental health support, Urban Sports Club, monthly retail vouchers, team & company events.

Next steps

Click “Apply for this job” and submit your CV and LinkedIn profile. We move fast.

  1. Intro call: Get to know each other, see if there’s mutual excitement.

  2. 5 minute Loom: walk us through something you’re proud of. A feature you shipped, an app you vibe-coded. Your pick.

  3. Deep-dive call: Unpack your Loom case with our head of design/CPO, discuss your experience & perspective.

  4. On-site day: Meet our CEO, CPO & the team. Work together, get a real feel for the culture. We’ll cover travel.

We encourage applications from exceptional talent regardless of traditional background requirements.

Knowunity is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of nationality, ethnic origin, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, or marital status. Please don't include photos or age in your application.

title: Product Designer
descriptionHtml:
Our mission

We're making Africa the first cashless continent.

In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash.

We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast.

Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in...

How you'll help us achieve it

We are growing our product design team and looking for an experienced mobile designer to expand features on our Android and iOS apps. You will have the opportunity to make financial services more accessible and inclusive for millions of people through working with thoughtful product managers, researchers, and engineers!

In this role, you'll:

  • Work closely with product managers, user researchers, engineers, and data analysts from the start to end of a feature.
  • Create high quality designs, interactions, and prototypes to explore ideas in service of the best solution for the project (Wave uses Figma).
  • Craft user research plans and work directly with our user researchers to identify problems and validate solutions in user testing.
  • Contribute to Wave's design system and component library.
  • Talk to customers and find solutions to their problems by thinking critically from their perspective.
  • Communicate the reasoning behind your product decisions in review sessions and in conversation with PMs.
  • Prototype visual and UX concepts and iterate towards the right solution (Wave uses Claude for mobile prototyping with Android apks).

Key details

  • This is a fully remote role. Candidates must be based in one of our hiring hubs (US, UK, Spain, Kenya, Ghana, Canada) or in one of our operating markets in Africa, including Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, and Burkina Faso.
  • You'll travel to one of our key markets for a 1 week immersion trip with your immediate team (Wave covers all costs). Outside of this 1 week immersion, you'll also travel to a market country with our product design lead and PMs, for a total of travel 2x a year. You're highly encouraged to visit market counties more often! We also provide a yearly stipend of $1,200 USD to meet with coworkers every year.
  • Our salaries are competitive and are calculated using a transparent formula. For this role, we are offering a salary of up to $187,000 USD based on your location (paid in your local currency equivalent), plus a generous equity package.
  • Major benefits:
    • Subsidized health insurance for you and your dependents and retirement contributions (both vary from country to country)
    • 6 months fully paid parental leave and subsidized fertility assistance
    • Unlimited vacation with a 20-day minimum requirement, with most folks taking between 21-30 days exclusive of statutory holidays
    • $10,000 annual charitable donation matching

Requirements

  • Experience with low and high-fidelity design & prototyping with LLMs on Android mobile apps
  • Fluency in English. French language skills are a plus.
  • At least 6 years of end-to-end in-house experience, with a consumer focus on product design with mobile apps.
  • Excellent visual and interaction design skills, with an eye at removing friction from flows
  • Attention to detail and high level of visual craft
  • Strong illustration and animation skills. We use After Effects and Lottie at Wave but anything that can be converted to a Lottie file works
  • Ability to deliver high-quality designs with speed and polish
  • Bias towards action. Identify UX improvements without waiting for the perfect conditions
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills
  • Ability to think through complex interaction design as well as thinking about tradeoffs of each solution
  • Curiosity for understanding and unpacking customer behaviors and needs
  • Experience balancing business goals, customer needs, and technical tradeoffs, while explaining your point of view to the team

You might be a good fit if you

  • Are detail-oriented and able to balance multiple projects
  • Can iterate separate concepts quickly to user test design bets. The ability to move fast and update designs based on customer feedback is an important quality we're looking for
  • Think carefully about in-the-weeds details and their role within the design system
  • Feel comfortable anticipating and designing for edge cases
  • Enjoy pairing with designers, engineers, and product managers
  • Are excited to learn about how all our products work together
  • Can speak, read, and write in French. This is nice to have but not a strong requirement - we have large markets in West Africa where French will come in handy.

Our team

  • We have a rapidly growing in-country team in Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, Mali, Burkina Faso, The Gambia, Uganda, Niger, Sierra Leone, and Cameroon plus remote team members spread across the world.
  • We're deeply passionate about our mission of bringing radically affordable financial services to the people who need them most.
  • We foster autonomy for our employees. You'll own your projects at every stage, from understanding the problem to monitoring your solution in production.
  • We raised the largest Series A in Africa in 2021. Our world-class investors, include Founders Fund, Sequoia Heritage, Stripe, Ribbit Capital, Y Combinator, and Partech Africa.
  • We are on Y Combinator's top companies by revenue.

Fill out the form below, and upload a resume in English and a cover letter describing your interest in Wave and the role.

title: Product Engineer
descriptionHtml:
A little about us

incident.io is the AI software reliability platform trusted by engineering teams at Notion, Linear, Ramp and 2,000+ companies who can't afford downtime.

The stakes are real, the talent is insane, and somehow it's a genuinely lovely place to work. We all pull our weight, go the extra mile, and put in the bit of magic most companies don't have time for, all while having fun and never taking ourselves too seriously.

We've raised $100+ million from Index Ventures, Insight Partners, and Point Nine, and we're growing fast. There's never been a better time to join.

The role in one line

At incident.io, what you build is yours: the whole loop, from hearing directly from customers what's worth building, to building it, with the trust to run with it and make something you're actually proud of.

What that looks like day to day

You'll spend real time in the codebase, but also on calls with customers, in Slack threads with them, reading their feedback. Understanding what customers need matters as much as building it. Once something's yours, it's yours end to end: the design and planning, the implementation, the testing, the delivery, and the follow up conversation with the customer who asked for it.

Day to day you're working in Go, TypeScript and React. That's just what we use, not a requirement for what you've used before. We care about how you think, not which stack you've clocked hours in.

We build with AI, not around it. Claude Code, Cursor, and Wispr are all standard kit here.

Flat structure, no ladder. People come from all kinds of backgrounds: some have founded companies, some have been CTOs, some are earlier in their careers. Here everyone's the same thing: a builder. The only thing that actually matters is whether you're curious about how the whole thing works, not just your bit of it.

Who you are

  • "If not me, then who" is basically how you operate. You don't wait around for something to be officially yours before you deal with it.

  • You own your work, but you build as a team. You unblock people, back your teammates up, and care as much about the team shipping great things as about your own bit of it.

  • You spot things before anyone asks you to. If a customer's about to notice a problem, you've usually already fixed it.

  • You communicate clearly, whether that's a Slack message to a customer, a design doc, or explaining a tricky trade off to your team.

  • You're comfortable in ambiguity, not just tolerant of it. Early ideation, half formed problems, and shifting priorities don't throw you off.

  • You share work when it's about 70% done, not 100%: drafts, MVPs, rough cuts, because you'd rather get feedback early than polish something in isolation.

  • You’re product minded, not just technically minded. You have real opinions about what should get built and why, and you share them, but you’re just as quick to change your mind when someone makes a better case.

  • You adapt fast. Feedback changes your plan, not your mood.

Supporting you

We work hard and we think life outside work matters just as much. Our benefits pack is built to support both.

  • Private medical insurance. Seriously good cover - we want you and the people you love to be looked after.

  • Competitive annual leave. Showing up at your best requires switching off, and we make sure you have time to do that.

  • First Friday of every month off. Yes, seriously.

  • Enhanced pension. We put real money in, because future-you deserves better than an afterthought.

  • Meaningful equity. We're rapidly scaling, and everyone who helps shape the outcome should share in it.

  • Unlimited AI spend. For everyone, not just engineers. We're all-in on AI across the company, and we expect you to be too.

  • Generous parental leave. The early days with a new baby matter more than anything we're doing here, and we want you to be present for them.

  • Two budgets that have your back. £1000 to invest in your setup, £500 a year to invest in yourself.

Compensation: £110K – £200K • Offers Equity

title: Product Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Evervault

Evervault offers modular payments infrastructure for companies building their own payments stack. We keep raw card data off your systems, cut PCI compliance work, improve acceptance, mitigate fraud and chargebacks and decrease your cost of payments, so you keep full control. Trusted by Ramp, Rippling, Modern Treasury and Overwolf; Series B, led by Ribbit Capital.

Role Overview

We’re hiring a Senior/Staff Product Engineer for our Cards team in London. You’ll own problems end-to-end across our payments infrastructure: tokenisation, card network integrations, 3DS and dispute management. That runs from customer conversations, through API design, to production code and measuring whether it worked. You’ll lead by example: mentoring, raising the bar and owning technical direction, staying hands-on the whole time.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Building core payments infrastructure, including tokenisation, network integrations, 3DS and dispute management

  • Designing developer-facing APIs, SDKs and primitives that developers enjoy using

  • Building high-throughput, distributed systems that handle millions of card transactions

  • Working directly with customers to understand their payment stacks, debug integrations and shape the roadmap

  • Shipping across the stack: backend services, APIs, UI components and documentation

  • Setting technical direction and mentoring engineers on the team

Requirements

  • 6+ years of engineering experience, including 2–4+ recent years in at least one of: payments infrastructure or fintech, developer tooling, or design-first products

  • Strong fundamentals in distributed systems, networking and infrastructure, beyond just frameworks

  • Product-minded: you think about the developer experience of every API you design and judge your work by its impact on users

  • Comfortable explaining complex technical decisions to non-technical people and working in front of customers

  • Founder-like ownership: you take problems to completion without waiting to be told what to do

Nice to Have

  • Rust and TypeScript experience (we care more about engineering ability than our exact stack)

  • Knowledge of card payments: networks, tokenisation, 3DS or PCI DSS

This Might Not Be for You If…

  • You want to build from a spec: you’ll be expected to find and define the problem yourself

  • You want to manage people soon: this is primarily a Senior IC role with technical leadership rather than people leadership

  • You prefer to stay in one layer of the stack: you’ll move between backend, APIs, UI and docs

  • You’d rather avoid customers: you’ll be on calls and debugging integrations with them

  • You want to work fully remotely: we’re in our Shoreditch office Tuesday to Thursday

Compensation, Benefits & Why Join

  • Competitive, London weighted salary

  • Stock options with an extended exercise window

  • Private health insurance

  • Unlimited PTO and flexible working hours

  • Daily lunch budget

  • Senior technical influence on a small, fast-growing team building infrastructure that processes millions of card transactions

Interview Process

  1. Recruiter screen

  2. Hiring manager screen

  3. Technical interview

  4. Pair programming

  5. Systems design (for Staff-level candidates)

  6. Final round with our founder

  7. References and offer

Location

This role is based in London, in our Shoreditch office Tuesday to Thursday. We do not currently sponsor UK work visas.

Candidates must be based in the location specified. Any applications from candidates not in the required location may not receive a response.

At Axle Energy, we’re building the infrastructure that will underpin the decarbonised energy system. descriptionHtml:
L’histoire du groupe Theodo et son succès Theodo accompagne depuis 2009 les entreprises innovantes dans la conception, le développement et le déploiement de produits digitaux ingénieux - tels que la plateforme TF1+, l'application LCL Pro ou l'application France Identité Numérique - en tirant parti du meilleur de la technologie et de l’approche Lean. En 2025, le groupe Theodo génère 100M€ de CA. Créée en 2016, Theodo Data & AI est l'entité Data et IA de Theodo. Notre ambition est d'accompagner nos clients dans la conception et le déploiement de leur stratégie data ainsi que la recherche et le développement de solutions d’intelligence artificielle à l’état de l’art. L'entreprise est en pleine croissance : chaque année, Theodo Data & AI enregistre une croissance de plus de 30 % de son chiffre d'affaires, ouvrant ainsi de nouvelles opportunités passionnantes pour les Theodoers !
Tes futures missions : En tant que Product Manager, ton rôle est d’aider l’équipe à maximiser la valeur du produit en priorisant et livrant des fonctionnalités de qualité, au service de la satisfaction client. - Prioriser et livrer des fonctionnalités à forte valeur ajoutée, en respectant les jalons et les engagements pris auprès du client. - Montrer la valeur et l’avancement de l’équipe en rendant le travail visible et en facilitant les décisions du client (review decks, daily mails,…). - Comprendre les préférences du client et organiser une réaction rapide et adaptée en cas de problème, en s’appuyant sur des outils comme le modèle de valeur, les questionnaires clients et les résolutions de problème. - Piloter le delivery au quotidien en appliquant la méthodologie Lean : gestion du backlog, rédaction de user stories claires et planification des sprints. - Collaborer étroitement avec le client pour comprendre ses besoins, faciliter ses décisions et co-construire les solutions. - Traduire les enjeux produit en exigences claires pour l’équipe technique, en t’appuyant sur l’analyse des usages, l’étude de l’environnement et les benchmarks. - Aider l’équipe à tenir ses engagements en anticipant les risques, en résolvant les problèmes et en contribuant aux routines d’amélioration continue (résolution de problèmes, rétrospectives). Une équipe mixte de 5 experts Theodo a développé deux algorithmes (prévision des KPI et optimisation des briques d’assortiment) capables de traiter des volumes massifs de données et de s’adapter à la diversité des formats de magasins. Résultat : +7,5 % de chiffre d’affaires. Une méthodologie basée sur l’apprentissage continu : Chez Theodo, nous avons construit notre approche tech autour d’une conviction forte : on développe d’abord les personnes, avant de développer les produits. Notre Lean Tech® System met l’accent sur l’apprentissage continu : tu évolueras dans un environnement qui investit sur le long terme, où l’objectif est de te permettre de progresser chaque jour, tout en construisant des produits utiles et performants pour nos clients. title: Product Manager - Edge Systems (All Genders)
descriptionHtml:
At Stark, we forge the future of European and national security through cutting-edge, AI-driven technology and unmatched engineering precision. As a premier defence technology company, our mission is clear: to equip NATO Allies and their partners  with next-generation autonomous defence platforms and advanced AI-driven software built to perform in the world’s most demanding environments.

We believe that true security stems from relentless innovation. By combining elite engineering talent with agile technology and an AI-native operational culture, Stark turns complex defence challenges into field-tested, multi-domain solutions.

WHY JOIN US

  • The software and systems you work on directly protect personnel and defend European and national sovereignty.
  • You will work alongside industry-leading minds on autonomous systems, advanced propulsion, and secure cyber platforms.
  • We foster a fast-paced, collaborative environment where bold ideas are supported by serious R&D backing.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Minerva software team develops our overarching command, control, and edge autonomy software across multiple domain platforms and handheld ground stations. We are a geographically distributed, multi-disciplinary engineering group bridging high-level decision-making software with physical vehicle control and sensor payloads. In this role, you will work within the Minerva product organisation and report directly to the Lead Product Manager to ensure seamless cross-platform functionality and multi-sensor integration across all operational deployments.

YOUR MISSION

You will support the product strategy for integrating our core Minerva software architecture—spanning C2 systems to Edge stacks—across diverse uncrewed platforms and sensor payloads. Reporting directly to the Lead Product Manager, you will translate complex multi-domain operational requirements and hardware constraints into structured, actionable engineering roadmaps. Success looks like unified cross-platform releases, advanced AI capabilities delivered on edge assets, robust sensor integration cycles, and reliable platform software performance across all deployment domains.

WHAT YOU WILL DO AT STARK

  • Specify Concepts of Operation, system and subsystem product requirements, and acceptance criteria 
  • Incorporate customer requirements, operator and customer feedback, and the wider STARK product vision into scalable Minerva versions across different uncrewed platforms and handheld control systems
  • Establish metrics and acceptance criteria for cross-platform software stability, data latency, and sensor fusion reliability
  • Define expectations and priorities for AI systems running within edge constraints 
  • Collaborate closely with Lead Product Manager, Product Owners and Technical Product Managers, and Engineering Leads to evaluate technical trade-offs across edge computing and C2 capabilities
  • Collaborate with system engineers and hardware teams across different hardware platforms to ensure Minerva edge software delivers maximum performance
  • Work directly with engineering leads and product colleagues to track sprint progress and remove blockers
  • Support integration compliance with military communication standards and protocols (e.g., SAPIENT, TAK, SitaWare)
  • Ensure the Minerva stack and development processes respect industry audit requirements (e.g. AQAP) 
  • Anticipate tests and validations and collaborate with IV&V, Product Safety, InfoSec, Configuration Management colleagues to ensure fast release turnarounds without compromising on safety and security  

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE MISSION

  • 3+ years of technical product management or product ownership experience software-heavy or complex systems environment
  • Demonstrated experience supporting complex software integration projects across hardware devices, sensors, or edge computing stacks
  • Strong technical literacy in software architecture, APIs, and data integration patterns
  • Experience with foundational AI systems (e.g. in computer vision, localisation) 
  • Proven track record of defining product specifications, backlog grooming, and user stories for agile engineering teams
  • Excellent cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to bridge hardware, software, and operational perspectives
  • Fluent English verbal and written communication skills

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience with defence tech, C2 systems, robotics, or autonomous unmanned vehicles
  • Familiarity with sensor integration (Radar, EO/IR, LiDAR) and defence protocols (TAK, SAPIENT)
  • Experience with software products designed for degraded or offline tactical network conditions
  • Experience with hardware/software integrations

If you're interested in building the future of European Defence with us, and you see yourself reflected on the description above, please send us your CV in English. We're looking forward to meeting you!

SECURITY CLEARANCE

Due to the nature of our work in the defence sector, candidates must be eligible to obtain and maintain the appropriate security clearance required for this position. Details will be provided during the recruitment process.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

We are an equal-opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

DATA PRIVACY STATEMENT

This data privacy statement, which refers exclusively to data collected as part of the online application process, is to inform you about how your personal data that is collected as part of the online application process is handled at our end.

The controller

The controller under data protection law is:

SKD SE

Französische Strasse 12, 10117 Berlin

Commercial register entry number: HRB 260878

Registration Court: Amtsgericht Charlottenburg

Data Protection officer: heyData GmbH, Schützenstraße 5, 10117 Berlin, www.heydata.eu, -----

Personal data collected as part of the application process

Personal data means any information concerning the personal or material circumstances of an identified or identifiable individual. This includes information such as, for example, your name, address, telephone number and date of birth, but also data relating to your specific career etc. by reference to which a specific individual can be identified with reasonable effort. However, information which cannot be (in)directly associated with your real-life identity is not personal data.

Fundamentals and purposes of processing personal data collected from application documents and during the application process

If you apply to us electronically, i.e. via e-mail or using our online form, we will collect and process your personal data for the purpose of executing the application process and preparing contracts.

By submitting an application via our recruitment website, you express your interest in taking up work with us. In this context, you transmit personal data, which we will use and store exclusively for the purpose of your job search / application process.

In particular, the following data is collected during this process:

  • name (first and last names)
  • e-mail address
  • phone number
  • LinkedIn profile (optional)
  • channel through which you found us

Furthermore, you can choose to upload expressive documents such as a cover letter, your CV and reference letters. These may contain additional personal data such as date of birth, address etc.

Only authorized HR staff and/or staff involved in the application process have access to your data.

The personal data is stored, as a rule, exclusively for the purpose of filling the vacancy for which you have applied.

Your data will be stored for a period of 180 days after the application process has been concluded. This is usually done to fulfill legal requirements and/or defending ourselves against any claims arising from legal provisions. After this period, we are obligated to delete or anonymize your data. In case of anonymization, the data will only be available to us in the form of so-called metadata, without any direct personal reference, for statistical analysis (for example, share of male and/or female applicants, number of applications per specified period of time etc.).

Furthermore, we reserve the right to store your data for 180 days after the application process has been concluded for the purpose of adding it to our Talent Pool in order to identify any other vacancies that may be of interest to you. This includes, for example, applications for apprenticeships or internships. By accepting the data privacy statement, you consent to any further storage of your data as well as its inclusion in our Talent Pool.

Should you be offered and accept a position with us during the application process, we will store the personal data collected as part of the application process for at least the duration of your employment.

Disclosure of data to third parties

Data transmitted as part of your application will be transferred using TLS encryption and stored in a database. This database is operated by Greenhouse, which offers a human resource and applicant management software solution (https://www.greenhouse.com/data-processing-addendum). In this context, Greenhouse is our processor under article 28 of the GDPR. Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today's challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future. Leveraging Data, AI, and real-time decision-making we turn energy complexity into growth opportunities for our partners. 

By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable and affordable.

With teams across Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

What will I be doing?

Lead the localisation efforts for our global energy billing platform, ensuring it meets the specific regulatory, market, and cultural requirements of France, from meter read to bill.
You'll be in charge of the French localisation of the Billing Module—one of the core product domains at the heart of the Kaluza platform. The Billing module processes consumption, pricing, and account data to schedule, calculate, and generate accurate, timely, and compliant invoices throughout a customer’s lifecycle. The module automatically manages billing cycles, generates bills, handles corrections, and produces the data that feeds invoices, billing-related communications, payment schedules, and downstream financial reporting, while powering customer and agent UIs.

This is a hands-on, full-stack product role — you'll work across the whole domain and alongside PMs from other domains and from the global billing teams to ensure the overall billing  journey from meter to bill meets the requirements of French clients.

  • Collaborate intensely with clients and in-country experts to understand their unique needs and requirements, negotiate scope, and build a roadmap.

  • Deep dive into French energy market regulations, translating complex compliance needs into detailed product specifications for the billing system.

  • Define and manage detailed product requirements for features related to country-specific needs from getting a read to generating a bill (meter reading protocols, invoice formats, taxation rules, payment methods, and regulatory reporting).

  • Work closely with engineering, UX, and QA teams to ensure the successful implementation and testing of localised billing functionalities.

  • Act as the go-to expert for global teams on specific French market nuances related to energy billing and customer journeys.

  • Continuously monitor changes in French energy legislation and market practices, proactively adapting the product roadmap to maintain compliance and competitiveness.

About You

Ideally you'll have/be:

  • Proven experience as a Product Manager, or equivalent role in software companies, with a strong track record of successfully localising complex software products for international markets

  • Solid understanding of the end-to-end B2C billing lifecycle including meter data, tariffs, invoicing, and debt management.

  • A track record in regulated markets where billing complexity matters, energy, telecoms, financial services, or similar. Familiarity with the French energy market (ENGIE, CRE, switching, tariff structures) is advantageous.

  • Exceptional ability to translate abstract regulatory text or client requirements into clear, actionable, outcome-driven requirements for development teams.

  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams (engineering, design, legal, operations, client success) to deliver localised solutions.

  • Excellent stakeholder and client management skills, able to lead conversations across requirements, scope, expectations, and roadmap alignment, and communicate technical & market complexity clearly to varied audiences.

  • Proficiency in AI tools throughout all stages of the product lifecycle — from discovery and ideation to delivery and iteration.Fluent in French and English — our platform and many of our teams operate in English, so you move easily between both.

  • A builder's mindset — you're autonomous, learn fast, and aren't afraid to go deep. You're comfortable interrogating a codebase with AI tools, reading an API schema or data model, and writing a SQL query to get the answer you need.

  • Comfortable with ambiguity and pace — you can operate effectively when not everything is defined, know when to make a call, and aren't afraid to escalate or ask for help when it matters.

  • Fluent in French and very comfortable in English — our platform and many of our teams operate in English, so you move easily between both

Kaluza Values

Here at Kaluza we have five core values that guide us as a business: 

Play to win, Solve the real problem, Build trust every day, Own the outcome, Go further together

We want the best people

We’re keen to meet people from all walks of life — our view is that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We want to build teams which represent a variety of experiences, perspectives and skills, and we recognise talent on the basis of merit and potential.

We understand some people may not apply for jobs unless they tick every box. But if you're excited about joining us and think you have some of what we're looking for, even if you're not 100% sure, we'd still love to hear from you.

title: Product Manager - Juno
descriptionHtml:
At Joko, our mission is to we help consumers save time and money when shopping online or in-store.

Founded in Paris, Joko is a tech company and certified B Corp with over 120 talents across Paris, Barcelona, and New York (and beyond). More than 7 million users already save money every day at 10,000+ merchants with Joko.

From cashback and automatic coupons to price alerts, we've kept expanding our products to make shopping smarter. Today, Joko is an AI shopping app: with Juno, our shopping assistant, users can find the right product at the best price in only a few seconds, with recommendations that get sharper the more they use it.

Having reached profitability in our core market, we’re now scaling globally, with a strong focus on the US.

It’s still day 1, come build the future of shopping with us!

📱 Our Product Team

Led by Fabien, our VP Product, Joko's Product team groups the passionate individuals behind our users' delight! From brainstorming to development to launch, the Product team's main mission is to turn ideas into reality by working hand-in-hand with the Engineering, Design, and Business teams.

Joko is organized into four product tribes, each owning a key dimension of the company's value:

  • Business lines owns the current core value proposition, covering online shopping, in-store experiences, and gift cards, each run as a dedicated team.

  • Scale focuses on growing and amplifying this value through growth, international expansion, and shared core user experiences across the app.

  • Juno builds the next value proposition: an AI shopping assistant that finds the right product at the best price in seconds, backed by a universal catalog of what merchants actually sell.

  • AI Platform helps Joko become a state-of-the-art AI company from the inside, owning the internal agent infrastructure, automation layer, internal tools, infrastructure, compliance, security and operational scalability.

🤖 The Engine task force

Juno is Joko's most ambitious bet: becoming the front door to shopping. An AI assistant that understands what someone is genuinely looking for, searches thousands of merchants at once, and gets them to the right decision in seconds rather than hours — the reflex people reach for before they buy anything.

The Juno tribe is split into two task forces. Engine owns the assistant itself: the conversational experience users interact with, and the product logic that turns an intent into the right recommendation. Catalog owns the universal product catalog that powers it.

Engine is where Juno meets the user. It owns the conversation itself: how someone expresses a vague intent, how the assistant narrows it down, and how a recommendation is presented so that it is actually trusted. Nobody has settled what a great shopping conversation looks like, so there are no patterns to borrow and the answers have to be found by building and testing.

The task force is a small, autonomous team: a Product Manager who owns it, a Product Designer, and software engineers. This role is its first Product Manager, so the scope, the standards, and the way the team works are yours to define.

🎯 What you will do

As Product Manager for the Engine task force, you own it. That means the end-to-end user experience of Juno, from the conversational interface on mobile and web to the product logic behind the recommendations. You will report to Yosr, who leads the Juno tribe, and work day to day with a Product Designer, software engineers, and the Catalog task force.

  • Conversational product design: There is no market standard for what a great shopping conversation looks like. You will define it. That means testing a lot, iterating fast, and inventing interaction patterns for a surface that has none yet.

  • Designing with AI's limits in mind: A model-backed flow behaves differently from a deterministic one. You will design for hallucinations, unexpected outputs, and edge cases: what the fallback is, what the model gets fed, what the user sees when it goes wrong. This is a large part of the craft in this role.

  • Discovery, user testing & iteration: You will run user tests continuously, read real conversations, spot where the experience breaks, and turn that into the next iteration. You will own the rollout strategy and decide what ships to whom, when.

  • Roadmap & ownership: You will define the vision and roadmap for the assistant experience, prioritise against company priorities and technical reality, and own delivery from problem framing to launch.

  • Measurement: Evaluating an AI experience is a hard problem in itself. You will define what quality means for Juno, build the metrics that track it, and use them to drive decisions.

  • Competitive positioning: Generic assistants ship new shopping capabilities constantly. You will define what makes a specialised shopping assistant win.

👀 Who we're looking for

  • Experience: You have at least 2 to 3 years of experience as a Product Manager. We are flexible on seniority, but you need enough depth to bring real experience to a team that is being built.

  • AI product experience: You have shipped user-facing features powered by AI, on a product with a meaningful user base. You know what it takes to put a model in front of real users and keep the experience good.

  • UX & UI judgment: You have strong instincts on user experience and interface, and you have wrestled with the specific difficulty of designing an AI feature. This role is deeply user-facing, and this criterion carries the most weight.

  • Data fluency: You are comfortable defining metrics, instrumenting them, and evaluating outcomes with numbers. Every decision on this team is backed by data.

  • AI fluency: You are hands-on and genuinely curious about AI tools and how models behave. Juno is built on AI, so you will be in the product every day.

  • ML knowledge: A strong bonus. The engineers bring that depth already, so we weigh UX judgment on AI features more heavily than model internals.

  • 0-to-1 appetite: You want to build something that does not exist yet. Blank pages energise you.

  • Location: Based in France or Spain.

  • Languages: Fluent in English, both written and spoken. French is a plus, but it is optional.

  • Mindset: You have an entrepreneurial mindset, you like challenges, you welcome feedback and you love constantly learning and getting better.

💎 Our perks

(Some of the benefits listed below are available to full-time positions only)

At Joko, we believe that flexibility and trust are essential. Our work environment reflects this through:

  • Flexible remote : If you live in Paris, you can choose to work from our office or from home with no constraints. If you live elsewhere, we can provide access to a coworking space and a coworking budget.

  • Work from anywhere : Want to spend a month in Italy while working? You can work from most countries in the world for up to 3 months per year.

On top of that, we offer plenty of perks:

  • 💸 Top-market compensation

  • 📈 Equity for everyone with the chance to own a piece of what you build

  • 🤖 Half-day each week dedicated to leveling up with AI by exploring new tools, iterating hard, and sharpening your skills

  • 🌴 Yearly offsite in amazing locations and budget for team-building events & monthly in-person gatherings

  • 💪 Contribution to your ClassPass subscription

  • 🍼 8-week leave paid 100% for the second parent

  • …and much more, check the full list here!

🤝 Our hiring process

  1. Intro call: Quick screening with the Hiring Manager or the Talent team.

  2. Step 1 – Team interview (45 min): Conversation with two Joko team members (could include the Hiring Manager, people from the team you’d join, or colleagues from other teams).

  3. Step 2 – Role-specific assessments

    • For non-engineering roles: A take-home case study followed by a 45-min interview. We assess both your output and how you think in real time. The exercise will be relevant to your role (e.g. analysis, strategy, or process design).

    • For engineering roles: A 90-min live technical interview on CoderPad covering code understanding, review, system design, and product thinking (with AI serving as a collaboration tool).

  4. Step 3 – Leadership interview (45 min): Conversation with a SteerCo member and a Founder.

  5. References: Up to 3 calls with former colleagues or managers.

☕ You may also be invited for coffee with team members to get a feel for our culture.
