title: Product Manager On-Ramp & Swap (100% remote)
descriptionHtml:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

Tether Wallet is our self-custodial wallet, built to bring USDT and XAUT directly to the people who rely on Tether every day, especially in markets where access to stable money and savings is hardest. For that to work, getting into these assets has to be simple, fast and affordable. Our goal is to give every Tether Wallet user the best option to exchange any local currency or token into USDT and XAUT, wherever they are.

In this role, you will define and own the strategy for buying and swapping into USDT and XAUT across our target markets. You will work hand in hand with our expansion teams to map the payment landscape in each market: which payment methods people actually use, which card schemes and bank rails dominate, and which on-ramp and swap providers can serve them. Based on that, you will identify the best partner for each market and bring them on board as a service partner of Tether Wallet.

This role sits at the intersection of product, payments and partnerships. You will own the outcome end to end, from the first partner evaluation through integration and the in-app experience to the conversion numbers after launch. If you enjoy turning a fragmented global payments landscape into a buy button that just works, we want to hear from you.

Key responsibilities:

  • Buy & Swap Strategy: Define and own the strategy and roadmap for buying and swapping into USDT and XAUT in Tether Wallet, covering fiat on-ramps, card payments, local payment methods and token-to-token swaps.

  • Market & Payment Landscape: Work with our expansion teams to build a deep understanding of each target market, including dominant payment methods, card schemes, bank transfer and instant payment rails, mobile money, local regulation, and the on-ramp and swap providers active there.

  • Partner Evaluation & Selection: Define clear evaluation criteria such as market and payment method coverage, fees and FX spreads, approval and conversion rates, KYC experience, settlement speed, reliability and compliance standing, and use them to select the best on-ramp or swap partner for each market.

  • Partner Onboarding: Lead selected partners from evaluation to go-live as service partners of Tether Wallet, coordinating with Legal, Compliance and Business Development on due diligence, commercial terms and contracts.

  • Integration & Delivery: Translate partner capabilities and APIs into clear product requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria, and work with engineering and design to deliver a seamless in-app buy and swap experience.

  • Routing & Optimization: Define the logic that decides which partner and payment method a user is offered based on country, currency, amount, price and availability, so every user gets the best available option.

  • Performance & Partner Management: Define and track KPIs across the buy and swap funnel, such as conversion, payment approval rates, KYC drop-off, total cost to the user and volume by market and partner. Use the data to improve the experience, manage partner performance and incidents, and regularly review whether each market still has the right partner.


Mandatory:

  • 5+ years of product management experience in the financial industry (banking, payment service provider, FinTech)

  • 3+ years of product management experience in DeFi or crypto industry

  • Good understanding of crypto wallets and DeFi features, including token swaps, DEX aggregators and on-chain transaction flows.

  • Good understanding of global payment systems and credit card schemes (e.g. Visa, Mastercard), including authorization, 3-D Secure and chargebacks, as well as local payment methods such as bank transfers, instant payment rails and mobile money.

  • Hands-on experience with fiat on-ramp, off-ramp or swap providers, or with integrating third-party payment providers and gateways into a consumer product.

  • Proven experience evaluating, selecting and onboarding external partners, and managing their performance after launch.

  • Working knowledge of KYC/AML requirements and how they affect user onboarding and conversion.

  • Technical enough to read partner API documentation, assess integration options and work closely with engineering teams.

  • Data-driven: experience defining funnel KPIs and using data to improve conversion and make partner decisions.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with partners, expansion teams and engineers across time zones in a remote environment.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @tether.to or @tether.io

title: Product Safety & Certification Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About EH Energy Engineering

EH Energy is developing cutting-edge fuel cell technology for heavy-duty mobility and large-scale stationary power applications. Our uniquely redesigned product delivers a significantly more compact fuel cell system with high power density and lower production costs. In response to the challenges of climate change and the global shift toward decentralized energy, EH Energy provides high-performance, cost-effective fuel cell solutions to our clients and partners.

To support our rapid growth and bring our systems to global markets, we are seeking a Certification Engineer. In this critical role, you will take full ownership of our product compliance roadmap, bridging the gap between innovative engineering and strict global regulations. You will lead hazard and risk assessments, define certification strategies across international markets (EU, North America, marine), and interface directly with notified bodies and classification societies to ensure our fuel cell systems are safe, fully compliant, and market-ready.

This role requires a full-time, on-site presence at our office in Nyon, Switzerland. We are unable to offer remote or hybrid arrangements, so candidates should be based locally or prepared to relocate.

 

Key responsibilities

Certification strategy and project management

  • Identify applicable directives, regulations, harmonised standards and class rules early in the development cycle and translate them into design requirements (EU, North America, marine)

  • Select and manage notified bodies, NRTLs, classification societies and test laboratories, own budgets, schedules and contracts for certification work

  • Plan and witness type tests, factory acceptance tests (FAT) and site acceptance tests (SAT)

Safety engineering and risk analysis

  • Lead risk assessments to ISO 12100 and hazard studies (HAZID, HAZOP to IEC 61882)

  • Lead design and process FMEA (IEC 60812) for stacks, balance of plant, containers and fuel processing

  • Run explosion-protection assessments: hazardous area classification (IEC 60079-10-1), ventilation and gas detection concepts, and equipment selection

  • Specify and verify safety functions to ISO 13849 (PL) and IEC 61508, including safety requirement specifications and validation reports

Compliance and technical documentation

  • Compile and maintain technical construction files, CE Declarations of Conformity, type-approval dossiers and certification reports

  • Write and review user, installation, operation and maintenance manuals, safety instructions and labelling

  • Maintain the standards register and assess the impact of new or revised standards

  • Manage certification change control: assess design changes for impact on existing certificates

Collaboration and continuous improvement

  • Act as the internal authority on certification scope: ensure in-service conformity of series production with certified designs, and support procurement and supply chain on material and packaging compliance (e.g. RoHS, packaging regulations).

  • Support design reviews and supplier qualification, including component certificates (ATEX, PED, electrical)

Standards and regulatory scope

The role covers, but is not limited to, the frameworks below. Working knowledge of most is expected; deep expertise in several is required

  • IEC 62282 series, CSA/ANSI FC 1:2021, ISO 16110-1 and Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230

     

Required qualifications

  • Master’s or bachelor’s degree in mechanical, electrical, chemical, process or safety engineering, or equivalent

  • 5+ years in product certification, compliance or safety engineering for complex electromechanical or process equipment (energy, gas, process, machinery or marine)

  • Direct experience with hydrogen or fuel cell systems and the IEC 62282 series, CSA/ANSI FC 1 or ISO 16110

  • Proven track record of taking products through CE marking and third-party certification with notified bodies or NRTLs

  • Hands-on experience leading FMEA, HAZOP and risk assessments, and documenting them to auditor standard

  • Solid knowledge of ATEX / IECEx, hazardous area classification and explosion-protection concepts

  • Experience specifying and validating safety functions to ISO 13849 and/or IEC 61508

  • Excellent technical writing: clear, structured, audit-ready technical files and manuals

  • Fluent English, written and spoken

     

Preferred qualifications and personal profile

Nice to have

  • Marine type approval with a classification society (DNV, LR, BV, ABS) or IGF Code projects

  • Experience with fuel processing, reformers or fire equipment, and with pressure equipment under PED

  • Certified functional safety qualification or ATEX/IECEx competence certification

  • Familiarity with North American codes (NEC, NFPA) and UL/CSA certification

Personal profile

  • Rigorous and structured, with a strong safety mindset and an eye for detail

  • Pragmatic: finds compliant solutions that keep development moving

  • Confident communicator with engineers, auditors, authorities and customers

  • Self-driven in a fast-growing, scale-up environment; comfortable owning topics end to end

     

Start date: Immediately

title: Product & Yield Engineer (Data-focused)
descriptionHtml:
About Fractile

Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts.

 

The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. The defining work of the 21st century will be marked by the engine of inference delivering immense and diffuse chains of intellectual inquiry, in drug discovery, in software engineering, in materials discovery, in any field where progress is driven by deep reasoning and intelligence to resolve complex problems.

We are looking for an Engineer to play a key role in the development and manufacture of Fractile's silicon products, with a particular focus on product, yield and manufacturing data analysis. Working across New Product Introduction (NPI), Yield Engineering and Product Quality, you will analyse large and complex semiconductor datasets to identify trends, isolate sources of variation, improve yield and reliability, and provide clear technical insight to engineering teams and manufacturing partners. This is a highly hands-on individual contributor role for someone who enjoys working directly with data, investigating complex technical problems and turning analysis into actionable engineering conclusions.

Skills and Experience

  • Demonstrable experience within the semiconductor industry in Product Engineering, Test Engineering, Yield Engineering, Data Analytics or Quality Engineering, ideally spanning NPI through to high-volume production

  • Strong experience analysing semiconductor manufacturing and test data to identify trends, correlations, excursions, yield loss mechanisms and opportunities for improvement

  • Solid experience in as many of the following areas as possible:

    • Wafer fab: analysis of Process Integration, Yield Enhancement, D0 Control, defect reduction and process variation data

    • IC Assembly: Assembly Process or Package Design, 3D IC and wafer stacking, Assembly Quality Control, BOM optimisation and Yield Engineering

    • Fabless Semiconductor: IC Product Qualification, reliability and failure analysis, RMA investigation and production monitoring

  • Strong knowledge of WAT, WS/CP and FT datasets, including correlation across manufacturing and test stages

  • Excellent data mining, statistical analysis and root-cause investigation skills, with the ability to turn complex datasets into clear engineering conclusions

  • Experience identifying yield signatures, parameter distributions, outliers, spatial patterns, lot-to-lot variation and systematic versus random failure mechanisms

  • Extensive hands-on use of semiconductor industry data analysis tools and software such as yieldHUB, Spotfire, JMP or equivalent

  • Ability to create scripts, automated analyses, dashboards and repeatable analytical workflows for standard engineering investigations and reporting

  • Experience applying statistical methods to semiconductor manufacturing data, including SPC, Cp/Cpk, distributions, correlation analysis, hypothesis testing and trend analysis

  • Ability to combine data from multiple sources and manufacturing stages to investigate complex product and process issues

  • Familiarity with FMEA-derived semiconductor qualification plans and relevant standards such as JEDEC

  • Understanding of semiconductor failure analysis methods and the ability to use analytical data to guide selection of destructive and non-destructive investigation techniques

  • Strong ability to communicate analytical findings through concise visualisations, reports and technical presentations

  • Comfortable working independently on ambiguous technical problems and driving investigations from initial data exploration through to a supported conclusion

  • Good communication skills and a collaborative, team-player attitude

  • Self-starter, flexible and able to manage multiple analyses and investigations in parallel

  • Willing and able to travel worldwide when needed

Desirable

  • Experience building automated semiconductor yield-monitoring, reporting or anomaly-detection workflows

  • Experience working with large semiconductor datasets using SQL, Python or similar data-analysis tools

  • Experience developing dashboards, standard analytical journals or reusable engineering analysis frameworks

  • Multi-cultural awareness, including experience working with Far East suppliers and manufacturing partners

  • A Bachelor's degree or above in Electronics, Microelectronics, Semiconductor Physics, Engineering or a similar discipline

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary: A competitive salary reflective of your experience and the specialist nature of the role.

  • Equity & Ownership: meaningful equity so everyone shares in the value creation

  • Benefits: Private Medical, Dental and Vision, Contributory Pension, 25 Days holiday plus bank holidays and Life/Critical Illness Insurance.

  • Diverse & fun office: we believe the hardest problems get solved by the broadest range of minds. We are committed to Equal Employment Opportunity through attracting and retaining a diverse team and building an inclusive environment.

Fractile is seeking to increase the clock speed of global progress, one chip at a time. We’ve recently raised $220M from investors including Founders Fund and Accel and our most important work lies ahead. Join us!

 

Export controls

Our work involves technologies subject to UK, US and other international export control regulations. Certain roles may require additional eligibility checks to ensure compliance with applicable law. We'll be transparent about this throughout the hiring process.

descriptionHtml:
About WPP Production

We are WPP Production - the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi-channel content systems at scale. About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

A Hybrid working model

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

The role

HEX brings together creative talent, emerging technology and industry-leading partners to turn innovation into scalable solutions for our clients.

We’re looking for a Programme Director to lead the end-to-end delivery of a complex, high-profile programme at the intersection of creative production, AI and emerging technology.

You will translate strategic objectives into an integrated delivery plan, bring multiple workstreams together and ensure the programme delivers against its commitments. You’ll take ownership of programme governance, dependencies, risks and decisions, providing the clarity and control needed to navigate complexity and maintain momentum.

Working across senior leadership, technology partners, clients and multidisciplinary delivery teams, you’ll connect the bigger picture with the detail of execution, ensuring everyone is aligned on what needs to happen, when and why.

What you’ll do

Lead the programme

  • Own the integrated programme plan, translating objectives into clear workstreams, milestones, deliverables and success measures.
  • Establish effective governance, clear accountability and a consistent approach to programme reporting and decision-making.
  • Maintain oversight of the critical path, dependencies and delivery commitments, ensuring activity across workstreams comes together to achieve the overall programme objectives.
  • Provide a clear view of programme health, progress and emerging issues, giving leadership the information needed to make timely, informed decisions.

Drive delivery

  • Hold workstream leads accountable for commitments, following through on actions and intervening where delivery is at risk.

Align clients and stakeholders

  • Build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders across WPP, technology partners and client organisations.
  • Create alignment across teams with different priorities, ensuring clear ownership, timely decisions and a shared understanding of programme objectives.
  • Lead programme reviews and executive reporting, communicating progress, risks, decisions and required actions with clarity.
  • Act as the central point of coordination for programme delivery, connecting stakeholders and ensuring commitments translate into action.

Deliver measurable outcomes

  • Maintain oversight of performance against programme objectives, milestones, budgets and agreed commercial commitments, working with the relevant commercial and finance leads.
  • Define and track success measures that demonstrate client adoption, business impact and value delivered.
  • Identify emerging delivery or commercial risks, making their implications visible and driving appropriate action.
  • Use performance data and programme insight to inform decisions, address underperformance and improve outcomes throughout the programme lifecycle.

What you’ll bring

  • Significant experience leading complex programmes involving multiple workstreams, interdependent deliverables and senior stakeholders.
  • A proven track record of translating strategic objectives into executable plans and delivering against challenging commitments.
  • Strong programme management expertise across integrated planning, governance, critical path management, risk, dependencies and change control.
  • The judgement to anticipate problems, navigate ambiguity and make effective decisions when priorities or delivery conditions change.
  • The confidence to challenge constructively, influence senior stakeholders and hold teams accountable across matrixed organisations.
  • Strong commercial awareness, including an understanding of budgets, forecasts and performance against agreed commitments.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to turn complex information into clear decisions, recommendations and executive-level reporting.
  • A proactive, collaborative approach, combining attention to detail with a clear focus on overall programme objectives.

Experience in creative production, digital transformation, AI-enabled programmes or technology partnerships would be advantageous.

What success looks like

  • A clear, integrated programme plan that connects workstreams, milestones, dependencies and outcomes.
  • Predictable, well-controlled delivery, with risks anticipated, blockers resolved and commitments actively managed.

title: Projectontwikkelaar woningbouw
descriptionHtml:
Wil jij bouwen aan de woningbouwopgave én aan een nieuwe ontwikkelorganisatie? Als Senior Projectontwikkelaar bij Dura Vermeer Bouw & Vastgoed werk je aan grootschalige woningbouwprojecten in Midden-Nederland. Je stapt in na tendergunning en bent verantwoordelijk voor de verdere ontwikkeling richting realisatie. In een ondernemende omgeving krijg je alle ruimte om mee te bouwen aan het team, je expertise in te zetten in de samenwerking met bouwpartners én door te groeien naar een rol met meer inhoudelijke en coachende verantwoordelijkheid.

Dit wordt jouw baan

Ondernemend, ervaren en klaar om impact te maken? Dan voel jij je thuis binnen deze nieuwe ontwikkelorganisatie van Dura Vermeer. Als Senior Projectontwikkelaar werk je aan omvangrijke woningbouwontwikkelingen en help je niet alleen projecten verder te brengen, maar ook het team en de organisatie. Je begrijpt hoe ontwikkeling en bouw elkaar versterken, neemt eigenaarschap en krijgt de ruimte om mee te denken, mee te bouwen en mee te groeien. Je bent betrokken vanaf de fase na tendergunning en schakelt intensief met de bouw om projecten succesvol richting uitvoering te brengen. Daarnaast krijg je de mogelijkheid om in de toekomst ontwikkelaars te begeleiden en bijvoorbeeld door te groeien naar een rol als Hoofd Vastgoedontwikkeling.

Wat ga je doen

Deze functie richt zich nadrukkelijk niet op de initiatieffase of acquisitiekant van gebieds- en vastgoedontwikkeling. De focus ligt op het moment waarop een tender is gewonnen en projecten daadwerkelijk gerealiseerd gaan worden. Je werkt aan (midel)grote woningbouwontwikkelingen van honderden woningen en bent de verbindende factor tussen ontwikkeling en bouw. Dat maakt deze rol ideaal voor een ervaren ontwikkelaar die energie krijgt van het realiseren van projecten, ondernemerschap toont en wil meegroeien met een ambitieuze organisatie.

· Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de ontwikkeling van woningbouwprojecten vanaf tendergunning tot aan de start van de realisatie;

· Je stuurt het ontwikkelproces aan op het gebied van kwaliteit, planning, financiën en risico's;

· Je verbindt de belangen van gemeenten, adviseurs, beleggers, corporaties, bouwteams en andere stakeholders;

· Je werkt intensief samen met collega's van Bouw om projecten optimaal uitvoerbaar en haalbaar te maken;

· Je vertaalt ambities en plannen naar concrete ontwikkelbeslissingen die bijdragen aan een succesvolle uitvoering;

· Je voert regie op vergunningstrajecten, overeenkomsten en besluitvorming;

· Je bewaakt de businesscase en stuurt op waardecreatie gedurende het gehele ontwikkelproces;

· Je draagt actief bij aan de verdere opbouw en professionalisering van de ontwikkelorganisatie;

· Je begeleidt en coacht minder ervaren projectontwikkelaars en krijgt de ruimte om op termijn een meer aansturende rol te vervullen.

Meer bij Dura Vermeer

Dura Vermeer is een onafhankelijk familiebedrijf. En dat merk je. In hoe we samenwerken, naar elkaar omkijken en bouwen met oog voor de volgende generaties. Al sinds 1855 bouwen we aan Nederland, in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek. Onze onafhankelijkheid en lange termijn visie vormen daarbij de basis.

Met een omzet van € 2,6 miljard en ruim 3.700 collega’s behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Maar uiteindelijk draait het bij ons niet om die cijfers. Het draait om mensen. Om collega’s die samen werken aan projecten waar je trots op bent iconisch én dichtbij en bijdragen aan oplossingen voor maatschappelijke vraagstukken.

Onze ambities zijn groot. En die maken we alleen waar met betrokken mensen. Daarom investeren we in goed werkgeverschap en een werkomgeving waarin jij je thuis voelt. Waar je jezelf kunt zijn, je veilig voelt en je uitspreekt. Zodat jij het beste uit jezelf haalt en samen met ons meer maakt.


Hier zit je op jouw plek

Bij Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Utrecht staan we aan het begin van een nieuw hoofdstuk. Waar we jarenlang bekend stonden als een sterke renovatie/transformatiespecialist, zijn we sinds begin dit jaar uitgegroeid tot een volwaardige Bouw en Vastgoed organisatie. Naast renovatie en transformatie realiseren we nu ook nieuwbouwprojecten in de woning- en utiliteitsbouw én zetten we de volgende stap naar eigen gebieds- en vastgoedontwikkeling.

Dat betekent dat je terechtkomt in een organisatie die volop in beweging is. Met ruim 100 collega's binnen onze werkmaatschappij bouwen we niet alleen aan duurzame woningen, utiliteitsprojecten en leefomgevingen, maar ook aan de toekomst van onze eigen organisatie. De lijnen zijn kort, de ambities groot en de kansen om mee te bouwen aan nieuwe werkwijzen, teams en projecten liggen voor het oprapen.

Hier krijg je de ruimte om impact te maken. Niet vanaf de zijlijn, maar midden in een frisse organisatie die zich verder ontwikkelt en waarin ondernemerschap, samenwerking en eigenaarschap centraal staan. Samen bouwen we aan projecten waar we trots op zijn én aan een organisatie die klaar is voor de toekomst.


Dit breng jij mee

· Minimaal 5 tot 10 jaar ervaring als projectontwikkelaar, ontwikkelmanager of vergelijkbare functie;

· Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding;

· Ervaring met woningbouwontwikkelingen;

· Aantoonbare ervaring met projecten van substantiële omvang (200+ woningen is een pre).;

· Ruime ervaring met ontwikkeltrajecten in de SO-, VO- en DO-fases, het verkrijgen van omgevingsvergunningen en verkooptrajecten;

· Inzicht in bouwtechnische uitgangspunten om adviseurs aan te sturen en het plan verder uit te werken;

· Ervaring binnen een ontwikkelaar, ontwikkelende bouwer of vastgoedorganisatie.

title: Regional Director of Operations, UK, Europe and Africa
descriptionHtml:
Regional Director of Operations, UK, Europe and Africa

Kenyon International Emergency Services, part of the TrustFlight Group

Bracknell, United Kingdom | Full time, permanent | Competitive salary and benefits package

When the worst happens, families need someone they can trust. Lead that response.

When an aircraft is lost, a ship is in distress or a community is struck by disaster, families are suddenly facing the hardest days of their lives. They need answers, they need to be treated with dignity, and they need to know that the people they have lost are being cared for. For more than a century, Kenyon International Emergency Services has been the organisation that airlines, governments and major companies call on to make sure that happens.

We are looking for a senior crisis leader to direct that response across the UK, Europe and Africa. This is a role for someone who has stood in the room when it mattered, who leads with calm authority, and who believes that how an organisation treats the bereaved and the injured says everything about its character.

About Kenyon

Kenyon provides emergency planning, family assistance, humanitarian support and recovery services to clients around the world, drawing on a network of more than 2,500 trained responders who can be mobilised at short notice into any jurisdiction. Our clients rely on us to keep their promises to the people affected by an incident, and we hold ourselves to that standard every day, not only on the day of an activation.

Kenyon is part of the TrustFlight Group, an aviation safety and compliance technology business. That gives Kenyon something unusual in this sector: a world class technology team working alongside it, and a genuine commitment to using AI to make crisis response faster, better informed and more humane. Our values are simple and we mean them: integrity, and a customer first attitude in everything we do.

The role

Kenyon operates a two hub leadership model. You will lead the Bracknell hub, with regional accountability for operational delivery, readiness, contracted offices and relationships across the UK, Europe and Africa. Your peer, the Regional Director of Operations in Vancouver, leads the Americas and Asia Pacific. Together you share accountability for the readiness and quality of Kenyon’s response worldwide.

Senior Incident Director for activations

Senior on call duty is shared between the two Directors on a fixed twelve hour rota, with a structured handover at each change of duty, so that cover is continuous around the clock and neither Director works through their own night. Your window runs from approximately 06:00 to 18:00 UK time.

When an incident arises during your window, wherever in the world it occurs, you take up the role of Senior Incident Director. You will have the authority to set the deployment posture, commit responders and stand the organisation up or down without further approval. Where a client requires it, you will deploy as their strategic point of contact, leading the response on their behalf at the most demanding moments an organisation can face, including mass casualty, government led and politically sensitive events.

Major activations are infrequent, and Kenyon holds its capability through a surge based model rather than a large permanent workforce. Your judgement of regional readiness, kept current every week of the year, is what makes that model work.

What you will lead

· Regional readiness and response. Maintain and continuously measure activation readiness across the UK, Europe and Africa, and develop the procedures, protocols and contingency plans that underpin it.

· Your team and offices. Line manage the Regional Operations Manager in Bracknell, run the Bracknell hub and its regional operations as one regional function, and hold contracted offices to defined standards through quarterly reviews and an annual assessment.

· Protecting those we serve. Make sure the information of casualties, families and clients is protected with the same care during and after an activation as on any other day.

· The responder network. Work with the Responder Manager to keep the network vetted, trained and available across the region, including building language capable responders across Europe and Africa. Own the global standards for responder vetting, training currency, deployment conduct and post incident review, ensuring they are consistently applied across both hubs.

· AI and digital quality assurance. Work with the Vancouver Director and TrustFlight Group technology team to define and evaluate AI enabled quality and operational reporting tools, including an AI internal auditor supporting ISO 9001, ISO 27001 and ISO 22300 evidence gathering, gap identification and audit trail maintenance. Ensure these tools meet group information security, data governance and ethical standards.

· Global operational standards. Work with the Vancouver Director to compare regional procedures, share lessons learned and adopt improvements across both hubs, ensuring consistent service quality while recognising regional operational requirements.

· Relationships that matter. Build trusted working relationships with government agencies, emergency services, aviation authorities and clients across the region, and provide the operational insight that informs board level reporting.

Why join us

· Work that matters. Few roles offer the chance to lead a service whose sole purpose is to bring order, care and dignity to people at the worst moment of their lives.

· Real authority. A senior seat on the Kenyon leadership team, reporting to the Managing Director, with decision making authority during activations.

· A sustainable model. A shared rota designed so that no Director carries standing 24/7 availability, because sound judgement depends on rest.

· Room to build. The opportunity to shape Kenyon’s growth across the UK, Europe and Africa, while leading the development of global quality, certification and responder standards and helping shape how AI strengthens operational assurance across Kenyon.

In your cover letter, tell us about an incident you have led and what it taught you about caring for the people affected. Applications will be treated in strict confidence.

Kenyon International Emergency Services and TrustFlight are equal opportunity employers. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and will make reasonable adjustments throughout the recruitment process for anyone who needs them. This position is employed by Kenyon International Emergency Services Limited.


What you will bring

· At least ten years in operational crisis management or emergency response, including five or more in a leadership role.

· Experience leading large scale or complex incident responses in international environments, ideally including direct responsibility for strategic command.

· A track record of managing contracted service providers against defined performance standards.

· Experience working within a quality management framework in a regulated or standards led environment, and alongside board level governance.

· The composure, judgement and compassion to lead when the stakes are highest, and the humility to put the needs of affected families first.

· Willingness to travel internationally at short notice, including to the United States and across Asia Pacific.

· Eligibility to live and work in the UK.

It would be a real advantage if you also have

· Professional fluency in Spanish, or another principal European and African language.

· Familiarity with the ISO 22300 series, including ISO 22320, or equivalent certification experience.

· Experience overseeing a 24/7 contact centre operation.

· Practical experience commissioning AI or automation tools in an operational setting.

· Knowledge of the aviation, maritime, energy or government crisis response markets in the Europe and Africa.

About Kaluza

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

What you'll do

The Release, Environments and Change Engineer (REC Engineer) has three key areas of responsibility. You will operate Release, Environments and Change processes and procedures, and you’ll be involved in, and often lead, the identification and implementation of process improvements using AI and other tools.

You will work closely with the REC Manager and Environments Manager and operate the processes they define. These processes may rely on manual activities and controls at first, so you’ll take a leading role in replacing them with appropriate automation, and then identify mechanisms and methods to govern those automated controls.

You will collaborate with Enablement teams and engineering teams across Kaluza to make sure processes are understood, embedded and followed. You’ll be a decision maker with the authority to decline or postpone releases and changes, and you’ll handle client communication where approval is required for a change or release.

  • Operating promotion gates, making promote or block decisions between environments in line with contractual and ways-of-working agreements, and escalating high-risk calls.

  • Facilitating change approvals, release Go/No-Go meetings and release trains, preparing releases against readiness criteria and tracking per-team readiness and environment-deployed status.

  • Using AI-assisted checks to confirm quality gates are met, summarise what changed in a release, score change risk and flag incomplete or stale records, applying your own judgment to improve the reliability of the results.

  • Maintaining complete, accurate change and configuration records, keeping every change traceable across the full environment stack, and managing the change and release calendar.

  • Building and maintaining release automation, including readiness checks, artefact promotion, AI-drafted release notes and notifications, and reporting feeds.

  • Working with engineering teams in real time to roll back failed releases or apply fixes, and coordinating with incident and problem management so planned changes, hotfixes and major incidents stay in sync.

  • Communicating changes and releases internally and externally, supporting environment coordination and validation, running post-implementation reviews and retros, and giving operational input into gate definitions and the wider process.

What you’ll bring 

  • Strong organisation and attention to detail, with the ability to juggle multiple moving parts and spot incomplete records or inconsistencies.

  • Clear communication and strong facilitation skills, comfortable coordinating across teams, leading check-ins, keeping everyone aligned, driving decisions and chasing things through to completion.

  • The confidence to say no and hold the line when something isn’t ready, and to escalate when you’re unsure.

  • Comfort with Jira (or similar), including configuring boards, workflows and tickets.

  • Scripting and automation skills to build and maintain the automation around a release process (readiness checks, artefact promotion, release notes and reporting), plus familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and integrating automated testing into deployment workflows.

  • Day-to-day use of AI tooling with a critical eye, catching what it gets wrong rather than waving it through.

  • Experience building or integrating AI agents (e.g. LangChain, AutoGen, custom frameworks, MCP-based tooling), with an understanding of prompt engineering and LLM evaluation techniques such as faithfulness, relevance and LLM-as-a-judge, since traditional pass/fail assertions don’t translate well to testing AI agents.

What will set you apart

  • Any exposure to how software gets released or how environments work, even informally.

  • Light scripting or automation experience, or the appetite to learn it.

  • A calm head under time pressure.

Our Values

Five values guide how we work at Kaluza:

  • Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.

  • Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.

  • Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.

  • Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.

  • Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.

Come as you are

title: Head of Engineering | xpate
descriptionHtml:
Role: Head of Engineering
Company: xpate
Location: London or remote
Job Type: Full-time

About xpate

xpate has been a card acquirer since 2019. It combines acquiring and banking for B2B clients only, with €100M+ in annual revenue. About 100 people work there, around 15 of them in engineering. HQ is in London, and the team is spread across Latvia, Cyprus, Serbia and Singapore.

The business is changing. xpate is moving from direct sales to distribution through platforms and partners: embedded finance and Payfac-as-a-Service. The platform has to change with it. Tooling, data flow, processes and the release cycle all need a rebuild, and much of the workflow is still tracked by hand.

xpate also wants to become AI-native. Guardrails go around the core – the data layer and financial data – so it can’t be lost, rewritten or broken. Everything else runs through an agentic harness on top, so non-engineering teams can build their own tools by prompting agents.

What you will do

  • Lead the platform and organizational transformation from the inside, together with the current team.

  • Own the whole technical picture: infrastructure, architecture and vendors.

  • Replace the traditional PM → engineer handoff. Test the idea that engineering and product can work as one, with engineers talking directly to the business and domain experts.

  • Move code writing to LLMs with automated QA. Start where mistakes are cheap and reach the critical financial components later.

  • Hire engineers who talk to people and ask questions, not only write code. You can bring in 1–2 people who share the vision.

  • Focus on internal efficiency. The business sets the direction – the job is not to set a product or market vision of your own.

First 6 months

  • Months 1–3: bring all data flow – customer, financial and manual – into one clear perimeter.

  • Months 4–6: build the harness on top, so non-engineering teams can prompt agents, create their own tools and run their workflows.

What you need to succeed

  • You have built financial systems: ledger, reconciliation, processing, gateway, double-entry accounting. Ideally you wrote them yourself, and you know what a few cents of error cost at scale.

  • You have a strong data architecture background.

  • You can hold the full technical picture: infrastructure, architecture and vendors.

  • You are a senior engineer with proven results. Team size doesn’t matter – leading 4–5 people is fine.

  • You know code quality and review still matter, and you are ready to change how the work gets done.

  • You think and talk like a business person.

  • You are a mature operator: collaborative, transparent, no “I know best”. You change things carefully and still make bold calls.

  • Payments or acquiring background is not required – any financial systems experience works.

  • Nice to have: you have rebuilt or transformed a team before.

  • Nice to have: you are based in London.

What you get

  • A new role with a clear mission: transform the platform and the way the company works.

  • Direct work with the founders, reporting to the CEO.

  • A team of about 15 engineers to inherit and reshape.

  • A profitable company moving into Payfac-as-a-Service and embedded distribution.

  • An AI-native setup where non-engineers build their own tools.

  • Year 1 is fixed pay. From year 2, shadow equity tied to P&L performance, with a path to real equity. Details to be agreed.

title: Senior Manager, Global Benefits
descriptionHtml:
Dataiku is the Platform for AI Success, the enterprise orchestration layer for building, deploying, and governing AI. In a single environment, teams design and operate analytics, machine learning, and AI agents with the transparency, collaboration, and control enterprises require. Sitting above data platforms, cloud infrastructure, and AI services, Dataiku connects the full enterprise AI stack - empowering organizations to run AI across multi-vendor environments with centralized governance.

The world’s leading companies rely on Dataiku to operationalize AI and run it as a true business performance engine delivering measurable value. For more, visit the Dataiku blog, LinkedIn, X, and YouTube.

Senior Manager, Global Benefits

We’re ~1,300 builders across 18 countries. We share context openly, work across functions and borders, question defaults, and own our outcomes. Our People team runs on Dataiku too, with AI agents and automated workflows.

The role

Location: EMEA - Remote · Reports to: Global Total Rewards Lead

You’ll own Dataiku’s global benefits programs across all countries where we operate. The goal: benefits that help us win AI talent, feel consistent and fair wherever people work, meet local requirements, and stay financially sustainable.

Our People function is lean and decentralized. You’ll set benefits strategy with the Global Total Rewards Lead, partner directly with Finance, Legal, Payroll and our brokers, lead day-to-day benefits operations, and have real autonomy. This is a builder role: you’ll challenge how benefits work today and use AI to make them simpler to run and easier for employees to use.

What you’ll do

  •         Shape the strategy. Define and evolve our global benefits philosophy with the Global Total Rewards Lead, balancing market competitiveness, consistency across countries and cost discipline.
  •         Own the global portfolio. Design and manage health, retirement, insurance, leave and wellbeing programs across our entities and EOR countries, setting a clear global floor with smart local variation.
  •         Run renewals and vendors. Lead annual renewals, broker and carrier relationships, and RFPs. Negotiate on data, not habit, and hold vendors to clear service levels.
  •         Keep us compliant. Make sure plans meet local rules in every country. You’ll own US compliance directly (ERISA, ACA, COBRA, nondiscrimination testing, Form 5500) as well as statutory and collective-agreement obligations in Europe and beyond.
  •         Manage cost. Own the global benefits budget and forecasts with Finance. Model plan changes, track claims and utilization trends, and bring clear trade-offs to decision-makers.
  •         Lead benefits operations. Lead the team that runs enrollment, life events, leaves, payroll and HRIS integrations, and EOR coordination. Build processes that scale without adding headcount.
  •         Use AI to reinvent the experience. Automate enrollment, eligibility checks, reconciliations and employee questions with AI agents and workflows. Make it easy for employees to understand and use what we offer.
  •         Support growth and change. Set up benefits for new countries, entity conversions from EOR, and acquisitions, with clean harmonization plans.
  •         Communicate clearly. Build benefits guides, open-enrollment campaigns and manager resources that people actually read.

What we’re looking for

  •         Extensive global benefits experience in a global, high-growth tech or enterprise software company.
  •         Deep expertise in benefits design, renewals, vendor/broker management and benchmarking across multiple countries.
  •         Strong, hands-on US benefits compliance experience, plus experience with European programs and statutory requirements, including UK and French benefits and pensions.
  •         Experience managing benefits through both owned entities and Employer of Record providers (e.g. Deel, Remote).
  •         A track record of building or transforming benefits programs, not just administering them.
  •         Experience leading a team and influencing senior stakeholders in lean, fast-moving environments.
  •         Strong analytical skills for cost modeling and claims analysis, and real curiosity for AI and automation (Workday a plus).

Why join us

  •         Real impact: shape benefits for a global AI company helping the world’s largest enterprises make AI work.
  •         Ownership: the autonomy to build, with direct access to Total Rewards, Finance and People leadership.
  •         Growth: help reinvent how People programs are delivered, with AI-powered workflows.

Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

Senior Professional Services Project Manager (London area)

An overview of this role

GitLab Senior Professional Services Project Managers manage complex projects from initiation through delivery and closure. In this role, you'll coordinate with cross-functional teams and our global customers to complete distinct projects on time and within budget. You'll use your experience managing information technology and software consulting projects and your knowledge of traditional and agile project management and software development methods. You'll also manage executive stakeholder communications, manage escalations, and help improve Professional Services project management practices.

What you’ll do

  • Manage large-scale commercial projects and executive stakeholder meetings and communications.
  • Collaborate with GitLab Support, Engineering, and Product teams to resolve complex customer problems using GitLab technologies.
  • Drive improvements to Professional Services project management tools, processes, procedures, and templates.
  • Summarize key customer projects monthly and provide a summary for quarterly business reviews.
  • Develop and manage delivery schedules, customer expectations, project scope, resources, status, risks, and issues for technical and consulting services.
  • Manage customer escalations by coordinating with customers and GitLab stakeholders, including the executive team, Sales, and Technical Account Managers.
  • Establish reliable, repeatable delivery processes, metrics, and operational procedures.
  • Set and achieve forecast goals by aligning customers, Technical Architects, project engineers, partner consultants, and delivery partners.

What you’ll bring

  • Experience managing complex information technology or software consulting projects for external customers from initiation through closure.
  • Ability to manage project scope, schedules, resources, customer expectations, risks, issues, and multiple priorities while delivering concise executive-level status reports.
  • Ability to build effective relationships with customer leaders, communicate with internal and external stakeholders, and manage escalations.
  • Ability to identify and resolve project challenges, motivate advisory teams and contributors, and mediate conflicts.
  • Experience supporting timely revenue recognition and executing change orders when needed.
  • Knowledge of project management and technical delivery methods for software, including Project Management Institute methodologies, agile or Scrum, the software development lifecycle, and project management or agile tools such as GitLab.
  • Enterprise customer and Professional Services experience is a plus.

How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees

  • Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
  • Flexible Paid Time Off 
  • Team Member Resource Groups
  • Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Growth and Development Fund
  • Parental Leave

title: (Senior) React Native Engineer (m/f/x) - Based in Germany
descriptionHtml:
Cara Care, a digital health company backed by Bayer AG, is on a mission to improve people’s digestive health through technology. As we expand our product portfolio and modernize our platform, we’re looking for a versatile, pragmatic, and forward-thinking (Senior) React Native Engineer (m/f/x) to help shape the future of digital therapeutics.

Your Role

You’ll join a cross-functional product team with high ownership, lean processes, and a clear focus: deliver real impact to patients. We’re looking for someone who thrives on solving real-world problems with code, is technology-open, and knows when to build fast and when to build right. You’ll also help us use AI tools and coding agents thoughtfully in day-to-day engineering, turning emerging capabilities into reliable workflows that improve how we design, build, test, and operate patient-facing products.

Your Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and ship high-quality React Native apps for iOS and Android with TypeScript.
  • Use AI coding agents to implement features, refactor code, and generate tests. Define clear tasks and constraints, provide relevant context, and validate the resulting changes through code review, automated tests, and checks on real devices.
  • Own the full mobile lifecycle: architecture, implementation, automated testing, release management, monitoring, and iteration.
  • Integrate native capabilities (push notifications, deep links, biometric auth, camera/sensors); write and maintain native modules when needed (Swift/Kotlin).
  • Drive mobile performance and reliability (startup time, bundle size, memory, battery) and meet accessibility best practices.
  • Set up and evolve mobile CI/CD (e.g., Fastlane, GitHub Actions/Bitrise), internal testing (TestFlight/Play Console), and release pipelines.
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and Medical to explore, define, and deliver patient-centric features, and to improve our current platform.
  • Connect AI-assisted development workflows to design and engineering tools via MCP, for example to access Figma specifications and components, check implementations against designs, and automate repetitive coding and validation tasks. Keep patient data, credentials, and other sensitive information out of unapproved tools and workflows.
  • Uphold technical excellence in architecture, code quality, and security, especially in a regulated healthcare environment, including applicable requirements under IEC 62304, BSI TR-03161, and the MDR.
  • Contribute to a platform that powers multiple regulated digital health products across indications like IBS, GERD, and upcoming expansions.
  • Mentor other developers and help raise the technical bar across the team.

Requirements

Your Profile

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with at least 3 years focused on React Native and shipping production apps.
  • Expert with React Native and TypeScript, React Navigation, state management, and testing (Jest, React Native Testing Library; Detox a plus).
  • Hands-on experience using AI coding agents to implement features, refactor code, and write automated tests, including connecting agents to engineering tools via MCP. You can explain how you scoped the work, verified the results, and handled tool permissions and sensitive data.
  • Proven track record delivering to App Store and Google Play, including handling certificates/provisioning, in-app updates, and staged rollouts.
  • Solid understanding of mobile security and privacy: secure storage, keychain/keystore, certificate pinning, data minimization, and PII handling.
  • Experience with mobile CI/CD and release automation (Fastlane, GitHub Actions or Bitrise), and tools like Sentry.
  • Product mindset: you’ve worked in product-centric teams, collaborated closely with non-technical stakeholders, and care deeply about UX and accessibility.
  • Bonus: experience in regulated industries, healthcare, or other security-conscious environments; native iOS/Android development (Swift/Kotlin)


💡Please note: Cara Care is a remote-first company with a fully distributed team. All team members are based in Germany so candidates must reside in Germany to join us.

Benefits

💸 Fair compensation: We offer fair pay, regular salary reviews, and the equipment you need to do your best work.

🫶 Great team spirit: Join a vibrant, interdisciplinary team and enjoy a friendly, supportive working atmosphere, with regular in-person team events.

👨‍💻 Remote-first working: Prefer working from home? No problem. Want to join us at our Berlin office? That works too. Our remote-first approach gives you the flexibility to work where it suits you best.

🏝️ 30 days off per year: Rest matters. You’ll get 26 vacation days plus 4 additional company-wide mental health days each year to take a breather and recharge.

🦉 Flexible working hours: Whether you’re an early bird or prefer a later start, you can shape your working day around what works for you.

🏋️ Urban Sports Club (USC): Enjoy access to a wide range of sports, fitness, and wellness activities at discounted rates.

🧠 OpenUp: Access a variety of resources and services to support your mental health and personal wellbeing.

🛍️ Corporate Benefits: Get attractive discounts and exclusive offers from a wide range of well-known brands and providers.

🚀 Make a real impact: Be involved, contribute your ideas, and help shape what comes next. Your voice matters, and you can make a real difference.

About Cara Care

Cara Care is a digital health company on a mission to improve the lives of people with digestive health conditions through holistic, science-based digital therapies.

Our established IBS therapy, Cara Care für Reizdarm, provides personalised content, practical exercises, and symptom tracking to help people better understand and manage their condition. It is listed in the German Federal Institute for Drugs and Medical Devices’ (BfArM) directory of digital health applications (DiGA) and is covered by statutory health insurance in Germany.

We are expanding our product portfolio and evolving our technology platform to bring digital therapies to more people across a broader range of conditions.

Backed by Bayer

We’re proud to share that Cara Care has recently joined the Bayer Group, a move that strengthens our mission and enables us to scale our impact even further. With Bayer’s global healthcare expertise and our innovative digital approach, we’re poised to redefine care for digestive health.

What It’s Like to Work With Us

At Cara Care, you’ll be part of an interdisciplinary team of doctors, designers, engineers, and creatives who are deeply passionate about improving lives. We’re inspired by our patients and driven by real-world impact. We move fast, collaborate closely, and never lose sight of the importance of well-being—both for our users and ourselves.

Diversity Matters to Us

We believe that diverse teams build better products. That’s why we’re committed to creating an inclusive environment for everyone—regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, or disability.

We know that applying for a new job is a big step, and we genuinely appreciate your time and effort. We’re excited to get to know you!

title: Senior SAP FI/CO ABAP Application Developer - Produktentwicklung (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Als Senior SAP FI/CO ABAP Application Developer (m/w/d) gestaltest du die Zukunft unserer Produktfamilie und Transformationsplattform Natuvion DCS (Data Conversion Suite) im Bereich Content, mit Fokus auf Finanzwesen und Controlling. Du bringst dein Wissen über SAP FI/CO und SAP S/4HANA Finance in unsere Migrationstemplates ein und arbeitest eng mit unserem Projektgeschäft im Bereich Datentransformation und -migration sowie mit unseren Partnern zusammen.

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Du arbeitest aktiv an Design, Entwicklung und Erweiterung unserer Services im Bereich DCS Migrate Content für SAP FI/CO / S/4HANAFinance

  • Du konzipierst, entwickelst und implementierst neue Migrationstemplates für zentrale Finanz- und Controlling-Objekte, z. B. Sachkonten, offene Posten in Debitoren- und Kreditorenbuchhaltung, Anlagen, Kostenstellen, Profit-Center, Innenaufträge und Salden

  • Du verbesserst vorhandene Funktionen: Du findest Optimierungspotenzial, behebst Fehler, setzt Produktanforderungen um und sicherst so die Qualität unserer FI/CO-Templates

  • Du überführst Lösungen aus Finance-Transformationsprojekten (z. B. S/4HANA-Conversions, Buchungskreis- oder Kontenplanumstellungen) in Produktdesign und Templates

  • Du überwachst laufend Sicherheit, Performance und Datenkonsistenz der Lösungen, inklusive Abstimmbarkeit der Finanzdaten, und greifst bei Bedarf schnell ein

  • Du unterstützt Kolleginnen und Kollegen im Projektgeschäft mit deiner FI/CO-Expertise


Dein Profil:

  • Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium der (Wirtschafts-)Informatik oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung

  • Du hast Erfahrung in der SAP-ABAP-Entwicklung, idealerweise auch in einer objektorientierten Sprache (ABAP OO oder Java)

  • Du hast umfassende technische Erfahrung in SAP FI/CO bzw. SAP S/4HANA Finance und kennst Datenmodell und Prozesse in Rechnungswesen und Controlling

  • Erfahrung im Themengebiet der (SAP-)Datenmigration und vor allem im Bereich der tabellenbasierten Datenmigration sind von Vorteil

  • Du arbeitest strukturiert und denkst analytisch und lösungsorientiert

  • Du arbeitest gern im Team und willst dich laufend weiterentwickeln

  • Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch

Falls du denkst, dass du nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllst: Bei uns sind deiner Entwicklung „keine Grenzen gesetzt“! Geh mit uns gemeinsam deinen Weg – Wir unterstützen dich dabei! Zeige uns einfach wer du bist.

Was dich bei uns erwartet:

Ein Umfeld, dass jederzeit offen für Veränderungen und Optimierungen ist. Ein „das war schon immer so“ gibt es bei uns nicht. Du hast die Chance dein Wissen einzubringen, Prozesse zu gestalten, vorhandenen Themen zu standardisieren oder Abläufe zu optimieren. Sei Impulsgeber und bringe uns mit deiner Expertise noch weiter nach vorne!

Wir schaffen Rahmenbedingungen, in denen du dich wohlfühlst:

  • Home-Office Verträge & absolute Flexibilität durch freie Gestaltung der Arbeitszeit

  • Unbefristete Festanstellung und 30 Tage Urlaub

  • FlexWork: Bis zu 3 Monate pro Jahr remote aus dem europäischen Ausland arbeiten

  • Monatliches Budget für individuell wählbare Benefits aus über 50 möglichen Angeboten über emplu, verschiedene Angebote über Corporate Benefits, sowie Fahrrad- und Autoleasing per Gehaltsumwandlung

  • Mental Health Benefit 'Nilo' – 10 kostenlose Sessions mit Psycholog:innen jährlich sowie Zugang zu Meditationen und Kursen

  • Wir unterstützen dich gezielt bei deiner fachlichen und persönlichen Entwicklung bei Natuvion

  • Mentorenprogramm für eine strukturierte und persönliche Einarbeitung

  • Werde Teil des #teamgreen - Bei Natuvion arbeitest du an innovativen Projekten als Teil eines Teams, das füreinander einsteht. Wir setzen auf Zusammenarbeit, Offenheit und Vertrauen

  • Modernes Equipment und zentrale Büros in Walldorf, Berlin, München und Leipzig

title: Solutions Architect
descriptionHtml:
About LiveKit

LiveKit is building the infrastructure layer for the agentic era of computing. Our platform gives developers everything they need to build, test, deploy, scale, and observe AI agents in production. Founded in 2021, LiveKit powers voice and agentic AI applications for OpenAI, Salesforce, Spotify, Meta, and tens of thousands of other developers, collectively facilitating billions of calls each year.

 

About This Role

We're hiring a Solutions Architect (Pre-Sales) to be the technical partner to the engineers and enterprises building on LiveKit.

You'll work alongside an account executive to understand what a customer is trying to build, design the right architecture, and bring it to life with live demos and proofs-of-concept — guiding teams from first conversation to production.

This role is ideal for someone who loves to build, is energized by talking with other engineers, and takes pride in turning a hard technical problem into something that just works. Real-time voice and video is visceral — latency, quality, and reliability are felt, not read about — so the best conversations include something live. You'll collaborate closely with our Sales, Engineering, Product teams to win technical decisions and to make sure what you hear in the field informs how we build.

You'll thrive here if you:

  • love to build and solve the most challenging customer problems with LiveKit

  • have a curious mind with a continuous desire to learn and improve

  • enjoy demoing and presenting, whether to a room or engineer, to a CTO or at a conference

  • have a team first mentality, seeking to lift others around you as you progress in your career

 

What You'll Do

  • Partner with an account executive as the technical lead on strategic deals — from discovery and architecture design through demos, POCs, and technical decisions

  • Advise customers on cloud architecture and deployment across self-hosted and LiveKit Cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure)

  • Build live demos and reference applications — voice agents, video pipelines, telephony integrations — tailored to each customer's use case, and reusable by the wider team

  • Scope and run proofs-of-concept against clear, shared success criteria, guiding customers all the way to production

  • Reason with customers about connectivity, infrastructure, and end-to-end latency to design for scale and reliability

  • Create technical content — blog posts, guides, webinars, and conference talks — that helps developers and enterprises build with LiveKit

  • Act as the technical enabler for your region's pod, and share field insight with Product and Engineering to help shape the roadmap

 

Who You Are

  • 4+ years in solutions architecture, sales engineering, or a customer-facing engineering role (or equivalent hands-on engineering experience with strong customer instincts)

  • Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, GCP, or Azure) — you can architect, deploy, and debug real applications

  • Comfortable with the modern deployment toolchain: containers, Kubernetes, infrastructure-as-code, and networking fundamentals (load balancing, DNS, firewalls/NAT)

  • Able to reason about connectivity, infrastructure, and latency end to end — how architecture, network path, compute, co-location, and model choice shape the AI agentic experiences of today

  • Strong programming ability in at least one of our core SDK languages — Python, TypeScript/Node, or Go

  • A clear communicator who can demo, present, and write for technical audiences

 

Nice to Have

  • Working knowledge of real-time media protocols and their latency/quality trade-offs (WebRTC, RTP/SRTP, WebSockets)

  • Familiarity with the AI voice stack: STT/TTS providers, LLM integration, speech-to-speech models, turn detection, and telephony/SIP

  • Experience speaking at meetups or conferences, or a track record of technical writing or open-source contributions

 

Our Commitment to You

  • An opportunity to build something truly impactful to the world

  • Contribute to open source alongside world-class engineers

  • Competitive salary and equity package

  • Health, dental, and vision benefits

  • Flexible vacation policy

title: Strategic Account Executive, EMEA (100% hunting role)
descriptionHtml:
Sonatype is the software supply chain security company. Sonatype is accelerating the future of agentic software development. As developers and AI agents build faster than ever, enterprises need a new level of control, visibility, and confidence at the moment software is assembled. Our Nexus One platform helps development, security, and platform teams govern the components, dependencies, models, and artifacts that power modern applications without slowing innovation down.

We are uniquely positioned to lead this next era. Sonatype operates both Maven Central, one of the world’s largest public open source registries, and Nexus Repository, a top-ranked enterprise repository used by thousands of organizations and over 70% of the Fortune 100. With over 1 trillion downloads annually across our ecosystem, we have unmatched visibility into how software is published, consumed, and propagated. That insight helps our customers make smarter decisions earlier, reduce rework, avoid security surprises, and ship AI-powered software with greater speed and confidence.

We are seeking an exceptional Enterprise Account Executive to accelerate Sonatype's growth across one of the most commercially significant and competitive enterprise technology markets.

This is a pure new-logo acquisition role for an accomplished enterprise hunter who thrives on creating opportunities, displacing established competitors and winning complex, high-value enterprise business.

As artificial intelligence transforms how software is developed, organisations are facing unprecedented challenges around open source security, software supply chain integrity, developer productivity and governance.

Sonatype operates at the intersection of these challenges, helping some of the world's largest organisations build and deploy software securely through industry-leading software supply chain intelligence and an integrated platform spanning repository management, application security and malware prevention.

The territory presents an opportunity for a commercially ambitious seller to develop strategic enterprise relationships, challenge established technology providers and build a significant new-business pipeline.

You will own a defined portfolio of enterprise prospects, with a clear mandate to identify, develop and close new-logo opportunities.

This is not an account management position, nor is it a role designed around managing an inherited customer portfolio.

Your success will be defined by the new customers you acquire, the competitive opportunities you create and the revenue you generate.

You will be expected to operate confidently against an annual quota, bringing the commercial discipline, enterprise sales experience and competitive intensity required to deliver sustained performance.

We're particularly interested in speaking with consistently high-performing enterprise sellers who have achieved President's Club, Pinnacle Club or equivalent recognition and can demonstrate repeated success in complex, competitive technology markets.


Our role in detail:

  • Identify and prioritise strategic prospects based on enterprise size, software development complexity, security maturity, competitive landscape and commercial potential.

  • Build sophisticated account plans identifying organisational structures, executive stakeholders, buying committees, incumbent technology providers and potential entry points.

  • Generate significant self-sourced pipeline through proactive outbound prospecting, executive engagement, targeted account-based campaigns and strategic networking.

  • Establish relationships with CIOs, CTOs, CISOs, VP Engineering, DevSecOps, Platform Engineering and Application Security leadership.

  • Engage enterprise prospects before formal buying processes begin, helping customers recognise challenges and opportunities they may not yet be actively addressing.

  • Collaborate with Marketing, Sales Engineering, Channel and executive leadership to develop coordinated account acquisition strategies.

  • Identify opportunities to position Sonatype's broader software supply chain platform through compelling customer-specific business cases.

  • Maintain strong commercial discipline around pipeline coverage, opportunity qualification, deal progression and forecasting.

    • Competitive Displacement & Enterprise Deal Execution:

    Competitive displacement will be a significant component of this role.

    We are looking for someone who understands the enterprise cybersecurity, DevSecOps and developer tooling landscape and is confident challenging established technology providers.

    You will be expected to:

    • Identify enterprise accounts using competing or incumbent software supply chain, repository management and application security technologies.

    • Develop account-specific competitive displacement strategies based on customer challenges, technical requirements and business outcomes.

    • Demonstrate a strong understanding of the competitive landscape, including organisations such as JFrog, Snyk, Black Duck, Mend, GitHub, GitLab, Checkmarx and Veracode.

    • Understand where Sonatype's intelligence, security capabilities, platform breadth and preventative approach provide meaningful customer differentiation.

    • Lead sophisticated enterprise sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders, technical evaluations, proofs of value, procurement and executive decision-making.

    • Develop strong economic buyer relationships and build compelling financial, operational and security business cases.

    • Apply structured enterprise sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC to establish clear qualification, decision criteria, competitive positioning and mutual action plans.

    • Navigate complex negotiations and commercial discussions while maintaining strong customer relationships.

    • Build internal and external champions capable of influencing enterprise purchasing decisions.

    • Demonstrate the judgement to qualify out opportunities where genuine customer value or a viable purchasing path cannot be established.

      • We want a seller who knows how to win when the customer already has a solution, not someone who only succeeds when there is no competition.

      Industry Knowledge & Technical Credibility:

      This role requires a strong understanding of the market in which Sonatype operates.

      You should be comfortable discussing how modern enterprise organisations develop, secure and deploy software, and how AI is changing the speed and complexity of those processes.

      You will:

      • Understand the commercial and technical challenges associated with open source software, software composition analysis, DevSecOps and application security.

      • Engage confidently with technical and executive buyers around software supply chain risk, developer productivity, governance and security.

      • Position Sonatype's platform capabilities across Nexus Repository, Firewall, Lifecycle and related solutions.

      • Understand how software supply chain intelligence can help organisations identify vulnerable components, prevent malicious packages entering development and make better risk decisions.

      • Translate technical capabilities into measurable business outcomes rather than relying on feature-led selling.

      • Recognise opportunities to position Sonatype as a strategic enterprise platform rather than a standalone point solution.

      • Stay informed about emerging technology, AI-assisted development, competitive market movements and evolving enterprise security requirements.

        • Channel & Cross-Functional Enterprise Selling:

        Enterprise sales success requires the ability to bring the right expertise together around the customer.

        You will:

        • Build productive relationships with regional channel partners, systems integrators and enterprise solution providers.

        • Identify partner-sourced and partner-influenced opportunities that support new-logo acquisition.

        • Collaborate with Sales Engineering to develop effective technical validation strategies and proofs of value.

        • Partner with Marketing on account-based campaigns, executive engagement and targeted enterprise outreach.

        • Engage executive sponsors where appropriate to support strategic opportunities.

        • Coordinate internal resources effectively while retaining clear ownership of the commercial outcome.

        • Share competitive intelligence, customer insights and market feedback to improve Sonatype's broader enterprise go-to-market execution.

          • Role Outcomes:

          Success in this role means establishing a high-performing, predictable new-logo acquisition engine across the assigned territory.

          • Deliver against an annual new-business quota.

          • Consistently originate and close new enterprise customer opportunities.

          • Build a sustainable, self-generated enterprise pipeline.

          • Demonstrate strong enterprise deal qualification, commercial judgement and forecast accuracy.
