          • Create repeatable territory development and enterprise acquisition practices that support long-term growth.

            • What Success Looks Like:

            First 30 Days — Understand, Assess & Prioritise

            You will develop a deep understanding of Sonatype's technology, competitive positioning, customer value proposition and enterprise go-to-market strategy.

            Who You Are:

            You are an accomplished enterprise technology sales professional with a demonstrable track record of acquiring new customers, exceeding ambitious revenue targets and winning in highly competitive markets.

            You are a hunter by nature, motivated by opening doors, creating opportunities and winning business that would otherwise remain with a competitor.

            Essential Experience & Capabilities

            Proven Enterprise New-Business Performance

            • Demonstrated success carrying and achieving substantial enterprise new-business quotas, ideally around $2 million annually or at a comparable level of commercial complexity.

            • A track record of consistent quota attainment and strong new-logo acquisition.

            • Evidence of personally originating, developing and closing complex enterprise opportunities.

                  • Enterprise Territory Development

                  • Experience developing a geographic or named-account territory through proactive outbound activity.

                  • Strong account prioritisation, stakeholder mapping and territory planning.

                    • Technical & Industry Understanding

                    • Strong familiarity with cybersecurity, DevSecOps, application security, developer tooling, cloud infrastructure or adjacent enterprise technology.

title: Robotics Test Automation Engineer (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
About the Role

You will develop software for system and regression testing of our robots, including test scripts, test tools, and automation solutions. Your core output will be high-quality, reusable test software that helps the team improve the efficiency, coverage, and repeatability of robot system testing.

This is a development engineer role. You will collaborate with the robotics test and system test engineers in the team to develop scripts, tools, and automation solutions for key software and hardware test scenarios across our robot systems.

In addition to software development, you will have the opportunity to participate directly in validation and debugging work on physical robots and in simulation environments. You will run and refine the tools and automated test solutions you develop on real systems, gaining first-hand insight into how robots behave and the challenges they face in real-world environments.

Your Responsibilities

  • Develop system, integration, and regression test scripts in Python or C++ for various robotic platforms
  • Develop ROS 2-based test tools, such as nodes for stimulating and monitoring the system, tools for data recording and replay, log and rosbag analysis, and test result reporting
  • Debug, validate, run, and maintain automated test solutions in simulation environments and on physical robots
  • Develop scripts and tools for long-duration stability, performance, and fault-injection testing
  • Work with system test engineers in the team to turn manual test scenarios suitable for automation into stable, reusable test scripts
  • Integrate test scripts into CI/CD pipelines so that they run automatically with each build
  • Maintain test code quality through code reviews, documentation, and version control
  • Use the tools you develop to support issue reproduction, diagnosis, and analysis

What You Bring

  • Hands-on ROS 2 development experience gained through work, internships, a thesis, or student projects; able to write nodes using rclpy or rclcpp, with familiarity in topics, services, actions, parameters, launch files, and rosbag
  • A robotics background, with practical experience in robot development or testing through work, internships, a working student role, a thesis, or student projects
  • Strong programming skills in at least one of Python or C++
  • A Bachelor’s degree or higher in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related field; recent graduates are welcome
  • Familiarity with Linux and Git
  • A long-term interest in robot testing and quality engineering, as well as an interest in debugging and validating your own code on real robots
  • Good written and spoken English skills

Nice to Have

  • Experience with robot arms, legged robots, or other mobile robot platforms
  • Experience developing automated tests for real hardware
  • Familiarity with simulation tools such as Gazebo, Isaac Sim, or MuJoCo
  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines, such as GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, or Jenkins
  • Experience with Docker and test environment management
  • Experience with HIL or SIL test setups

What we offer

  • A dynamic high-tech company, combined with financial soundness and world-class investors.
  • Join an interdisciplinary, international team with 60+ different nationalities in a collaborative work environment.
  • Lots of development opportunities as we continue to grow.
  • Challenging tasks and impactful projects alongside experts that enable professional and personal growth.
  • Corporate Benefits Program covering health, mobility, and learning for 100€ net per month.
  • Modern office facilities with a rooftop terrace overlooking Munich, free drinks & fruits, and regular company events contribute to a good working environment

About us

Agile Robots is a leading provider of AI-powered robotics solutions. By combining artificial intelligence and robotics, the company makes industries smarter, more flexible, and more efficient. 

Founded in Munich in 2018 by renowned robotics researchers from the German Aerospace Center (DLR), Agile Robots has experienced rapid global growth. Today, more than 3,500 highly skilled robotics and AI enthusiasts are employed worldwide. The company has one of the largest research and development teams in the AI and robotics industry. 

Agile Robots has built a unique portfolio, together with the subsidiaries BÄR Automation, Franka Robotics, idealworks, and Krause Automation, the company covers all areas of AI-driven robotics.

Find out more at: https://www.agile-robots.com/en/

title: Sales Account Manager France
descriptionHtml:
Technology is what we do. Passion is what sets us apart.

At ITQ, we partner with some of the world's leading brands to unlock the full potential of Cloud Native, Cloud Infrastructure, Private AI, Managed Services and Project Management. But technology is only part of the story.

We believe the best results come from people who are curious, driven and passionate about what they do. That's why we give you the freedom to grow, the trust to shape your own path and the opportunity to make a real impact.

How you’ll make your impact

ITQ is growing fast in France. To keep up with this growth, we are strengthening our French sales team and are looking for a Sales Account Manager to join it. As Sales Account Manager at ITQ, you will work alongside experienced sales colleagues to build and develop ITQ's customer base in France, and help shape the further development of ITQ as an end-to-end service provider.

You are a team player with experience in selling IT services who enjoys working with enthusiastic and dynamic teams and colleagues in the ITQ Family.

What you’ll be doing

  • Contribute to ITQ's growth in the French market as part of an established team of sales professionals, working together to cover the French territory.

  • From day one, you will build and manage customer opportunities in collaboration with your fellow Account Managers and the (inside) sales team. Over time you will build and sustain your own pipeline across new and existing customer accounts, based on the full breadth of ITQ services.

  • Within the team, you drive ITQ's commercial activities on your accounts, including sales of all ITQ services: professional, managed and support services, as well as software licenses and hardware resales.

  • Together with the sales team and stakeholders, you co-develop a sales strategy towards ITQ's revenue and profitability targets. You build and maintain partner relationships with other IT service providers in France.

  • You are a trusted advisor to our customers, understanding their "why" and helping them translate it into solutions and services that keep them one step ahead of their competition.

  • You create offers and service descriptions, pursue opportunities and close them. Accurate forecasting of license, service and other sales, and creating new customers in the CRM system, are familiar to you.

Who you are

  • You have a degree in business informatics, business administration or an apprenticeship as an IT systems clerk, or comparable training.

  • You have 3+ years of experience selling services, managed services, software licenses and hardware resales.

  • You are familiar with the VMware portfolio, the vendor, its partners and clients.

  • You are oriented towards mid-sized to large business accounts.

  • You are reliable, responsible and feel responsible for ITQ and our customers.

  • You have an independent, self-reliant and goal-oriented way of working, and you enjoy sharing and collaborating within a team.

  • You are versatile in all business development matters.

  • You have already successfully demonstrated your teamwork and organizational skills.

  • You are a native French speaker with excellent written and spoken English.

  • Ideally, you are located in the Île-de-France region.

We offer some awesome perks

Because when passionate people thrive, everyone benefits.

At ITQ, we believe that when people have the freedom to grow, the support to develop and the opportunity to follow their passions, they do their best work. That's why we've created an environment where you can thrive; professionally and personally.

  • Tailored learning & development: No traditional performance reviews. Instead, you’ll have continuous conversations, training and certification opportunities to help you become the very best at what you do.

  • A community of experts: Join a team of passionate professionals who genuinely enjoy sharing knowledge, supporting one another and celebrating success together.

  • Sales commission: Your success drives our growth. That's why your achievements are rewarded through a commission scheme linked to your sales performance.

  • Mobility that works for you: Whether you prefer a lease car or a mobility budget, you'll have the flexibility to choose the option that best fits your lifestyle.

  • The right tools from day one: Choose your own laptop and phone with our budget equipment, delivered before you start. We also provide a home office budget to help you create your ideal workspace.

  • ITQlife: We organize activities throughout the year that bring colleagues together: from our traditional summer BBQ to our annual weekend and various team outings.

  • Your well-being matters: You’ll have access to a vitality coach, who can support you with your psychical and mental well-being.

  • And of course… we offer a solid foundation by offering a competitive salary, insurances and a pension plan.

descriptionHtml:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

  • Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

3 days per week in our London office

Build your enterprise sales career at n8n

n8n is growing rapidly at the intersection of AI, automation and enterprise software. More than 1.7 million active builders use n8n each month, and we’re scaling our enterprise business as more organisations look for ways to connect AI with the systems, data and workflows that run their businesses.

We’re building our SDR team in London and looking for a Sales Development Representative to join us.

You’ll partner closely with Enterprise Account Executives to break into some of the largest organisations in the NEMEA region. This isn’t about maximising email volume. You’ll take a thoughtful, account-based approach: researching strategic companies, identifying the right stakeholders, understanding their priorities, and creating relevant conversations around automation and AI.

If you’re succeeding in an SDR/BDR role and want greater exposure to enterprise selling, strategic account planning, technical buyers and a genuine path towards AE, this could be a great next step.

Why you will thrive at n8n?

Serious momentum. n8n has grown rapidly into a major player in workflow automation and AI, with more than $100M in ARR, 1,400+ enterprise customers, and a $5.2B valuation following strategic investment from SAP.

Build towards AE. We want the SDR role to be a platform for your next step. High-performing SDRs can develop through our structured SDR → AE programme, with live deal exposure, discovery and MEDDPICC coaching, call reviews, and opportunities to take greater ownership of real opportunities alongside experienced AEs.

Learn enterprise selling. Work alongside Enterprise AEs on account strategy, stakeholder mapping, messaging, discovery and opportunity creation - gaining exposure to how complex enterprise deals are built from the start.

Sell where the market is going. You’ll engage technical and executive buyers around AI, automation and some of the most important technology challenges businesses are tackling today.

Use AI to sell smarter. Experiment with AI, n8n and modern sales technology to research accounts, understand buyers, personalise outreach and improve how you work. You don’t need to be an engineer - but you should be curious about technology and excited to learn.

What you’ll do;

  • Build enterprise pipeline: Prospect into a focused set of strategic accounts and create qualified opportunities.

  • Develop account strategies: Partner with Enterprise AEs to identify priority companies, stakeholders, challenges, use cases and engagement strategies.

  • Research your prospects: Understand the business and technical priorities of stakeholders across IT, DevOps, SecOps, Engineering and related teams.

  • Create outreach that gets attention: Develop thoughtful, personalised messaging tied to real account priorities rather than generic sequences.

  • Prospect across channels: Engage prospects through email, phone, LinkedIn and other relevant channels.

  • Lead early-stage discovery: Understand business needs, technical environments, priorities, urgency and potential fit with n8n.

  • Continuously improve: Use Salesforce, Outreach, Apollo, AI tools, coaching and performance data to sharpen your approach.

What we’re looking for;

We’re looking for someone with a strong SDR foundation who wants to develop into an excellent enterprise seller.

You’ll likely be a good fit if you have:

  • SDR or BDR experience in B2B SaaS, software or technology

  • Experience generating pipeline through outbound prospecting within mid- market or enterprise accounts

  • A strong sales track record against your targets

  • Fluency in English (verbal and written) + an additional language is beneficial

  • Confidence engaging senior business and technical stakeholders

  • A thoughtful approach to account research, personalisation and qualification

  • Curiosity about technical products, automation and AI

  • Resilience, consistency and ownership of your results

  • The ability to work from our London office three days per week

Bonus points if you have: experience prospecting into technical audiences; familiarity with buying committees, Salesforce, Outreach, Apollo or MEDDPICC; experience using AI or automation in your own sales workflow.

What success looks like

Success here is about quality, not just activity.

You’ll build a deep understanding of your accounts, identify the right stakeholders, create messaging that earns attention and generate qualified enterprise opportunities that can turn into meaningful revenue.

Along the way, you’ll build experience in enterprise account strategy, technical selling, discovery, AI and automation, and complex B2B sales - giving you a strong foundation for the next stage of your career.

Interested?

If you have a strong foundation in outbound sales, you’re curious about technology, and you’re excited by the opportunity to help build n8n’s enterprise business while developing towards your next step in sales, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Sales Development Representative (SDR)
descriptionHtml:
Sales Development Representative

Edinburgh

 

Wordsmith

Wordsmith is building the legal operations platform for in-house teams, and we are growing fast.

We believe in-house legal is becoming one of the most important functions in the AI era. Every business is moving faster, but legal work is still too often scattered across inboxes, chats, documents, and disconnected systems.

Wordsmith brings that work into one system. Requests come in from across the business, AI agents handle the routine, lawyers stay in control where judgment matters, and every step is captured as work happens.

We are built for in-house legal, not law firms. Our goal is to help legal teams move faster, reduce unnecessary external counsel spend, and become a function the business can run with.

More than 500 companies, including Financial Times, Safelite, Trip.com, Canva, Starling, and Sage, use Wordsmith. Backed by $100M from Index Ventures, General Catalyst, Highland Europe, and others, we are building one of the defining companies in legal AI.

The Role

We’re hiring a Sales Development Representative (SDR) to spearhead our outbound engine and book high-quality opportunities with in-house legal teams.

This is the frontline of our growth. You’ll be responsible for finding the right accounts, crafting compelling outreach, and breaking into companies. You’ll work hand-in-hand with our Account Executives (AEs) and Marketing teams to build a predictable pipeline.

This is an early-stage environment. Things move fast, priorities shift, and there isn’t always a clear playbook. You’ll need to be resilient, highly organized, and willing to experiment with new ways to get a prospect’s attention.

What you’ll do

  • Build and execute targeted outbound campaigns (email, cold calling, LinkedIn) to general counsel and legal leaders.

  • Consistently hit and exceed monthly meeting-booked and pipeline targets.

  • Partner closely with AEs to strategize on key accounts and ensure smooth handoffs.

  • Act as a feedback loop for Marketing and Product by tracking what messaging resonates most with the market.

  • Maintain meticulous CRM data — keeping track of accounts, prospects, and outreach activity.

What we’re looking for

  • SaaS sales or lead generation experience (experience selling to legal, finance, or compliance is a major plus, but not required).

  • A relentless work ethic — you aren't afraid of the phone and view "no" as data, not a deterrent.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; you can cut through the noise with clear, value-led messaging.

  • High curiosity and coachability; you want to master the product, the market, and the art of sales.

  • High ownership — you take responsibility for outcomes, not just logging activities.

  • Organized, consistent, and reliable with excellent time management.

How we work

We’re an in-office team. We work together because it makes us faster, sharper, and more effective. You should expect to be in the office our out visiting clients as your default.

This is a high performance environment. We set a high bar, move quickly, and expect people to take ownership of real problems.

There isn’t always a clear path. The people who do well here figure things out, stay close to the work, and keep pushing until they get to the right outcome.

This role requires patience, structure, and strong judgement. You’ll be trusted to run complex deals with a high degree of autonomy.

 

Why Wordsmith

We’re in a period of strong momentum — growing quickly, winning new customers, and expanding into larger accounts.

The product is landing well, the market is ready, and the team is scaling to meet demand.

If you want to be in the room, close meaningful deals, and grow quickly in a high bar environment, this is one of the best places to do it.

Starte deine Sales-Karriere als SDR bei Pennylane in Berlin. Du sprichst mit Unternehmen, die bereits Interesse an unserer Software gezeigt haben, klärst ihren Bedarf und vereinbarst passende Demo-Termine für unsere Account Executives – ohne Kaltakquise. Mit Sales Academy, Buddy und Shadowing lernst du den SaaS-Vertrieb von Grund auf.

Du willst Arbeit, die etwas bewirkt – an einem Produkt, das bald Millionen von Unternehmer:innen in Europa helfen könnte?

Du arbeitest am besten in einer Kultur, die auf Vertrauen und Eigenverantwortung setzt?

Dann könnte Pennylane genau der richtige Ort für dich sein.

Unsere Vision

Unser Ziel ist es, die beliebteste Finanzmanagement-Software für KMU in Europa zu werden.

Wir befreien Unternehmer:innen von zeitraubenden Aufgaben in Buchhaltung und Finanzen und geben ihnen die Finanzkennzahlen an die Hand, die sie für die besten Entscheidungen für ihr Unternehmen brauchen.

Gleichzeitig helfen wir Steuerkanzleien, weniger Zeit mit repetitiven Aufgaben und mehr Zeit mit der Beratung ihrer Mandant:innen zu verbringen.

Kontext

Pennylane ist eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Fintechs in Frankreich – und wir sind im zweiten Jahr unserer Expansion nach Deutschland, mit unserem deutschen Team in Berlin.

In 6 Jahren unseres Bestehens haben wir Folgendes erreicht:

  • 💻 Wir haben uns als bahnbrechende Buchhaltungs- und Finanzsoftware für kleine Unternehmen und ihre Steuerberater:innen bekannt gemacht.

  • 💰 Wir haben insgesamt 400 Millionen Euro eingesammelt, unter anderem von Sequoia, dem berühmten Fonds aus dem Silicon Valley, der früh in Unternehmen wie Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, PayPal und viele mehr investiert hat.

  • 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Wir sind von 7 Mitbegründern auf mehr als 1.100 zufriedene Pennylaner angewachsen: Wir gelten heute als einer der besten Arbeitsplätze in Frankreich (auch remote), mit einer Bewertung von 4,6/5 auf Glassdoor.

  • 🌍 Wir haben ein internationales Umfeld mit mehr als 25 Nationalitäten aufgebaut, mit einer starken Remote-freundlichen Kultur, in der 30 % der Mitarbeitenden bereits aus allen Teilen Europas arbeiten.

  • 🤝 Wir haben das Vertrauen tausender Kund:innen und Steuerkanzleien gewonnen – mit herausragenden Bewertungen.

  • 🚀 Bereits mehr als 1.300.000 KMU (kleine und mittlere Unternehmen) und über 6.500 Steuerkanzleien nutzen Pennylane in Frankreich!

Warum ist diese Rolle so wichtig für uns?

Das SDR-Team ist entscheidend dafür, wie wir neue Kund:innen gewinnen.

Als erstes Glied in unserer Sales-Kette prüfen SDRs, welche Anfragen gut zu Pennylane passen, und machen daraus Gesprächstermine – und legen damit die Basis für den Erfolg des gesamten Teams.

Das deutsche SDR-Team besteht aktuell aus 2 Personen, und du gestaltest es mit, während es wächst. Du brauchst keine jahrelange Sales-Erfahrung, um bei uns einzusteigen: Diese Rolle ist als Berufseinstieg im Vertrieb gedacht – wir investieren in dich mit unserer Sales Academy, einem Buddy aus dem Sales-Team und einem klaren Entwicklungsplan.

Wie trägst du zum Projekt bei?

Wir erhalten täglich viele Inbound-Anfragen von Unternehmen, die Pennylane kennenlernen möchten. Genau mit diesen arbeitest du – 100 % Inbound-Vertrieb, Kaltakquise (Outbound) gibt es in dieser Rolle nicht.

Als erste Ansprechperson für unsere zukünftigen Kund:innen verstehst du ihren Bedarf, begeisterst sie für unsere Lösung und vereinbarst eine Demo mit einem Account Executive – der den Deal dann zum Abschluss bringt.

Konkret heißt das:

  • Du reagierst während deiner Arbeitszeit schnell auf neue Anfragen – in der Regel innerhalb weniger Minuten, denn Tempo entscheidet bei Inbound über den Erfolg

  • Du führst strukturierte Erstgespräche (Discovery-Calls) – Unternehmensgröße, aktuelle Buchhaltung, Bedarf, Timing, Entscheider:innen – und erkennst, ob eine Anfrage zum KMU- oder zum Steuerkanzlei-Team gehört

  • Du fasst per Telefon, E-Mail und LinkedIn nach und reaktivierst Leads, die abgetaucht sind oder einen Termin verpasst haben

  • Du übergibst qualifizierte Leads mit einem klaren Briefing an den Account Executive und hältst Salesforce sauber – Lead-Status, Notizen, nächste Schritte

  • Du teilst Erkenntnisse zu Lead-Qualität und -Quellen mit dem Marketing

Dein Erfolg zeigt sich daran, wie viele passende Gesprächstermine du vereinbarst, wie viele davon stattfinden und aus wie vielen konkrete Verkaufschancen entstehen.

Wie sehen deine Aufgaben im Alltag aus?

Deine Verantwortung wächst mit dir – so sieht dein Weg bei uns aus:

Die ersten 3 Monate

  • Onboarding mit Sales Academy, Buddy und Shadowing: Du lernst Pennylane, unser Produkt, die Lead-Typen und unsere Pitches kennen

  • Du führst deine ersten Calls mit Leads aus kleineren Unternehmen

Monat 4 bis 8

  • Du managst deine eigene Inbound-Pipeline in Salesforce und übernimmst zunehmend komplexere Leads

  • Du bringst dich in die Weiterentwicklung unserer Prozesse ein und gibst Kundenfeedback an Produkt, Customer Care und Marketing weiter

Und danach …

  • Mit wachsender Erfahrung übernimmst du zusätzliche Verantwortung: eigene Projekte, die Pflege unserer Wissensdatenbank (Notion) und die Unterstützung neuer Kolleg:innen

  • Abhängig von deiner Leistung und offenen Positionen kannst du dich perspektivisch in Richtung Account Executive entwickeln

Wen wir suchen

  • Du möchtest im Vertrieb durchstarten – als Berufseinsteiger:in oder Quereinsteiger:in. Erste Erfahrungen im Inside Sales, Vertriebsinnendienst oder Kundenservice sind willkommen, etwa als Junior Sales Manager, Sales Development Representative (SDR) oder Business Development Representative (BDR). Auch aus Gastronomie, Hotellerie oder Einzelhandel bringst du wertvolle Erfahrung im Umgang mit Menschen mit. Vertriebserfahrung ist keine Voraussetzung.

  • Du interessierst dich dafür, wie Unternehmen funktionieren, und sprichst gern mit Unternehmer:innen

  • Du kommunizierst klar und souverän – am Telefon und schriftlich

  • Du bist organisiert, arbeitest gern mit Zielen und magst strukturierte Prozesse

  • Du willst lernen, nimmst Feedback gern an und bleibst beim Nachfassen dran – auch wenn es mal nicht sofort klappt

  • Du führst auf Deutsch souverän telefonische Beratungsgespräche und schreibst verständliche geschäftliche E-Mails; auf Englisch (unsere Unternehmenssprache) fühlst du dich sicher

  • Erfahrung mit einem CRM (idealerweise Salesforce) ist ein Plus

Was wir bieten

  • 📄 Unbefristeter Vollzeitvertrag, Start ab sofort

  • 🏢 Hybrides Arbeiten: 2 Tage pro Woche in unserem Berliner Office, die übrigen Tage flexibel

  • 🎓 Strukturiertes Onboarding: Sales Academy, Buddy-Programm und Shadowing

  • 🚀 Entwicklungsperspektive in Richtung Account Executive – abhängig von Leistung und offenen Positionen

  • 🌴 Unabhängig davon, wo du ansässig bist, erhältst du 30 von Pennylane bezahlte Urlaubstage.

  • 💵 Du erhältst ein wettbewerbsfähiges Vergütungspaket.

  • 📈 Du erhältst Unternehmensanteile, um vom Erfolg mitzuprofitieren, den du gemeinsam mit uns aufbaust.

  • 🏡 Du erhältst ein Budget, um dein Zuhause in einen komfortableren Arbeitsplatz zu verwandeln, sowie eine monatliche Pauschale, um in einem Coworking Space zu arbeiten, wann immer du möchtest. In Berlin haben wir ein Office, aus dem regelmäßig gearbeitet werden kann.

  • 🇬🇧 Du erhältst Zugang zu Busuu, um dein Englisch oder Französisch zu perfektionieren.

  • 💻 Du erhältst die neueste Apple-Ausrüstung.

  • 🎉 Wir legen Wert auf regelmäßige gemeinsame Veranstaltungen wie unsere Tech Days (die Remote-Pennylaner alle 3 Monate zusammenbringen) oder unser jährliches Firmenseminar, um wichtige Momente des Zusammenhalts für alle zu schaffen.

  • 🌍 Ein internationales Team mit mehr als 25 Nationalitäten und ein starkes, gut finanziertes Mutterunternehmen in Frankreich

🤝 Bewerbungsprozess

  1. Kennenlerngespräch mit Mirko, Recruiter (30 Min.)

  2. Zweites Gespräch mit Jacob, Global Head of Sales SME (30 Min.)

  3. Praktische Case Study und Debrief mit Jacob, Global Head of Sales SME, und einem Mitglied des Sales-SME-Teams (45 Min.) – keine Vorbereitung nötig; wir schauen auf Gesprächsführung und Lernfähigkeit, nicht auf Produktwissen

title: Sales Engineering Manager Core - UK&I
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

Samsara is seeking an experienced and results-driven Sales Engineering Manager to focus on our Enterprise Core business in the UKI. You should have experience managing and ideally growing a dispersed sales engineering team in a high-performance environment. Our Sales Engineering team is full of problem solvers and tinkerers who are not afraid to get their hands dirty (literally) and play a critical role in demonstrating and communicating the value of Samsara's platform with our largest customers.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support to make a larger impact.
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven't been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and inspired to go farther than you have before.
  • You are a team player: At Samsara, sales is a team sport. We help each other out by sharing best practices and focusing on winning as a team.

In this role, you will:

  • Manage individual and team performance ensuring our partnership with sales, product, support, and customer success teams are productive and efficient
  • Work with Account Executives and Regional Sales Directors on account planning, strategy, and sales call activity
  • Manage escalations (product issues, feature requests, etc.) in a pre-sales environment
  • Participate in customer/prospect calls as a trusted advisor
  • Partner with other Sales Engineering leaders to improve the overall Sales Engineering organization at Samsara

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • B.S. degree in Computer Science or similar
  • 5+ years of sales engineering management experience
  • Experience with Software Product sales: Infrastructure, SaaS
  • Knowledge in one or more of these areas of expertise: IoT, Networking / Security, SaaS, Cloud Technologies, or Physical Security
  • Strong technical and business acumen
  • Excellent communication, customer service, and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to partner with a broad coalition of stakeholders, ranging from sales, product, marketing, support, and customer success, and from individual contributors to executive team members across the organization
  • Demonstrated leadership, creativity, and problem-solving abilities
  • Excellent presentation and organizational skills
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced dynamic environment
  • Ability to travel as needed
  • Location: Remote, United Kingdom

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. title: Sales Manager - Enterprise
descriptionHtml:
Sales Manager - Enterprise

London

Wordsmith

Wordsmith is building the legal operations platform for in-house teams, and we are growing fast.

We believe in-house legal is becoming one of the most important functions in the AI era. Every business is moving faster, but legal work is still too often scattered across inboxes, chats, documents, and disconnected systems.

Wordsmith brings that work into one system. Requests come in from across the business, AI agents handle the routine, lawyers stay in control where judgment matters, and every step is captured as work happens.

We are built for in-house legal, not law firms. Our goal is to help legal teams move faster, reduce unnecessary external counsel spend, and become a function the business can run with.

More than 500 companies, including Financial Times, Safelite, Trip.com, Canva, Starling, and Sage, use Wordsmith. Backed by $100M from Index Ventures, General Catalyst, Highland Europe, and others, we are building one of the defining companies in legal AI.

The Role

We're hiring a Sales Manager to lead and scale an Enterprise team.

You'll own the number for your team, coach a group of Enterprise Account Executives who run complex, high-value deals across large organisations, and build the strategies and discipline that help them win. Your focus will be hiring, developing people, and driving consistent team performance across long, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.

This is an early-stage environment. Things move fast, priorities shift, and there isn't always a clear playbook. You'll need to make decisions, set the standard, and keep your team focused and moving.

What you'll do

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of Enterprise Account Executives

  • Own and consistently hit team revenue and pipeline targets

  • Guide deal strategy across complex buying groups and large accounts

  • Coach the team on navigating stakeholders across Legal, Finance, Security, IT, and Procurement

  • Help the team develop strong champions and drive internal alignment within accounts

  • Run tight forecasting, pipeline reviews, and deal inspection across longer sales cycles (6 to 12+ months)

  • Hire, onboard, and ramp new Account Executives as we scale

  • Partner closely with GTM Legal Engineers, Product, and Leadership on solution design and deal strategy

  • Maintain accurate forecasting and clear deal visibility across the team

What we're looking for

  • Experience closing complex enterprise SaaS deals

  • Experience managing and coaching a quota-carrying sales team

  • Track record of landing and expanding high-value accounts

  • Strong stakeholder management across multiple functions, and able to teach it

  • Ability to build champions and navigate internal politics

  • Structured, strategic approach to deal management

  • High ownership and accountability for outcomes

How we work

We're an in-office team. We work together because it makes us faster, sharper, and more effective. You should expect to be in the office or out visiting clients as your default.

This is a high performance environment. We set a high bar, move quickly, and expect people to take ownership of real problems.

There isn't always a clear path. The people who do well here figure things out, stay close to the work, and keep pushing until they get to the right outcome.

This role requires patience, structure, and strong judgement. You'll be trusted to lead complex deals and a high-performing team with a high degree of autonomy.

Why Wordsmith

We're in a period of strong momentum, growing quickly, winning new customers, and expanding into larger accounts.

The product is landing well, the market is ready, and the team is scaling to meet demand.

If you want to build a team, develop great salespeople, and grow quickly in a high bar environment, this is one of the best places to do it.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

Role Overview

Reporting directly to our Head of UKI, Harvey's Enterprise Sales Manager for UKI will lead and coach high-performing Account Executives selling into corporate legal departments across UK and Ireland. You will own delivery against ambitious revenue targets while rolling up your sleeves to work directly with prospective Enterprise customers. We are looking for a self-starter who can build pipeline and a team from a small base, navigate ambiguity, operate in a fast-paced environment, and make fast, clean personnel decisions. Ideal candidates will have experience scaling enterprise sales teams in net new logo environments, outstanding communication skills, and an instinct for understanding what legal buyers actually care about.

What You'll Do

  • Recruit, ramp, and lead a team of consultative, solution-based enterprise Account Executives selling into corporate legal departments across UKI.

  • Own the team's pipeline build as a weekly operating discipline - not a quarterly scramble - including outbound cadences, territory planning, and qualified pipeline coverage targets.

  • Be accountable for revenue, forecast accuracy, and the rigor of deal qualification across the team. Inspect deals, don't just take them on faith.

  • Personally engage in top accounts and complex deals as a player-coach, modeling the qualification, multi-threading, and executive engagement you expect from your team.

  • Work cross-functionally with Product, Legal Engineering, Marketing, and Customer Success to build effective sales processes tailored to the in-house legal buyer.

  • Build and iterate on the EMEA enterprise in-house playbook, documenting what works so it can be repeated and scaled.

  • Cultivate a culture of ownership, urgency, and development - attracting top sales talent and making fast, evidence-based personnel decisions when performance is off track.


What You Have

  • 10+ years of tech sales experience and 5+ years of people management experience.

  • A track record of building net new logo pipeline and revenue — not just managing an inherited book of expansion business.

  • Experience training and coaching a high-performance enterprise sales team selling complex, multi-stakeholder deals into corporate legal departments, financial services, or comparable professional services buyers.

  • Experience operating in an early-stage, high-growth environment where you built the motion - processes, cadences, and team — from a small base.

  • Strong communication skills with the ability to clearly articulate AI concepts and business value to General Counsels, Chief Legal Officers, and legal operations leaders.

  • Demonstrated qualification rigor and forecasting discipline - comfortable inspecting deals at the metric, economic buyer, and decision criteria level, and willing to disqualify aggressively.

  • A bias toward action on people decisions: comfortable having direct performance conversations early and making clean calls when the evidence is there.

  • Demonstrated passion for Harvey's mission and a strong point of view on how AI changes the work of in-house legal teams.

title: Sales Operations Business Partner
descriptionHtml:
About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About the role

We’re looking for a Sales Operations Business Partner to sit between our sales leadership and the systems, data, and processes that run the revenue engine. You’ll help the sales team understand where deals stand, where revenue is coming from, and where it’s at risk. You’ll own how we track pipeline, report on performance, and build the dashboards leaders rely on to make decisions. This is a role for someone who thinks in business outcomes first and uses data and tools as the means to get there.

What you’ll do

  • Own pipeline management processes, including stage definitions, forecasting cadence, and hygiene standards, and work with sales managers to keep the pipeline accurate.

  • Build and maintain regular sales reporting covering bookings, pipeline coverage, conversion rates, win/loss, and rep and team performance.

  • Design, build, and maintain dashboards that give leadership and frontline managers a clear view of performance against targets.

  • Act as a business partner to sales leaders: understand their priorities, translate them into operational requirements, and bring data-backed recommendations to planning and business reviews.

  • Support forecasting and quarterly business reviews by preparing the data, challenging assumptions, and flagging risks early.

  • Own day-to-day administration and configuration of the CRM (e.g. Salesforce or HubSpot), including fields, workflows, user access, and reporting structure, in partnership with the RevOps or systems team.

  • Drive adoption of CRM and sales processes by working with managers and reps, and by making the right behaviour the easy one.

  • Support territory, quota, and compensation-related analysis as needed, in partnership with Finance.

  • Identify process gaps and inefficiencies across the sales funnel and lead improvements, documenting changes and training the team on them.

  • Work cross-functionally with Marketing, Finance, Customer Success, and Product Ops to keep data consistent across systems.

What you’ll bring

  • 7+ years of experience in sales operations, revenue operations, GTM operations, or a related commercial role, ideally in a [B2B SaaS / relevant industry] environment.

  • Strong experience with CRM systems, ideally Salesforce or HubSpot, including reporting and basic administration.

title: SecOps Engineer - Stage Paris - Theodo Cloud
descriptionHtml:
L’histoire du groupe Theodo et son succès Theodo accompagne depuis 2009 les entreprises innovantes dans la conception, le développement et le déploiement de produits digitaux ingénieux - tels que la plateforme TF1+, l'application LCL Pro ou l'application France Identité Numérique - en tirant parti du meilleur de la technologie et de l’approche Lean. Theodo connait une croissance exceptionnelle depuis 15 ans : nos équipes rassemblent plus de 750 Theodoers, principalement des Software Engineers, passionnés de technologie et d’amélioration continue. En 2025, le groupe Theodo génère 100M€ de CA. Theodo Cloud est la practice DevSecOps de Theodo, spécialisée dans la construction d’infrastructures et la cybersécurité cloud. Notre mission : aider les scale-ups et grands comptes à résoudre leurs problématiques business grâce à la tech. Nos équipes construisent des infrastructures scalables, résilientes et sécurisées pour les développeurs et les utilisateurs finaux. L’objectif : faire de l’infrastructure un levier de croissance plutôt qu’un frein.
En 2021, Theodo Cloud lance Theodo Security : notre équipe experte en cybersécurité pour aider nos clients à sécuriser leur environnement Cloud. Pour continuer à nous développer, nous faisons grandir l’équipe et recrutons un ou une SecOps Engineer en stage de fin d’études. Les missions d’un(e) SecOps Engineer : Theodo Cloud intervient sur deux typologies de projets : - des projets spécifiques, liés à la sécurisation des infrastructures de nos clients (pentest, forensic et remédiations) - des projets transverses à Theodo Cloud pour implémenter la sécurité By-Design chez nos clients Dans tous les cas, nous intervenons toujours en équipe : Lead SecOps, SecOps, SRE, Agile Project Managers travaillent main dans la main pour garantir l’impact de nos actions chez nos clients ! En tant que SecOps Engineer, tu interviendras sur des projets : - d’audit et de pentest - en boîte blanche, grise ou noire selon les besoins du client, sur des périmètres qui peuvent aller des applications mobiles aux clusters Kubernetes, en passant par les applications web et les infrastructures cloud - de sécurisation d’infrastructure, avec une équipe 100% SecOps ou intégré à une équipe Ops - ces projets mélangent construction d’infrastructure, sécurisation, outillage et formation des équipes client Ton rôle sera de comprendre et répondre aux besoins d’un client à l’aide des outils les plus pertinents sur le marché. Kubernetes, Checkov, Falco, AWS, Google Cloud, Github Actions, Argo CD, Terraform… feront partie de ton quotidien ! Theodo Cloud est encore une jeune entreprise où il y a de la place pour construire des choses. En parallèle de ton projet, tu auras du temps dédié pour t’investir sur des sujets qui te tiennent à coeur : la formation des équipes business, le Green IT, la diversité, le marketing technique... Les opportunités d’évolution : Nous recrutons exclusivement des stagiaires de fin d’études sur ce poste, avec l’objectif de convertir ensuite le stage en CDI. Sur du plus long terme, la première étape d’évolution chez Theodo Cloud est de devenir Lead SecOps sur les projets, et d’être ainsi garant de la stratégie technique et de la montée en compétences de ton équipe. Nous proposons ensuite deux tracks d’évolution possibles : - une track Management, qui t’emmènera vers un rôle d’Engineering Manager - une track Expertise, qui te permettra d’accéder à un rôle de Staff Engineer Ton profil : Nous recherchons une personne ayant : - une solide formation académique en école d’ingénieur - une 1ère expérience (pro ou perso) avec les technologies infra / Cloud (Kubernetes, Docker, AWS, GCP...) et une appétence pour la cybersécurité ou une 1ère expérience (pro ou perso) en cybersécurité avec une appétence infra/Cloud - une forte envie de progresser - l’envie de travailler en équipe Tu ne coches pas 100% des critères mais tu penses tout de même correspondre à notre recherche ? Ne t’auto-censure pas et envoie-nous ta candidature, on se fera un plaisir de l’étudier ! Le processus de recrutement : Nous répondons à toutes les candidatures dans un délai de 3 jours. Si ton profil nous plait, nous te proposons le process suivant : - un appel téléphonique de 30 minutes avec un membre de l’équipe recrutement, pour comprendre tes critères de recherche - un entretien d’une heure avec le recruteur ou la recruteuse avec qui tu as échangé à la première étape, pour parler plus en détail de la culture Theodo Cloud - un entretien technique de débug de 45 minutes sur Docker compose avec un Ops - un entretien technique de 45 minutes avec de l'offensif et du défensif avec un SecOps Engineer - un entretien de motivation de 30 minutes avec un dirigeant de Theodo Notre process dure 2 semaines en moyenne. Tu seras accompagné(e) par une personne de l’équipe recrutement, qui sera là pour te coacher tout au long du process. Pourquoi rejoindre Theodo ? 💼 Rejoindre un groupe de 750 personnes avec de nombreuses possibilités d’évolutions cross-entités 🤝 Chaque Theodoer est accompagné par un coach interne. Son objectif : t’épauler dans ton quotidien et parler objectifs de carrière via des séances de coaching hebdomadaires. 🎯 Participation à des projets associatifs grâce à la Fondation Theodo (Ada Tech School, Code Phoenix, Article 1…) 🚇 Remboursement de 50% de l'abonnement de transport ou mobilité durable 🍽 Carte ticket-restaurants Swile Prêt à nous rejoindre ?

title: Security Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About OLIX

AI is growing faster than any technology in history, and the demand has created an infrastructure gap: we can no longer build chips or power stations fast enough to keep up. The industry still relies on a ten-year-old hardware blueprint that has reached its limit. The OLIX Decode Accelerator 1 (DX-1) is the first accelerator architected specifically for decode. Rack-scale co-design of logic, data movement, packaging, optics and interconnect delivers a step change in system-level performance.

The Role

We are hiring a Security Engineer to own the security of the systems every OLIX employee depends on: identity, devices, email, collaboration tools and our cloud estate. Our IP is the company, and protecting it is a hands-on engineering job.

You will own detection and response, harden our tooling, run vulnerability management and build the technical controls behind our ISO 27001 certification in 2027. You will work alongside our AI Security Engineer and IT Systems Engineer, and you will use automation and AI to make a small team cover a fast-growing company. This is a high-ownership role with the freedom to define how security engineering works at OLIX.

Responsibilities

  • Own detection and response: triage every security alert, work incidents end to end with our managed detection and response partner, and fix the root cause.

  • Harden the core estate: configure and baseline security across identity, endpoints, Google Workspace, Slack, Atlassian, GitHub and AWS.

  • Run vulnerability management: set remediation service levels, close vulnerabilities in order of real risk, and report progress every week.

  • Build certification controls: operate and evidence the controls for ISO 27001, SOC 2 and NIST CSF.

  • Extend detection coverage: connect new log sources to our SIEM and write the detection rules for them.

title: Security Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Why Conduct

The world's largest companies are slowed down by the software they run on. We're building the AI operating system that absorbs IT complexity and unlocks entirely new levels of speed, output, and ambition. We believe this is a generation-defining mission. Major enterprises already trust us with their most critical systems, we just closed a $60M+ Series A from top-tier funds, and we're still early enough that what you build here defines the company. We're a small, talent-dense team doing our life's work at Conduct - we value extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. If you bring that same drive, we will make sure this is the place you do yours too.

Who we hire

We work with some of the largest enterprises in the world, and security is core to earning and keeping that trust. We're looking for someone who takes real ownership of our security posture and genuinely cares about getting it right. This is a builder's role as much as an operator's: you'll design and ship the security features our enterprise customers need, not just run controls and tooling.

You'll stand out if you:

  • Have shipped security features as a software engineer - things like BYOK per tenant, SSO/SCIM, or SIEM-compatible audit logging - not just configured or audited them

  • Have hands-on experience with enterprise security requirements - completing security questionnaires, navigating customer requirements around data handling and contractual agreements

  • Are confident acting as the technical point of contact for developers, CISOs, and clients during security due diligence conversations

  • Bring pragmatic judgement - you know how to balance security rigour against the speed a startup needs to move at

  • Are genuinely excited about InfoSec and motivated to keep growing; we're open to less experience if the drive and aptitude are clearly there

What you'll own

You'll own our security posture end to end: the day-to-day operational work of keeping us secure, the security capabilities our enterprise customers demand, and the bigger initiatives on our security roadmap as we build out the function. This is as much a software engineering role as a security ops one - expect to spend real time in our codebase building features, alongside hands-on investigation, remediation, and shaping how security scales as we grow from 20 to 40+ engineers.

Day to day, you'll:

  • Design and build security features that ship in our product - like BYOK per tenant, SIEM-compatible audit logs, and SSO/SCIM - working directly in the codebase alongside product engineers

  • Own enterprise security end to end - completing customer security questionnaires, working through requirements around data handling and contractual agreements, and acting as the technical point of contact for our clients’ CISOs and security teams

  • Monitor and harden our cloud environment - tracking security recommendations, driving remediation, and making pragmatic risk-acceptance calls where they're justified

  • Investigate and respond to security alerts across our endpoint, cloud, and application stack

  • Build out our detection and monitoring capabilities, evolving our SIEM with alerting that cuts through the noise

  • Own vulnerability management end to end - triaging, tracking, and driving issues through to resolution

  • Proactively hunt for threats, from unusual behaviour in our environment to emerging risks like package and supply chain compromises

  • Run and refine security scanning across our infrastructure, applications, and dependencies

Who we hire

  • 3-7 years in a security engineering role

  • Background can come from any type of security engineering; what matters most is that you're comfortable reading and writing code - you'll be building product features and tooling, not just operating them

  • Experience working with enterprise customers is a plus, not a requirement

title: SEM Technician (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Your Role

As an SEM Technician (f/m/d), you will support tools and process qualifications and help investigate issues arising across our semiconductor process flow. Working closely with our Failure Analysis Engineer, Process Integration team and other engineering functions, you will perform Scanning Electron Microscopy (SEM) analysis and complementary characterization using techniques such as Energy-Dispersive X-ray Spectroscopy (EDX) and Focused Ion Beam (FIB).

Ideally you come with a first-hand experience working with SEM. You will initially work alongside our SEM experts to deepen your knowledge learn the tool’s operating principles, procedures and inspection requirements for our specific use cases. Through hands-on training and continuous knowledge transfer, you will build your skills in sample handling, imaging, measurement and troubleshooting; before gradually becoming an independent SEM user and taking greater ownership of the tool and the processes.

As the function develops, there may also be opportunities to operate additional defect-inspection tools and support defect analysis and yield improvement within our 300 mm manufacturing facility.

What You’ll Do

  • Prepare, handle and inspect a wide range of semiconductor samples according to defined analysis requirements

  • Perform accurate and reliable SEM analysis to support tool qualification, process qualification and root-cause investigations

  • Use complementary characterization techniques, including EDX and FIB, where required

  • Work closely with Failure Analysis, Process Integration and engineering teams to understand inspection requirements and communicate results effectively across functions

  • Maintain accurate records of incoming sample lots, expected outcomes, reporting deadlines and priorities

  • Perform daily, weekly and monthly tool-health checks, calibration and routine performance monitoring

  • Troubleshoot tool and measurement issues and coordinate with equipment vendors to maintain tool availability

  • Maintain an accurate inventory of consumables and spare parts required for reliable SEM operation

  • Standardize measurement procedures and reporting methods to ensure consistent and repeatable results

  • Document operating procedures and best practices and, over time, support the training of additional SEM operators

  • Support the operation of additional defect-inspection tools and contribute to defect analysis and yield-improvement activities as the team grows

What You Bring

  • Technical training or a bachelor’s or master’s degree in physics, chemistry, engineering, materials science or a related field

  • Previous hands-on experience operating SEM systems

  • Experience with FIB and EDX is highly desirable

  • An understanding of sample preparation, imaging, measurement and basic failure-analysis methods

  • Previous experience working in a semiconductor cleanroom is an advantage

  • Willingness and ability to spend extended periods working in a cleanroom while wearing the required PPE

  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to work carefully and consistently with sensitive samples and equipment

  • A structured approach to documentation, sample tracking and task prioritization

  • Confidence working in a dynamic environment with interconnected technical dependencies and changing priorities

  • Good communication skills in English, with a reliable, open and honest approach to working with stakeholders

  • Willingness to learn, take increasing ownership and support tasks beyond your immediate scope when needed

Our work culture

People Over Processes. At Black Semiconductor, flexibility is key—we ensure work adapts to life, not the other way around. We champion work-life harmony, where careers are meaningful and enriching. Our processes are human-centric, allowing you to focus on what matters

Let’s grow together. Your potential is our priority. We provide the autonomy to make a lasting impact and nurture your growth through a culture of continuous learning. We invest in your journey for professional and personal development

Your Health and Future Matter. Your well-being is paramount. We offer a comprehensive benefits package with outstanding insurance, pension and virtual stock options for your mental, physical, and financial health. Your peace of mind is our priority - in the present and future

We Live Openness. Collaboration and inclusivity are the cornerstones of our culture. We practice openness, fostering trust and respect. Individuality is our collective strength, fueling innovation and driving us forward

We connect chips – and people. We encourage qualified individuals from any background to apply. We foster an inclusive and supportive work environment that values collaboration, innovation, and growth. Join our team and be part of an organization dedicated to making a difference in the industry

title: Senior adviseur geotechniek
descriptionHtml:
Jouw impact bij Movares

Jouw geotechnisch advies bepaalt of civiele projecten veilig, uitvoerbaar en toekomstbestendig gerealiseerd kunnen worden.

Dit ga je doen bij Movares

  • Je werkt aan geotechnische analyses, adviezen en ontwerpen voor civiele en infrastructurele projecten;

  • je pakt, afhankelijk van je ervaring, projecten zelfstandig op, van vraagstelling tot advies en ontwerp;

  • je bent sparringpartner voor collega’s en opdrachtgevers bij complexe geotechnische vraagstukken.

Geotechniek bij Movares is breed en adviserend. Je werkt voor verschillende opdrachtgevers aan uiteenlopende projecten, zoals spoor- en railinfrastructuur, civiele constructies en waterbouwkundige werken. Je combineert technische analyse met advies en denkt mee over oplossingen die veilig, uitvoerbaar en duurzaam zijn.

Binnen het team deel je actief je kennis en draag je bij aan de verdere ontwikkeling van Geotechniek. Heb je meer ervaring, dan begeleid je ook junior-adviseurs inhoudelijk.

Dit ben jij bij Movares

Je bent een ervaren geotechnisch adviseur die verder kijkt dan zijn eigen berekening. Je overziet het geheel, maakt inhoudelijke keuzes en weet collega’s daarin mee te nemen. Je vindt het leuk om kennis te delen en bij te dragen aan de ontwikkeling van collega’s en het team.

Werk je nu bij een gespecialiseerd bureau en mis je de breedte van projecten, de invloed op inhoudelijke keuzes of de ruimte om collega’s te begeleiden? Of wil je jouw geotechnische expertise inzetten in projecten met grote maatschappelijke impact? Dan past deze rol goed bij jou.

Dit breng je ook mee:

  • meerdere jaren ervaring binnen de geotechniek, passend bij een medior-of senior rol;

  • ervaring met Deltares-software (D-serie); ervaring met Plaxis is een pre, net zoals affiniteit met lijninfrastructuur;

  • sterke schriftelijke en mondelinge vaardigheden in zowel het Nederlands als Engels.

Dit krijg je bij Movares

Bij Movares werk je aan opgaven die Nederland verder helpen. Tegelijk krijg je de ruimte om je werk en loopbaan in te richten op een manier die bij jou past. Met goede arbeidsvoorwaarden, veel flexibiliteit en volop mogelijkheden om je te ontwikkelen.

Een sterk fundament

Een goede basis begint bij voorwaarden waarop je kunt rekenen:

  • een salaris tussen € 4.650 en € 7.580 bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur;

  • een flexibele pot van minimaal 15% van je jaarsalaris, inclusief vakantiegeld;

  • een goede pensioenregeling bij Zwitserleven, waarbij Movares twee derde van de pensioenpremie betaalt;

  • een NS Business Card voor woon-werkverkeer en zakelijke reizen. Privé profiteer je met de kaart van de dalurenkorting.

Maximaal flexibel

Vorm een manier van werken die aansluit bij jouw leven én jouw ambities. Maak keuzes die bij jou passen:

  • flexibel werken volgens ons Any Time Any Place-principe, passend bij je team, klanten en projecten;

  • De mogelijkheid om twee weken per jaar te werken vanaf je vakantieadres binnen de EU;

  • 20 vakantiedagen bij een fulltime dienstverband, met de mogelijkheid om extra dagen te kopen vanuit je flexibele pot;

  • met je flexibele pot kies je wat voor jou belangrijk is, bijvoorbeeld voor extra inkomen, pensioen, een fiets, bedrijfsfitness, verduurzaming van je woning of het aflossen van je studieschuld;

  • € 750 budget per vijf jaar om je thuiswerkplek goed in te richten;

  • € 2,45 netto thuiswerkvergoeding per thuiswerkdag.

Veel ontwikkelmogelijkheden

  • Ontwikkel een loopbaan die past bij jouw talenten en ambities. Kies jouw eigen pad:

  • ruimte om je expertise, ambitie en loopbaan verder te ontwikkelen;

  • leren door te doen, samen met ervaren collega's en met gebruik van een breed aanbod aan ontwikkelmogelijkheden;

  • de kans om actief kennis te delen en mee te bouwen aan de toekomst van ons vakgebied.

Samen groeien

Deel mee in de waarde die we samen creëren en de groei van onze organisatie. Samen voor succes:

  • je flexibele pot groeit mee met de resultaten van Movares;

  • een winstdeling met een doelbedrag van 5% van je brutojaarsalaris, afhankelijk van de resultaten;

  • en de mogelijkheid tot participeren in de waardeontwikkeling van Movares door middel van aankoop van phantom-aandelen.

Jouw team bij Movares

Je werkt samen met een hechte groep geotechnische adviseurs die elkaar makkelijk weten te vinden. Eén dag per week – op woensdag – werken jullie sowieso samen op kantoor in Utrecht. Daarnaast is twee dagen per week op kantoor gangbaar, maar stemmen we locatie en werktijden flexibel af. Er is altijd iemand aanwezig en de lijnen zijn kort.

De sfeer in het team is open en gelijkwaardig. Er is weinig hiërarchie: senioriteit gaat hier niet over ‘boven iemand staan’, maar over kennis delen en elkaar verder helpen. Collega’s kunnen goed met elkaar opschieten, schakelen snel en staan voor elkaar klaar. Samenwerken doen we bewust, omdat we geloven dat je daar betere oplossingen van maakt.

descriptionHtml:
Unsere Opportunity

Predium hat in den letzten drei Jahren die führende ESG-Intelligence-Plattform für institutionelle Immobilienunternehmen in der DACH-Region gebaut - mit den stärksten Namen der Branche als Kunden: Asset Manager, Wohnungsbaugesellschaften, Banken. Unsere Kundenbasis, die Daten, unsere Glaubwürdigkeit sind wertvolles Kapital für den nächsten Schritt. Investment-, Kredit- und Asset-Management-Entscheidung werden in der Real Estate Branche noch immer in Excel getroffen, Fall für Fall. Wir bauen jetzt den AI-Analysten, der diese Arbeit übernimmt. Direkt auf den Daten des Kunden, skalierbar ohne zusätzliche Köpfe. Wir sind stark finanziert und bringen KI in die Real Estate Branche.

Deine Mission

Du verantwortest das Produkt auf beiden Ebenen: das bestehende ESG-Produkt weiterentwickeln und die nächste Evolutionsstufe mitgestalten, den AI-Analysten für Asset Manager, Credit Officers und Transaction Manager. Du arbeitest eng mit Engineers, Kunden und unserem Gründer- und Führungsteam zusammen. Du bist verantwortlich für Kundennutzen und Umsatz, nicht für Features. Du gehst zum Kunden mit, verstehst ihre Welt, und übersetzt das in validierte Prototypen und klare Build-Entscheidungen.

Was du konkret tust

  1. Own strategic product development: Du gehst raus zu unseren Kunden, verstehst ihre Prozesse sowie pain points, die sie selbst ohne dein Zutun nicht erwähnen. Du baust eigenverantwortlich Produkte, die die Nachhaltigkeit von Immobilien fördern und einen messbaren finanziellen Impact auf unsere Kunden und unser Produkt haben.
  2. Collaborate closely: Du arbeitest eng mit Gründern / Geschäftsleitung und einem starken Engineering-Team zusammen und erhältst jegliche Unterstützung, um die richtigen Produkte schnell an den Kunden zu bringen.
  3. Iterate fast, finish fully: Du erstellst Prototypen mit AI-Tools und hast die Freiheit, selbständig und schnell zu iterieren, um Ideen in Stunden zu testen statt in Wochen. Speed und Urteilsvermögen sind dein Kompass. „Shipped" bedeutet für dich: der Kunde nutzt es, und es liefert Wert.

Woran wir Erfolg messen

Du hast in den ersten 6 Monaten zu 2-3 vielversprechenden Product Bets durch echte Iteration mit Kundenfeedback beigetragen. Du bist in mindestens einem Kernbereich so tief drin, dass Engineers und Kunden dir vertrauen, wichtige Entscheidungen zu treffen.

Was du mitbringst

  1. Du hast bereits digitale B2B-Produkte end-to-end entwickelt und erfolgreich iteriert. Du verstehst Kundenprobleme, denkst wirtschaftlich und hast nachweislich Mehrwert für Kunden und das Business geschaffen.
  2. Du gehst souverän mit Unsicherheit um. Du definierst Hypothesen, testest schnell, triffst Entscheidungen auf Basis unvollständiger Informationen und übernimmst Verantwortung, statt auf perfekte Anforderungen zu warten.
  3. AI ist fester Bestandteil deiner täglichen Arbeitsweise. Du nutzt LLMs, Agents und moderne AI-Tools wie Cursor oder Claude produktiv und hast bereits AI-Features oder AI-Workflows entwickelt – inklusive der typischen Herausforderungen wie Evals, Latenz, Halluzinationen oder Human-in-the-Loop.
  4. Du kommunizierst klar und überzeugend. Du arbeitest eng mit Kunden, Design, Engineering und Go-to-Market zusammen und kannst komplexe Sachverhalte verständlich vermitteln.
  5. Du kommunizierst souverän auf Deutsch und Englisch.
  6. Du glaubst daran, dass außergewöhnliche Produkte durch enge Zusammenarbeit entstehen. Deshalb bist du vier Tage pro Woche mit dem Team im Münchner Büro.

Bonus Punkte

  1. Du hast selbst ein Unternehmen gegründet oder kommerzielle AI Lösungen gebaut.
  2. Erfahrung mit Immobilien-, ESG- oder Finanzdaten.

Dealbreakers

  1. Du willst primär selbst Production-Code besitzen. Diese Rolle entscheidet, was gebaut wird und warum, und misst sich am Kundennutzen, nicht an gemergten PRs.
  2. Du brauchst klare Spezifikationen und abgestimmte Roadmaps, bevor du anfängst. Ambiguität verlangsamt dich, statt dich neugierig zu machen.
  3. AI-Tools sind für dich noch kein Teil deines täglichen Workflows, nicht als Lernbereitschaft, sondern als aktuelle Realität.
  4. Du arbeitest lieber im Stillen als im engen Austausch mit Kunden, CS und Product. Bei Predium gibt es keine Rolle, die hinter Prozessen verschwindet.

Warum Predium?

  • Stage: ~40 Leute, stark finanziert, auf dem Weg die Kategorie zu definieren. Früh genug, dass vieles noch gebaut werden muss. Ja, es ist manchmal messy - aber genau das ist der Punkt. Wenn du einen fertigen Playbook-Job suchst, ist das hier nicht der richtige Fit.
  • Impact: Du bist nicht Rädchen #100 in einer Company. Was du hier aufbaust - Produkt, das Kunden wirklich nutzen - bleibt. Dein Beitrag ist direkt sichtbar, im Revenue und im Produkt.
  • Ownership: Wir managen nicht deine Zeit, wir messen deine Ergebnisse. Du bekommst Verantwortung und Freiraum - und die Erwartung, beides zu nutzen.
  • Compensation: Competitive Salary, Bonus und Equity-Beteiligung. Wir wollen, dass du am Erfolg partizipierst, den du mitaufbaust.
  • Team: Office-first im Werksviertel München, 3,5 Tage/Woche.

30 Urlaubstage · Wellpass · Deutschland-Ticket · Jobrad · Team-Events
