  • Sell our full model: paid Discovery, a fixed price build (portals, CPQ, field service, CRM, AI agents) and ongoing operation of the solution.

  • Shape solutions together with our solution architects and AI engineers, and sell only what we can deliver.

  • Grow accounts after go-live with new use cases, entities and agents.

  • Build your own pipeline through your network, the HubSpot partner ecosystem, referrals and targeted outreach.

  • Use AI tools in your own daily work for research, preparation and proposals.

What You Bring

Must-haves

  • At least eight years in B2B solution or services sales, including at least three years personally owning enterprise deals.

  • A track record of deals of EUR 100k and more that you originated and closed yourself, with several decision makers, procurement and IT involved.

  • A solid technical or process background (for example IT, engineering, business informatics or consulting) and real interest in AI, digitalisation and business processes. You don't code, but you can follow an architecture discussion and explain a trade-off to a CFO.

  • A consultative way of selling: you listen more than you talk, and clients describe you as helpful, not pushy.

  • Native or C2 level German and fluent English, written and spoken.

  • Within commuting distance of Böblingen and happy to travel to clients in DACH.

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience at an IT consultancy, system integrator or B2B software vendor selling CRM, ERP, CPQ, PIM, field service, data or AI projects.

  • Experience selling to machine builders or building materials companies with dealer or service networks.

  • Knowledge of HubSpot, Salesforce or Microsoft Dynamics at enterprise scale.

  • Experience with structured qualification such as MEDDPICC from real deals.

Your Team

You'll be part of our Sales Function and report directly to our CEO. You'll work alongside our Sales Manager and Senior Account Executive, and on every deal closely with solution architects, AI engineers, consultants and project managers from our Practices in Böblingen and Lisbon.

Tech Stack

HubSpot Sales Hub, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, PandaDoc, Confluence, Jira, Microsoft Teams, Claude. On the solution side you'll meet HubSpot, ERP integrations, custom portals and AI agents built on large language models.

What We Offer

  • Attractive package with a fixed salary and a variable component that rewards good deals, not just more deals.

  • 31 vacation days per year: 30 days plus one extra company day for Christmas or a holiday of your choice. Baden-Württemberg public holidays come on top.

  • Hybrid working with two office days per week at our Böblingen HQ.

  • Company pension plan (Allianz) with an employer contribution from your second year that grows with tenure.

  • Business Bike leasing with the 0.25 percent tax advantage, full insurance, annual service and free brand choice.

  • Lunch subsidy of 5 EUR tax-free per working day, up to 100 EUR per month.

  • Corporate Benefits discount platform covering travel, tech, fashion, mobility and insurance.

  • Direct impact. Flat hierarchy, direct line to the CEO, and the chance to shape how a growing AI consultancy sells.

About Thorit

Thorit is the AI & CRM consultancy for the agent-native enterprise. Agentic means software that acts on goals instead of waiting for clicks. As a Diamond HubSpot Partner we work with enterprise B2B clients in DACH and the Nordics, building the agent layer on top of HubSpot and the systems around it, then operating it with them.

Ready to Apply?

Send your application via Ashby. A cover letter is optional, but please include a short description of the largest deal you personally originated and closed: what the client bought, rough deal size, how many people were involved in the decision, and what made the difference.

title: Senior Security Operations Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

As a member of our Security Operations Team, you will collaborate with a global team of engineers to monitor and respond to security events, lead security incidents as Incident Commander, and lead digital forensic investigations in support of Employee Relations, Legal, Compliance, or Information Security cases.

Although you will be focused on security incident response, you will also have the opportunity to create and maintain runbooks, and automated workflows, and assist in process refinement and implementation. You will collaborate with a diverse team of engineers, and key stakeholders on security initiatives across the company. Above all, your focus is bringing Security expertise to the table in a collaborative, humble, and practical manner.

Location: This role is open to candidates residing in the UK

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether students get dropped off safely from school, or whether power gets restored quickly after a natural disaster.
  • You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.
  • You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. This Customer Success team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.

In this role, you will:

  • Monitor security events and provide technical analysis on alerts
  • Lead information security incidents and employee insider investigations by developing the incident response strategy, lead the execution through incident closure, while providing incident updates to key stakeholders throughout the incident
  • Deliver security guidance clearly and concisely for incident response and insider threat initiatives
  • Coordinate the building of services, capabilities, integrations, and implementations of technologies to support security operations, incident response, and insider threat
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices
  • Participate in our on-call rota covering weekends

Minimum requirements for the role:

title: (Senior) SEO & GEO Manager // AI Music Video Platform

What you’ll do:

  • Experiment, measure and improve: run small, data-informed experiments with teams, learn what works in our context, and turn successful approaches into repeatable standards and playbooks. 

What you’ll bring: 

  • Experience leveraging AI and Generative AI (GenAI) to enhance engineering productivity — including code generation, debugging, reviews, documentation, and decision support — with a proactive mindset toward adopting tools that streamline development and drive innovation. 
  • Deep, hands-on experience building production systems (we expect you’ve spent at least 5 years doing this, possibly much more), ideally with PHP and Laravel as well as TypeScript/Node.js/Next.js on AWS, Azure or GCP.

title: Senior Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Our Mission:

Scope automates the data collection that's slowing down the physical world.

Standards are vital for the safety of our infrastructure. Spending hours manually documenting them is not.

Dave is an inspector. Today he’s climbing through one of Europe’s biggest chemical plants, looking for the corrosion that could shut the whole site down, with a notebook and pen in hand. Tomorrow, he’ll spend even longer on the part of the job he hates: turning those scribbles into a report.

We’re building the AI-native data collection layer for the 2 billion field workers like Dave. Scope radically simplifies how inspectors collect data in the field, make decisions, and produce reports. Along the way, we’re building the largest dataset on the condition of the built world and the decisions experts make about it.

It’s a $2T market and we’re just getting started. We're growing rapidly, and already work with 7 of the top 10 companies in the space. Our customers inspect facilities and products for companies including AstraZeneca and SpaceX.

We take pride in our talent density, and have assembled a best-in-class team: acquired and future founders, people from institutions like Imperial, Carnegie Mellon and Oxford, and from firms like Palantir, Goldman Sachs and Flexport .

Since launching from Entrepreneurs First in 2024, we've raised an oversubscribed $20m round led by Index Ventures, the firm behind Figma, Revolut and Wiz, with over 100 unicorns backed to date.

About the role

  • Real product ownership. You’ll go on site with inspectors, decide what matters, design it, ship it, and see whether it worked.

  • The hard, interesting problems in AI. Field data is messy: voice notes, photos, video, half-finished sentences recorded in a chemical plant with no signal. Turning that into a report an expert will sign is a context-engineering problem nobody has solved well yet.

  • A small team that ships fast. We ship to production every day and put changes in front of inspectors within days, not quarters. Ideas go from a site visit to a live feature in a single sprint. If something doesn’t land, we learn why and iterate quickly. There are no layers of sign-off between you and the user.

What you’ll do

  • Redesign the mobile app for how inspectors actually work: gloves on, no signal, one hand holding on

  • Build the systems that takes voice notes, photos, videos and proactively finishes reports without being annoying

  • Engineer how we feed context to AI models: how to store, fetch and select standards, reports, media, user intention

  • Evolve our workflow builder: something between Retool, Webflow and n8n for inspections

  • Design the architecture behind the product: how unstructured data flows through the system, how AI is integrated, how offline and online behaviour stay seamless, and how we keep the product simple as it becomes more powerful.

Who you are

  • You’re deeply technical. You’re a little bit sad that AI tooling creates more distance between you and the code, and you still like knowing how things work underneath.

  • You’re a manager of one. We believe great teams are made up of highly agentic people who care more about shipping results than collecting badges.

  • You’ve got the scar tissue. You have 5+ years of experience and know which technical decisions matter, and which ones don’t.

  • You’ve shipped real applications. Ideally mobile, ideally with Expo or React Native. You care about the details that break in the real world: offline, flaky networks, error states.

  • You’re curious about AI as an engineering problem. You’re interested in getting messy real-world inputs into a model and getting something reliable back out, not just in calling an API.

Interview process

  • An initial call with our talent team.

  • A collaborative technical exercise with an engineer, usually in Typescript or Python.

  • An Interview with a cofounder - Jonny (CEO) or Jakob (CTO).

  • Onsite Product Interview - Meeting more people on the team and getting a feel of what it would be like to work here.

  • Offer!

Compensation and benefits

We’re in the office five days a week, so we’ve made it a great place to be.

  • £120k–£150k base + significant equity, so you have a real stake in what you’re building

  • 33 days’ holiday (including bank holidays, which you can take at your discretion.)

Never settle – We think of ourselves as ‘embedded hero-makers’ for our customers. We put them first, and if we say we’ll do something, we’ll move heaven and earth to do it. We think boldly and embrace change.

Take ownership - We think rigorously and deeply about a problem, but then charge at it, acting with and urgency and speed that sets us apart. But we never lose sight of quality or long-term scalability.

Be generous & candid - We encourage our people – and our customers – to challenge us and never shy away from tough conversations. We have a flat and inclusive culture where everyone can be themselves – and speak up.

Check out our Glassdoor page for the latest reviews or our LinkedIn for company updates and insights from the team.

Our engineering ways of working:

  • Our Product and Engineering organisation is structured into four tribes: Custody, Accounts, Experience, and Cloud & Security. Each tribe contains multiple autonomous squads, with clear full ownership over specific product domains.

  • The squads are intentionally small and cross-functional, typically made up of an Engineering Manager, Product Manager, and 3–5 engineers with complementary skills aligned to the domain they own.

  • We operate in a build-and-run model, with teams responsible for the full software lifecycle, from architecture and delivery through to operational support and incident management.

  • Our core platform is built on AWS serverless technologies including Lambda, SQS, EventBridge, API Gateway, S3, and ECS. We primarily develop in TypeScript and Node.js, with MongoDB as our primary document database. We also have a small number of C# services and are continuing to evolve our platform architecture, including expanding our use of ECS Fargate.

  • Infrastructure is managed through a combination of Terraform and Serverless Framework. We use GitHub Actions for CI/CD and incident.io to support our incident management processes and operational workflows.

  • We care deeply about engineering quality, pragmatic architecture, and continuous improvement. If you’d like to go deeper, we’re happy to share more about our engineering practices and technology radar during the interview process.

The role

As an engineer at Seccl you will design, build and operate reliable and scalable, testable and maintainable software solutions, building new functionalities and products using Typescript and Node.js. You play a key role in our software development and have a hands-on approach throughout the development process supporting resilient financial workflow systems and regulated investment operations. As a senior member of the team, you are the ‘go-to’ person for queries.

On a typical day you will…

  • Work collaboratively in a domain aligned cross-functional squad made up of engineers and product along with colleagues from customer-facing and operations teams

  • Design, implement and operate your services within your domain

  • Be accountable for the SLAs of your products and iterative improvements

  • Maintain and extend documentation for your services

  • Foster a culture of continuous improvement and technical excellence while understanding when “good enough for now” is appropriate

  • Provide guidance and mentorship for other engineers

  • Communicate with non-technical colleagues to answer queries about the Seccl system

What you need…

  • To own your services from design to operation. We operate a build-and-run model where engineers have autonomy but full accountability.

  • We care deeply about correctness, resilience and operational excellence because our systems underpin real customer investments.

  • Engineers are not passengers in their products but champions. Drive improvements and features while collaborating openly with product, operations and engineering colleagues, challenging ideas constructively and focusing on delivering the best outcomes for customers.

  • Have a strong ability to understand business and customer problems and turn them into efficient, scalable solutions. Be curious about how investment and custody products operate, and pragmatic in balancing customer value, operational correctness, engineering quality and long-term scalability.

  • Experience building financial systems with multi-region, multi-currency or trading-related complexity would be advantageous.

  • Experience in a strongly/statically typed language.

  • Have a strong understanding of designing, building, and running high-quality, standards-compliant workflow APIs, with a focus on testing, observability, and performance.

  • Have worked with a cloud provider (AWS/Azure/GCP). We use AWS.

  • Have worked with distributed systems and are comfortable debugging through tracing and observability.

  • Willing to be on-call for your services.

Core technical skills you must have:

  • Strong commercial experience with Node.js, specifically TypeScript

  • Experience with Amazon Web Services

  • Experience with Serverless products

  • Experience with document databases, ideally MongoDB

  • Experience mentoring engineers

  • Experience leading technical delivery in a build-and-run engineering model

  • Experience in a structured on-call process and incident management

  • Experience working in regulated industries, ideally financial services or FinTech.

This role isn’t for you if...

  • You rely on a lot of top-down direction. Here, you’ll have a lot of freedom and ownership of your role, and you’ll be expected to shape your own progression, bring forward ideas, and spot opportunities to improve

  • You’re not comfortable working in a fast-paced environment. Our speed and scalability are what set us apart; you need to be able to act quickly and think on your feet

  • You struggle to follow through on ideas. We value people who do what they say they will. If you care about something, you have the freedom here to make it happen

  • You don’t like change. You’ll get on great here if you relish the ambiguity of rapid growth and are willing to embrace uncertainty

What’s in it for you…

We offer a generous mix of benefits for the things that really matter to our people, including:

Base salary based on experience and skills demonstrated during our assessment phase

🌴 27 days holiday + bank holidays (some can be flexible) + day off on your birthday + three days (full time) per year for Dependant leave

💙 Two volunteering days per year

🏅 Length of service award – one month paid sabbatical at eight years

✅ 6% employer pension contribution, and life assurance

🏥 Private medical insurance with AXA Health

👪 Enhanced Parental leave

💻 MacBook and up to £500 home office set up budget

📖 £750 per person learning budget

🌎 Option to work abroad for up to six weeks a year

🌻 Health and wellbeing initiatives including free therapy via Wellness Cloud, mental health support via Headspace

🌱 Strong financial wellbeing focus including access to Octopus Money, Octopus Share Incentive Plan and will writing offering via Octopus Legacy

🎁 Perkbox – Flexi-points giving you a range of discounts and perks including free weekly coffee, gym and retail discounts

🚲 Access to initiatives like Cycle to Work and Octopus Electric Vehicle Leasing

Interview process

Interviewing is a two-way thing, and we want you to have the time and opportunity to get to know us, as much as we are getting to know you. Our interviews are conversational, so come with questions and be curious. In general, you can expect the interview process to look a bit like this:

  • Talent screen - 30 min intro call with our Talent partner or an Engineering manager

  • Bar raiser - 40 min with two Engineering leaders focused on Engineering culture alignment

  • Technical loop - 2h virtual technical assessment with 2 core components - system design, TypeScript code review with breaks between the stages. You will receive preparation materials for the round and more information on how to prepare.

⏳ We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out and you should expect to hear back from us within one to two weeks of applying.

All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.

descriptionHtml:
Location: London, Bristol or Edinburgh, UK (hybrid, three days a week in the office)

Level: Senior Engineering Manager PL2

Contract: Permanent

Please note: This role requires an existing right to work in the UK. We can’t offer visa sponsorship, but we review sponsorship role by role, so keep an eye on our careers site for future opportunities.


About Kaluza

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.


What you'll do

Kaluza runs the billing and payments engine behind some of the world's biggest energy retailers. Every bill sent and every payment collected across Kaluza's markets increasingly runs through one shared core platform, and GBPA exists to build and run that core, so foundational billing and payments capability gets built once and reused everywhere, rather than rebuilt separately for every new market or client relationship.

That matters because of where Kaluza is headed: as we grow into new markets and take on more of the world's largest energy retailers as clients, rebuilding core billing and payments capability separately for each one is slower, costlier, and more error-prone than building it once and configuring it at the edge. Getting this right directly shapes how fast Kaluza can bring new markets and clients onto the platform, and how reliable that platform is once they're on it.

We're also in the middle of reorganising how this part of the business works, moving from building billing and payments capability separately per area toward one shared global core that every area configures rather than rebuilds. Senior Engineering Managers across GBPA sit at the centre of that shift, each owning two domains rather than a single team.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead engineering across two GBPA domains through complex, ambiguous, cross-squad initiatives.

  • Own technical and product strategy across both domains simultaneously, rather than handing strategy off to a single team.

  • Diagnose systemic and organisational issues using deep domain knowledge, not just resolve team-level technical problems.

  • Manage cross-functional stakeholders across Product, Delivery, and adjacent engineering teams to align roadmap and trade-offs.

  • Carry full people-leader ownership for both teams: goal-setting, performance and pay conversations, hiring and recruitment.

  • Operate in a high-integrity data domain (billing and payments) where reliability and reconciliation come before speed.


What you'll bring

Ideally you’ll have:

  • A proven track record leading engineering team(s) through complex, ambiguous, cross-squad initiatives — not single-team delivery.

  • Experience owning technical and product strategy across multiple domains or services simultaneously.

  • Track record of diagnosing systemic or organisational issues and resolving them with deep domain knowledge, not just fixing team-level technical problems.

  • Be a strong cross-functional stakeholder manager, working with Product, Delivery, and adjacent engineering teams to align roadmap and trade-offs.

  • Have full people-leader experience: goal-setting, performance and pay conversations, hiring and recruitment for the team(s) you lead.

  • Be comfortable operating in a high-integrity data domain (billing or payments), where quality and reconciliation matter as much as delivery speed.

  • Demonstrable record of applying AI/LLMs to deliver customer impact, not just adopting AI tooling internally.

  • Demonstrable customer obsession and a working-backwards practice: start from the customer problem and ship the simplest solution that solves it, rather than the most sophisticated one available.

  • Have a track record of successfully navigating complex stakeholder and leadership dynamics, influencing the wider organisation beyond your direct scope to improve product quality and team experience.

What will set you apart: 

  • Direct experience in billing, payments, or API platform domains.

  • Experience operating a "global core, configurable edge" or multi-market platform model (one engine, configuration at the edge, no client-specific forks of core logic).

  • Experience mentoring senior engineers toward people-leadership roles.


Our Values

Five values guide how we work at Kaluza:

  • Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.

  • Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.

  • Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.

  • Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.

  • Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.


Our Perks

  • Time off and family: 26 days’ holiday, plus 26 weeks’ full pay for new parents with no qualifying service period

  • Health and security: Private medical insurance with virtual GP, life assurance, pension scheme, free mortgage advice and eye tests

  • Pay and flexibility: Discretionary bonus, a Flex Fund of 5% [of salary] to spend on the benefits you want most, retail discounts through Perks at Work

  • Growth and setup: Personal learning budget, home office budget

  • Climate: Furthr, our climate action app


Come as you are

We want to meet people from all walks of life. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be, and we recognise talent on merit and potential. If you’re excited about the role but don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you.

title: Senior Solutions Architect
descriptionHtml:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The Role:

Every Celonis outcome starts with data. As a Solutions Architect, you make sure our customers’ data gets into the Celonis Platform reliably, securely, and at scale, and that insights and actions flow back out into the systems and AI tools where work actually happens.

You’ll join our customer project teams as one of the first technical faces of Celonis. You’ll work hands-on across the full integration toolkit: deploying our out-of-the-box extractors, building custom API connectors in a low-code environment, writing code for push-based ingestion, connecting Celonis to customer lakehouses and LLMs, and configuring writebacks, SSO, and user provisioning. Part implementation consultant, part integration engineer, part trusted technical advisor, this role is ideal for someone early in their career who wants broad exposure to enterprise architecture and modern data and AI integration patterns.

The work you’ll do:

Data integration and ingestion:

  • Implement standard extractors. Install, configure, and troubleshoot Celonis out-of-the-box extractors in customer landscapes, including SAP (ECC and S/4HANA), JDBC-based databases, and cloud applications such as Salesforce, ServiceNow, and others.
  • Build custom API connectors. Design and build custom connectors with Celonis Extractor Builder for source systems that expose data through REST or SOAP APIs, handling authentication (OAuth 2.0, API keys, certificates), pagination, rate limits, and incremental (delta) loads.
  • Enable push-based ingestion. Help customers design and develop scripts and pipelines (typically in Python) that push data to Celonis via the Data Ingestion API, and advise on file formats, scheduling, and error handling.
  • Connect to the lakehouse. Set up zero-copy data sharing between Celonis and customer lakehouses such as Databricks and Microsoft Fabric, including Delta Sharing configuration, access controls, and data freshness.
  • Unblock infrastructure. Work through on-premise agent deployments, networking, proxies, firewall and IP allowlisting, certificates, and service-account permissions with customer IT and infrastructure teams.
  • Keep pipelines healthy. Tune extraction schedules and delta strategies, monitor pipeline health, and resolve data load failures so customers get timely, trustworthy data.

Actions, AI, and platform connectivity:

  • Close the loop with writebacks. Configure Action Flows and other integration patterns that write back to customer systems (for example, updating records in SAP, Salesforce, or ticketing tools) so Celonis insights turn into action.

title: Senior Solutions Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Join Choco, where we build and own solutions that reshape a broken food system.

The global food supply chain is inefficient by design. Waste is high, margins are thin, and most distributor order processes are done over the phone, tracked across broad spreadsheets, and based on intuition rather than strong data.


At Choco, we’re changing that. We build software used daily by food distributors and their customers to run their business. It automates orders, reduces errors, and helps operations run faster and more reliably. Because it’s embedded in daily operations, our SaaS platform has immediate, real-world impact, on efficiency, margins, and how businesses run day to day.

Mission

As a Senior Solutions Engineer, you will deliver fast, reliable, API-driven integrations for our largest customers by translating business workflows into scalable, repeatable technical solutions. You will partner closely with Sales and Customer Success to deliver best-in-class integration experiences that drive adoption and long-term success. This role is primarily customer-facing, with a strong focus on solution design and customer outcomes rather than traditional software development. You'll build integrations primarily with low-code tools, using light scripting where needed.

What You’ll Do

  • Independently design, build, and deliver complex, scalable, and secure integrations between Choco and customer systems using low-code tools (e.g. n8n and Tray.ai).

  • Own complex and strategic integration projects end-to-end, from technical discovery and solution architecture to go-live, ensuring quality, scalability, and long-term reliability.

  • Partner with Account Executives in pre-sales by leading technical discovery, proofs of concept, and integration scoping, advising on feasibility and solution design for complex customer requirements.

  • Act as a technical escalation point, troubleshooting critical integration issues, proactively identifying risks, and driving sustainable solutions.

  • Collaborate closely with Customer Success, Implementation, and Product teams, providing technical guidance, documenting integration designs, and influencing product improvements based on customer needs.

  • Mentor junior Solutions Engineers, providing technical guidance, sharing expertise, and supporting their development through complex projects.

  • Drive continuous improvement of integration architecture, processes, and best practices to increase delivery efficiency, quality, and scalability globally.

  • Independently make technical and architectural decisions within complex projects, escalating only major strategic decisions requiring broader alignment.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of experience in solutions engineering, IT/ERP consulting, or systems integration.

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Experience managing end-to-end API integrations, including requirements gathering, solution design, implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing support across multiple customer environments.

  • Experience with low-code or automation tools such as n8n, Zapier, and Tray.ai.

  • Basic programming knowledge (e.g. JavaScript or Python) and working knowledge of REST APIs, JSON/XML, webhooks, authentication (OAuth, API keys), and data mapping.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a collaborative, solution-focused mindset.

  • Excellent communicator with the ability to make complex ideas clear and simple.

  • This position requires in-office attendance 3 days per week in our Paris office.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with the ERP or ordering systems common among food and beverage distributors.

  • Background in food distribution, supply chain, or B2B SaaS.

  • Familiarity with EDI, SFTP/flat-file integrations, or basic SQL.

  • Comfort using AI tools to speed up discovery, documentation, and integration builds.

What you get

  • Work on digitalizing core operating systems for food distributors, automating orders, sales and payments in a system that still largely runs on calls and spreadsheets.

  • Work with an AI product with proven product–market fit, already embedded in distributor workflows and directly affecting order accuracy, speed, and margins.

  • Join a global team across 6 countries and 40+ nationalities, building a company that has raised $300M+ and reached unicorn status (~$1.2B valuation) with the ambition to define this category end-to-end.

  • In return, you get real ownership, equity, and the support to do your best work, including competitive compensation, health and wellbeing support, and long-term benefits like a sabbatical (all localized by office).

  • Collaborate with people who want to own outcomes in a messy, real-world system and make it work at scale.

If you want to work on real problems, take ownership, and raise the bar, we should talk.

title: Senior Specialist, Information Security
descriptionHtml:
Who we are 

We simplify wealth creation. Founded in 2014 in Vienna, Austria by Eric Demuth, Paul Klanschek and Christian Trummer, we’re here to help people trust themselves enough to build their financial freedom — for now and the future. Our user-friendly, trade-everything platform empowers both first-time investors and seasoned experts to invest in the cryptocurrencies, crypto indices, stocks*, precious metals and commodities* they want — with any sized budget, 24/7. Our global team works across different cultures and time zones, bringing our products to more than 7 million customers, making us one of Europe’s safest and most secure platforms that powers modern investing.

Headquartered in Austria but operating across Europe, our products are built by fast-moving, talented, “roll-up-your-sleeves-and-make-it-happen” kind of people. It’s these diverse perspectives and innovative minds operating as ONE TEAM that keep Bitpanda at the cutting edge of our industry. So if you’re someone who thinks big, moves fast and wants to make an impact right from day one, then get ready to join our industry-changing team. Let’s go!

Your mission

As an Information Security Senior Specialist, you will lead and scale major elements of our security governance in a regulated fintech environment. You’ll own complex, cross-functional GRC domains (e.g., ISMS/ISO 27001 at scale, regulatory readiness, enterprise technology risk, third-party risk for critical vendors, compliance in key partnerships), drive measurable improvement in control effectiveness, and act as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders.

What you’ll do 

  • Information Security Operating Model & GRC Ownership: Own and evolve one or more GRC domains end-to-end (e.g., ISMS operations, BCM, risk governance), including strategy, annual plan, cadences, and success metrics. Drive control rationalization and proportionality: tighten controls for critical/regulated assets and streamline low-risk areas to ensure an efficient, risk-aligned posture.

  • Risk Management & Strategic Decision Support: Facilitate and challenge high-impact risk assessments (new products, major architectural changes, critical vendors), ensuring consistency and defensible rationale. Drive risk treatment at scale: align owners, negotiate timelines, track commitments, and escalate where residual risk remains above appetite.

  • Audit, Assurance & Continuous Control Testing: Lead complex audits and assessments end-to-end (multi-entity, regulator-facing), including readiness, walkthroughs, and remediation. Design and run a risk-based control testing program to identify weaknesses and drive durable remediation (process fixes, automation, tooling) while translating regulatory requirements into structured internal work programs.

  • Enablement & Leadership through Others: Mentor Specialists, Associates, and Senior Associates; set quality standards for documentation, evidence, and stakeholder engagement. Act as a “GRC translator” for engineering and operations teams, helping them implement requirements efficiently and consistently across the organization.

Who you are

  • Strong working knowledge of ISO 27001 and DORA (and/or SOC 2 / PCI DSS / NIST) with ability to design controls, define evidence, and test effectiveness.
  • Strong understanding of technology risk across cloud, IAM, SDLC governance, incident management, vulnerability management, logging/monitoring, and third-party risk.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication; able to produce executive-ready materials and auditor-facing narratives.

What’s in it for you

  • Flexibility to work where you thrive – Enjoy the freedom of our Hybrid working model, combining onsite collaboration and remote work, with an additional 25 days per year to work from a city or country of your choice.
  • Reward for your impact – Receive a competitive total compensation package aligned with Bitpanda’s pay-for-impact policy, including participation in our stock option plan.

  • Time to recharge – On top of your standard annual leave, prioritise your wellbeing in 2027 with 3 additional days of paid time off to rest, reset, and recharge, available once you’ve been with us for 6 months.
  • Continuous learning and growth – Grow your skills and stay ahead in your career with unlimited access to Udemy’s library of online courses at your own pace.

title: Senior Systems Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Fractile

Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts.

 

The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. The defining work of the 21st century will be marked by the engine of inference delivering immense and diffuse chains of intellectual inquiry, in drug discovery, in software engineering, in materials discovery, in any field where progress is driven by deep reasoning and intelligence to resolve complex problems.

The Role

We build the control chain that powers on, monitors, updates, and protects devices and racks across bare metal, RTOS, and embedded Linux. It’s production-critical software that keeps racks stable, updates safe, and hardware secure. It’s a critical layer in turning a tokens per second benchmark into a tokens per month system, turning great silicon into reliable output at rack scale.

You’ll be there for the first racks coming to life and rollout days where update safety matters. Your work makes the difference between a bad failure and a clean recovery path. This is the work that makes the system something operators can trust.

What you’ll do

  • Develop firmware and services for management controllers at every level: rack management, BMC, and board/device controllers (RTOS and bare metal)

  • Build systems software for board and rack management, from early bring-up through to production deployment

  • Implement the critical flows that keep fleets healthy: power-on and provisioning, monitoring/telemetry, updates, recovery, and security

  • Integrate with the wider host/device stack (drivers and runtime libraries) so the system works end-to-end

  • Work closely with hardware and device software teams to define reliable interfaces, validate behaviour, and debug boundary issues

What we’re looking for

  • Proven experience shipping production-critical, reliable embedded systems across two or more of: bare metal, RTOS, embedded Linux (or deep expertise in one with clear ability to ramp the others)

  • Strong C and/or Rust, and excellent engineering judgement around safety, testing, debugging, and failure modes

  • A reliability-first mindset: you design for observability, diagnosability, and recovery paths that are predictable and testable

  • Comfortable working close to the hardware/software boundary (bootloaders/BSP/kernel-adjacent work) and collaborating tightly with HW, driver, and runtime teams

title: Signal Processing Engineer (RF Processing & Analytics)
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

As Signal Processing Engineer within RF Processing & Analytics, you own the algorithms that turn raw electromagnetic intercepts into an actionable picture of the RF environment — detecting, characterizing, and identifying the emitters around our platforms in contested environments. You work across the signals captured by our Radar, Radio, and Electronic Warfare modules, building the classification and analytics layer that turns isolated detections into a real-time electronic order of battle for operators and downstream autonomy.

Responsibilities

  • Signal Detection & Characterization: Build algorithms to detect, deinterleave, and extract parameters (PRI, pulse width, frequency, modulation) from intercepted RF emissions.

  • Emitter Classification & Identification: Develop classification pipelines — combining feature-based methods and machine learning — to identify emitter types and match them against threat libraries.

  • Electronic Order of Battle: Design the analytics that turn individual detections into a coherent, real-time picture of emitters, tracks, and threat posture.

  • AI-Assisted Analytics: Apply machine learning to modulation recognition, anomaly detection, and emitter fingerprinting where it improves classification confidence in dense, contested spectrum.

  • Cross-Module Data Fusion: Work with signals captured by Radar, Radio, and Electronic Warfare to build a unified processing pipeline rather than siloed, single-sensor analysis.

  • Real-Time Pipeline Engineering: Take algorithms from offline prototyping (MATLAB/Python) to real-time or near-real-time implementation, alongside software and embedded/FPGA engineers.

  • Field Validation: Validate detection and classification performance against simulated and real-world RF datasets, in lab and field-test conditions.

Candidate Requirements

  • Master's or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Signal Processing, Applied Mathematics, or a related field.

  • 3-6 years of experience in RF/radar signal processing, ideally with exposure to ELINT, ESM, or SIGINT applications.

  • Strong fundamentals in DSP: spectral analysis, filtering, multi-rate processing, statistical/adaptive signal processing.

  • Proficiency in Python and/or MATLAB for algorithm prototyping; working knowledge of C/C++ for production-oriented implementation.

  • Comfortable applying machine learning to signal classification problems.

  • Clear communicator, able to work across RF hardware, software, and data science disciplines.

  • Fluency in English required; French is a plus.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

C’est pour cette raison que ton quotidien ne se limite pas aux projets clients : chaque Theodoer contribue à rendre l’entreprise meilleure en développant de nouvelles connaissances pour tous, qu’il partage via des conférences en interne et en externe, des articles de blog, des groupes d’expertises avec d’autres passionnés au sein de Theodo France… Exemple de projets : Les problématiques et les technos sont très différentes d’un projet à l’autre, voici quelques exemples :
  • La plateforme Altitude développée en 6 mois pour AXA Climate permettant aux sociétés de gestion d'évaluer en moins de 10 min les risques liés au climat, à la transition carbone et à la biodiversité. Par exemple, Altitude est capable d’identifier des risques de montée des eaux et d’érosion côtière des bâtiments grâce à son algorithme et aux bases de données scientifiques d’AXA Climate. Toute la code base est en typescript, avec du React en frontend et du Serverless en backend.
  • L’application Cargo Readiness développée pour CMA CGM centralise la vérification de la conformité des containers avant onboarding (poids, documentation, normes). Auparavant dispersé entre plusieurs outils, ce suivi générait erreurs et retards. La nouvelle solution a permis de réduire de 90 % les annulations de dernière minute (<2 jours avant départ) et d’améliorer la fluidité logistique. L'application, en React, a été livrée en 4 mois, sur une API Rest en Spring Boot ingérant et consolidant des événements venant d'un broker centralisé. Dans un second temps l'IA de Mistral AI est venu se brancher à notre API pour améliorer l'expérience utilisateur.
Ton parcours de progression : Notre ambition est de former les leaders de la tech de demain. Grâce au coaching et formations que l’on propose, tu pourras :
  • Devenir un expert en développement en étant formé aux meilleurs standards de qualité
  • Développer des compétences transverses : coaching, recrutement, commercial, management et marketing technique
  • Participer à des groupes d’expertises avec d’autres passionnés (Cybersécurité, Serverless, Performance, GreenIT…)
  • Construire ton parcours sur-mesure pour atteindre tes objectifs : tech lead, senior architecte, CTO ou fondateur d’une entité..
Profil recherché : Pas besoin d’être déjà expert en développement : ce qu’on cherche, c’est ton potentiel !
  • Tu es étudiant en école d’ingénieur et tu cherches un stage de fin d’étude de 4 à 6 mois

title: Software Engineer I (New Grad)
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Are you a recent or upcoming graduate ready to launch your career at the forefront of industrial IoT? Join us and help shape the future of connected operations. You will immediately dive into challenging, real-world projects with the freedom and responsibility of a full-time engineer. We believe in providing a greenfield opportunity for growth and a high degree of ownership from day one. You will build and innovate, making a tangible impact on our global customers. You'll also have access to the latest AI tools, with generous token allotments, giving you the leverage to ship more and learn faster.

At Samsara, New Grads can work on a wide range of high-impact engineering challenges across our connected operations platform. Depending on the team, a New Grad may help build the backend infrastructure that powers our IoT platform, scaling data ingestion and storage systems that support over 15,000 hardware assets and tens of thousands of customers around the world. They may also work across the full stack, creating intuitive user experiences that turn data from millions of devices into actionable insights, while partnering closely with product and design to rapidly iterate on features that deliver real customer value.

On the mobile side, a New Grad could help strengthen the infrastructure behind our React Native app, enabling feature teams to move quickly and build performant, maintainable products. For those focused on embedded software, projects may include building and maintaining software that runs directly on Samsara hardware, spanning areas like edge AI, multimedia frameworks, power management, and real-time data processing in demanding real-world environments.

Throughout the interview process, we will dig into your past experience, what you are most interested in learning next, and where you would be the best fit across our engineering teams.

Our engineering teams use Golang for backend development, TypeScript and React for the web client, GraphQL for data access, and React Native for mobile development. Direct experience with this exact stack is not required, but experience with similar technologies is strongly encouraged.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world. The software you build will help keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and - most importantly - ensure workers return home safely.
  • You believe customers are more than a number. Our engineers are deeply invested in our customers and the daily problems they face. They visit customers in person to understand not just how Samsara helps them today, but where our products need to go next. You'll participate in customer interviews, collaborate with success and product teams, and use metrics to ensure your work translates into real outcomes.
  • You're curious and self-driven. You challenge yourself outside of class - hackathons, side projects, tearing apart how something works just because you want to understand it. You move fast, embrace new technology, and treat learning as constant.
  • You're drawn to hard problems and own them end to end. You dig into complexity, research it thoroughly, and find the simplest solution that works - then see it through, holding yourself to a high standard along the way.
  • You're AI-forward. You've woven AI into how you work, whether that's accelerating debugging, drafting code, or exploring unfamiliar problem spaces faster. You're quick to experiment and always looking for smarter ways to build.
  • You're a collaborator. You work well independently and across cross-functional teams, and you're motivated by winning together, not just individually.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • Current Senior pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related technical field, with an expected graduation date in 2027.
  • This is a full-time, remote OR in-person hybrid role requiring 3 days per week in our London, UK office and 2 days working remotely.

Applications will close October 30th at 6:00pm (UK)

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

title: Software Engineer (Mobile) - London
descriptionHtml:
ABOUT US

Teton is redefining the role of healthcare workers through cutting-edge AI technology and a great product experience. As populations grow older and staff shortages increase, healthcare systems are under pressure. Our mission is to decrease the cost of healthcare while improving the quality of care.

Our product enables care teams to intervene, prevent and operate more efficiently. Our ambient sensors in resident rooms capture activity, sleep, respiration, gait and more. These signals are used both to react fast to risk events, like falls, and for long-term health analysis, so care teams can take action.

Teton is scaling fast, operating in the Nordics, the UK, DACH and the US. We recently raised a $20M Series A. You can expect travel to the US to meet users and team members.

We focus relentlessly on product excellence and user experience, deploying solutions at speed that make a tangible difference for carers. We are an aspiring meritocracy, biased towards action and always striving to raise the bar. If you are driven by impact, speed and levelling up, this might be the place for you.

The position is onsite at our office in London, United Kingdom. If you are looking for a 9-to-5 job, perform best with structure and struggle to deal with unknowns, this is not for you. We believe close collaboration within a hard-working, high-agency team enables the fastest and most efficient iteration cycles, helping us build an impactful product that healthcare professionals truly love to use.

THE JOB

We're looking for a talented and driven Software Engineer to join our Mobile team, building the tools that care workers rely on during every shift. Our app runs 24/7 in care facilities, delivering real-time alerts and monitoring residents. This isn't a typical app dev role. You'll work across the full stack, from React Native UI to backend infrastructure, in an environment where reliability directly impacts patient safety.

In this role, you will focus on:

  • Feature Development: Own features end-to-end, from design discussions through implementation to production rollout across multiple markets and languages.

  • Reliability & Debugging: Keep our real-time alert pipeline rock-solid. Debug push notification delivery on Android and iOS, investigate ANR issues, and troubleshoot weird bugs in care environments with unreliable Wi-Fi.

  • Backend, Infrastructure & Systems: Work across backend services, databases, cloud infrastructure and internal platforms to support the systems our app depends on. You will not just consume APIs; you will help shape, improve and fix the systems behind them.

  • Testing & Validation: Build automated test coverage (e.g. Maestro for E2E) across a range of devices and OS versions. Validate that alerts arrive when they must.

  • Developer Experience: Improve shared components, internal tooling and build pipelines so the team ships faster with fewer surprises.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Strong TypeScript skills. This is the language for everything we build.

  • Solid experience with React Native and Expo in production.

  • Comfortable working across the stack: you've touched databases, queues or cloud infrastructure, not just UI.

  • Experience with native iOS or Android development (Kotlin/Swift) is a strong plus, as we occasionally need to go below the managed Expo layer.

  • Familiarity with real-time systems, push notifications or TanStack is a plus.

  • AWS or equivalent cloud platform experience.

  • Previous startup experience and/or shipping a product where you owned the outcome.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work both independently and in a team.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Participation in our warrant program (stock options).

  • A small team where your decisions directly shape the product.

  • A London-based office with close collaboration, no async-only culture.

  • Work on software that healthcare workers depend on every day. The impact is tangible and immediate.

JOIN OUR TEAM

We're looking for individuals who share our vision and value ownership and entrepreneurship over a conventional job.

At Teton, you'll have the chance to make a real impact with your work.

If you're ready for more than just a job, come aboard and be part of our mission to transform healthcare.

title: Software Engineer Node/React - CDI Paris - Theodo Extend
descriptionHtml:
L'histoire du groupe et de son succès Theodo accompagne depuis 2009 les entreprises innovantes dans la conception, le développement et le déploiement de produits digitaux ingénieux - tels que la plateforme TF1+, l'application LCL Pro ou l'application France Identité Numérique - en tirant parti du meilleur de la technologie et de l’approche Lean. Theodo connait une croissance exceptionnelle depuis 15 ans : nos équipes rassemblent plus de 750 Theodoers, principalement des Software Engineers, passionnés de technologie et d’amélioration continue. En 2025, le groupe Theodo génère 100M€ de CA. Tu rejoins Theodo Extend, la nouvelle entité du groupe Theodo, pensée pour répondre à une réalité terrain : de plus en plus de clients souhaitent garder la main sur la gestion produit tout en intégrant des développeurs de haut niveau dans leurs équipes. En 2024, nous avons collaboré avec plus de 100 clients, dont Carrefour, Dior ou Yves Saint Laurent, 63 experts mobilisés sur ces missions
Ta mission : En tant que Software Engineer chez Theodo Extend, tu es intégré à 100 % dans une équipe client, mais tu n’es jamais seul. Tu restes pleinement connecté à notre communauté d’ingénieurs passionnés, tu es formé aux meilleures pratiques, et tu bénéficies d’un accompagnement continu. Tu travailleras par exemple sur : - La reprise d’une base de code existante pour en assurer la fiabilité, la maintenabilité et la scalabilité via une migration complète vers une stack moderne - La mise en production d’une V1 en quelques semaines, dans des contextes de forte contrainte, en maîtrisant l'ensemble du cycle : conception, dev, QA, mise en prod. - Le développement d’interfaces complexes en React / Next.js, tout en intégrant les contraintes UX/UI issues d’une refonte de marque ou d’objectifs business - Le fait de pouvoir travailler en autonomie partielle ou complète, en interaction directe avec les équipes produit/métier du client, notamment quand aucune expertise technique interne n’est disponible. Refonte d’une application critique pour IRIS Capital - Pour IRIS, fonds de capital-risque, nous avons réécrit une application stratégique de Ruby vers Python, afin de fiabiliser la détection de startups à fort potentiel. - Au programme : nettoyage d’une base de données divisée par 150, création d’une extension Chrome en Vue 3, et mise en place d’une nouvelle API pour fluidifier la communication avec les investisseurs. - Objectif : rendre l’outil plus rapide, plus fiable et automatisé, avec un impact direct sur les décisions d’investissement. title: Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

About the role

At blp, we create cutting-edge products for automated document processing. We have dedicated engineering teams for each product. The teams fully own their product, that means we understand the business problem that our product solves and own the roadmap how the product evolves.

We have a strong sense of end-to-end ownership and a desire to have direct impact by solving real world problems. As a team, we also strive to own and shape how we work together and how we grow, both as individuals and as a team.

 

What you'll do

  • Lead and Influence: Guide technical direction for major initiatives, shape how the product evolves and mentor team members along the way.

  • Promote Innovation and Collaboration: Work closely with colleagues, share what you learn openly, and continuously improve processes, tools, and team practices.

  • The Tech Stack for this role includes Golang, MySQL, Docker images deployed on a Kubernetes cluster in our cloud infrastructure (GCS, AWS or Azure) and Github CI/CD.

 

What you'll bring

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.

  • 3+ years of experience in a software engineering role.

  • Passionate about software craftsmanship: Strong understanding of software development principles, Clean Code and Clean Architecture.

  • Product thinking: Ability to translate business problems into precise requirements, specifications and ultimately into code.

  • Entrepreneurial mindset: link your daily work to team and company goals, balance cost and benefit, deliver high-quality solutions efficiently.

  • Ownership: take responsibility for your technical work, for the product we build and the team we shape.

  • Team-oriented: proactively support team goals, close gaps.

  • Abstraction and efficient communication: simplify complex systems, identify core concepts, communicate complex ideas to different stakeholders.

 

What you'll get

  • Full ownership. You own the product's roadmap, from business problem to shipped code.

  • End-to-end impact. You're on a team that owns what it builds, start to finish.

  • A modern, varied tech stack. Continuous learning as the platform scales.

title: Solution Architect AI-Modernisation - CDI Paris - Theodo
descriptionHtml:
L’histoire du groupe Theodo et son succès Theodo accompagne depuis 2009 les entreprises innovantes dans la conception, le développement et le déploiement de produits digitaux ingénieux - tels que la plateforme TF1+, l'application LCL Pro ou l'application France Identité Numérique - en tirant parti du meilleur de la technologie et de l’approche Lean. Theodo connait une croissance exceptionnelle depuis 15 ans : nos équipes rassemblent plus de 750 Theodoers, principalement des Software Engineers, passionnés de technologie et d’amélioration continue. En 2025, le groupe Theodo génère 100M€ de CA. Aujourd’hui, l’ambition du groupe est de se positionner comme le leader de l’IA appliquée au développement logiciel, c’est pourquoi nous avons lancé la practice AI Modernisation. Au sein de cette practice, nous accompagnons nos clients dans la modernisation de leurs systèmes legacy. Grâce à une IA maîtrisée et une méthode éprouvée, nous allons 3 fois plus vite sur le delivery de ces projets critiques.
La practice accompagne principalement des scale-ups comme Qonto ou Doctolib et des grands groupes comme Carrefour, Pernod Ricard, Les Mousquetaires, Urgo, Cdiscount ou Edenred. Si tu veux rejoindre le futur de la tech, tu es au bon endroit !

Si tu veux rejoindre le futur de la tech, tu es au bon endroit.

Tes futures missions

En tant que Solution Architect AI Modernisation, tu es le binôme technique des sales sur les cycles de vente complexes. Ta mission : concevoir des stratégies de migration ingénieuses qui rassurent autant la DSI que les métiers, et gagner les deals grâce à ta légitimité technique et ta posture de partenaire stratégique.

Qualification technique et relation avec les référents client

  • Qualifier techniquement les leads entrants : volume de code, dépendances, contraintes de conformité, maturité IA interne du client
  • Mener les échanges avec les DSI, RSSI, CTO et architectes en créant de la confiance par ta compétence et ton assertivité
  • Identifier les préférences client structurantes : sécurité, performance, stack cible, contraintes sur l'existant, LLM autorisés (Claude Code, modèles on-prem…)

Conception de la solution technique

  • Concevoir une stratégie de migration ingénieuse : trajectoire incrémentale (strangler pattern, isolation du risque), choix de la stack cible, intégration des outils d'AI coding pour accélérer la compréhension du code et la transpilation
  • Produire les livrables différenciants : schémas d'architecture, ADR, POC à montrer au prospect pour closer
  • Faire de la veille sur les patterns de modernisation, les LLM et les outils d'AI coding à l'état de l'art

Estimation et défense de la proposition

  • Estimer en fonction de la complexité technique et du budget client, en identifiant les zones de risque et de complexité
  • Soutenir la proposition face à un client métier et une DSI exigeante, en justifiant la valeur par le coût de l'inaction, le time-to-market et la sécurisation du CA

Passage en delivery

  • Aider l'équipe commerciale à prévoir le delivery en définissant les équipes à staffer
  • Assurer la passation aux équipes de delivery au démarrage des projets et le SAV technique

Quelques exemples de projets sur lesquels tu pourrais intervenir :

Migration de Loopback2 vers Nest pour upgrade de Node 10 vers Node 20. Grâce à notre méthode accélérée par l'IA, nous passons d'une estimation à 70 semaines sans IA à une migration terminée en 21 semaines, et nous accélérons la vitesse de delivery par 3.
  • Pernod Ricard : modernisation d'une application interne de gestion de campagnes marketing avec des millions d'euros en jeu. En 23 semaines, migration complète de Vue/Express vers React/Nest avec une réécriture pragmatique, et connexion à leur nouvel ERP, auparavant impossible sans la migration.

Tes perspectives d'évolution

L'AI coding est en train de tout changer dans la façon de construire du logiciel. En nous rejoignant, tu es au cœur de cette bascule : tu vois les outils évoluer mois après mois, tu travailles avec ceux qui définissent les nouvelles pratiques, et dans 2 ans tu sauras faire des choses que la plupart des devs découvriront à peine.

Notre Lean Tech® System met l’accent sur l’apprentissage continu : tu évolueras dans un environnement qui investit sur le long terme, où l’objectif est de te permettre de progresser chaque jour, tout en construisant des produits utiles et performants pour nos clients.

Profil recherché :

Mit einer erfolgreichen Lokalisierungsstrategie und Präsenz in über 80 Ländern verfolgt das Unternehmen das klare Ziel, die weltweit führende Marke der Branche zu werden und durch sichere, zuverlässige Technologien aktiv eine grüne Zukunft mitzugestalten.

Aufgaben

  • Leitung und Weiterentwicklung des technischen Supports für die DACH-Region (Deutschland, Österreich und Schweiz), einschließlich der Festlegung von Prioritäten, Servicestandards und Arbeitsabläufen für das regionale Supportteam.

  • Führung, Coaching und Unterstützung der technischen Supportingenieure, einschließlich Aufgabenverteilung, Kompetenzentwicklung, Leistungsfeedback und technischer Schulungen.

  • Verantwortung für das Eskalationsmanagement bei komplexen Kunden- und Produktproblemen sowie Sicherstellung einer zeitnahen Ursachenanalyse, klaren Kommunikation und wirksamen Problemlösung.

  • Definition und Überwachung von Service-KPIs, Reaktionszeiten und Problemtrends sowie datenbasierte Verbesserung der Kundenzufriedenheit, Teameffizienz und Supportqualität.

  • Technische Unterstützung auf Expertenniveau im Pre- und After-Sales für Vertriebsmanager, Distributoren, Installateure, EPC-Unternehmen und Schlüsselkunden, einschließlich Produktauswahl, Systemkonfiguration, Installation, Inbetriebnahme und Fehlerbehebung.

  • Aufbau und Pflege enger technischer Kundenbeziehungen durch regelmäßige Besprechungen, Vor-Ort-Besuche und Projektunterstützung.

  • Planung und Durchführung von Produkteinführungen, technischen Schulungen, Webinaren, Workshops und Kundenveranstaltungen in der DACH-Region.

  • Erfassung und Weitergabe von Kundenanforderungen, Marktfeedback und wiederkehrenden technischen Problemen an das Produktmanagement und die Forschung und Entwicklung sowie Nachverfolgung der daraus abgeleiteten Maßnahmen.

  • Koordination lokaler Produkttests und Validierungen, einschließlich Firmware-, Software-, Kompatibilitäts- und Systemintegrationstests.

  • Entwicklung und Pflege von technischen Supportprozessen, Wissensdatenbanken, Handbüchern, FAQs, Leitfäden zur Fehlerbehebung und Schulungsunterlagen.

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Vertrieb, Produktmanagement, Service sowie Forschung und Entwicklung zur Sicherstellung einheitlicher technischer Lösungen und kontinuierlicher Verbesserungen.

Anforderungen

  • Abgeschlossenes Bachelorstudium oder höherer Abschluss in Elektrotechnik, Elektronik, erneuerbaren Energien, Automatisierungstechnik oder einem verwandten technischen Fachgebiet.

  • Fundierte Erfahrung im technischen Support, im technischen Außendienst, in der Anwendungstechnik oder im technischen Pre-Sales, idealerweise in den Bereichen Photovoltaik, Wechselrichter, Batteriespeicher oder erneuerbare Energiesysteme.

  • Erfahrung in der Führung, im Coaching oder in der Koordination eines technischen Support- oder Serviceteams.

  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in den Bereichen Photovoltaikanlagen, Wechselrichter, Batterien, elektrische Systeme, Kommunikationssysteme und Inbetriebnahme.

  • Nachgewiesene Fähigkeit, Eskalationen zu steuern, mehrere Fälle zu priorisieren und Probleme bis zur vollständigen Lösung zu verfolgen.

  • Ausgeprägte Fähigkeiten in der Fehlerdiagnose, Ursachenanalyse und Problemlösung.

  • Kundenorientierter Führungsstil sowie ausgeprägte Fähigkeiten im Stakeholdermanagement und in der bereichsübergreifenden Zusammenarbeit.

  • Souveräne Kommunikation mit Installateuren, Distributoren, EPC-Unternehmen und Geschäftskunden sowohl auf technischer als auch auf Managementebene.

  • Bereitschaft zu Dienstreisen innerhalb der DACH-Region sowie gelegentlich innerhalb Europas.

  • Fließende Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse sind erforderlich. Chinesischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil.
